<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_s">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_s_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृष्णि</span> <i>pṛṣṇi</i> <a href="#entry-p_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du prince <a href="#entry-yaadava" class="skt-link">yādava</a> Pṛṣṇi ou Pṛśni, descendant de <a href="#entry-Uv_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">Vṛṣṇi</a>; <a href="#entry-Uzvaphalka" class="skt-link">Śvaphalka</a> est son fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृष्ट</span> <i>pṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praz" class="skt-link">praś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣṭā</i> demandé; interrogé, questionné; prié d'accorder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> désiré — <a href="#entry-p_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> demande, requête.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृष्ठ</span> <i>pṛṣṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">prastha</a>] <a href="#entry-p_r_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«ce qui est prééminent»] dos; plate-forme, terrasse; revers — loc. <i>pṛṣṭhe</i> adv. derrière, de derrière — <a href="#entry-p_r_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣṭhā</i> ifc. derrière.<br> <i>pṛṣṭhena</i> <i>vah</i> porter sur le dos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_s_thatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛṣṭhatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. par derrière; secrètement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de dos; opp. <a href="#entry-ja_thare_na" class="skt-link">jaṭhareṇa</a>.<br> <i>pṛṣṭhataḥ</i> <i>kṛ</i> tourner le dos à, renoncer à ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>pṛṣṭhato</i> <i>gam</i> suivre ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>pṛṣṭhato</i> <i>bhū</i> être en arrière; ne pas être considéré.<br> <a href="#entry-p_r_s_tha" class="skt-link">pṛṣṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_sadazva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛṣadaśva</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_r_sadazva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sadazva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sadazvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣadaśvā</i> antilope <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [«qui chevauche une antilope»] se dit des vents [<a href="#entry-marutas" class="skt-link">marutas</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_sat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृषत्</span> <i>pṛṣat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-p_r_s" class="skt-link">pṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_r_sat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_satii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣatī</i> qui asperge <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tacheté; bigarré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> animal tacheté; not. antilope; syn. <a href="#entry-p_r_sata" class="skt-link">pṛṣata</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. se dit des animaux montés par les vents [<a href="#entry-marutas" class="skt-link">marutas</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pṛṣantas</i> gouttes d'eau; aspersion.<br> <i>pṛṣatām</i> <i>pati</i> m. [«maître de la pluie»] vent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_sata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृषत</span> <i>pṛṣata</i> [<a href="#entry-p_r_sat" class="skt-link">pṛṣat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_r_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_satii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣatī</i> tacheté, tavelé — <a href="#entry-p_r_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. antilope tachetée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> goutte d'eau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Pṛṣata «(au visage) tavelé»; <a href="#entry-Ubharadvaaja" class="skt-link">Bharadvāja</a> était son ami; il répandit sa semence à la vue de la nymphe <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a> et donna ainsi naissance au roi <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_sodara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛṣodara</i> [<a href="#entry-udara" class="skt-link">udara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_r_sodara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sodara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_r_sodaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛṣodarā</i> au ventre tacheté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [générique] se dit de composés dont la formation est irrégulière (comme <a href="#entry-p_r_sodara" class="skt-link">pṛṣodara</a>, qui fait l'élision du ‘<i>t</i>’).<br> <a href="#entry-p_r_sat" class="skt-link">pṛṣat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_r_1">

    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृ</span> <i>pṛ_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(piparti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pṛṇāti)</i> sauver, secourir; escorter; amener à ⟨acc.⟩; délivrer de ⟨abl.⟩; protéger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> surpasser; traverser — ca. <i>(pārayati)</i> faire traverser; secourir, protéger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> résister à, se mesurer à; surmonter, prévaloir sur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. περαω; lat. <i>experior</i>; all. fahren; ang. fare.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पॄ</span> <i>pṝ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pṛṇāti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(pṛṇati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(piparti)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(apārīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pūrṇa</i>, <i>pūrta</i><i>)</i> inf. <i>(pūritum)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> combler, remplir, satisfaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> compléter; souffler dans (not. conque); tendre (arc) — ca. <i>(pārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pārita</i><i>)</i> remplir, accomplir (un vœu) — ca. <i>(pūrayati)</i> ca. md. <i>(pūrayate)</i> remplir ⟨acc.⟩ (de ⟨i.⟩), satisfaire, enrichir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> remplir de bruit, souffler dans (not. conque); tendre (arc) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> compléter (une phrase); couvrir complètement, encercler — dés. <i>(pupūrṣati)</i> désirer remplir — ps. <i>(pāryate)</i> ps. <i>(pūryate)</i> être rempli, être comblé (de ⟨i.⟩); être satisfait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>plenus</i>, <i>impleo</i>; ang. full; all. voll; fr. plein.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>ya</i> <i>etam</i> <i>evam</i> <i>upāste</i> <i>pūryate</i> <i>prajayā</i> <i>paśubhiḥ</i> [SB.] Ceux qui l'honorent ainsi sont comblés de progéniture et de troupeaux.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृथ</span> <i>pṛtha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-p_rth" class="skt-link">pṛth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_rtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rtha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛthā</i> large — <a href="#entry-p_rtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> paume de la main <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> empan (mesure de longueur, du bout du majeur au poignet, égal à 13 pouces [<a href="#entry-afgula" class="skt-link">aṅgula</a>], environ 25 cm) — <a href="#entry-p_rthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛthā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pṛthā «la Large», fille du prince <a href="#entry-yaadava" class="skt-link">yādava</a> <a href="#entry-Uzuura" class="skt-link">Śūra</a>, qui la donna comme fille adoptive à son cousin <a href="#entry-Ukunti" class="skt-link">Kunti</a>, d'où son autre nom de <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a>; le sage <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a> lui donna une incantation [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] par laquelle elle pouvait se faire féconder par un dieu; elle essaya le charme en invoquant <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, qui lui donna son fils <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>, et lui rendit sa virginité; plus tard, 1⟨sup⟩re⟨/sup⟩ épouse du roi <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a>, qui ne pouvait procréer sans mourir, elle enfanta de <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> avec <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a>, de <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> avec <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a>, et d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> avec <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthagjana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthagjana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthagjana" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme du commun, quidam; homme de basse extraction, rustre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pṛthagjanās</i> la plèbe, la multitude.<br> <a href="#entry-p_rthak" class="skt-link">pṛthak</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृथक्</span> <i>pṛthak</i> [<a href="#entry-p_rth" class="skt-link">pṛth</a>] adv. séparément, différemment, particulièrement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> individuellement, un par un; pour chacun.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthaktva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthaktva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthaktva" class="skt-link">n.</a> singularité, particularité, individualité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] de l'individualité.<br> <i>pṛthaktvena</i> adv. un par un.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthivii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृथिवी</span> <i>pṛthivī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">pṛthu</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">f.</a> sol, terre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la Terre, l'une des 9 substances [<a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a>] du <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>, l'un des 5 éléments [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] du <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>; son <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">pañcabhūtasthala</a> est <a href="#entry-Uekaamrezvara" class="skt-link">Ekāmreśvara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pṛthivī «l'Immense», la Terre personnifiée; elle est l'épouse de <a href="#entry-Udyau" class="skt-link">Dyau</a> [<a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>] ou de <a href="#entry-Up_rthu" class="skt-link">Pṛthu</a> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>].<br> <i>pṛthivīṃ</i> <i>gam</i> se prosterner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthiviipaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthivīpāla</i> [<a href="#entry-paala" class="skt-link">pāla</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthiviipaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«gardien de la Terre»] roi.<br> <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthiviipati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthivīpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthiviipati" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«maître de la Terre»] roi.<br> <i>na</i> <i>aviṣṇuḥ</i> <i>pṛthivīpatiḥ</i> Qui n'est pas <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> ne peut être roi.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृथु</span> <i>pṛthu</i> [<a href="#entry-p_rth" class="skt-link">pṛth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rthvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛthvī</i> large, vaste, étendu, ample, immense — <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du bon roi Pṛthu «l'Immense», incarnation mineure de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, créé par barratage de la bonne partie de <a href="#entry-Uvena" class="skt-link">Vena</a>; en inventant l'agriculture, il trait la Vache-Terre <a href="#entry-Uzabalaa" class="skt-link">Śabalā</a> de ses richesses à l'âge d'or [<a href="#entry-satyayuga" class="skt-link">satyayuga</a>]; c'est l'Homme primordial de l'ère d'avant <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>, et le créateur de l'investiture royale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Pṛthu_1, fils d'<a href="#entry-Uanara_nya_1" class="skt-link">Anaraṇya_1</a> père de <a href="#entry-Utrizafku" class="skt-link">Triśaṅku</a> — f. cf. <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a> — f. cf. <a href="#entry-p_rthvii" class="skt-link">pṛthvī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πλατυς; lat. <i>planus</i>; fr. plat, plaine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthula</i> [<a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_rthula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rthula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rthulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pṛthulā</i> large; grand.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthulaazva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthulāśva</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthulaazva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Pṛthulāśva «au Grand cheval», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uanenaa" class="skt-link">Anenā</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; il est père de <a href="#entry-Uprasenajit" class="skt-link">Prasenajit</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">pṛthu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthvii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृथ्वी</span> <i>pṛthvī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-p_rthu" class="skt-link">pṛthu</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Pṛthvī la Terre; cf. <a href="#entry-Up_rthivii" class="skt-link">Pṛthivī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthviibhaaranaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthvībhāranāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaara" class="skt-link">bhāra</a>-<a href="#entry-naaza" class="skt-link">nāśa</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthviibhaaranaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> «qui enlève le fardeau de la Terre», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthviidhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthvīdhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaara_1" class="skt-link">dhāra_1</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthviidhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pṛthvīdhāra, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a> «qui porte la Terre»; cf. <a href="#entry-vaastupuru_sa" class="skt-link">vāstupuruṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthviiraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthvīrāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthviiraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Pṛthvirāja III, dernier roi <i>rājput</i> de la dynastie <a href="#entry-caahuvaa_na" class="skt-link">cāhuvāṇa</a>; selon le <a href="#entry-Up_rthviraajarasa" class="skt-link">Pṛthvirājarasa</a>, il épousa la fille du roi de <a href="#entry-Ukanyaakubja" class="skt-link">Kanyākubja</a> en l'enlevant lors d'un <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a> auquel il n'était pas convié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rthviiraajarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛthvīrājarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rthviiraajarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pṛthvirājarasa, poème épique en <a href="#entry-brajabhaa_saa" class="skt-link">brajabhāṣā</a> du barde Canda Bardai, à la gloire du roi <a href="#entry-Up_rthviraaja" class="skt-link">Pṛthvirāja</a> III.<br> <a href="#entry-p_rthviiraaja" class="skt-link">pṛthvīrāja</a> <br> <a href="#entry-p_rthvii" class="skt-link">pṛthvī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rzni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पृश्नि</span> <i>pṛśni</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-p_r_sat" class="skt-link">pṛṣat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-p_rzni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rzni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-p_rzni" class="skt-link">f.</a> varié, tacheté, bigarré (not. vaches, serpents, grenouilles, etc.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. multiples <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'une famille de sages [<a href="#entry-_r_s" class="skt-link">ṛṣ</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. cf. <a href="#entry-Up_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">Pṛṣṇi</a> — <a href="#entry-p_rzni" class="skt-link">f.</a> vache tachetée; (au fig.) la Terre, le Ciel étoilé ou nuageux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-p_rznipar_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pṛśniparṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-par_nii" class="skt-link">parṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-p_rznipar_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Desmodium gangeticum</i>, arbuste de la famille des papilionacées, aux fleurs blanches ou lilas; c'est l'une des 5 racines médicinales mineures [<a href="#entry-hrasvapa_ncamuula" class="skt-link">hrasvapañcamūla</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-p_rzni" class="skt-link">pṛśni</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प</span> <i>pa</i> nota. le nombre 1; cf. <a href="#entry-ka_tapayaadi" class="skt-link">kaṭapayādi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्</span> <i>paṇ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(paṇate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>paṇita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>paṇya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> jouer, parier qqc. ⟨g.⟩; risquer, gagner au jeu qqc. ⟨i.⟩ à qqn ⟨acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(paṇayati)</i> négocier, marchander; vendre, faire du commerce <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire des affaires (au montant de ⟨g. acc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vendo</i>; fr. vendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्ड</span> <i>paṇḍa</i> <a href="#entry-pa_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> eunuque; mauviette, impuissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>paṇḍu</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>paṇḍra</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्डा</span> <i>paṇḍā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science, connaissance, sagesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_daavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_n_daavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_daavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_daavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇḍāvatī</i> savant.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_n_daa" class="skt-link">paṇḍā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_daka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_daka" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme efféminé; homosexuel passif; syn. <a href="#entry-kliiba" class="skt-link">klība</a>, <a href="#entry-_sa_n_dha" class="skt-link">ṣaṇḍha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Paṇḍaka «Minet», un fils de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> <a href="#entry-Usaavar_na" class="skt-link">Sāvarṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_n_da" class="skt-link">paṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_dharapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्ढरपुर</span> <i>paṇḍharapura</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikapur" class="skt-link">puṇḍarīkapur</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_dita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्डित</span> <i>paṇḍita</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇḍitā</i> sage, savant, maître; lettré, érudit en textes sacrés — <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. np. de Paṇḍita, titre d'érudit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. pundit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditaraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitarāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditaraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. np. de Paṇḍitarāja, titre de «Prince des érudits»; il fut décerné not. à <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha_1" class="skt-link">Jagannātha_1</a> par Shah Jahān.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditasabhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitasabhā</i> [<a href="#entry-sabhaa" class="skt-link">sabhā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditasabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> assemblée de lettrés, débat d'érudits; conseil des sages.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditasarvasva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitasarvasva</i> [<a href="#entry-sarvasva" class="skt-link">sarvasva</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditasarvasva" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Paṇḍitasarvasva «Vademecum du lettré [<a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>]», manuel de rituels hindous selon la tradition de l'Orissa.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science, instruction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditatama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitatama</i> a. <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditatama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditatamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇḍitatamā</i> le plus instruit; très savant — <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> terme d'adresse respectueuse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_n_ditatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇḍitatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_n_ditatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> science, instruction
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण</span> <i>paṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pa_n" class="skt-link">paṇ</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> jeu, mise, pari (de ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contrat, convention, traité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enjeu; salaire, prix, récompense; richesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> poids de cuivre utilisé comme monnaie, valant 20 fèves [<a href="#entry-maa_sa" class="skt-link">māṣa</a>] — <a href="#entry-pa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇā</i> ifc. id.<br> <i>paṇaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> parier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पणन</span> <i>paṇana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pa_n" class="skt-link">paṇ</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'acheter; transaction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vente, troc, trafic (de ⟨iic.⟩).<br> <i>śatasya</i> <i>vyavaharaṇaṃpaṇanam</i> [S.K.] Transaction commerciale (ou pari au jeu) en centaines.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_naniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇanīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_naniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_naniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_naniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇanīyā</i> négociable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à laisser en gage.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_nana" class="skt-link">paṇana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पणव</span> <i>paṇava</i> <a href="#entry-pa_nava" class="skt-link">m.</a> tambour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पणि</span> <i>paṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_n" class="skt-link">paṇ</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> avare, ladre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. [RV.] classe de démons avides gardiens de trésors; il gardaient l'aurore <a href="#entry-Uu_saa" class="skt-link">Uṣā</a> prisonnière dans la caverne <a href="#entry-Uvala" class="skt-link">Vala</a>, et ses rayons étaient leurs vaches.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पण्य</span> <i>paṇya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pa_n" class="skt-link">paṇ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇyā</i> valable; à négocier — <a href="#entry-pa_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> marchandise, commodité; commerce, trafic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyabhuumi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyabhūmi</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuumi" class="skt-link">bhūmi</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyabhuumi" class="skt-link">f.</a> magasin; entrepôt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_nyabhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nyabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nyabhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṇyabhūtā</i> qui est un objet de commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyajana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand, commis de magasin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyakambala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyakambala</i> [<a href="#entry-kambala" class="skt-link">kambala</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyakambala" class="skt-link">m.</a> couverture propre à la vente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyamuulya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyamūlya</i> [<a href="#entry-muulya" class="skt-link">mūlya</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyamuulya" class="skt-link">n.</a> prix d'une marchandise.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_nya" class="skt-link">paṇya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyapati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> patron de commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyaphala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyaphala</i> [<a href="#entry-phala" class="skt-link">phala</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyaphala" class="skt-link">n.</a> bénéfice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyaphalatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyaphalatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyaphalatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> profit, prospérité.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_nyaphala" class="skt-link">paṇyaphala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṇyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> valeur marchande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(apīpaṭhat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(apaṭhīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>paṭhita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>paṭhitavya</i><i>)</i> ppft. <i>(peṭhivas)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> lire, lire à haute voix, réciter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> répéter, étudier; enseigner — pr. md. <i>(paṭhate)</i> étudier — ca. <i>(pāṭhayati)</i> faire lire; enseigner; instruire en ⟨2 acc.⟩ — int. <i>(pāpaṭhīti)</i> réciter souvent — int. md. <i>(pāpaṭhyate)</i> étudier assidûment — dés. <i>(pipaṭhiṣati)</i> vouloir étudier.
