  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_dava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाण्डव</span> <i>pāṇḍava</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">pāṇḍu</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_n_dava" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] patr. des 5 fils (adoptifs) de <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a>: les 3 fils de <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a>: le roi <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> fils d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, et <a href="#entry-Unakula" class="skt-link">Nakula</a> et <a href="#entry-Usahadeva" class="skt-link">Sahadeva</a>, fils jumeaux de <a href="#entry-Umaadrii" class="skt-link">Mādrī</a> et des <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a>; avec <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a> ils furent conviés par <a href="#entry-Uduryodhana" class="skt-link">Duryodhana</a> à un grand festival en l'honneur de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> à <a href="#entry-Uvaara_navata" class="skt-link">Vāraṇavata</a> où ils vécurent dans un palais de laque destiné à être incendié pour les faire périr; avertis du danger, il s'échappèrent par un tunnel, et partirent vivre incognito, déguisés en brâhmanes, à <a href="#entry-Uekacakraa" class="skt-link">Ekacakrā</a>; de là ils allèrent au <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a> de <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>, où <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> gagna le tournoi d'archerie; par suite d'une parole de <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a> leur ordonnant d'en partager le prix, ils durent épouser <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> tous les cinq; <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a> partagea le royaume, et ils créérent leur capitale <a href="#entry-Uindraprastha" class="skt-link">Indraprastha</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> se fit sacrer roi [<a href="#entry-raajasuuya" class="skt-link">rājasūya</a>]; mais il perdit son royaume aux dés avec le tricheur <a href="#entry-Uzakuni" class="skt-link">Śakuni</a>, et les frères durent s'exiler pendant 12 ans; la 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ année, lors de leur exil chez le roi <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a>, il se cachèrent sous des fausses identités; <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> se travestit en <a href="#entry-Ub_rhanna_daa" class="skt-link">Bṛhannaḍā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> en <a href="#entry-Ukafka" class="skt-link">Kaṅka</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> en <a href="#entry-Uballava" class="skt-link">Ballava</a>, <a href="#entry-Unakula" class="skt-link">Nakula</a> en <a href="#entry-Ugranthika" class="skt-link">Granthika</a>, et <a href="#entry-Usahadeva" class="skt-link">Sahadeva</a> en <a href="#entry-Utantipaala" class="skt-link">Tantipāla</a>, tandis que <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> se dissimula comme la <a href="#entry-sairandhrii" class="skt-link">sairandhrī</a> <a href="#entry-Umaalinii_1" class="skt-link">Mālinī_1</a>; à leur retour la grande guerre éclata avec leurs cousins les <a href="#entry-Ukauravaas" class="skt-link">Kauravās</a>, qu'il vainquirent avec l'aide de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pāṇḍavās</i> myth. les cinq Pāṇḍavās; en gén. leur clan, opposé à celui des <a href="#entry-Ukauravaas" class="skt-link">Kauravās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_ditya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाण्डित्य</span> <i>pāṇḍitya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_n_ditya" class="skt-link">n.</a> érudition, savoir, compétence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_du">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाण्डु</span> <i>pāṇḍu</i> a. <a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">f.</a> jaune pâle, pâle; clair, blanchâtre — <a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">m.</a> pâleur; jaunisse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pāṇḍu «le Pâle», fils de l'ascète <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uambaalikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambālikā_1</a> sa belle-sœur «blême de peur»; roi de <a href="#entry-Uhastinaapura" class="skt-link">Hastināpura</a> par suite de la cécité incapacitante de son aîné <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>, il mena une campagne de conquêtes établissant la suprématie des <a href="#entry-kauravaas" class="skt-link">kauravās</a>; puis il renonça au trône en devenant ermite dans la montagne de <a href="#entry-Uzataz_rfga" class="skt-link">Śataśṛṅga</a>; il y fut maudit par le daim-<a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a> Kiṃdama qu'il tua alors qu'il s'accouplait, et condamné lui-même à mourir s'il faisait l'amour; sa première épouse <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a>, qui avait reçu du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a> un <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> ayant le pouvoir d'invoquer les dieux pour enfanter, lui donna ses trois fils aînés: <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> fils d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; celle-ci permit ensuite à sa deuxième épouse <a href="#entry-Umaadrii" class="skt-link">Mādrī</a> d'user une fois de ce don; celle-ci tricha en enfantant des jumeaux <a href="#entry-Unakula" class="skt-link">Nakula</a> et <a href="#entry-Usahadeva" class="skt-link">Sahadeva</a> en invoquant les <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a>; un jour de printemps, <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a> ne put résister au charme de <a href="#entry-Umaadrii" class="skt-link">Mādrī</a> et en mourut <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>pallidus</i>; fr. pâle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_dura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाण्डुर</span> <i>pāṇḍura</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">pāṇḍu</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_n_dura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_dura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_duraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṇḍurā</i> blanchâtre, pâle; rôsé, beige — <a href="#entry-paa_n_dura" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur beige ou rosée — <a href="#entry-paa_n_dura" class="skt-link">n.</a> dépigmentation, vitiligo.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_durafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇḍuraṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-rafga" class="skt-link">raṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṇḍuraṅgā</i> blanc; de complexion claire — <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pāṇḍuraṅga, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_t_thala" class="skt-link">Viṭṭhala</a>-<a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka</a> «au teint clair» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la principauté de Pāṇḍuraṅga_1 du royaume hindouïsé du <a href="#entry-Ucampaa_1" class="skt-link">Campā_1</a> au Sud-Vietnam.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_durafgamahaatmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇḍuraṅgamahātmya</i> [<a href="#entry-mahaatmya" class="skt-link">mahātmya</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafgamahaatmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pāṇḍuraṅgamahātmya, poème de dévotion à <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍuraṅga</a> dû à Tenali Rāmakṛṣṇudu, poète Telugu de la cour de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).<br> <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">pāṇḍuraṅga</a> <br> <a href="#entry-paa_n_du" class="skt-link">pāṇḍu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_dya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाण्ड्य</span> <i>pāṇḍya</i> <a href="#entry-paa_n_dya" class="skt-link">m.</a> nom du pays Pāṇḍya du sud du Deccan (Madurai) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_dya" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍya</a> «du pays <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_dya" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍya</a>»; il combattait sur un éléphant aux côtés des <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍavās</a> dans la grande bataille; après un long combat, il fut mis à mort par <a href="#entry-Uazvatthaamaa" class="skt-link">Aśvatthāmā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sa dynastie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pāṇḍyās</i> les habitants du pays <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_dya" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_n_dyadeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇḍyadeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-deza" class="skt-link">deśa</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_n_dyadeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. le pays <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_dya" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍya</a> (autour de mod. Madurai).<br> <a href="#entry-paa_n_dya" class="skt-link">pāṇḍya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_navika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाणविक</span> <i>pāṇavika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_nava" class="skt-link">paṇava</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_navika" class="skt-link">m.</a> joueur de tambour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाणि</span> <i>pāṇi</i> <a href="#entry-paa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> main; syn. <a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>, <a href="#entry-hasta" class="skt-link">hasta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la faculté [<a href="#entry-karmendriya" class="skt-link">karmendriya</a>] de préhension, dont le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; son élément [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] prédominant est <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a> l'air; la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] associée est la sensation tactile [<a href="#entry-sparza" class="skt-link">sparśa</a>] qui excite le sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] tactile [<a href="#entry-tvak" class="skt-link">tvak</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. paume.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigha</i> [<a href="#entry-gha" class="skt-link">gha</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigha" class="skt-link">m.</a> (musique) [«qui frappe avec la main»] musicien (not. joueur de tambour).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigraaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigrāha</i> [<a href="#entry-graaha" class="skt-link">grāha</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigraaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> mariage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> époux [«qui prend la main»].<br> <i>pāṇigrāham</i> adv. en prenant par la main.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigraahaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigrāhaka</i> [<a href="#entry-graahaka" class="skt-link">grāhaka</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigraahaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> marié; époux; syn. <a href="#entry-paa_nigrahiit_r" class="skt-link">pāṇigrahītṛ</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«saisie de la main»] mariage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigraha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigrahaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-graha_na" class="skt-link">grahaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigraha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. rite de la cérémonie du mariage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nigrahiit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇigrahītṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-grahiit_r" class="skt-link">grahītṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nigrahiit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> marié; époux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nini">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाणिनि</span> <i>pāṇini</i> <a href="#entry-paa_nini" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Pāṇini, grammairien du sanskrit du 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant., né à Śalātura au <a href="#entry-Ugandhaara" class="skt-link">Gandhāra</a> (près de mod. Lahore); il mit au point une grammaire du sanskrit, appelée l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>, qui fait autorité à ce jour.<br> <i>siṃho</i> <i>vyākaraṇasya</i> <i>karturaharat</i> <i>prāṇān</i> <i>muneḥ</i> <i>pāṇineḥ</i> [PT.] Un lion prit la vie du sage <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>, auteur de la grammaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_niniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाणिनीय</span> <i>pāṇinīya</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_nini" class="skt-link">pāṇini</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_niniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṇinīyā</i> gram. de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a> ou de son école — <a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> spécialiste de l'école de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a> — <a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. linguistique.<br> <i>siddhyaty</i> <i>evam</i> <i>apāṇinīyaṃ</i> <i>tu</i> <i>bhavati</i> [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Mahābhāṣya</a>] On peut y arriver ainsi, mais ça ne suit pas <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_niniiyavyaakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇinīyavyākaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaakara_na" class="skt-link">vyākaraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_niniiyavyaakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. grammaire selon l'école de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_niniiyavyaakara_nodaahara_nakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇinīyavyākaraṇodāharaṇakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-udaahara_nakoza" class="skt-link">udāharaṇakośa</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_niniiyavyaakara_nodaahara_nakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. recueil des exemples de la grammaire selon l'école de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_niniiyavyaakara_na" class="skt-link">pāṇinīyavyākaraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_niniiyazik_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇinīyaśikṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-zik_saa" class="skt-link">śikṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_niniiyazik_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. np. de la Pāṇinīyaśikṣā, traité de phonétique dû à <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a> ou à ses disciples.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">pāṇinīya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ninyukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇinyukta</i> [<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_ninyukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ninyukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ninyuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṇinyuktā</i> gram. dit par <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.<br> <i>pāṇinyuktaṃ</i> <i>pramāṇam</i> gram. le <a href="#entry-munitraya" class="skt-link">munitraya</a> fait autorité.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_nini" class="skt-link">pāṇini</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nipaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇipāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nipaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. les mains et les pieds.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nipadma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇipadma</i> [<a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">padma</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nipadma" class="skt-link">m.</a> [<a href="#entry-ruupaka" class="skt-link">rūpaka</a>] main gracieuse [«semblable à un lotus»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nipii_dana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇipīḍana</i> [<a href="#entry-pii_dana" class="skt-link">pīḍana</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nipii_dana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. fait pour l'époux de presser la main de la mariée lors du mariage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_nipu_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṇipuṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-pu_ta" class="skt-link">puṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_nipu_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_nipu_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> creux de la main (pour boire).<br> <a href="#entry-paa_ni" class="skt-link">pāṇi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_sa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाषण्ड</span> <i>pāṣaṇḍa</i> a. <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṣaṇḍī</i> hérétique, impie — <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> imposteur; faux hindou — <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> hérésie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_sa_n_dastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṣaṇḍastha</i> [<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṣaṇḍasthā</i> soc. établi dans l'hérésie; qui appartient à une secte hérétique; not. jaïne, bouddhiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_sa_n_dataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṣaṇḍatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> hérésie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_sa_n_din">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṣaṇḍin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_din" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_din" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_dinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṣaṇḍinī</i> soc. hérétique; not. jaïne, bouddhiste.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_sa_n_da" class="skt-link">pāṣaṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_saa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाषाण</span> <i>pāṣāṇa</i> <a href="#entry-paa_saa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> pierre — <a href="#entry-paa_saa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṣāṇī</i> petite pierre servant de mesure de poids.<br> <i>na</i> <i>devo</i> <i>vidyate</i> <i>kāṣṭhe</i> <i>na</i> <i>pāṣāṇe</i> <i>na</i> <i>mṛṇmaye</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>bhāveṣu</i> <i>vidyate</i> <i>devaḥ</i> <i>tasmāt</i> <i>bhāvo</i> <i>hi</i> <i>kāraṇam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Dieu ne réside pas dans l'idole de bois, de pierre ni d'argile; c'est dans le cœur de l'homme en vérité que Dieu trouve son origine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_saa_nabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṣāṇabheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_saa_nabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Solenostemon Scutellarioides</i>, lamier vieux garçon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_saa_nabhedaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṣāṇabhedaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] id.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_saa_nabheda" class="skt-link">pāṣāṇabheda</a> <br> <a href="#entry-paa_saa_na" class="skt-link">pāṣāṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाट्</span> <i>pāṭ</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pa_t" class="skt-link">paṭ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pāṭayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pāṭita</i><i>)</i> fendre, déchirer, arracher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाट</span> <i>pāṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_t" class="skt-link">pāṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> largeur; extension — <a href="#entry-paa_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭā</i> série, suite, succession — <a href="#entry-paa_tii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭī</i> math. arithmétique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटक</span> <i>pāṭaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pa_t" class="skt-link">paṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭikā</i> qui fend, qui divise — <a href="#entry-paa_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> berge, rivage; gradins descendant à une rivière — <a href="#entry-paa_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭikā</i> part; partition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incision, lacération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटल</span> <i>pāṭala</i> a. <a href="#entry-paa_tala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_talaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭalā</i> rouge pâle, rose, orangé — <a href="#entry-paa_tala" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur rose ou orange <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Stereospermum colais</i> ou bot. <i>Bignonia suaveolens</i> arbre aux fleurs jaunes bordées de rouge en forme de trompette; c'est l'une des 5 racines médicinales majeures [<a href="#entry-b_rhatpa_ncamuula" class="skt-link">bṛhatpañcamūla</a>] — <a href="#entry-paa_tala" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. sa fleur, la bignone, au parfum suave — <a href="#entry-paa_talaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭalā</i> natu. id. — <a href="#entry-paa_tali" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tali" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭali</i> natu. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_taligraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭaligrāma</i> [<a href="#entry-graama" class="skt-link">grāma</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_taligraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du village de Pāṭaligrāma, au <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>; il fut fortifié par <a href="#entry-Uajaatazatru_1" class="skt-link">Ajātaśatru_1</a>, qui en fit sa capitale <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>pāṭaligāma</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_taliputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭaliputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_taliputra" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Pāṭaliputra, dans la vallée du Gange, fondée par <a href="#entry-Uajaatazatru_1" class="skt-link">Ajātaśatru_1</a>; elle fut la capitale du <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>, puis de l'empire <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a> (mod. Paṭnā au <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a>); cf. <a href="#entry-Ukusumapura" class="skt-link">Kusumapura</a>, <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta" class="skt-link">Candragupta</a>, <a href="#entry-Upu_spapurii" class="skt-link">Puṣpapurī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_tala" class="skt-link">pāṭala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटन</span> <i>pāṭana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pa_t" class="skt-link">paṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_tana" class="skt-link">n.</a> division; lacération, destruction — <a href="#entry-paa_tanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭanā</i> coupe, incision.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटव</span> <i>pāṭava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_tu" class="skt-link">paṭu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_tava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭavā</i> malin, habile, adroit — <a href="#entry-paa_tava" class="skt-link">n.</a> acuité, intensité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> habileté, adresse en ⟨loc.⟩ — ifc. rapidité, précipitation à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> santé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_th">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठ्</span> <i>pāṭh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pāṭhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pāṭhita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>pāṭhanīya</i>, <i>pāṭhya</i><i>)</i> faire lire; enseigner; instruire en ⟨2 acc.⟩ — ps. <i>(pāṭhyate)</i> être instruit en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठ</span> <i>pāṭha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paa_th" class="skt-link">pāṭh</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lecture, récitation (not. du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>); étude; leçon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. recueil de règles de la grammaire ou de ses annexes; leur mémorisation par récitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thaalaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭhālaya</i> [<a href="#entry-aalaya" class="skt-link">ālaya</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_thaalaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> école.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thaantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭhāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_thaantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. [«autre lecture»] variante d'un texte.<br> <i>iti</i> <i>pāṭhāntaram</i> selon une autre lecture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭhabheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_thabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [philologie] correction, variante, interpolation d'un texte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठक</span> <i>pāṭhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_th" class="skt-link">pāṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_thaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhikā</i> récitant, lecteur — <a href="#entry-paa_thaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> étudiant; lettré, précepteur, enseignant — <a href="#entry-paa_thikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhikā</i> étudiante; lettrée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thakaadhama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭhakādhama</i> [<a href="#entry-adhama" class="skt-link">adhama</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_thakaadhama" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. pire récitateur; on en recense de 6 variétés; cf. <a href="#entry-likhitapaa_thaka" class="skt-link">likhitapāṭhaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_thaka" class="skt-link">pāṭhaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठनीय</span> <i>pāṭhanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-paa_th" class="skt-link">pāṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_thaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhanīyā</i> qui doit être enseigné; qu'il faut étudier.<br> <i>mahārājyaṃ</i> <i>vā</i> <i>pālanīyam</i> <i>mahābhāṣyaṃ</i> <i>vā</i> <i>pāṭhanīyam</i> Il faut soit gouverner un grand royaume, soit étudier le <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Mahābhāṣya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thazaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṭhaśālā</i> [<a href="#entry-zaalaa" class="skt-link">śālā</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_thazaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> salle d'études védiques.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठिन्</span> <i>pāṭhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_thin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhinī</i> compétent — ifc. compétent en — <a href="#entry-paa_thin" class="skt-link">m.</a> étudiant; lettré; enseignant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. brâhmane ayant terminé ses classes védiques.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठित</span> <i>pāṭhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paa_th" class="skt-link">pāṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_thita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhitā</i> enseigné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_thya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाठ्य</span> <i>pāṭhya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_thya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_thyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭhyā</i> qui doit être enseigné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a besoin d'être instruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tiira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटीर</span> <i>pāṭīra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_tiira" class="skt-link">paṭīra</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_tiira" class="skt-link">m.</a> pâte de bois de santal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_tita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाटित</span> <i>pāṭita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paa_t" class="skt-link">pāṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_titaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṭitā</i> fendu; déchiré; cassé — <a href="#entry-paa_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> fracture, not. de la jambe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पा</span> <i>pā_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pibati)</i> pft. <i>(papau)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <i>(apāt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pīta_1</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(pibat)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>pānīya</i>, <i>peya</i>, <i>pātavya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pītvā</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> boire — ps. <i>(pīyate)</i> être bu — ca. <i>(pāyayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pāyita</i><i>)</i> donner à boire, arroser — dés. <i>(pipāsati)</i> ppr. <i>(pipāsat)</i> désirer boire — int. md. <i>(pepīpyate)</i> ppr. md. <i>(pepīpyamāna)</i> boire en excès; boire continûment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πινω; lat. <i>bibo</i>; fr. boire, breuvage, bière.<br> <i>pāyaṃ</i> <i>pāyam</i> ayant bu encore et encore.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पा</span> <i>pā_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pāti)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] <i>(apāsīt)</i> subj. <i>(pāsati)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>prati</i><i>)</i> protéger, défendre — ca. <i>(pālayati)</i> garder, protéger, sauver, conserver; défendre contre ⟨abl.⟩ — dés. <i>(pipāsati)</i> vouloir défendre — int. md. <i>(pāpāyate)</i> défendre avec acharnement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>pasco</i>; fr. pâture, pasteur.<br> <i>śivaḥ</i> <i>pātu</i> que <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> vous protège.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पा</span> <i>pā_3</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_2" class="skt-link">pā_2</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-paa_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_3" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui garde, qui protège.<br> <i>surāpā</i> qui garde l'alcool.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_4">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पा</span> <i>pā_4</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-paa_4" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_4" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui boit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाच्</span> <i>pāc</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pācayati)</i> faire cuire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paacaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाचक</span> <i>pācaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paac" class="skt-link">pāc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paacaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paacaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paacikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pācikā</i> qui cuit, qui rôtit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui aide la digestion; qui fait mûrir — <a href="#entry-paacaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> cuisinier — f. cf. <a href="#entry-paacikaa" class="skt-link">pācikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाचन</span> <i>pācana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paac" class="skt-link">pāc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paacana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paacanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pācanī</i> qui fait cuire; qui fait mûrir; qui facilite la digestion — <a href="#entry-paacana" class="skt-link">m.</a> feu; acidité — <a href="#entry-paacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cuisson <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pansement d'une blessure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> digestif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paacikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाचिका</span> <i>pācikā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-paacaka" class="skt-link">pācaka</a>] <a href="#entry-paacikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> cuisson; maturité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cuisinière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paacikaabhaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pācikābhārya</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaaryaa" class="skt-link">bhāryā</a>] <a href="#entry-paacikaabhaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> mari d'une cuisinière.<br> <a href="#entry-paacikaa" class="skt-link">pācikā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाद्</span> <i>pād</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pādita</i><i>)</i> faire aller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाद</span> <i>pāda</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">m.</a> pied <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pied d'un arbre, d'une colonne, d'une montagne; position, site <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rayon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> quart, quatrième partie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vers dans une stance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. mot, élément d'un mot composé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. section d'un ouvrage; not. regroupement d'aphorismes [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la faculté [<a href="#entry-karmendriya" class="skt-link">karmendriya</a>] de marche, dont le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; son élément [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] prédominant est <a href="#entry-tejas" class="skt-link">tejas</a> le feu; la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] associée est l'aspect [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>], qui excite le sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] de la vision [<a href="#entry-ak_si" class="skt-link">akṣi</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>pādau</i> les deux pieds <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [ChU.] partition conceptuelle du <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> selon <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a>; il y en a quatre: l'Espace [<a href="#entry-prakaazavat" class="skt-link">prakāśavat</a>], l'Illimité [<a href="#entry-anantavat" class="skt-link">anantavat</a>], le Radiant [<a href="#entry-jyoti_smat" class="skt-link">jyotiṣmat</a>] et le Cognitif [<a href="#entry-aayatanavat" class="skt-link">āyatanavat</a>] — ifc. pl. <i>pādās</i> [«aux pieds (d'une personne)»] expression de respect <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πεδον; lat. <i>pedis</i>; ang. foot; all. Fuss; fr. pied.<br> <i>pādābhyām</i> adv. à pied.<br> <i>śrīpādau</i> soc. [«aux pieds de <a href="#entry-Uzrii" class="skt-link">Śrī</a>»] symbole sectaire vishnouite, un trait vertical rouge entre deux blancs, porté en <a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadaahata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādāhata</i> [<a href="#entry-aahata" class="skt-link">āhata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paadaahata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paadaahata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paadaahataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādāhatā</i> piétiné; frappé par le pied — <a href="#entry-paadaahati" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādāhati</i> coup de pied.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-paadaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> extrémité du pied <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. fin d'un vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पादक</span> <i>pādaka</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-paadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pied — <a href="#entry-paadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādikā</i> sandale — ifc. pied de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadapa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādapa_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paadapa_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> arbre [«qui boit par la racine»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadapa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādapa_2</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paadapa_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> repose-pieds — <a href="#entry-paadapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādapā</i> chaussure, babouche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadarak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādarakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-rak_sa" class="skt-link">rakṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paadarak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paadarak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paadarak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādarakṣā</i> qui protège les pieds (not. de l'éléphant de combat).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadataa_ditaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādatāḍitaka</i> [<a href="#entry-taa_ditaka" class="skt-link">tāḍitaka</a>] <a href="#entry-paadataa_ditaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pādatāḍitaka, drame en un acte de style <a href="#entry-bhaa_na" class="skt-link">bhāṇa</a> de <a href="#entry-Uzyaamalika" class="skt-link">Śyāmalika</a>; c'est l'un des <a href="#entry-caturbhaa_nii" class="skt-link">caturbhāṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पादशस्</span> <i>pādaśas</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a><a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. gram. (récitation) mot par mot, en suivant le <a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">padapāṭha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pied par pied; vers par vers; quartier par quartier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाद्म</span> <i>pādma</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">padma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paadma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paadma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paadmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādmā</i> relatif au lotus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadmapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādmapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-paadmapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-padmapuraa_na" class="skt-link">padmapurāṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paadma" class="skt-link">pādma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadodaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādodaka</i> [<a href="#entry-udaka" class="skt-link">udaka</a>] <a href="#entry-paadodaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau pour (laver) les pieds.<br> <a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaduka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पादुक</span> <i>pāduka</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaduka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaduka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paadukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādukā</i> <a href="#entry-paadukii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādukī</i> muni de pieds; qui va à pied, piéton — <a href="#entry-paadukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādukā</i> sandale, babouche; soulier, chaussure (socque de bois) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. trace de pieds dans un temple honorant un dieu ou un vénérable.<br> <i>gurupādukā</i> phil. sainte sandale du <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>; son invocation apporte la libération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadukaapa_ncaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pādukāpañcaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">pañcaka</a>] <a href="#entry-paadukaapa_ncaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] np. du Pādukāpañcaka, texte ésotérique traitant de l'anatomie mystique.<br> <a href="#entry-paaduka" class="skt-link">pāduka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाद्य</span> <i>pādya</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pādyā</i> relatif aux pieds — <a href="#entry-paadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> (eau) pour (laver) les pieds.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paafkta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाङ्क्त</span> <i>pāṅkta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pafkti" class="skt-link">paṅkti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paafkta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paafkta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paafktii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṅktī</i> formé de 5 parties.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paafkteya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṅkteya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paafkteya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paafkteya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paafkteyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṅkteyā</i> soc. fréquentable, admissible dans les rangs de sa caste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paafktya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāṅktya</i> [<a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paafktya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paafktya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paafktyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāṅktyā</i> soc. fréquentable, admissible dans les rangs de sa caste.<br> <a href="#entry-paafkta" class="skt-link">pāṅkta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paagala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पागल</span> <i>pāgala</i> a. <a href="#entry-paagala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paagala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paagalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāgalā</i> dérangé, fou; dément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाक</span> <i>pāka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] <a href="#entry-paaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> cuisson, maturation; perfectionnement, mûrissement; maturité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de cuire, de bouillir, de rôtir, de brûler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> digestion; inflammation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jeunesse, simplicité, innocence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> petit d'un animal; enfant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pāka «Simplet», <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> tué par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. sirop — <a href="#entry-paakii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pākī</i> ifc. cuisson de, etc.<br> <i>pākaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> faire la cuisine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pākarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-paakarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> sauce du plat, son goût.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakayaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pākayajña</i> [<a href="#entry-yaj_na" class="skt-link">yajña</a>] <a href="#entry-paakayaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. oblation de nourriture cuite; on en liste sept: <a href="#entry-a_s_takaa" class="skt-link">aṣṭakā</a>, <a href="#entry-paarva_nasthaaliipaaka" class="skt-link">pārvaṇasthālīpāka</a>, <a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>, <a href="#entry-zraava_nii" class="skt-link">śrāvaṇī</a>, <a href="#entry-aagrahaaya_nii" class="skt-link">āgrahāyaṇī</a>, <a href="#entry-caitrii" class="skt-link">caitrī</a>, <a href="#entry-aazvayujii" class="skt-link">āśvayujī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakazaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pākaśāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-zaasana" class="skt-link">śāsana</a>] <a href="#entry-paakazaasana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> «qui punit <a href="#entry-Upaaka" class="skt-link">Pāka</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pākaśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-paakazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> art culinaire.<br> <a href="#entry-paaka" class="skt-link">pāka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाकिन्</span> <i>pākin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-paakin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paakin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paakinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pākinī</i> qui mûrit, qui cuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाक्य</span> <i>pākya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paakya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paakyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pākyā</i> qui peut être cuit; comestible; mûr <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obtenu par cuisson ou évaporation — <a href="#entry-paakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> (sel) de marais salant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाल्</span> <i>pāl</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-paa_2" class="skt-link">pā_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pālayati)</i> ppr. <i>(pālayat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pālita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>pālya</i><i>)</i> garder, protéger, sauver, conserver; défendre contre ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाल</span> <i>pāla</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] <a href="#entry-paala" class="skt-link">m.</a> gardien, protecteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> berger, bouvier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de la dynastie Pāla, qui régna not. sur le <a href="#entry-Ugau_da" class="skt-link">Gauḍa</a> (~800–~1050) à l'Est de l'Inde; pl. les Pālās — <a href="#entry-paalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālā</i> ifc. protecteur de — <a href="#entry-paalii_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālī_1</i> femme de bouvier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paalaagala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पालागल</span> <i>pālāgala</i> <a href="#entry-paalaagala" class="skt-link">m.</a> messager — <a href="#entry-paalaagalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālāgalī</i> soc. 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ femme d'un prince, la moins respectée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paalaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पालक</span> <i>pālaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paalaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paalaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālikā</i> qui garde, qui protège, qui nourrit — <a href="#entry-paalaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> gardien, protecteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> père adoptif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prince, roi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du mauvais roi Pālaka dans la pièce <a href="#entry-Um_rcchaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">Mṛcchakaṭikā</a>; le fils du bouvier <a href="#entry-Uaaryaka_1" class="skt-link">Āryaka_1</a> met fin à son règne tyrannique et le détrône <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> garde, majordome.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paalana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पालन</span> <i>pālana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paalana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paalanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālanī</i> qui garde, qui protège, qui nourrit — <a href="#entry-paalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> protection, défense, garde; préservation; entretien <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lait d'une vache qui a vêlé récemment.<br> <i>pālanī</i> <i>jananī</i> nourrice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पालि</span> <i>pāli</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] <a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">f.</a> var. <i>pālī_2</i> frontière, limite, marge; bord, bordure; raie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lobe de l'oreille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rangée, ligne, intervalle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> digue, barrage; pont <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. nourriture prescrite à un étudiant pendant ses études par son <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> giron, ventre; circonférence; pou <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. le <a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a> est un dialecte moyen-indien [<a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a>] utilisé pour les textes sacrés du bouddhisme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पालित</span> <i>pālita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālitā</i> gardé, protégé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाल्य</span> <i>pālya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-paal" class="skt-link">pāl</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paalya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paalyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pālyā</i> à protéger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाम</span> <i>pāma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-paaman" class="skt-link">pāman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paamaghna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāmaghna</i> [<a href="#entry-ghna" class="skt-link">ghna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paamaghna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paamaghna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paamaghnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāmaghnī</i> qui guérit des affections cutanées — <a href="#entry-paamaghna" class="skt-link">m.</a> soufre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पामन्</span> <i>pāman</i> <a href="#entry-paaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> maladie de peau; éruption cutanée, prurit; cicatrice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पामन</span> <i>pāmana</i> [<a href="#entry-paama" class="skt-link">pāma</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paamana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paamanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāmanā</i> atteint de prurit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paamara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पामर</span> <i>pāmara</i> [<a href="#entry-paama" class="skt-link">pāma</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paamara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paamara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paamaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāmarā</i> affecté d'une maladie de peau; lépreux — <a href="#entry-paamara" class="skt-link">m.</a> misérable, canaille; idiot — <a href="#entry-paamara" class="skt-link">n.</a> mauvaise conduite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paamavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāmavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paamavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paamavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paamavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāmavatī</i> affecté d'une maladie de peau.<br> <a href="#entry-paama" class="skt-link">pāma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पान</span> <i>pāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de boire (not. de l'alcool) — <a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">n.</a> boisson, breuvage — <a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">m.</a> distillateur; tenancier de taverne.<br> <i>payaḥpānam</i> <i>bhujaṅgānāṃ</i> <i>sukham</i> Boire du lait est le plaisir des serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paanaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pānaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-paanaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paanaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> boisson, breuvage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paanakarasaraagaasava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pānakarasarāgāsava</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>-<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>-<a href="#entry-aasava" class="skt-link">āsava</a>] <a href="#entry-paanakarasaraagaasava" class="skt-link">m.</a> boissons, assaisonnements et liqueurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paanakarasaraagaasavayojana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pānakarasarāgāsavayojana</i> [<a href="#entry-yojana" class="skt-link">yojana</a>] <a href="#entry-paanakarasaraagaasavayojana" class="skt-link">n.</a> l'art de préparer les boissons, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-paanaka" class="skt-link">pānaka</a> <br> <a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">pāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पानीय</span> <i>pānīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pānīyā</i> potable; à boire — <a href="#entry-paaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> breuvage; eau potable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paantha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पान्थ</span> <i>pāntha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-panthan" class="skt-link">panthan</a>] <a href="#entry-paantha" class="skt-link">m.</a> voyageur; nomade — <a href="#entry-paanthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pānthā</i> ifc. fait d'accompagner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paanthatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pānthatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-paanthatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> condition de voyageur; nomadisme.<br> <a href="#entry-paantha" class="skt-link">pāntha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाप</span> <i>pāpa</i> a. <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāpā</i> pécheur, mauvais, méchant, vicieux, criminel; funeste — <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> mécréant; malfaiteur, criminel — <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> mal, faute, péché, vice, crime <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le Mal; opp. <a href="#entry-pu_nya" class="skt-link">puṇya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>peccare</i>; fr. péché.<br> <i>pāpam</i> adv. mauvaisement, à tort.<br> <i>śāntaṃ</i> <i>pāpam</i> <i>vade retro, satanas</i>.<br> <i>sadā</i> <i>devā</i> <i>janānmuñcanti</i> <i>pāpāt</i> Les dieux délivrent toujours les hommes des péchés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-paapaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> péché.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapamitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpamitra</i> [<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] <a href="#entry-paapamitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> ami de débauche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mauvaise fréquentation; opp. <a href="#entry-kalyaa_namitra" class="skt-link">kalyāṇamitra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapamitratva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpamitratva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-paapamitratva" class="skt-link">n.</a> amitié avec de mauvaises personnes.<br> <a href="#entry-paapamitra" class="skt-link">pāpamitra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapanaazinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpanāśinī</i> [<a href="#entry-naazin" class="skt-link">nāśin</a>] <a href="#entry-paapanaazinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. du bassin sacré de Pāpanāśinī, à <a href="#entry-Ubhuvanezvarii_1" class="skt-link">Bhuvaneśvarī_1</a>; son eau «enlève les péchés»; on peut s'y baigner un jour par an.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapanizcaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpaniścaya</i> [<a href="#entry-nizcaya" class="skt-link">niścaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paapanizcaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paapanizcaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paapanizcayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāpaniścayā</i> voué au mal, criminel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaparddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāparddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-_rddhi" class="skt-link">ṛddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-paaparddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«succès en péché»] chasse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaparddhika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāparddhika</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-paaparddhika" class="skt-link">m.</a> chasseur.<br> <a href="#entry-paaparddhi" class="skt-link">pāparddhi</a> <br> <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">pāpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaparogin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāparogin</i> [<a href="#entry-rogin" class="skt-link">rogin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaparogin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaparogin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaparogi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāparogiṇī</i> malade d'une maladie due au péché, comme la lèpre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapayoni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāpayoni</i> [<a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a>] <a href="#entry-paapayoni" class="skt-link">f.</a> matrice immonde (dans laquelle on renaît par punition de ses péchés).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapi_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पापिष्ठ</span> <i>pāpiṣṭha</i> [super. <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">pāpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paapi_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paapi_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paapi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāpiṣṭhā</i> le pire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paapiiyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पापीयस्</span> <i>pāpīyas</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">pāpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paapiiyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paapiiyas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paapiiyasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāpīyasī</i> pire; plus méchant — <a href="#entry-paapiiyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> gredin, canaille; criminel.<br> <i>māraḥ</i> <i>pāpīyān</i> m. bd. le diable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paar_s_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्ष्णि</span> <i>pārṣṇi</i> <a href="#entry-paar_s_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> talon; dos <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrière-garde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> axe reliant les chevaux externes d'un quadrige (les chevaux internes étant harnassés au timon [<a href="#entry-dhur" class="skt-link">dhur</a>] du chariot).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paar_s_nitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārṣṇitra</i> [<a href="#entry-tra" class="skt-link">tra</a>] <a href="#entry-paar_s_nitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> protège-dos <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> armée de réserve.<br> <a href="#entry-paar_s_ni" class="skt-link">pārṣṇi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paar_sada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्षद</span> <i>pārṣada</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-par_sad" class="skt-link">parṣad</a>] <a href="#entry-paar_sada" class="skt-link">m.</a> suivant, compagnon; membre de la suite d'un roi ou d'un dieu (not. <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> participant à une réunion; spectateur — <a href="#entry-paar_sada" class="skt-link">n.</a> manuel de grammaire; not. recueil <a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">prātiśākhya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paar_sata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्षत</span> <i>pārṣata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-p_r_sata" class="skt-link">pṛṣata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paar_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paar_sata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paar_satii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārṣatī</i> relatif à l'antilope — <a href="#entry-paar_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pārṣata, patr. de <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a> et de <a href="#entry-Udh_r_s_tadyumna" class="skt-link">Dhṛṣṭadyumna</a> — <a href="#entry-paar_satii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārṣatī</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pārṣatī, patr. de <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार</span> <i>pāra</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-p_r_1" class="skt-link">pṛ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">n.</a> rive opposée, rivage; coté opposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fin, extrémité, limite; but — a. <a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārī</i> ifc. qui traverse, qui surmonte ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>pāraṃ</i> <i>gam</i> atteindre, réaliser (un but, un vœu, une connaissance ⟨g. loc.⟩).<br> <i>pāraṃ</i> <i>nī</i> achever, conclure.<br> <i>carcāpāraḥ</i> qui étudie à fond le <a href="#entry-carcaapaa_tha" class="skt-link">carcāpāṭha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaraaya_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārāyaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>] <a href="#entry-paaraaya_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> consultation, récitation, étude (not. du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> ou d'un <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> totalité; notamment texte complet d'une tradition — <a href="#entry-paaraaya_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārāyaṇī</i> méditation; élucidation.<br> <i>vedapārāyaṇa</i> soc. récitation complète du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> de sa tradition familiale, à raison d'une leçon par jour.<br> <a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">pāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaraazarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाराशर्य</span> <i>pārāśarya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paraazara" class="skt-link">parāśara</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-paaraazarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. patr. de <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>, «Fils de <a href="#entry-Uparaazara" class="skt-link">Parāśara</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaraga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāraga</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaraga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaraga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaragaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāragā</i> parti au loin; qui a traversé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompli; qui connaît à fond, familier de ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩; érudit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaragata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāragata</i> [<a href="#entry-gata" class="skt-link">gata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaragata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaragata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaragataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāragatā</i> qui a atteint la rive opposée (de ⟨g.⟩); qui a traversé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. qui a atteint la libération — <a href="#entry-paaragata" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. saint homme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaragraamika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāragrāmika</i> [<a href="#entry-graamika" class="skt-link">grāmika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaragraamika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaragraamika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaragraamikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāragrāmikī</i> [«provenant d'un autre village»] hostile, inamical.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारक्य</span> <i>pārakya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paraka" class="skt-link">paraka</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarakya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarakyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārakyā</i> appartenant à autrui, étranger; syn. <a href="#entry-parakiiya" class="skt-link">parakīya</a> — <a href="#entry-paarakya" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramaarthika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारमार्थिक</span> <i>pāramārthika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paramaartha" class="skt-link">paramārtha</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaramaarthika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaramaarthika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaramaarthikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāramārthikī</i> phil. qui concerne la vérité suprême; idéal, absolu; réel, essentiel, vrai; opp. <a href="#entry-vyaavahaarika" class="skt-link">vyāvahārika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui recherche la vérité suprême.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramaarthikabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāramārthikabheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-paaramaarthikabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. différence essentielle.<br> <a href="#entry-paaramaarthika" class="skt-link">pāramārthika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāramita</i> [<a href="#entry-ita" class="skt-link">ita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaramita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaramita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāramitā</i> parvenu sur la rive opposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui mène au but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. transcendant (not. connaissance spirituelle) — <a href="#entry-paaramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāramitā</i> perfection, vertu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. une des 6 perfections d'un accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>]: la générosité [<a href="#entry-daana" class="skt-link">dāna</a>], la vertu [<a href="#entry-ziila" class="skt-link">śīla</a>], la tolérance [<a href="#entry-k_saanti" class="skt-link">kṣānti</a>], la vigueur [<a href="#entry-viirya" class="skt-link">vīrya</a>], la méditation [<a href="#entry-dhyaana" class="skt-link">dhyāna</a>] et la sagesse [<a href="#entry-praj_naa_2" class="skt-link">prajñā_2</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramparya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारम्पर्य</span> <i>pāramparya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-parampara" class="skt-link">paraṃpara</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-paaramparya" class="skt-link">n.</a> succession ininterrompue; tradition.<br> <i>pāramparyeṇa</i> successivement, progressivement.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaramparyopadeza">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarasa">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारस</span> <i>pārasa</i> a. <a href="#entry-paarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārasī</i> perse — <a href="#entry-paarasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārasī</i> langue perse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>parsi</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarasika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārasika</i> var. <i>pāraśika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-paarasika" class="skt-link">m.</a> perse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pārasikās</i> les perses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pārasīkās</i> les perses.<br> <a href="#entry-paarasa" class="skt-link">pārasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaraskara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारस्कर</span> <i>pāraskara</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paras" class="skt-link">paras</a>-<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paaraskara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Pāraskara, auteur d'un <a href="#entry-g_rhyasuutra" class="skt-link">gṛhyasūtra</a> and of a <a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. d'un pays.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारय</span> <i>pāraya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paari" class="skt-link">pāri</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaraya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaraya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārayā</i> qui traverse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paare">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारे</span> <i>pāre</i> [loc. <a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">pāra</a>] ind. sur l'autre rive.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaregafgam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāregaṅgam</i> [<a href="#entry-gafgaa" class="skt-link">gaṅgā</a>] adv. de l'autre côté du Gange.<br> <a href="#entry-paare" class="skt-link">pāre</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paari">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारि</span> <i>pāri</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-p_r_1" class="skt-link">pṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pārayati)</i> faire traverser; secourir, protéger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> résister à, se mesurer à; surmonter, prévaloir sur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paari_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारि</span> <i>pāri_1</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaribhaa_sika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāribhāṣika</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sika" class="skt-link">bhāṣika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāribhāṣikī</i> conventionnel, technique — <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāribhāṣikī</i> gram. [<a href="#entry-Uprazastapaada" class="skt-link">Praśastapāda</a>] catégorie des noms.<br> <i>pāribhāṣikī</i> <i>saṃjñā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] nom introduit par une définition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaribhaa_sikapadaarthasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāribhāṣikapadārthasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>-<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sikapadaarthasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pāribhāṣipadārthasaṃgraha, œuvre de <a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a> de Kurugunthi Śrīrāma <a href="#entry-zaast_r" class="skt-link">śāstṛ</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paaribhaa_sika" class="skt-link">pāribhāṣika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaribhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāribhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-paaribhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Erythrina indica</i>, arbre corail; il perd ses feuilles en été et se couvre de grandes fleurs pourpres; cf. <a href="#entry-bahupu_spa" class="skt-link">bahupuṣpa</a>, <a href="#entry-mandaara" class="skt-link">mandāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarijaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārijāta</i> [<a href="#entry-jaata" class="skt-link">jāta</a>] <a href="#entry-paarijaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Nyctanthes arbortristis</i>, jasmin nocturne; arbre à feuilles opposées, aux fleurs blanches au parfum suave qui fleurissent la nuit et tombent avant l'aube; la corolle de sa fleur a 5 à 8 lobes autour d'un centre orange; ses fleurs décorent les sanctuaires; il est utilisé en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-zephaalikaa" class="skt-link">śephālikā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth.
