Jasmin céleste, l'un des 5 arbres [<a href="#entry-pa_ncav_rk_sa" class="skt-link">pañcavṛkṣa</a>] du paradis <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; il fut produit lors du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> en ramena des fleurs sur Terre à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, pour voir à qui celui-ci les offrirait; il les offrit à <a href="#entry-Urukmi_nii" class="skt-link">Rukmiṇī</a>, et <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> en informa <a href="#entry-Usatyabhaamaa" class="skt-link">Satyabhāmā</a> pour susciter sa jalousie, tout en suggérant qu'elle demande à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> d'aller chercher l'arbre pour le planter sur Terre; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Usatyabhaamaa" class="skt-link">Satyabhāmā</a> allèrent voler une branche de l'arbre céleste, mais <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, informé du vol par <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a>, livra bataille contre <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; il perdit, mais maudit la plante de ne jamais porter fruit; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> planta l'arbre dans le jardin de <a href="#entry-Usatyabhaamaa" class="skt-link">Satyabhāmā</a>, mais de telle sorte que ses fleurs tombent dans celui de <a href="#entry-Urukmi_nii" class="skt-link">Rukmiṇī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>parjā</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarijaatahara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārijātaharaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-hara_na" class="skt-link">haraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-paarijaatahara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. vol par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> du Jasmin céleste du <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paarijaata" class="skt-link">pārijāta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarijaataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārijātaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-paarijaataka" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarik_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारिक्षित</span> <i>pārikṣita</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-parik_sit" class="skt-link">parikṣit</a>] <a href="#entry-paarik_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pārikṣita, patr. de <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. dynastie <a href="#entry-kuru" class="skt-link">kuru</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>pārīkṣita</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaripaarzva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारिपार्श्व</span> <i>pāripārśva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paripaarzva" class="skt-link">paripārśva</a>] <a href="#entry-paaripaarzva" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. suite d'un prince, entourage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. figurants au théâtre (spectateurs, serviteurs, courtisans).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaripaarzvaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāripārśvaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaripaarzvaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaripaarzvaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaripaarzvikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāripārśvikā</i> soc. serviteur, valet, membre de la suite d'un prince — <a href="#entry-paaripaarzvika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>pāripārśvika</i> soc. assistant du directeur de théâtre [<a href="#entry-suutradhaara" class="skt-link">sūtradhāra</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-trigata" class="skt-link">trigata</a> — <a href="#entry-paaripaarzvikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāripārśvikā</i> soc. femme de chambre.<br> <a href="#entry-paaripaarzva" class="skt-link">pāripārśva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारित</span> <i>pārita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-p_rr" class="skt-link">pṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāritā</i> rempli, accompli; complet; terminé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paariyaatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāriyātra</i> [<a href="#entry-yaatraa" class="skt-link">yātrā</a>] <a href="#entry-paariyaatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de la chaîne Pāriyātra (mod. Hindukush) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. partie Ouest de la chaîne <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paari_1" class="skt-link">pāri_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्थ</span> <i>pārtha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-p_rthaa" class="skt-link">pṛthā</a>] <a href="#entry-paartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pārtha [«fils de <a href="#entry-Up_rthaa" class="skt-link">Pṛthā</a>»], matronyme d'un <a href="#entry-paa_n_dava" class="skt-link">pāṇḍava</a> ayant pour mère <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a> (<a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>); not. <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prince en gén.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarthagjanika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्थग्जनिक</span> <i>pārthagjanika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-p_rthagjana" class="skt-link">pṛthagjana</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarthagjanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarthagjanika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarthagjanikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārthagjanikā</i> qui se rapporte à l'homme de la rue; vulgaire, grossier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarthasaarathi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārthasārathi</i> [<a href="#entry-saarathi" class="skt-link">sārathi</a>] <a href="#entry-paarthasaarathi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pārthasārathi, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> «Conducteur du char d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>», incarnant <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> dans son rôle de Sauveur [<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>] de l'Humanité; son temple se trouve à mod. Chennai-Triplicane.<br> <a href="#entry-paartha" class="skt-link">pārtha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarthiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्थिव</span> <i>pārthiva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarthiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarthiva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarthivaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārthivā</i> <a href="#entry-paarthivii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārthivī</i> terrestre; humain; royal, princier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de terre; se dit not. d'un <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> — <a href="#entry-paarthiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme, mortel; roi, prince <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Pārthiva «Prince», personnifiant l'an 19 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaru_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारुष्ण</span> <i>pāruṣṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paru_sa" class="skt-link">paruṣa</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-paaru_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. étourneau; on compare le mouvement de ses volées à celui du feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaru_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पारुष्य</span> <i>pāruṣya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-paru_sa" class="skt-link">paruṣa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paaru_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paaru_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paaru_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāruṣyā</i> dureté, rudesse, grossièreté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarva_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्वण</span> <i>pārvaṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarva_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarva_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarva_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārvaṇī</i> relatif aux phases de la lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. qui concerne les fêtes religieuses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarva_nasthaaliipaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārvaṇasthālīpāka</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaaliipaaka" class="skt-link">sthālīpāka</a>] <a href="#entry-paarva_nasthaaliipaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. oblation de riz ou d'orge liée aux phases de la lune, un <a href="#entry-paakayaj_na" class="skt-link">pākayajña</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paarva_na" class="skt-link">pārvaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्वत</span> <i>pārvata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-parvata" class="skt-link">parvata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paarvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paarvata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paarvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārvatī</i> relatif à la montagne; montagnard, montagneux — <a href="#entry-paarvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pārvatī</i> myth. np. de la déesse Pārvatī «Fille de la Montagne», fille de <a href="#entry-Uhimavaan" class="skt-link">Himavān</a> et de <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; elle est la réincarnation de <a href="#entry-Usatii" class="skt-link">Satī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uumaa" class="skt-link">Umā</a>, <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzailaputrii" class="skt-link">Śailaputrī</a>; on la fête à <a href="#entry-jyai_s_thaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭhāṣṭamī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarvatiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārvatīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-paarvatiiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> habitant des montagnes.<br> <a href="#entry-paarvata" class="skt-link">pārvata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarzva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पार्श्व</span> <i>pārśva</i> <a href="#entry-paarzva" class="skt-link">n.</a> flanc, côté; côtes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à proximité de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>pārśvayos</i> adv. des deux côtés.<br> <i>pārśvam</i> prép. vers.<br> <i>pārśve</i> à côté de, près de, vers.<br> <i>pārśvāt</i> du côté de, loin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarzvaabhyudaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārśvābhyudaya</i> [<a href="#entry-abhyudaya" class="skt-link">abhyudaya</a>] <a href="#entry-paarzvaabhyudaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pārśvābhyudaya «Triomphe de <a href="#entry-Upaarzvanaatha" class="skt-link">Pārśvanātha</a>», prodige poétique de <a href="#entry-Ujinasena" class="skt-link">Jinasena</a> qui narre la vie du 23⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> en vers utilisant comme seconds hémistiches les vers successifs du <a href="#entry-Umeghaduuta" class="skt-link">Meghadūta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paarzva" class="skt-link">pārśva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarzvanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārśvanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-paarzvanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Pārśvanātha, 23⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a>; ascète du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant., il aurait fondé un ordre de 8 communautés; son corps est bleu foncé, son symbole est un cobra à 7 têtes; un grand temple l'honore à <a href="#entry-Ukhajuraaho" class="skt-link">Khajurāho</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paarzvatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pārśvatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. de côté; à côté (de ⟨g. iic.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पात्</span> <i>pāt</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pātayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pātita</i><i>)</i> faire tomber, abattre, jeter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातृ</span> <i>pātṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātrī</i> buveur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पात</span> <i>pāta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paata" class="skt-link">m.</a> vol, chute, descente, arrivée subite; accident; coup (d'épée) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. point nodal d'une orbite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paataala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाताल</span> <i>pātāla</i> [<a href="#entry-paata" class="skt-link">pāta</a><a href="#entry--ala" class="skt-link">-ala</a>] <a href="#entry-paataala" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. du monde [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] Pātāla, septième enfer souterrain; les dragons [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>] y habitent; <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> y règne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de la section [<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-Upaataala" class="skt-link">Pātāla</a> d'un <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a> traitant de mythes infernaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paataalezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātāleśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-paataalezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du Pātāleśvara «le Seigneur souterrain», temple shivaïste du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, creusé dans le roc dans la cave de <a href="#entry-Upa_ncaalezvara" class="skt-link">Pañcāleśvara</a> à Pune au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paataala" class="skt-link">pātāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातक</span> <i>pātaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paat" class="skt-link">pāt</a>] <a href="#entry-paataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> péché, crime [«qui fait déchoir (de sa caste)»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातव्य</span> <i>pātavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paatavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paatavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paatavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātavyā</i> que l'on doit boire.<br> <i>rugṇaiḥ</i> <i>auṣadhaṃ</i> <i>pātavyam</i> le remède doit être bu par les malades.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata_njala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातञ्जल</span> <i>pātañjala</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pata_njali" class="skt-link">patañjali</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paata_njala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paata_njala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paata_njalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātañjalī</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Upata_njali" class="skt-link">Patañjali</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata_njaladarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātañjaladarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] <a href="#entry-paata_njaladarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. np. du Pātañjaladarśana, doctrine du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> selon <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata_njalav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātañjalavṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-paata_njalav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Pātañjalavṛtti, glose du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a> dûe au roi <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uraajamaarta_n_da" class="skt-link">Rājamārtaṇḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata_njalav_rttivivara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātañjalavṛttivivaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vivara_na" class="skt-link">vivaraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-paata_njalav_rttivivara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pātañjalavṛttivivaraṇa, sous-commentaire du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> attribué par certains à <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paata_njalav_rtti" class="skt-link">pātañjalavṛtti</a> <br> <a href="#entry-paata_njala" class="skt-link">pātañjala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paata_njalayogazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātañjalayogaśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-yogazaastra" class="skt-link">yogaśāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-paata_njalayogazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pātañjalayogaśāstra de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a>, comprenant le <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> et son commentaire le <a href="#entry-Uyogabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Yogabhāṣya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातिन्</span> <i>pātin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paatin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paatin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paatinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātinī</i> qui tombe, qui vole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पातित</span> <i>pātita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paat" class="skt-link">pāt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paatita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paatita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paatitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātitā</i> tombé, jeté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पात्र</span> <i>pātra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> coupe, gobelet; bol, vase, pot, récipient (à boire) — <a href="#entry-paatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> (personne) digne de, apte à ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩; digne de recevoir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. personnage de théâtre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. conseiller royal, ministre — <a href="#entry-paatraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātrā</i> ifc. réceptacle de — <a href="#entry-paatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pātrī</i> vase, plat, pot.<br> <i>pātrīkṛ</i> faire de qqc. un récipient pour ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> honorer; décerner une distinction.<br> <i>pātrībhū</i> devenir une personne de mérite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-paatrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être un réceptacle pour ⟨g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> capacité, valeur; dignité, honneur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paatratva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pātratva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-paatratva" class="skt-link">n.</a> capacité, valeur; dignité, honneur.<br> <a href="#entry-paatra" class="skt-link">pātra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाव्</span> <i>pāv</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pāvayati)</i> faire nettoyer, faire purifier; purifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paavaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पावक</span> <i>pāvaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paavaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> feu [purificateur] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pāvaka «Purificateur», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.<br> <i>vasūnāṃ</i> <i>pāvakaścāsmi</i> [BhG.] Parmi les huit merveilles, je suis le Feu purificateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पावन</span> <i>pāvana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paavanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāvanī</i> pur, sacré; purifiant, purificateur — <a href="#entry-paavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> purification — <a href="#entry-paavanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāvanī</i> myth. np. de la Pāvanī, une <a href="#entry-divyagafgaa" class="skt-link">divyagaṅgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाय</span> <i>pāya</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-paaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पायस</span> <i>pāyasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-payas" class="skt-link">payas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paayasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paayasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paayasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāyasī</i> préparé avec du lait — <a href="#entry-paayasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> riz cuit dans du lait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पायिन्</span> <i>pāyin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-paayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāyinī</i> qui boit (régulièrement) ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>kaṣayapāyiṇo</i> <i>gāndhārāḥ</i> Les habitants du <a href="#entry-Ugandhaara" class="skt-link">Gandhāra</a> qui boivent régulièrement des jus de plantes pour rester en bonne santé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पायु</span> <i>pāyu</i> <a href="#entry-paayu" class="skt-link">m.</a> anus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la faculté [<a href="#entry-karmendriya" class="skt-link">karmendriya</a>] d'évacuation, dont le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a>; son élément [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] prédominant est <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a> la terre; la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] associée est l'odeur [<a href="#entry-gandha" class="skt-link">gandha</a>] qui excite le sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] de l'odorat [<a href="#entry-ghraa_na" class="skt-link">ghrāṇa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayudhvani">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāyudhvani</i> [<a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>] <a href="#entry-paayudhvani" class="skt-link">m.</a> pet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayuupastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāyūpastha</i> [<a href="#entry-upastha" class="skt-link">upastha</a>] <a href="#entry-paayuupastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> anus et parties génitales.<br> <a href="#entry-paayu" class="skt-link">pāyu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paayya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाय्य</span> <i>pāyya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paayya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paayyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāyyā</i> ⟨acc.⟩ à faire boire; à boire — <a href="#entry-paayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de boire — <a href="#entry-paayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाश</span> <i>pāśa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pazu" class="skt-link">paśu</a>] <a href="#entry-paaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lien, corde, chaîne; lacet, collet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. lacet-arme de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nœud; boucle (de cheveux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) lien, attachement — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(pāśayati)</i> attacher, lier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>paciscor</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazcaattya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाश्चात्त्य</span> <i>pāścāttya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pazcaat" class="skt-link">paścāt</a><a href="#entry--tya" class="skt-link">-tya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paazcaattya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paazcaattya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paazcaattyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāścāttyā</i> à l'Ouest; à l'arrière; postérieur; dernier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>pāścātya</i> f. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazcaatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाश्चात्य</span> <i>pāścātya</i> forme dégéminée de <a href="#entry-paazcaattya" class="skt-link">pāścāttya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazupaalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाशुपाल्य</span> <i>pāśupālya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pazupaalya" class="skt-link">paśupālya</a>] <a href="#entry-paazupaalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> élevage (de bétail).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazupata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाशुपत</span> <i>pāśupata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pazupati" class="skt-link">paśupati</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paazupatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāśupatī</i> sacré à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Upazupati" class="skt-link">Paśupati</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. qualifie une doctrine d'émancipation ascétique, courant <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> dévotionnel créé par <a href="#entry-Ulakuliiza" class="skt-link">Lakulīśa</a> — <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">m.</a> sectateur de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Upazupati" class="skt-link">Paśupati</a> — <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>pāśupatajñāna</i>] myth. np. du Pāśupata, arme céleste avec laquelle <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> trancha la cinquième tête de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, aussi appelée <a href="#entry-brahmaziras" class="skt-link">brahmaśiras</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> en donna le secret à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>, après l'avoir combattu [<a href="#entry-Ukiraataarjuniiya" class="skt-link">Kirātārjunīya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazupatasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāśupatasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-paazupatasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. lit. np. du Pāśupatasūtra; <a href="#entry-Ukau_n_dinya" class="skt-link">Kauṇḍinya</a> en fit le commentaire [<a href="#entry-Upa_ncaarthabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Pañcārthabhāṣya</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazupatavrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāśupatavrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-paazupatavrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. observances de la doctrine <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a>: adorer <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, répéter son nom, se couvrir de cendres, trangresser les normes sociales; not. rituel ascétique célébrant <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> sous sa forme <a href="#entry-Upazupati" class="skt-link">Paśupati</a>, donné dans un appendice [<a href="#entry-parizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">pariśiṣṭa</a>] de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uatharvaziras" class="skt-link">Atharvaśiras</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paazupatayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāśupatayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-paazupatayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pāśupatayoga, section du <a href="#entry-Uskandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Skandapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ncaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाञ्चाल</span> <i>pāñcāla</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">pañcāla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_ncaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāñcālī</i> relatif au peuple <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">pañcāla</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du roi Pāñcāla, qui s'attaqua à <a href="#entry-Usa_mvara_na" class="skt-link">Saṃvaraṇa</a> — <a href="#entry-paa_ncaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>pāñcālās</i> peuple des Pāñcālās; cf. <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍī</a> — <a href="#entry-paa_ncaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāñcālī</i> myth. np. de Pāñcālī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> «du pays <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">pañcāla</a>» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manière de parler [<a href="#entry-riiti" class="skt-link">rīti</a>] du <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">pañcāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ncajanya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाञ्चजन्य</span> <i>pāñcajanya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a>-<a href="#entry-janya" class="skt-link">janya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_ncajanya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncajanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncajanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāñcajanyā</i> relatif aux cinq races de l'humanité — <a href="#entry-paa_ncajanya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pāñcajanya, conque de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Appel de toutes les races»; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> la déroba à <a href="#entry-Upa_ncajana" class="skt-link">Pañcajana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ncaraatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाञ्चरात्र</span> <i>pāñcarātra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. doctrine des <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatraas" class="skt-link">pāñcarātrās</a> — <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>pāñcarātrās</i> soc. secte tantrique <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ncaraatrika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pāñcarātrika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatrika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatrika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pāñcarātrikā</i> qui dure 5 nuits (ou jours) — <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatrika" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. adepte de la doctrine <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pāñcarātra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pāñcarātra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paa_ncika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पाञ्चिक</span> <i>pāñcika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-paa_ncika" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Pāñcika, génie [<a href="#entry-yak_sa" class="skt-link">yakṣa</a>] des richesses et de la fécondité de la culture du <a href="#entry-Ugandhaara" class="skt-link">Gandhāra</a> (vers 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle); on le dit général en chef de l'armée de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>; son épouse est l'ogresse repentie <a href="#entry-Uhaariitii" class="skt-link">Hārītī</a>; on l'appelle aussi <a href="#entry-Ujambhala" class="skt-link">Jambhala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पच्</span> <i>pac</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pacati)</i> pft. <i>(papāca)</i> aor. ps. <i>(apāci)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(apīpacat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] <i>(apākṣat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pakva</i><i>)</i> ppft. <i>(pecivas)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>paktvā</i><i>)</i> cuire, cuisiner; rôtir, bouillir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> porter au feu (briques) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) consumer, tourmenter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cuire ⟨acc.⟩ à partir de ⟨acc.⟩ — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pacate)</i> cuire (pour soi) — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(pacyate)</i> mûrir; (intrans.) mijoter, devenir cuit — ps. <i>(pacyate)</i> mûrir (avec acc. du fruit) — ca. <i>(pācayati)</i> faire cuire — dés. <i>(pipakṣati)</i> vouloir cuire — int. md. <i>(pāpacyate)</i> cuire sans cesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>coquo</i>; ang. to cook.<br> <i>taṇḍulān</i> <i>odanam</i> <i>pacati</i> il cuit du riz à partir de grains.<br> <i>lokaḥ</i> <i>pacyamānaḥ</i> le monde en développement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pac_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पच्</span> <i>pac_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-pac_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pac_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pac_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> cuisson de ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पच</span> <i>paca</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] <a href="#entry-paca" class="skt-link">m.</a> cuisson — <a href="#entry-pacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pacā</i> cuisson; maturation — <a href="#entry-pacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pacā</i> ifc. qui cuit.<br> <i>śvapacaḥ</i> [«qui mange les chiens»] intouchable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पचक</span> <i>pacaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] <a href="#entry-pacaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> cuisinier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacakastrii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pacakastrī</i> [<a href="#entry-strii" class="skt-link">strī</a>] <a href="#entry-pacakastrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> cuisinière.<br> <a href="#entry-pacaka" class="skt-link">pacaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पचन</span> <i>pacana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] <a href="#entry-pacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cuisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पचत्</span> <i>pacat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-pac" class="skt-link">pac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pacat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pacat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pacantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pacantī</i> cuisant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पचत</span> <i>pacata</i> [<a href="#entry-pacat" class="skt-link">pacat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pacata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pacata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pacataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pacatā</i> cuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacata_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पचत</span> <i>pacata_1</i> [imp. <a href="#entry-khaad" class="skt-link">khād</a>] ind. cuisez!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pacatabh_rjjataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pacatabhṛjjatā</i> [<a href="#entry-bh_rjjata" class="skt-link">bhṛjjata</a>] <a href="#entry-pacatabh_rjjataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mets et grillades continuels.<br> <a href="#entry-pacata_1" class="skt-link">pacata_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pad_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद्</span> <i>pad_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(padyate)</i> fut. md. <i>(patsyate)</i> pft. <i>(papāda)</i> pft. md. <i>(pede)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>panna</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ati</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> aller, marcher, se rendre à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tomber, plonger — ca. <i>(pādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pādita</i><i>)</i> faire aller — int. md. <i>(panīpadyate)</i> int. md. <i>(panīpadīti)</i> aller rapidement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pad_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद्</span> <i>pad_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui va <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a tant ⟨iic.⟩ de pieds — <a href="#entry-padii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद</span> <i>pada</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">n.</a> pas, enjambée; case d'échiquier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (empreinte de) pied; pied (mesure de longueur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lieu, place, séjour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trace, signe; position, rang, titre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> quart de strophe, vers; mot (fléchi) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. th. nominal; syn. <a href="#entry-praatipadika" class="skt-link">prātipadika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. forme de conjugaison d'un verbe déterminant ses suffixes (<a href="#entry-parasmaipada" class="skt-link">parasmaipada</a> pour la voix active, <a href="#entry-aatmanepada" class="skt-link">ātmanepada</a> pour la voie moyenne ou réfléchie) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. racine carrée; quadrant.<br> <i>padena</i> adv. à pied.<br> <i>padaṃ</i> <i>dā</i> faire un pas, se déplacer.<br> <i>padaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> faire un pas dans ⟨loc.⟩, entrer.<br> <i>padam</i> <i>ātan</i> s'étendre, améliorer sa position.<br> <i>padaṃ</i> <i>dhā</i> suivre les traces de, rivaliser avec ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>padaṃ</i> <i>nidhā</i> poser le pied sur ⟨loc.⟩; (au fig.) faire impression.<br> <i>pade</i> <i>pade</i> adv. à chaque pas; en toute occasion.<br> <i>trīṇi</i> <i>padāni</i> <i>viṣṇoḥ</i> myth. les trois enjambées de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Utrivikrama" class="skt-link">Trivikrama</a>.<br> <i>viṣṇoḥ</i> <i>pādau</i> myth. les pieds de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> (emplacement entre les deux sourcils où l'on appose la marque sectaire [<a href="#entry-uurdhvapu_n_dra" class="skt-link">ūrdhvapuṇḍra</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, c.-à-d. deux marques verticales).<br> <i>śaktaṃ</i> <i>padam</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] Un mot, c'est ce qui a un pouvoir expressif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaanukrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padānukrama</i> [<a href="#entry-anukrama" class="skt-link">anukrama</a>] <a href="#entry-padaanukrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. concordance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. signification d'un mot, dénotation; notion, concept; entité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] catégorie ou modalité; on en compte 6: <a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a> des substances, <a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a> des propriétés ou espèces, <a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a> des activités, <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a> des substrats génériques, <a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a> des substrats discriminatifs, et <a href="#entry-samavaaya" class="skt-link">samavāya</a> des inhérences <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] entité concevable et nommable; concept dénotable; on en compte 7 catégories: <a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a> (substance), <a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a> (qualité), <a href="#entry-kriyaa" class="skt-link">kriyā</a> (action), <a href="#entry-jaati" class="skt-link">jāti</a> (généricité), <a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a> (individualité), <a href="#entry-samavaaya" class="skt-link">samavāya</a> (inhérence) et <a href="#entry-abhaava" class="skt-link">abhāva</a> (absence); <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> conteste ces catégories et en propose d'autres <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Uzivaananda" class="skt-link">Śivānanda</a>] objet qui peut être conceptualisé et nommé — ifc. gram. catégorie de mot composé; <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a> distingue les types <a href="#entry-puurvapadaartha" class="skt-link">pūrvapadārtha</a>, <a href="#entry-uttarapadaartha" class="skt-link">uttarapadārtha</a>, <a href="#entry-anyapadaartha" class="skt-link">anyapadārtha</a>, et <a href="#entry-ubhayapadaartha" class="skt-link">ubhayapadārtha</a>, suivant la dépendance sémantique du composé envers ses constituants.<br> <i>vyaktyākṛtijātayastu</i> <i>padārthāḥ</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Unyaayadarzana" class="skt-link">Nyāyadarśana</a>] Les entités signifiantes combinent trois aspects: le caractère générique [<a href="#entry-jaati" class="skt-link">jāti</a>], l'aspect [<a href="#entry-aak_rti" class="skt-link">ākṛti</a>] et l'objet individuel [<a href="#entry-vyakti" class="skt-link">vyakti</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaarthadharmasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārthadharmasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>-<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-padaarthadharmasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Padārthadharmasaṃgraha «Traité des lois de la classification des concepts», ouvrage de <a href="#entry-Uprazastapaada" class="skt-link">Praśastapāda</a> commentant le <a href="#entry-Uvaize_sikasuutra" class="skt-link">Vaiśeṣikasūtra</a>, mais apportant aussi d'importantes contributions nouvelles à la doctrine discriminative [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaarthaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārthaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padaarthaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padaarthaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padaarthikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padārthikā</i> qui a pour signification.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaarthakha_n_dana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārthakhaṇḍana</i> [<a href="#entry-kha_n_dana" class="skt-link">khaṇḍana</a>] <a href="#entry-padaarthakha_n_dana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Padārthakhaṇḍana «Réexamen des catégories sémantiques»; cf. <a href="#entry-Upadaarthatattvaniruupa_na" class="skt-link">Padārthatattvanirūpaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaarthatattvaniruupa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārthatattvanirūpaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>-<a href="#entry-niruupa_na" class="skt-link">nirūpaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padaarthatattvaniruupa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Padārthatattvanirūpaṇa «Investigation à propos du sens», ouvrage de sémantique [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Uziroma_ni" class="skt-link">Śiromaṇi</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Upadaarthakha_n_dana" class="skt-link">Padārthakhaṇḍana</a> par les commentateurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaarthokti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padārthokti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-padaarthokti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. explication de la signification d'un mot.<br> <a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaatin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पदातिन्</span> <i>padātin</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a><a href="#entry--tin" class="skt-link">-tin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padaatin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padaatin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padaatinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padātinī</i> qui va à pied, piéton; fantassin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>padāti</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pion des échecs [<a href="#entry-caturafgaa" class="skt-link">caturaṅgā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaccheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padaccheda</i> [<a href="#entry-cheda" class="skt-link">cheda</a>] <a href="#entry-padaccheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. segmentation, décomposition en mots d'une phrase; analyse de composés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padadarzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padadarśin</i> [<a href="#entry-darzin" class="skt-link">darśin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padadarzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padadarzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padadarzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padadarśinī</i> gram. tenant de la théorie selon laquelle le mot est l'unité de signification; opp. <a href="#entry-vaakyadarzin" class="skt-link">vākyadarśin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padak_rtya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padakṛtya</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rtya" class="skt-link">kṛtya</a>] <a href="#entry-padak_rtya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Padakṛtya, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Ucandrasi_mha" class="skt-link">Candrasiṃha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padama_njarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padamañjarī</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_njarii" class="skt-link">mañjarī</a>] <a href="#entry-padama_njarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Padamañjarī «Bouquet de mots», commentaire de la <a href="#entry-Ukaazikaa" class="skt-link">Kāśikā</a> <a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>, composé par <a href="#entry-Uharadatta" class="skt-link">Haradatta</a> vers 1100.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padani_spatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padaniṣpatti</i> [<a href="#entry-ni_spatti" class="skt-link">niṣpatti</a>] <a href="#entry-padani_spatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. dérivation morphologique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padapaa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padapāṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. récitation du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> par la lecture mot à mot sans application du <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaapaa_tha" class="skt-link">saṃhitāpāṭha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Padapāṭha du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>, dû à <a href="#entry-Uzaakalya" class="skt-link">Śākalya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. plus gén. décomposition en mots d'une énonciation par inversion des règles euphoniques [<a href="#entry-sandhiviccheda" class="skt-link">sandhiviccheda</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-sandhirahita" class="skt-link">sandhirahita</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaparicaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padaparicaya</i> [<a href="#entry-paricaya" class="skt-link">paricaya</a>] <a href="#entry-padaparicaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. analyse morphologique d'un mot ou d'un texte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padapuurvaardha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padapūrvārdha</i> [<a href="#entry-puurvaardha" class="skt-link">pūrvārdha</a>] <a href="#entry-padapuurvaardha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padapuurvaardha" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. thème (opp. <a href="#entry-padottaraardha" class="skt-link">padottarārdha</a> suffixe).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padapuurvaardhavakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padapūrvārdhavakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-padapuurvaardhavakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique de l'usage lexical.<br> <a href="#entry-padapuurvaardha" class="skt-link">padapūrvārdha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padarak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padarakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-rak_sa" class="skt-link">rakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-padarak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> sandale de bois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padaspho_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padasphoṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">sphoṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-padaspho_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. pouvoir évocatif d'un mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padavaakyapramaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padavākyapramāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>-<a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">pramāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padavaakyapramaa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. le mot, la phrase et le jugement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padavaakyapramaa_naj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padavākyapramāṇajña</i> [<a href="#entry-j_na" class="skt-link">jña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padavaakyapramaa_naj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padavaakyapramaa_naj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padavaakyapramaa_naj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padavākyapramāṇajñā</i> phil. [«qui connaît le mot la phrase et le jugement»] savant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padavibhaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padavibhāga</i> [<a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">vibhāga</a>] <a href="#entry-padavibhaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. division en mots d'une phrase (par analyse du <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padavii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padavī</i> [<a href="#entry-vii_2" class="skt-link">vī_2</a>] <a href="#entry-padavii" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. guide; prophète — <a href="#entry-padavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> trace, sentier, chemin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> situation, endroit, site <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) voie; niveau, statut.<br> <i>padavyāṃ</i> <i>nidhā</i> suivre les traces de, rivaliser avec ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>vivādapadavīṃ</i> <i>prāptau</i> <i>samau</i> <i>sāmānyabhūmipau</i> [KSs.] Au tribunal, les rois et les gens ordinaires sont traités pareillement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padayaatraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padayātrā</i> [<a href="#entry-yaatraa" class="skt-link">yātrā</a>] <a href="#entry-padayaatraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pélerinage à pied.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paddhati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paddhati</i> [<a href="#entry-hati" class="skt-link">hati</a>] <a href="#entry-paddhati" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«frappé par le pied»] trace, chemin, sentier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> guide, manuel, ouvrage d'apprentissage; bréviaire, liturgie; not. guide de rituel védique; syn. <a href="#entry-prayoga" class="skt-link">prayoga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moyen, technique; système.<br> <a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">pad_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद्म</span> <i>padma</i> <a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Nelumbium speciosum</i>, lotus rose; c'est un symbole de beauté et de pureté — <a href="#entry-padmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padmā</i> myth. np. de Padmā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a> «pure comme le lotus» — <a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">n.</a> math. un milliard.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-padmaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture des jambes croisées «en lotus» (jambe gauche repliée sur l'aine droite, jambe droite symétrique au-dessus).<br> <a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">padma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmaavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padmaavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padmaavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padmaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padmāvatī</i> np. «qui porte le lotus» — <a href="#entry-padmaavat" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Padmāvatī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a> «portant le lotus» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Padmāvatī_1, une épouse d'<a href="#entry-Uazoka" class="skt-link">Aśoka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [KSs.] np. de Padmāvatī_2, fille du roi <a href="#entry-Upradyota_1" class="skt-link">Pradyota_1</a> du <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>; [<a href="#entry-Usvapnavaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">Svapnavāsavadattā</a>] elle est fille du roi <a href="#entry-Udarzaka" class="skt-link">Darśaka</a>; le roi <a href="#entry-Upradyota" class="skt-link">Pradyota</a> demanda sa main pour son fils, mais elle épousa <a href="#entry-Uudayana" class="skt-link">Udayana</a> après bien des péripéties.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmabandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-padmabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. poème géométrique [<a href="#entry-citrakaavya" class="skt-link">citrakāvya</a>] en forme de lotus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmabhuu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmabhūṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">bhūṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padmabhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. décoration civile (légion d'honneur indienne).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmacara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmacaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-cara_na" class="skt-link">caraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padmacara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-padmapaada" class="skt-link">padmapāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmanaabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmanābha</i> [<a href="#entry-naabhi" class="skt-link">nābhi</a>] <a href="#entry-padmanaabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Padmanābha, aspect de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a> «dont le nombril porte un lotus».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmanaabhasvaamin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmanābhasvāmin</i> [<a href="#entry-svaamin" class="skt-link">svāmin</a>] <a href="#entry-padmanaabhasvaamin" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. temple <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> de Padmanābhasvāmī, à <a href="#entry-Uanantazayana" class="skt-link">Anantaśayana</a> (mod. Trivandrum) au <a href="#entry-Ukerala" class="skt-link">Kerala</a>; le temple d'origine est du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, le <a href="#entry-gopura" class="skt-link">gopura</a> construit en 1566; le temple présent fut construit en 1750 par le roi Mārtaṇḍa <a href="#entry-Uvarmaa" class="skt-link">Varmā</a> qui prit le titre, avec ses descendants, de <a href="#entry-Upadmanaabha" class="skt-link">Padmanābha</a> <a href="#entry-Udaasa" class="skt-link">Dāsa</a>; la statue couchée de <a href="#entry-Upadmanaabha" class="skt-link">Padmanābha</a> y fait 6 m de long; on dit qu'elle est faite de 12008 <a href="#entry-zaalagraama" class="skt-link">śālagrāma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-padmanaabha" class="skt-link">padmanābha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmanaabhatiirtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmanābhatīrtha</i> [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] <a href="#entry-padmanaabhatiirtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Padmanābhatīrtha, disciple principal de <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a>; à la mort du maître, il devint le pontife de l'ordre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmanidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmanidhi</i> [<a href="#entry-nidhi" class="skt-link">nidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-padmanidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Padmanidhi, l'un des 9 trésors de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> [<a href="#entry-navanidhi" class="skt-link">navanidhi</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmapaa_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmapāṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_ni" class="skt-link">pāṇi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padmapaa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padmapaa_ni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padmapaa_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui tient un lotus — <a href="#entry-padmapaa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Padmapāṇi, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uavalokitezvara" class="skt-link">Avalokiteśvara</a> «tenant un lotus».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-padmapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Padmapāda ou Padmacaraṇa «Pied de lotus», disciple de <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a>; on lui doit l'exégèse <a href="#entry-Upa_ncapaadikaa" class="skt-link">Pañcapādikā</a> de son commentaire <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutra" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtra</a> <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmaprabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmaprabha</i> [<a href="#entry-prabha" class="skt-link">prabha</a>] <a href="#entry-padmaprabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Padmaprabha «Splendeur de Lotus», 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son symbole est une fleur de lotus rouge <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de l'astronome jaïne Padmaprabha_1 <a href="#entry-Usuuri" class="skt-link">Sūri</a>, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ubhuvanadiipaka" class="skt-link">Bhuvanadīpaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padmapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Padmapurāṇa ou Pādmapurāṇa [PP.], énorme recueil mythologique, en 5 parties [<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>]: <a href="#entry-Us_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">Sṛṣṭi</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhuumi" class="skt-link">Bhūmi</a>, <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a>, <a href="#entry-Upaataala" class="skt-link">Pātāla</a>, <a href="#entry-Uuttara" class="skt-link">Uttara</a>; il inculque le culte de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; il en existe deux recensions; sa rédaction s'étend sur plusieurs siècles à partir du 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, ses parties tardives sont postérieures au <a href="#entry-Ubhaagavatapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhāgavatapurāṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-saattvika" class="skt-link">sāttvika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. d'un texte sacré <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a> du 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il relate les exploits de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmaraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmarāga</i> [<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] <a href="#entry-padmaraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> rubis [«de la couleur du lotus»] — <a href="#entry-padmaraagii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padmarāgī</i> myth. l'une des 7 langues d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> [<a href="#entry-saptajihva" class="skt-link">saptajihva</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmasambhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmasambhava</i> [<a href="#entry-sambhava" class="skt-link">sambhava</a>] <a href="#entry-padmasambhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Padmasambhava «Issu du lotus», moine fondateur de la secte des bonnets rouges au Tibet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmavar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmavarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padmavar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padmavar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padmavar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padmavarṇā</i> au teint de lotus — <a href="#entry-padmavar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Padmavarṇa, un fils de <a href="#entry-Uyadu" class="skt-link">Yadu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padmavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padmavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padmavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padmavatī</i> plein de fleurs de lotus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmavibhuu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmavibhūṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vibhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">vibhūṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-padmavibhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. décoration civile (officier de la légion d'honneur indienne).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmazrii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padmaśrī</i> [<a href="#entry-zrii" class="skt-link">śrī</a>] iic. mod. (titre) honorable (décoration civile, mérite indien).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padmin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद्मिन्</span> <i>padmin</i> [<a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">padma</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padmin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padmin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padminī</i> qui tient un lotus — <a href="#entry-padminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padminī</i> natu. bot. <i>Nelumbium speciosum</i>, lotus rose <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excellente femme, noble dame.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padottaraardha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padottarārdha</i> [<a href="#entry-uttaraardha" class="skt-link">uttarārdha</a>] <a href="#entry-padottaraardha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padottaraardha" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. suffixe (opp. <a href="#entry-padapuurvaardha" class="skt-link">padapūrvārdha</a> thème).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padottaraardhavakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>padottarārdhavakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-padottaraardhavakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique de l'usage des suffixes.<br> <a href="#entry-padottaraardha" class="skt-link">padottarārdha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-padya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पद्य</span> <i>padya</i> [<a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">pad_2</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-padya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-padya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-padyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padyā</i> relatif au pied; relatif à un vers; en vers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui porte des marques de pas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de telle longueur en pieds — <a href="#entry-padya" class="skt-link">n.</a> vers; stance de 4 vers [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mètre; poésie (opp. <a href="#entry-gadya" class="skt-link">gadya</a>) — <a href="#entry-padyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>padyā</i> pl. traces de pas; enjambées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pafgu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पङ्गु</span> <i>paṅgu</i> a. <a href="#entry-pafgu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pafgu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pafguu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paṅgū</i> boiteux; infirme des jambes — <a href="#entry-pafgu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Paṅgu, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uzani" class="skt-link">Śani</a> «qui traîne la patte».<br> <i>andhapaṅgunyāya</i> maxime de l'aveugle et du paralytique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pafgutaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṅgutā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pafgutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> claudication.<br> <a href="#entry-pafgu" class="skt-link">paṅgu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पङ्क</span> <i>paṅka</i> <a href="#entry-pafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> boue, fange <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pâte, onguent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) souillure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pafkaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paṅkaja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-pafkaja" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. [«né de la boue»] bot. <i>Nelumbium speciosum</i>, lotus rose.<br> <a href="#entry-pafka" class="skt-link">paṅka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pafkti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पङ्क्ति</span> <i>paṅkti</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncan" class="skt-link">pañcan</a>] <a href="#entry-pafkti" class="skt-link">f.</a> série de 5, groupe de 5, pentade <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> série, collection, groupe; rang, rangée (not. pour s'asseoir à un repas) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mètre véd. de 5 fois 8 syllabes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du cheval Paṅkti, attelé au char de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>.<br> <i>sarpapaṅkti</i> nœud de serpents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pahlava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पह्लव</span> <i>pahlava</i> <a href="#entry-pahlava" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>pahlavās</i> nom d'un peuple du nord-ouest de l'Inde (les Iraniens-Parthes) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [VP.] ils sont considérés comme un peuple <a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a> déchu; conquis par <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a>, ils furent astreints à porter la barbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paifga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैङ्ग</span> <i>paiṅga</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">piṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paifga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paifga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paifgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paiṅgī</i> concernant la souris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paifgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैङ्गल</span> <i>paiṅgala</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">piṅgala</a>] <a href="#entry-paifgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. patr. de <a href="#entry-Upifgala" class="skt-link">Piṅgala</a> — <a href="#entry-paifgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du manuel de <a href="#entry-Upifgala_2" class="skt-link">Piṅgala_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैल</span> <i>paila</i> <a href="#entry-paila" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage Paila, un compilateur du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paippalaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैप्पलाद</span> <i>paippalāda</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pippalaada" class="skt-link">pippalāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paippalaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paippalaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paippalaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paippalādā</i> lit. relatif à <a href="#entry-Upippalaada" class="skt-link">Pippalāda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>paippalādasaṃhitā</i>] lit. qualifie la recension Paippalāda de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a> selon l'école de <a href="#entry-Upippalaada" class="skt-link">Pippalāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paippalaadopani_sad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paippalādopaniṣad</i> [<a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>] <a href="#entry-paippalaadopani_sad" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Paippalādopaniṣad; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzarabhopani_sad" class="skt-link">Śarabhopaniṣad</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paippalaada" class="skt-link">paippalāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paitaamaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैतामह</span> <i>paitāmaha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pitaamaha" class="skt-link">pitāmaha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paitaamaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paitaamahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paitāmahī</i> relatif au grand-père <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> issu de ou concernant <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> — <a href="#entry-paitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. patr. de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. les ancêtres — <a href="#entry-paitaamaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. épith. du <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> de <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_1" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paizaaca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पैशाच</span> <i>paiśāca</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pizaaca" class="skt-link">piśāca</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paizaaca" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paizaaca" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paizaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paiśācī</i> myth. propre aux <a href="#entry-pizaacaas" class="skt-link">piśācās</a>; diabolique, infernal — <a href="#entry-paizaaca" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. nom d'un mode de mariage (en abusant d'une femme endormie, enivrée ou faible d'esprit) — <a href="#entry-paizaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paiśācī</i> hist. langue moyen-indienne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पक्ष</span> <i>pakṣa</i> <a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> aile, plume <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> côté, flanc, épaule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faction, parti; multitude, troupe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> point de vue, alternative; opinion, thèse; parti-pris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> partisan, adhérent, sympathisant; adepte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moitié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. demi-lunaison, quinzaine; cf. <a href="#entry-zukla" class="skt-link">śukla</a>, <a href="#entry-k_r_s_na" class="skt-link">kṛṣṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] hypothèse; terme mineur d'un syllogisme.<br> <i>pakṣāntare</i> dans l'autre cas, d'autre part.<br> <i>pakṣīkṛ</i> s'approprier; prendre position.<br> <i>sandigdhasādhyavān</i> <i>pakṣaḥ</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] Le sujet est ce qui est conjecturé du prédicat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sa_sa_s_thii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣaṣaṣṭhī</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">ṣaṣṭhī</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sa_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. tantr. forme ailée de <a href="#entry-U_sa_s_thii" class="skt-link">Ṣaṣṭhī</a>-<a href="#entry-Uzakunii" class="skt-link">Śakunī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_saantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_saantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> alternative.<br> <a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sadhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣadhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sadhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du logicien <a href="#entry-Ujayadeva_2" class="skt-link">Jayadeva_2</a> Pakṣadhara de <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a> (~1424–~1500); <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Uziroma_ni" class="skt-link">Śiromaṇi</a> le prit pour maître, après des débuts difficiles dus à son insolence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sadharmataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣadharmatā</i> [<a href="#entry-dharmataa" class="skt-link">dharmatā</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sadharmataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] nature inhérente au sujet d'une prédication, montrant que le sujet vérifie le prédicat.<br> <i>hetoḥ</i> <i>pakṣavṛttitvaṃ</i> <i>pakṣadharmatā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] La nature inhérente au sujet est la présence de la cause dans le sujet.<br> <i>vyāptiviśiṣṭapakṣadharmatā</i> <i>jñānam</i> <i>parāmarśaḥ</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] L'inférence est la connaissance de la nature inhérente au sujet qualifié par la concomitance inévitable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sapaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣapāta</i> [<a href="#entry-paata" class="skt-link">pāta</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sapaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> partialité, parti-pris [«chute d'un côté»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पक्षस्</span> <i>pakṣas</i> [<a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sas" class="skt-link">n.</a> aile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> côté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> encadrement d'une porte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aile d'une armée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_sataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être partisan; adhésion à un parti <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. adhésion à un argument; défense d'une thèse.<br> <i>pakṣatāṃ</i> <i>gam</i> prendre le parti de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_satva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pakṣatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pak_satva" class="skt-link">n.</a> ifc. adhésion à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pak_savat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
