<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परोक्ष</span> <i>parokṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-paras" class="skt-link">paras</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-parok_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parokṣā</i> hors de portée de la vue; invisible; opp. <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">pratyakṣa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> absent; étranger, inconnu; incompréhensible; secret — <a href="#entry-parok_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parokṣā</i> gram. temps du parfait; sa conjugaison [<a href="#entry-vibhakti" class="skt-link">vibhakti</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-li_t" class="skt-link">liṭ</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(parokṣāyate)</i> agir comme si hors de portée de vue.<br> <i>parokṣam</i> var. <i>parokṣe</i> adv. hors de la vue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à l'insu de, en l'absence de, derrière le dos de ⟨i. g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>parokṣāt</i> adv. secrètement, à l'insu de ⟨i.⟩.<br> <i>parokṣeṇa</i> adv. hors de la vue; secrètement, mystérieusement.<br> <i>paro'kṣakāmā</i> <i>hi</i> <i>devāḥ</i> Les dieux aiment le mystère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_saartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parokṣārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-parok_saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_saartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_saarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parokṣārthā</i> phil. dont le sens est secret — <a href="#entry-parok_saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> chose cachée à la vue.<br> <a href="#entry-parok_sa" class="skt-link">parokṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_sak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parokṣakṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-parok_sak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_sak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-parok_sak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parokṣakṛtā</i> soc. se dit d'un hymne dans lequel la divinité est adressée à la 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ personne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_sataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parokṣatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-parok_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> invisibilité; imperceptibilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_satva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parokṣatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-parok_satva" class="skt-link">n.</a> invisibilité; imperceptibilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parok_savaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parokṣavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-parok_savaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. doctrine ésotérique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paropakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परोपकार</span> <i>paropakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>-<a href="#entry-upakaara" class="skt-link">upakāra</a>] <a href="#entry-paropakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> secours, aide; bénéfice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paropakaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paropakārin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paropakaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paropakaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paropakaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paropakāriṇī</i> charitable.<br> <a href="#entry-paropakaara" class="skt-link">paropakāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paropakaaritva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paropakāritva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-paropakaaritva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de porter secours à autrui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paropataapitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परोपतापित्व</span> <i>paropatāpitva</i> [<a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>-<a href="#entry-upataapitva" class="skt-link">upatāpitva</a>] <a href="#entry-paropataapitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> action de faire du mal à autrui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parovaram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परोवरम्</span> <i>parovaram</i> [<a href="#entry-paras" class="skt-link">paras</a>-<a href="#entry-vara_2" class="skt-link">vara_2</a>] adv. en succession.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parpa_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्पट</span> <i>parpaṭa</i> <a href="#entry-parpa_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> fine galette de farine de lentille, frite ou grillée; mod. <i>pappaḍam</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paru_s_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परुष्णी</span> <i>paruṣṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-paru_sa" class="skt-link">paruṣa</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-paru_s_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la rivière Paruṣṇī (mod. Rāvī), qui coule au Pañjāb; cf. <a href="#entry-daazaraaj_na" class="skt-link">dāśarājña</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paru_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">परुष</span> <i>paruṣa</i> a. <a href="#entry-paru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paru_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paru_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paruṣā</i> dur, rude, grossier, désagréable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> âpre, raide; raide (cheveu); sale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्व</span> <i>parva</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvadhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parvadhi</i> [<a href="#entry-dhi" class="skt-link">dhi</a>] <a href="#entry-parvadhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> la Lune [«qui porte les phases»].<br> <a href="#entry-parva" class="skt-link">parva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्वन्</span> <i>parvan</i> <a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> nœud (d'une tige), joint, articulation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> membre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. section d'un livre; not. l'une des 18 sections du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>: <a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>, <a href="#entry-sabhaa" class="skt-link">sabhā</a>, <a href="#entry-vana" class="skt-link">vana</a>, <a href="#entry-viraa_ta" class="skt-link">virāṭa</a>, <a href="#entry-udyoga" class="skt-link">udyoga</a>, <a href="#entry-bhii_sma" class="skt-link">bhīṣma</a>, <a href="#entry-dro_na" class="skt-link">droṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-kar_na" class="skt-link">karṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-zalya" class="skt-link">śalya</a>, <a href="#entry-sauptika" class="skt-link">sauptika</a>, <a href="#entry-strii" class="skt-link">strī</a>, <a href="#entry-zaanti" class="skt-link">śānti</a>, <a href="#entry-anuzaasana" class="skt-link">anuśāsana</a>, <a href="#entry-aazvamedhika" class="skt-link">āśvamedhika</a>, <a href="#entry-aazramavaasika" class="skt-link">āśramavāsika</a>, <a href="#entry-mausala" class="skt-link">mausala</a>, <a href="#entry-mahaaprasthaanika" class="skt-link">mahāprasthānika</a>, et <a href="#entry-svargaaroha_na" class="skt-link">svargārohaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasion, moment favorable; jour décisif, jour fatal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. fête, jour consacré; not. festival de <a href="#entry-caaturmaasya" class="skt-link">cāturmāsya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. quinzaine (lunaire); l'un des 4 jours marquant les phases d'un mois lunaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्वत</span> <i>parvata</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-parvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> montagne; chaîne de montagnes; colline; rocher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 7 (pour les 7 chaînes de montagnes) — <a href="#entry-parvataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parvatā</i> ifc. montagne de, tas de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvataagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parvatāgra</i> [<a href="#entry-agra" class="skt-link">agra</a>] <a href="#entry-parvataagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> sommet.<br> <a href="#entry-parvata" class="skt-link">parvata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvatamastaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parvatamastaka</i> [<a href="#entry-mastaka" class="skt-link">mastaka</a>] <a href="#entry-parvatamastaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parvatamastaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> sommet d'une montagne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parvatavaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>parvatavāsin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasin_1" class="skt-link">vāsin_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-parvatavaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parvatavaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-parvatavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parvatavāsinī</i> qui habite les montagnes — <a href="#entry-parvatavaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> montagnard — <a href="#entry-parvatavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>parvatavāsinī</i> natu. bot. <i>Nardostachys grandiflora</i>, nard indien; son rhizome est utilisé pour son parfum et en médecine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parya_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्यट्</span> <i>paryaṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>-<a href="#entry-a_t" class="skt-link">aṭ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(paryaṭate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>paryaṭita</i><i>)</i> errer; voyager à travers ⟨acc. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-parya_tita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्यटित</span> <i>paryaṭita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-parya_t" class="skt-link">paryaṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-parya_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-parya_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-parya_titaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paryaṭitā</i> qui a erré — <a href="#entry-parya_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> pérégrination.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaabhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याभू</span> <i>paryābhū</i> [<a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>-<a href="#entry-aabhuu_1" class="skt-link">ābhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(paryābhavati)</i> se renverser.<br> <i>dakṣiṇena</i> <i>ced</i> <i>yāyāṃ</i> <i>tarhi</i> <i>na</i> <i>śakaṭaṃ</i> <i>paryābhavet</i> Je préfère aller par le Sud pour éviter que le chariot ne se renverse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaakula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याकुल</span> <i>paryākula</i> [<a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>-<a href="#entry-aakula" class="skt-link">ākula</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paryaakula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaakula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaakulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paryākulā</i> troublé, agité; confus — ifc. plein de, rempli de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याप्</span> <i>paryāp</i> [<a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>-<a href="#entry-aap" class="skt-link">āp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(paryāpnoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>paryāpta</i><i>)</i> cesser, se borner à — dés. <i>(parīpsati)</i> désirer, désirer obtenir — pr. md. <i>(paryāpnute)</i> chercher à atteindre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याप्त</span> <i>paryāpta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paryaap" class="skt-link">paryāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paryaapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaaptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paryāptā</i> obtenu, gagné; suffisant, abondant; adéquat <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> complet, parfait, fini.<br> <i>paryāptam</i> adv. complètement; assez, suffisamment, à volonté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याप्ति</span> <i>paryāpti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paryaap" class="skt-link">paryāp</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaapti" class="skt-link">f.</a> complétion; finition, achèvement; conclusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> complétude; suffisance; totalité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obtention, acquisition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adéquation, pertinence; fait d'être approprié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. distinction des objets selon leurs propriétés; intensionnalité — ifc. propre à, qui sert à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaaptiniveza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāptiniveśa</i> [<a href="#entry-niveza" class="skt-link">niveśa</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaaptiniveza" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] insertion de pertinence.<br> <a href="#entry-paryaapti" class="skt-link">paryāpti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्यास</span> <i>paryāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paryas" class="skt-link">paryas</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de tailler; rotation; résolution <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conclusion; not. strophes de conclusion d'un hymne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्यासित</span> <i>paryāsita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-paryas" class="skt-link">paryas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paryaasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paryāsitā</i> jeté; détruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पर्याय</span> <i>paryāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-parii" class="skt-link">parī</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> tour, révolution, parcours; répétition, succession; manière de procéder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> période, intervalle de temps; fois <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> suite récurrente; formule répétée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> synonyme; terme équivalent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. développement normal d'un phénomène du début à sa fin.<br> <i>paryāyeṇa</i> adv. l'un après l'autre; successivement; alternativement.<br> <i>tava</i> <i>paryāyaḥ</i> c'est ton tour.<br> <i>mama</i> <i>paryāyaḥ</i> c'est mon tour.<br> <i>caturthe</i> <i>paryāye</i> à la 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyabandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaayabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. ensemble de vers indépendants traitant d'un même sujet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayacyuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyacyuta</i> [<a href="#entry-cyuta" class="skt-link">cyuta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paryaayacyuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaayacyuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paryaayacyutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paryāyacyutā</i> qui a perdu son tour; évincé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayakrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyakrama</i> [<a href="#entry-krama" class="skt-link">krama</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaayakrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> ordre de succession; tour normal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaayapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. mot synonyme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayavakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyavakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaayavakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique de l'usage des synonymes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. périodiquement; successivement, l'un après l'autre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paryaayokta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paryāyokta</i> [<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] <a href="#entry-paryaayokta" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. figure de style [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] où le fait signifié est évoqué par une tournure ou une paraphrase.<br> <a href="#entry-paryaaya" class="skt-link">paryāya</a>
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(patati)</i> pft. <i>(papāta)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>patita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>patitvā</i>, <i>-patya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ava</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> aller d'un mouvement rapide ou continu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tomber <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) déchoir; pécher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> voler — ca. <i>(pātayati)</i> faire tomber, abattre, jeter — dés. <i>(pipatiṣati)</i> s'apprêter à voler ou tomber — int. <i>(pāpatīti)</i> fondre sur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>peto</i>, <i>impetus</i>.<br> <i>aśvāt</i> <i>patati</i> il tombe de cheval.<br> <i>narakaṃ</i> <i>patati</i> il tombe en enfer.
  </div>
</div>

(dramaturgie) épisode ou évènement d'un récit ou d'une pièce de théâtre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chance, bonne fortune.

</div>

  </div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patatrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pata_njali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पतञ्जलि</span> <i>patañjali</i> <a href="#entry-pata_njali" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Patañjali_1, grammairien du 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant., originaire de <a href="#entry-Ugonarda" class="skt-link">Gonarda</a>; il est l'auteur du grand commentaire <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Mahābhāṣya</a> sur la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>; on le dit incarnation d'<a href="#entry-Uaadize_sa" class="skt-link">Ādiśeṣa</a>; on le représente comme un buste humain sur un corps de serpent, en posture d'<a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">añjali</a> et tenant la conque [<a href="#entry-zafkha" class="skt-link">śaṅkha</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du philosophe Patañjali_2, auteur antique du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a>, compilation d'aphorismes sur le <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>, de date controversée (4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle?) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du sage Patañjali, forme déifiée identifiant les deux précédents avec <a href="#entry-Ucaraka" class="skt-link">Caraka</a>; il est à la fois initiateur du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>, transmetteur de l'<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a> et grammairien suprême du sanskrit; en tant que réincarnation de <a href="#entry-Uze_sa" class="skt-link">Śeṣa</a>, on le représente en <a href="#entry-Uaadinaaga" class="skt-link">Ādināga</a> avec un corps de serpent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-path">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पथ्</span> <i>path</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pathati)</i> aller, se déplacer — ca. <i>(pāthayati)</i> envoyer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pathin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पथिन्</span> <i>pathin</i> var. <i>panthan</i> <a href="#entry-pathin" class="skt-link">m.</a> voie, chemin, route; conduite, manière; secte, doctrine — <a href="#entry-patha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>patha</i> ifc. voie de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πατος; lat. <i>pontis</i>; ang. path.<br> <i>pathi</i> adv. en route.<br> <i>panthānaṃ</i> <i>dā</i> céder le pas à ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>panthānena</i> de cette façon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pathya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पथ्य</span> <i>pathya</i> [<a href="#entry-path" class="skt-link">path</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pathya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pathya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pathyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pathyā</i> approprié, convenable; sain, salubre, salutaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> régulier, normal — <a href="#entry-pathya" class="skt-link">n.</a> diète; bien-être — <a href="#entry-pathyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pathyā</i> route, chemin, voie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. forme régulière d'un mètre; opp. <a href="#entry-vipulaa" class="skt-link">vipulā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पति</span> <i>pati</i> [<a href="#entry-pat_2" class="skt-link">pat_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">m.</a> mari — ifc. maître, seigneur de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>potis</i>; gr. ποσις.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patiga_nita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>patigaṇita</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_nita" class="skt-link">gaṇita</a>] <a href="#entry-patiga_nita" class="skt-link">n.</a> math. np. du Patigaṇita, traité d'arithmétique de <a href="#entry-Uzriidharaacaarya" class="skt-link">Śrīdharācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patighnii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>patighnī</i> [<a href="#entry-ghnii" class="skt-link">ghnī</a>] <a href="#entry-patighnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. femme meurtrière de son mari.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पतित</span> <i>patita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-patita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-patita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-patitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>patitā</i> tombé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>patitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-patitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> qualité d'époux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patitvaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पतित्वा</span> <i>patitvā</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] ind. étant tombé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pativrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pativrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-pativrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> loyauté et fidélité à son maître — <a href="#entry-pativrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pativratā</i> femme fidèle et vertueuse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pativratagu_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pativrataguṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pativratagu_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> vertu de loyauté ou fidélité.<br> <a href="#entry-pativrata" class="skt-link">pativrata</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patnii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्नी</span> <i>patnī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-patnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> épouse; maîtresse de maison, patronne; femme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ποτνια.<br> <i>sapatnīka</i> a. m. n. accompagné de sa femme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patniivat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>patnīvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-patniivat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-patniivat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-patniivatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>patnīvatī</i> marié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompagné de ses épouses.<br> <a href="#entry-patnii" class="skt-link">patnī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्र</span> <i>patra</i> forme dégéminée de <a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">pattra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patrikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्रिका</span> <i>patrikā</i> forme dégéminée de <a href="#entry-pattrikaa" class="skt-link">pattrikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pattana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्तन</span> <i>pattana</i> <a href="#entry-pattana" class="skt-link">n.</a> ville, cité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>paṭṭana</i> id. — <a href="#entry-pattanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pattanī</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-patti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्ति</span> <i>patti</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pad_1" class="skt-link">pad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-patti" class="skt-link">m.</a> fantassin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> peloton (comprenant un éléphant, un char, 3 cavaliers, 5 fantassins); cf. <a href="#entry-senaamukha" class="skt-link">senāmukha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pattra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्त्र</span> <i>pattra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">n.</a> aile, plume; plumes d'une flèche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> feuille, pétale; not. feuille odorante <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> feuille (pour écrire); feuillet d'un livre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lettre, document écrit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lame (d'une épée) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>patra</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>penna</i>; ang. feather; all. Feder.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pattrabhafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pattrabhaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-bhafga" class="skt-link">bhaṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-pattrabhafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> décoration du corps et du visage par des lignes parfumées (not. au musc).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pattralekhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pattralekhā</i> [<a href="#entry-lekhaa" class="skt-link">lekhā</a>] <a href="#entry-pattralekhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-pattrabhafga" class="skt-link">pattrabhaṅga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a>] np. de la belle princesse Pattralekhā «Fardée», fille d'un roi de <a href="#entry-Ukuluuta" class="skt-link">Kulūta</a> soumis par le roi <a href="#entry-Utaaraapii_da" class="skt-link">Tārāpīḍa</a>, ramenée captive à sa cour, et présentée par la reine <a href="#entry-Uvilaasavatii" class="skt-link">Vilāsavatī</a> au prince <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da_1" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa_1</a> comme compagne porteuse de bétel; elle est une incarnation de <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_1" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">pattra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pattrikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पत्त्रिका</span> <i>pattrikā</i> [<a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">pattra</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-pattrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> feuille; lettre, document, bulletin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. magazine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>patrikā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_msya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौंस्य</span> <i>pauṃsya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_msya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_msya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_msyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṃsyā</i> relatif aux hommes; mâle, viril — <a href="#entry-pau_msya" class="skt-link">n.</a> virilité; acte viril.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_mzcaliiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौंश्चलीय</span> <i>pauṃścalīya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_mzcaliiya" class="skt-link">puṃścalīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_mzcaliiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_mzcaliiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_mzcaliiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṃścalīyā</i> concernant les prostituées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_dariika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौण्डरीक</span> <i>pauṇḍarīka</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">puṇḍarīka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_n_dariika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_n_dariika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_n_dariikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṇḍarīkā</i> constitué de lotus (guirlande) — <a href="#entry-pau_n_dariika" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. sacrifice solennel [<a href="#entry-yaaga" class="skt-link">yāga</a>] de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>, durant 11 jours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_dra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौण्ड्र</span> <i>pauṇḍra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">puṇḍra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_n_dra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_n_dra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_n_drii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṇḍrī</i> relatif au pays <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">puṇḍra</a>, bengali — <a href="#entry-pau_n_dra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Pauṇḍra, conque de <a href="#entry-Ubhiimasena" class="skt-link">Bhīmasena</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pauṇḍrās</i> géo. le peuple des bengalis — <a href="#entry-pau_n_dra" class="skt-link">n.</a> marque sectaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_drak_setra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṇḍrakṣetra</i> [<a href="#entry-k_setra" class="skt-link">kṣetra</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_n_drak_setra" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du Pauṇḍrakṣetra, Bengale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_drak_setramaahaatmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṇḍrakṣetramāhātmya</i> [<a href="#entry-maahaatmya" class="skt-link">māhātmya</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_n_drak_setramaahaatmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pauṇḍrakṣetramāhātmya, description des lieux sacrés du Bengale; cf. <a href="#entry-Uuttarapau_n_drakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Uttarapauṇḍrakhaṇḍa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pau_n_drak_setra" class="skt-link">pauṇḍrakṣetra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_draka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṇḍraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_n_draka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. variété blonde de canne à sucre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. classe mélangée des bouilleurs de canne à sucre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. prince des <a href="#entry-pau_n_draas" class="skt-link">pauṇḍrās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pauṇḍraka, roi bengali orgueilleux qui mit au défi <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, qui le tua <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. géo. les bengalis; syn. <a href="#entry-pau_n_draas" class="skt-link">pauṇḍrās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_dravardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṇḍravardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_n_dravardhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-pu_n_dravardhana" class="skt-link">puṇḍravardhana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_n_dravardhanapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṇḍravardhanapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_n_dravardhanapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. ville de Pauṇḍravardhanapura, capitale des <a href="#entry-pu_n_draas" class="skt-link">puṇḍrās</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dranaagara" class="skt-link">Puṇḍranāgara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pau_n_dravardhana" class="skt-link">pauṇḍravardhana</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pau_n_dra" class="skt-link">pauṇḍra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौष</span> <i>pauṣa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_sya" class="skt-link">puṣya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṣā</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Upu_sya" class="skt-link">Puṣya</a> — <a href="#entry-pau_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. mois de <a href="#entry-Upu_sya" class="skt-link">Puṣya</a> (décembre-janvier).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_skara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौष्कर</span> <i>pauṣkara</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_skara" class="skt-link">puṣkara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_skara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_skara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_skarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṣkarī</i> relatif au lotus bleu — <a href="#entry-pau_skara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> manifesté par une fleur de lotus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_skarasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pauṣkarasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-pau_skarasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Pauṣkarasaṃhitā, qui détaille le culte de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvefka_tezvara" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭeśvara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pau_skara" class="skt-link">pauṣkara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pau_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौष्य</span> <i>pauṣya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pu_sya" class="skt-link">puṣya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pau_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pau_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauṣā</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Upu_sya" class="skt-link">Puṣya</a> — <a href="#entry-pau_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Pauṣya; sa femme donna ses ornements magiques à <a href="#entry-Uuttafka" class="skt-link">Uttaṅka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paudgalika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौद्गलिक</span> <i>paudgalika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pudgala" class="skt-link">pudgala</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paudgalika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paudgalika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paudgalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paudgalikā</i> phil. matériel, fait de substance physique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauga_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौगण्ड</span> <i>paugaṇḍa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-poga_n_da" class="skt-link">pogaṇḍa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pauga_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pauga_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauga_n_dii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paugaṇḍī</i> concernant les garçons; gamin — <a href="#entry-pauga_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> préadolescence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paulkasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौल्कस</span> <i>paulkasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pulkasa" class="skt-link">pulkasa</a>] <a href="#entry-paulkasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paulkasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paulkasī</i> soc. fils d'un homme <a href="#entry-ni_saada" class="skt-link">niṣāda</a> ou <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a> avec une <a href="#entry-k_satriyaa" class="skt-link">kṣatriyā</a>; ces hors-caste sont méprisés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauloma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौलोम</span> <i>pauloma</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puloman" class="skt-link">puloman</a>] <a href="#entry-pauloma" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. myth. les <i>paulomās</i>, fils de l'<a href="#entry-asurii" class="skt-link">asurī</a> <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_3" class="skt-link">Pulomā_3</a>; ils habitent une cité d'or indestructible dans les airs — <a href="#entry-paulomii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paulomī</i> myth. patr. de <a href="#entry-Uzacii" class="skt-link">Śacī</a> «Fille de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paunaruktya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौनरुक्त्य</span> <i>paunaruktya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-punarukta" class="skt-link">punarukta</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paunaruktya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paunaruktya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paunaruktyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paunaruktyā</i> redondant, superflu — <a href="#entry-paunaruktya" class="skt-link">n.</a> répétition; tautologie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. la redondance, un défault d'esthétique de la poésie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paur_nimaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौर्णिमा</span> <i>paurṇimā</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a>] <a href="#entry-paur_nimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> astr. jour de pleine lune; syn. <a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>paurṇamī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौर</span> <i>paura</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurā</i> urbain — <a href="#entry-paura" class="skt-link">m.</a> bourgeois, citadin, citoyen.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौराण</span> <i>paurāṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pauraa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pauraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauraa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurāṇā</i> vieux, ancien, antique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en rapport avec les légendes [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>]; mythologique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauraa_nika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौराणिक</span> <i>paurāṇika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pauraa_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pauraa_nika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauraa_nikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurāṇikā</i> mythologique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui connaît les vieilles légendes, qui parle d'autrefois <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. se dit des doctrines développées dans les recueils de <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paurastya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरस्त्य</span> <i>paurastya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puras" class="skt-link">puras</a><a href="#entry--tya" class="skt-link">-tya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paurastya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paurastya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paurastyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurastyā</i> à l'Est; devant, à l'avant; premier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. géo. le peuple de l'Est; syn. <a href="#entry-Ugau_daas" class="skt-link">Gauḍās</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paurava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरव</span> <i>paurava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puru" class="skt-link">puru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paurava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paurava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauravii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauravī</i> myth. descendant de <a href="#entry-Upuru" class="skt-link">Puru</a> — <a href="#entry-paurava" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du peuple Paurava du Nord-Ouest de l'Inde (mod. Pañjāb) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. géo. le peuple des Pauravās.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paurohita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरोहित</span> <i>paurohita</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paurohita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paurohita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paurohitii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurohitī</i> concernant un <a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paurohitya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरोहित्य</span> <i>paurohitya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-paurohitya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-paurohitya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-paurohityaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paurohityā</i> relatif à un <a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a> ou à sa famille — <a href="#entry-paurohitya" class="skt-link">n.</a> sa charge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauru_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरुष</span> <i>pauruṣa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-puru_sa" class="skt-link">puruṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pauru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pauru_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauru_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauruṣā</i> humain; masculin, viril — <a href="#entry-pauru_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> virilité; acte viril ou héroïque; vertu, courage, force <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. ce qui est humain; opp. <a href="#entry-daiva" class="skt-link">daiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pauru_seya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौरुषेय</span> <i>pauruṣeya</i> [<a href="#entry-pauru_sa" class="skt-link">pauruṣa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pauru_seya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pauru_seya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pauru_seyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pauruṣeyā</i> fait par l'homme, de nature humaine; not. <a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pautra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पौत्र</span> <i>pautra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pautra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pautra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pautrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pautrī</i> filial — <a href="#entry-pautra" class="skt-link">m.</a> petit-fils (fils d'un fils) — <a href="#entry-pautrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pautrī</i> petite-fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवमान</span> <i>pavamāna</i> [ppr. md. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pavamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavamānā</i> en train d'être purifié; coulant clair (se dit du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>) — <a href="#entry-pavamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. chant de louange [<a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a>] chanté par le <a href="#entry-saamaga" class="skt-link">sāmaga</a> lors du sacrifice <a href="#entry-jyoti_s_toma" class="skt-link">jyotiṣṭoma</a>; il y en a trois pour chacun des trois pressurages [<a href="#entry-savana_1" class="skt-link">savana_1</a>]: <a href="#entry-bahi_spavamaana" class="skt-link">bahiṣpavamāna</a>, <a href="#entry-maadhyandina" class="skt-link">mādhyaṃdina</a> et <a href="#entry-t_rtiiya" class="skt-link">tṛtīya</a> ou <a href="#entry-aarbhava" class="skt-link">ārbhava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवन</span> <i>pavana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavanā</i> propre, net, pur — <a href="#entry-pavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> air, brise, vent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pavana «Purificateur», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> le Vent; il est père de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> par <a href="#entry-Ua_njanaa" class="skt-link">Añjanā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. souffle vital; on en compte 5 [<a href="#entry-praa_naas" class="skt-link">prāṇās</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 5 — <a href="#entry-pavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> nettoyage, purification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> instrument de purification; filtre, tamis, passoire, van — <a href="#entry-pavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavanā</i> ifc. vent de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavanaazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pavanāśana</i> [<a href="#entry-azana_2" class="skt-link">aśana_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pavanaazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> serpent [«qui se nourrit d'air»]; syn. <a href="#entry-zvasanabhuj" class="skt-link">śvasanabhuj</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pavana" class="skt-link">pavana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवर्ग</span> <i>pavarga</i> [<i>(pa)</i>-<a href="#entry-varga" class="skt-link">varga</a>] <a href="#entry-pavarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. la classe des labiales.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवितृ</span> <i>pavitṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pavit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavit_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavitrī</i> qui purifie; purificateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवित्र</span> <i>pavitra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-puu_1" class="skt-link">pū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«instrument de purification»] tamis, filtre, passoire; not. tamis à <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cordon brâhmanique; syn. <a href="#entry-upaviita" class="skt-link">upavīta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> purification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> de purification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. (deux) tiges d'herbe <a href="#entry-kuza" class="skt-link">kuśa</a> pour asperger ou tenir les offrandes — <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. fête de <a href="#entry-tantuparvan" class="skt-link">tantuparvan</a>, en l'honneur de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> — a. <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavitrā</i> qui purifie; qui écarte le péché; sacré — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(pavitrayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pavitrita</i><i>)</i> nettoyer, purifier; rendre heureux.<br> <i>pavitrīkṛ</i> nettoyer, purifier, sanctifier.<br> <i>pavitrībhū</i> se purifier.<br> <i>na</i> <i>hi</i> <i>jñānena</i> <i>sadṛśaṃ</i> <i>pavitramiha</i> <i>vidyate</i> [BhG.] Il n'y a pas de meilleure purification que le savoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavitraaropa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pavitrāropaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aaropa_na" class="skt-link">āropaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pavitraaropa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. investiture du cordon sacré; syn. <a href="#entry-upanayana" class="skt-link">upanayana</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> not. fête célébrant l'initiation de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, célébrée à cf. <a href="#entry-tantuparvan" class="skt-link">tantuparvan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavitrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pavitratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pavitrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pureté, propreté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavitrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pavitrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pavitrin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitrin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitri_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavitriṇī</i> qui purifie, purifiant; pur, clair.<br> <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">pavitra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pavitrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पवित्रित</span> <i>pavitrita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pavitra" class="skt-link">pavitra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pavitrita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pavitritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pavitritā</i> propre, pur; nettoyé, purifié, sanctifié; heureux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पय</span> <i>paya</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-payas" class="skt-link">payas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पयस्</span> <i>payas</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a>] <a href="#entry-payas" class="skt-link">n.</a> lait; liquide, pluie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sperme, force virile — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(payāyate)</i> avoir le goût du lait — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(payasyati)</i> se répandre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payasvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>payasvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-payasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-payasvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-payasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>payasvatī</i> juteux; succulent, riche de lait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payo_s_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>payoṣṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-u_s_na" class="skt-link">uṣṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-payo_s_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la rivière Payoṣṇī, qui descend des monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>; myth. on dit que son eau est mêlée de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] le roi <a href="#entry-Ugaya" class="skt-link">Gaya</a> offrit aux <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> cinq <a href="#entry-azvamedha" class="skt-link">aśvamedha</a> sur les rives de la <a href="#entry-Upayo_s_nii" class="skt-link">Payoṣṇī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-paya" class="skt-link">paya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payodhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>payodhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] <a href="#entry-payodhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> sein [«qui porte le lait»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payonidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>payonidhi</i> [<a href="#entry-nidhi" class="skt-link">nidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-payonidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> océan.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-payovrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>payovrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-payovrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. rituel du lait, enseigné par <a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a> à <a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a> pour qu'elle donne naissance à <a href="#entry-Uvaamana" class="skt-link">Vāmana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-payas" class="skt-link">payas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-paz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्</span> <i>paś</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-d_rz_1" class="skt-link">dṛś_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(paśyati)</i> pr. md. <i>(paśyate)</i> ppr. <i>(paśyat)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ut</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> voir; visiter; regarder; considérer comme ⟨2 acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>conspicio</i>; all. spähen; ang. spy; fr. espion.<br> <i>paśya</i> regarde! eh bien!<br> <i>paśyāmi</i> compris! (je vois).<br> <i>na</i> <i>paś</i> être aveugle.<br> <i>paśu</i> regarde! vois!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्च</span> <i>paśca</i> a. <a href="#entry-pazca" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazca" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paścā</i> en arrière, derrière, après; à l'Ouest.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaadahas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścādahas</i> [<a href="#entry-ahas" class="skt-link">ahas</a>] adv. dans l'après-midi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaadukti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścādukti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-pazcaadukti" class="skt-link">f.</a> répétition, redite.<br> <a href="#entry-pazcaat" class="skt-link">paścāt</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्चात्</span> <i>paścāt</i> [abl. <a href="#entry-pazca" class="skt-link">paśca</a>] adv. par derrière, de dos, vers l'Ouest <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> donc, ensuite, enfin — prép. cl. après, derrière ⟨abl. g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>post</i>.<br> <i>paścāt</i> <i>kṛ</i> dépasser, surmonter.<br> <i>paścāt</i> <i>tap</i> se repentir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaattaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścāttāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-taapa" class="skt-link">tāpa</a>] <a href="#entry-pazcaattaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«après les tourments (de la culpabilité)»] repentir, regret.<br> <i>paścāttāpaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> se repentir, regretter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaattaapahata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścāttāpahata</i> [<a href="#entry-hata" class="skt-link">hata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazcaattaapahata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcaattaapahata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcaattaapahataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paścāttāpahatā</i> frappé par le repentir.<br> <a href="#entry-pazcaattaapa" class="skt-link">paścāttāpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcaattara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścāttara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazcaattara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcaattara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcaattaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paścāttarā</i> qui suit ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcima">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्चिम</span> <i>paścima</i> [<a href="#entry-pazca" class="skt-link">paśca</a><a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazcima" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcima" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazcimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paścimā</i> en arrière; dernier, final; occidental — <a href="#entry-pazcimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paścimā</i> la direction de l'Ouest.<br> <i>paścimaṃ</i> <i>dṛś</i> voir pour la dernière fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcimaamnaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścimāmnāya</i> [<a href="#entry-aamnaaya" class="skt-link">āmnāya</a>] <a href="#entry-pazcimaamnaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. «doctrine de l'Ouest», ordre de <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a> dont le <a href="#entry-ma_tha" class="skt-link">maṭha</a> se trouve à <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a>; il s'y développa le culte de <a href="#entry-Ukubjikaa" class="skt-link">Kubjikā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Umanthaanabhairava" class="skt-link">Manthānabhairava</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pazcima" class="skt-link">paścima</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcimaataana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścimātāna</i> [<a href="#entry-aataana" class="skt-link">ātāna</a>] <a href="#entry-pazcimaataana" class="skt-link">m.</a> étirement du dos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazcimaataanaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paścimātānāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-pazcimaataanaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture de l'étirement du dos: jambes droites, on prend ses orteils avec ses mains et on pose le front sur les genoux.<br> <a href="#entry-pazcimaataana" class="skt-link">paścimātāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पशु</span> <i>paśu</i> <a href="#entry-pazu" class="skt-link">m.</a> bête, animal domestique; bétail; opp. <a href="#entry-m_rga" class="skt-link">mṛga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. animal du sacrifice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> âme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. non-initié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>pecus</i>; ang. fee; all. Vieh.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazubandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśubandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-pazubandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. sacrifice de bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazudharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśudharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-pazudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> comportement animal, instinct <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> copulation, bestialité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. se dit du remariage des veuves.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazumaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśumāra</i> [<a href="#entry-maara" class="skt-link">māra</a>] <a href="#entry-pazumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. manière de sacrifier le bétail.<br> <a href="#entry-pazu" class="skt-link">paśu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazumat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśumat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazumat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazumat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazumatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paśumatī</i> riche en bétail — <a href="#entry-pazumat" class="skt-link">m.</a> propriétaire de bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazupaalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśupālya</i> [<a href="#entry-paalya" class="skt-link">pālya</a>] <a href="#entry-pazupaalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> élevage du bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazupati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśupati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-pazupati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Paśupati, le «Maître des âmes», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, personnification du sacrifice rituel; chargé par les dieux d'arrêter l'inceste primordial commis par <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, il lui coupa sa cinquième tête avec l'arme <a href="#entry-Upaazupata" class="skt-link">Pāśupata</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ulakuliiza" class="skt-link">Lakulīśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazupatinaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśupatinātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-pazupatinaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Paśupatinātha, sanctuaire shivaïte du Népal, sur les bords de la rivière <a href="#entry-Uvaafmatii" class="skt-link">Vāṅmatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pazupati" class="skt-link">paśupati</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazuprera_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśupreraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-prera_na" class="skt-link">preraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pazuprera_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> conduite du bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazut_rp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśutṛp</i> [<a href="#entry-t_rp_2" class="skt-link">tṛp_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazut_rp" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazut_rp" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazut_rp" class="skt-link">f.</a> amateur de bétail; voleur de bétail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazutva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>paśutva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pazutva" class="skt-link">n.</a> condition animale; bestialité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्य</span> <i>paśya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paz" class="skt-link">paś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paśyā</i> qui regarde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazyat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्यत्</span> <i>paśyat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-paz" class="skt-link">paś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazyat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazyat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazyantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paśyantī</i> en train de voir, voyant — <a href="#entry-pazyantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paśyantī</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a>] son au 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ stade de la manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prostituée.<br> <i>paśyatas</i> adv. en présence de; sous le nez de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pazyata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पश्यत</span> <i>paśyata</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-pazyat" class="skt-link">paśyat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pazyata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pazyata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pazyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>paśyatā</i> visible, manifeste, en évidence; à voir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्च</span> <i>pañca</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pa_ncan" class="skt-link">pañcan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nca_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_s" class="skt-link">ṣaṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_nca_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nca_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_nca_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcaṣā</i> pl. <i>pañcaṣās</i> au nombre de cinq ou six.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_nca_sa_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaṣaṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_s_ti" class="skt-link">ṣaṣṭi</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_nca_sa_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> 65.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcāṅgā</i> constitué de 5 parties, en 5 étapes — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. almanach [«qui traite de 5 sujets»]: les jours solaires [<a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">vāra</a>], les jours lunaires [<a href="#entry-tithi" class="skt-link">tithi</a>], les stations lunaires [<a href="#entry-nak_satraa_ni" class="skt-link">nakṣatrāṇi</a>], les conjonctions astrales [<a href="#entry-yogaas" class="skt-link">yogās</a>], et les périodes lunaires [<a href="#entry-kara_naas" class="skt-link">karaṇās</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-pa_njii" class="skt-link">pañjī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaafguli">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāṅguli</i> [<a href="#entry-afguli" class="skt-link">aṅguli</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafguli" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafguli" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafguli" class="skt-link">f.</a> large de 5 doigts.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaafgulika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāṅgulika</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafgulika" class="skt-link">m.</a> marque de main droite imprimée ou gravée dans le sol d'un sanctuaire.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaafguli" class="skt-link">pañcāṅguli</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaagni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāgni</i> [<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaagni" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. les 5 feux sacrés: <a href="#entry-anvaahaaryapacana" class="skt-link">anvāhāryapacana</a>-<a href="#entry-dak_si_na" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-gaarhapatya" class="skt-link">gārhapatya</a>, <a href="#entry-aahavaniiya" class="skt-link">āhavanīya</a>, <a href="#entry-sabhya" class="skt-link">sabhya</a> et <a href="#entry-aavasathya" class="skt-link">āvasathya</a> — a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaagni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaagni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaagni" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. qui maintient les 5 feux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui pratique l'austérité des 5 feux; syn. <a href="#entry-pa_ncatapas" class="skt-link">pañcatapas</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. qui connaît la doctrine des 5 feux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaak_sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcākṣara</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaak_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaak_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaak_sarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcākṣarī</i> formé de 5 syllabes — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaak_sarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcākṣarī</i> soc. [<a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>] formule d'adoration de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <i>oṃ</i> <i>namaḥ</i> <i>śivāya</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaakhyaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcākhyāna</i> [<a href="#entry-aakhyaana" class="skt-link">ākhyāna</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaakhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcākhyāna «Cinq histoires»; cf. <a href="#entry-Upa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">Pañcatantra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaakhyaanaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcākhyānaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaakhyaanaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pañcākhyānaka, version du <a href="#entry-Upa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">Pañcatantra</a> compilée en 1199 par <a href="#entry-Upuur_nabhadra" class="skt-link">Pūrṇabhadra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaakhyaana" class="skt-link">pañcākhyāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चाल</span> <i>pañcāla</i> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. pays Pañcāla, habité par une tribu de 6 clans de guerriers du Nord de l'Inde, à l'est des <a href="#entry-Ukuravas" class="skt-link">Kuravas</a> et des <a href="#entry-Umatsyaas" class="skt-link">Matsyās</a>; sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Ukaampilyaa" class="skt-link">Kāmpilyā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] le <a href="#entry-Upa_ncaala" class="skt-link">Pañcāla</a> était le royaume de <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>; son ancien condisciple <a href="#entry-Udro_na" class="skt-link">Droṇa</a> le combattit, et confisqua la partie du pays au nord du Gange [<a href="#entry-Uahicchattra" class="skt-link">Ahicchattra</a>] pour y faire régner son fils <a href="#entry-Uazvatthaamaa" class="skt-link">Aśvatthāmā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pañcālās</i> son peuple, les Pañcālās ou <a href="#entry-Upaa_ncaalaas" class="skt-link">Pāñcālās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaalezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāleśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaalezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de la cave de Pañcāleśvara à Pune, abritant le <a href="#entry-Upaataalezvara" class="skt-link">Pātāleśvara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaala" class="skt-link">pañcāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaanana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcānana</i> [<a href="#entry-aanana" class="skt-link">ānana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaanana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaanana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaananii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcānanī</i> [«qui a 5 faces»] fougueux, passionné — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaanana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pañcānana, forme farouche de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lion — ifc. soc. forme des titres d'érudits; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvizvanaatha_4" class="skt-link">Viśvanātha_4</a> — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaananii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcānanī</i> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a>] les 5 concepts: l'effet [<a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a>], la cause [<a href="#entry-kaara_na" class="skt-link">kāraṇa</a>], l'union [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>], les injonctions rituelles [<a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>] et la cessation de la souffrance [<a href="#entry-du_hkhaanta" class="skt-link">duḥkhānta</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaarthabhaa_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcārthabhāṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaarthabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcārthabhāṣya, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Upaazupatasuutra" class="skt-link">Pāśupatasūtra</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Ukau_n_dinya" class="skt-link">Kauṇḍinya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaartha" class="skt-link">pañcārtha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncama" class="skt-link">pañcama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāsya</i> [<a href="#entry-aasya" class="skt-link">āsya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcāsyā</i> qui a 5 visages ou 5 têtes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avec 5 pointes (flèche).<br> <a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaavara_nastava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāvaraṇastava</i> [<a href="#entry-aavara_na" class="skt-link">āvaraṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-stava" class="skt-link">stava</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaavara_nastava" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcāvaraṇastava d'Agoraśivācārya, texte <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> d'Inde du Sud du 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, traitant de prescriptions pour la représentation de <a href="#entry-Usadaaziva" class="skt-link">Sadāśiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaavayava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāvayava</i> [<a href="#entry-avayava" class="skt-link">avayava</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaavayava" class="skt-link">m.</a> consistant en 5 parties <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] le syllogisme en 5 parties: <a href="#entry-pratij_naa_2" class="skt-link">pratijñā_2</a> la thèse à démontrer, (sous la forme du prédicat [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a>] appliqué au sujet [<a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>]) <a href="#entry-hetu" class="skt-link">hetu</a> la raison hypothétique, <a href="#entry-udaahara_na" class="skt-link">udāharaṇa</a> la concomitance [<a href="#entry-vyaapti" class="skt-link">vyāpti</a>] avec l'exemple à l'appui [<a href="#entry-d_r_s_taanta" class="skt-link">dṛṣṭānta</a>], <a href="#entry-upanaya" class="skt-link">upanaya</a> l'application, et <a href="#entry-nigamana" class="skt-link">nigamana</a> la conclusion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaayatana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāyatana</i> [<a href="#entry-aayatana" class="skt-link">āyatana</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayatana" class="skt-link">n.</a> arch. plan de temple avec 5 sanctuaires en quinconce; ils sont traditionnellement consacrés à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uambikaa" class="skt-link">Ambikā</a>-<a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. autel domestique comprenant ces 5 divinités, la principale étant au centre du carré formé par les 4 autres <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cérémonie utilisant 5 symboles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaayatanapuujaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāyatanapūjā</i> [<a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayatanapuujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. service religieux domestique quotidien offert sur l'autel <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayatana" class="skt-link">pañcāyatana</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-_sa_nmata" class="skt-link">ṣaṇmata</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayatana" class="skt-link">pañcāyatana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaayudha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāyudha</i> [<a href="#entry-aayudha" class="skt-link">āyudha</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayudha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pañcāyudha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> «aux cinq armes»; syn. <a href="#entry-pa_ncabaa_na" class="skt-link">pañcabāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चाश</span> <i>pañcāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a>-<a href="#entry-daza" class="skt-link">daśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcāśī</i> cinquantième.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaazaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcāśaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcāśikā</i> 50 — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcāśikā</i> ifc. collection de 50; cinquantaine de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. forme de noms d'ouvrages.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaazat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चाशत्</span> <i>pañcāśat</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a>-<a href="#entry-dazat" class="skt-link">daśat</a>] num. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaazat" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. cinquante, cinquantaine.<br> <i>pañcāśat</i> <i>lipi</i> les 50 lettres de l'alphabet utilisées dans les charmes [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncabaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcabāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-baa_na" class="skt-link">bāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncabaa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pañcabāṇa, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> «aux cinq flèches de fleurs».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. <i>pañcabhūtāni</i> phil.
