[<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] ensemble des 5 éléments matériels: <a href="#entry-aakaaza" class="skt-link">ākāśa</a> l'Éther ou Espace, <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a> l'Air, <a href="#entry-tejas" class="skt-link">tejas</a> le Feu, <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a> l'Eau et <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a> la Terre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncabhuutamahaalifga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcabhūtamahāliṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-mahaalifga" class="skt-link">mahāliṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutamahaalifga" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. les 5 signes de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> associés aux 5 éléments, et à 5 grandes manifestations de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">pañcabhūtasthala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcabhūtasthala</i> [<a href="#entry-sthala" class="skt-link">sthala</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. sanctuaire de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> associé à l'un des 5 éléments: <a href="#entry-Uekaamrezvara" class="skt-link">Ekāmreśvara</a> à <a href="#entry-Ukaa_nciipuram" class="skt-link">Kāñcīpuram</a> pour <a href="#entry-p_rthivii" class="skt-link">pṛthivī</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujambukezvara" class="skt-link">Jambukeśvara</a> à Tiruvanaikka pour <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaru_naacalezvara" class="skt-link">Aruṇācaleśvara</a> à Tiruvannamalai pour <a href="#entry-tejas" class="skt-link">tejas</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaalahastiizvara" class="skt-link">Kālahastīśvara</a> près de Tirupati pour <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a> et <a href="#entry-Ucidambara" class="skt-link">Cidambara</a>-<a href="#entry-Una_taraaja" class="skt-link">Naṭarāja</a> à <a href="#entry-Ucidambaram" class="skt-link">Cidambaram</a> pour <a href="#entry-aakaaza" class="skt-link">ākāśa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuuta" class="skt-link">pañcabhūta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncacatvaari_mzat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcacatvāriṃśat</i> [<a href="#entry-catvaari_mzat" class="skt-link">catvāriṃśat</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncacatvaari_mzat" class="skt-link">f.</a> 45.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncacuu_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcacūḍā</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daa" class="skt-link">cūḍā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncacuu_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de Pañcacūḍā, nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] qui décrit dans l'<a href="#entry-Uumaasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">Umāsaṃhitā</a> la mauvaise nature des femmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चदश</span> <i>pañcadaśa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncadazan" class="skt-link">pañcadaśan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadaśī</i> quinzième — <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadaśī</i> astr. 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour d'une demi-lunaison, jour de pleine ou nouvelle lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadazan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadaśan</i> [<a href="#entry-dazan" class="skt-link">daśan</a>] num. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazan" class="skt-link">*</a> pl. quinze.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadazavaar_sika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadaśavārṣika</i> [<a href="#entry-vaar_sika" class="skt-link">vārṣika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazavaar_sika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazavaar_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazavaar_sikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadaśavārṣikī</i> âgé de 15 ans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadazika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadaśika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadaśikā</i> de longueur 15; au nombre de 15.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadazin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadaśin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadaśinī</i> constitué de 15 parties — <a href="#entry-pa_ncadazin" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Pañcadaśī, œuvre d'<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a> <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvidyaara_nya" class="skt-link">Vidyāraṇya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadevata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadevata</i> [<a href="#entry-devataa" class="skt-link">devatā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncadevata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadevata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadevataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcadevatā</i> myth. relatif aux 5 divinités (<a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>, <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>).<br> <i>pañcadevata</i> <i>mantra</i> évocation des 5 dieux; cf. ci-dessous.<br> <i>namaḥ</i> <i>gaṇe</i> <i>nārāyaṇe</i> <i>rudre</i> <i>ambike</i> <i>bhāskare</i> Gloire à <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>, <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncadhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcadhā</i> [<a href="#entry--dhaa" class="skt-link">-dhā</a>] adv. cinq fois; en cinq parties; de cinq manières.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncagau_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcagauḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-gau_da" class="skt-link">gauḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncagau_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. les cinq peuples de l'Inde du Nord: <a href="#entry-Ugau_da" class="skt-link">Gauḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukanyakubja" class="skt-link">Kanyakubja</a>, <a href="#entry-Umaithila" class="skt-link">Maithila</a>, <a href="#entry-Uutkala" class="skt-link">Utkala</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uvafga" class="skt-link">Vaṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncagavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcagavya</i> [<a href="#entry-gavya" class="skt-link">gavya</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncagavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> les 5 produits de la vache: le lait [<a href="#entry-payas" class="skt-link">payas</a>], le fromage caillé [<a href="#entry-dadhan" class="skt-link">dadhan</a>], le beurre [<a href="#entry-gh_rta" class="skt-link">ghṛta</a>], l'urine [<a href="#entry-gomuutra" class="skt-link">gomūtra</a>] et la bouse [<a href="#entry-gomaya" class="skt-link">gomaya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcajana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. du démon [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] Pañcajana «Pentagène», fils de <a href="#entry-Usa_mhraada" class="skt-link">Saṃhrāda</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_rti" class="skt-link">Kṛti</a>; il vivait dans les eaux caché dans la conque <a href="#entry-Upaa_ncajanya" class="skt-link">Pāñcajanya</a>, et retenait prisonnier le fils du sage <a href="#entry-Usaandiipani" class="skt-link">Sāndīpani</a> qui s'était noyé à <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasak_setra" class="skt-link">Prabhāsakṣetra</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, qui s'acquitta ainsi de ses devoirs envers son <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> en ressuscitant son fils, avec l'assistance de <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>: il est père d'<a href="#entry-Uasiknii" class="skt-link">Asiknī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzafkhaasura" class="skt-link">Śaṅkhāsura</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pañcajanās</i> myth. les 5 catégories d'êtres humanoïdes: dieux [<a href="#entry-devaas" class="skt-link">devās</a>], hommes [<a href="#entry-janaas" class="skt-link">janās</a>], êtres célestes (nymphes [<a href="#entry-apsarasas" class="skt-link">apsarasas</a>] et centaures [<a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a>]), dragons [<a href="#entry-naagaas" class="skt-link">nāgās</a>] et ancêtres [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. les 5 gents, constituées des 4 classes [<a href="#entry-caturvar_na" class="skt-link">caturvarṇa</a>] auxquelles on ajoute les tribaux [<a href="#entry-ni_saada" class="skt-link">niṣāda</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncak_rtvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcakṛtvas</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rtvas" class="skt-link">kṛtvas</a>] adv. 5 fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncak_rtya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcakṛtya</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rtya" class="skt-link">kṛtya</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncak_rtya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. la manifestation de l'Être Suprême <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, en cinq activités: <a href="#entry-s_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">sṛṣṭi</a> la création, <a href="#entry-sthiti" class="skt-link">sthiti</a> la préservation, <a href="#entry-sa_mhaara" class="skt-link">saṃhāra</a> la destruction, <a href="#entry-tirobhaava" class="skt-link">tirobhāva</a> l'illusion et <a href="#entry-anugraha" class="skt-link">anugraha</a> <a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a> le pouvoir de la grâce ou libération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcikā</i> consistant en 5 composantes, de symétrie 5 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de 5 jours d'âge — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection de 5 objets — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> pentade, quinconce; catégorie de 5 notions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. not. poème en 5 vers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. jeu avec 5 dés (où les faces doivent être égales) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. conjonction défavorable de 5 planètes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncakarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcakarman</i> [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncakarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncakarmii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcakarmī</i> méd. les 5 traitements purificatoires: vomitif, purgatif, sternutatif, et laxatif avec ou sans huile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncakrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcakrama</i> [<a href="#entry-krama" class="skt-link">krama</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncakrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. manière de réciter le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> en 5 étapes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la «voie en 5 étapes», enseignement de Naagaarjuna.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncakroza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcakrośa</i> [<a href="#entry-kroza" class="skt-link">krośa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncakroza" class="skt-link">m.</a> distance de 5 lieues (environ 15 km) — <a href="#entry-pa_ncakrozii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcakrośī</i> soc. pays dans un rayon de 15 km autour d'un lieu sacré [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>], not. à <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a> et à <a href="#entry-Uofkaarezvara" class="skt-link">Oṃkāreśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. les 5 sujets traités par les recueils mythologiques [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>]: <a href="#entry-sarga" class="skt-link">sarga</a> la création de l'Univers, <a href="#entry-pratisarga" class="skt-link">pratisarga</a> les créations secondaires, <a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a> la généalogie des dieux et des sages, <a href="#entry-manvantara" class="skt-link">manvantara</a> la création de la race humaine et des premiers hommes, et <a href="#entry-va_mzaanucarita" class="skt-link">vaṃśānucarita</a> les généalogies et histoires dynastiques <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> collection de 5 signes — a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcalakṣaṇī</i> (ouvrage) qui traite des 5 sujets philosophiques — <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcalakṣaṇī</i> phil. not. ouvrage de logique [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>], tel que le Pañcalakṣaṇīsarvasva de <a href="#entry-Umathuraanaatha_1" class="skt-link">Mathurānātha_1</a>.<br> <i>kākacakṣur</i> <i>bakadhyāyī</i> <i>śvānanidras</i> <i>tathaiva</i> <i>ca</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>alpāhārī</i> <i>gṛhatyāgī</i> <i>vidyārthipañcalakṣaṇam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Attentif comme un corbeau, méditant comme un héron, manquant de sommeil comme un chien, se contentant de peu et ayant quitté son foyer, voici les cinq caractéristiques d'un étudiant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चम</span> <i>pañcama</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_nca" class="skt-link">pañca</a><a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcamī</i> ord. cinquième — <a href="#entry-pa_ncama" class="skt-link">m.</a> (mus.) 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ note de l'octave indienne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ consonne d'un <a href="#entry-varga" class="skt-link">varga</a>, nasale — <a href="#entry-pa_ncamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcamī</i> gram. ablatif (5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ déclinaison) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour d'une quinzaine lunaire; not festival des couleurs [<a href="#entry-rafgapa_ncamii" class="skt-link">raṅgapañcamī</a>] dans la quinzaine claire suivant <a href="#entry-phaalgunii" class="skt-link">phālgunī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncamanu_syavibhaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcamanuṣyavibhāga</i> [<a href="#entry-manu_sya" class="skt-link">manuṣya</a>-<a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">vibhāga</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncamanu_syavibhaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> [BS.] division en 5 types d'hommes pour la représentation canonique des arts plastiques [<a href="#entry-citra" class="skt-link">citra</a>]: <a href="#entry-ha_msa" class="skt-link">haṃsa</a>, né sous Jupiter, de taille 96 pouces [<a href="#entry-afgula" class="skt-link">aṅgula</a>], <a href="#entry-zaza" class="skt-link">śaśa</a>, né sous Saturne, de taille 99 pouces, <a href="#entry-rucaka" class="skt-link">rucaka</a>, né sous Mars, de taille 102 pouces, <a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>, né sous Mercure, de taille 105 pouces, et <a href="#entry-maalavya" class="skt-link">mālavya</a>, né sous Vénus, de taille 108 pouces; il existe d'autres classifications.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncamaveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcamaveda</i> [<a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncamaveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. ensemble des recueils traditionnels [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>], considérés comme formant le 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncamuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcamūla</i> [<a href="#entry-muula" class="skt-link">mūla</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncamuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> méd. 5 racines médicinales; cf. <a href="#entry-b_rhatpa_ncamuula" class="skt-link">bṛhatpañcamūla</a>, <a href="#entry-hrasvapa_ncamuula" class="skt-link">hrasvapañcamūla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पञ्चन्</span> <i>pañcan</i> num. <a href="#entry-pa_ncan" class="skt-link">*</a> le nombre cinq <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πεντε; lat. <i>quinque</i>; all. fünf; ang. five, punch; fr. cinq.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncanada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcanada</i> [<a href="#entry-nada" class="skt-link">nada</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncanada" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du Pañcanada «Pays des 5 rivières» (<a href="#entry-Uzatadru" class="skt-link">Śatadru</a>-Sutlej, <a href="#entry-Uvipaazaa" class="skt-link">Vipāśā</a>-Beās, <a href="#entry-Uiraavatii" class="skt-link">Irāvatī</a>-Rāvī, <a href="#entry-Ucandrabhaagaa" class="skt-link">Candrabhāgā</a>-Chenāb et <a href="#entry-Uvitastaa" class="skt-link">Vitastā</a>-Jhelum); mod. Pañjāb.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncanakha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcanakha</i> [<a href="#entry-nakha" class="skt-link">nakha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncanakha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncanakha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncanakhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcanakhā</i> (animal) à 5 griffes.<br> <i>pañcapañcanakhā</i> <i>bhakṣyāḥ</i> il n'y a que 5 animaux à 5 griffes qui peuvent être mangés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncanaliiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcanalīya</i> [<a href="#entry-nala" class="skt-link">nala</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncanaliiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcanalīya «Histoire des cinq <a href="#entry-Unala" class="skt-link">Nala</a>», épisode du <a href="#entry-Unai_sadhacarita" class="skt-link">Naiṣadhacarita</a> en style <a href="#entry-zle_sa" class="skt-link">śleṣa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncadaza" class="skt-link">pañcadaśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncapaadikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcapādikā</i> [<a href="#entry-paadikaa" class="skt-link">pādikā</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncapaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'exégèse Pañcapādikā du commentaire <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutra" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtra</a> <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a> de <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a>; son auteur est <a href="#entry-Upadmapaada" class="skt-link">Padmapāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaparvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaparvan</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaparvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. les 5 conjonctions favorables et les jours de fête correspondants: <a href="#entry-caturdazii" class="skt-link">caturdaśī</a> (avec not. <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thacaturdazii" class="skt-link">vaikuṇṭhacaturdaśī</a>, fête de <a href="#entry-diipaavali" class="skt-link">dīpāvali</a>, et <a href="#entry-zivaraatri" class="skt-link">śivarātri</a>); <a href="#entry-a_s_tamii" class="skt-link">aṣṭamī</a> (avec not. <a href="#entry-jyai_s_thaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭhāṣṭamī</a> et <a href="#entry-janmaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">janmāṣṭamī</a>); <a href="#entry-amaavaasyaa" class="skt-link">amāvāsyā</a> la nouvelle lune; <a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a> la pleine lune; et <a href="#entry-ravisafkraanti" class="skt-link">ravisaṃkrānti</a> l'entrée du soleil dans un signe du zodiaque (avec not. <a href="#entry-makarasafkraanti" class="skt-link">makarasaṃkrānti</a>, fête du nouvel an).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaraamak_setra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcarāmakṣetra</i> [<a href="#entry-raamak_setra" class="skt-link">rāmakṣetra</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraamak_setra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. géo. les 5 lieux de pélerinage de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-raamak_setra" class="skt-link">rāmakṣetra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaraatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcarātra</i> [<a href="#entry-raatra" class="skt-link">rātra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcarātrā</i> qui dure 5 nuits — <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> période de 5 nuits; not. rite durant 5 nuits <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. tradition <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> instituée par <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pañcarātrās</i> soc. livres sacrés de tradition <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaraatraagama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcarātrāgama</i> [<a href="#entry-aagama" class="skt-link">āgama</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatraagama" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. recueil [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] de tradition <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> fixant les observances du culte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaraatrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcarātrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatrin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatrin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatri_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcarātriṇī</i> soc. membre de la communauté <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaratha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaratha</i> [<a href="#entry-ratha" class="skt-link">ratha</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaratha" class="skt-link">m.</a> arch. plan de temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaratna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaratna</i> [<a href="#entry-ratna" class="skt-link">ratna</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaratna" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcaratna «Cinq vers offerts comme joyaux», poème dévotionnel consacré à <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. collection de 5 épisodes du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>: <a href="#entry-Ubhagavadgiitaa" class="skt-link">Bhagavadgītā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhii_smastavaraaja" class="skt-link">Bhīṣmastavarāja</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nusahasranaamastotra" class="skt-link">Viṣṇusahasranāmastotra</a>, <a href="#entry-Uanusm_rti" class="skt-link">Anusmṛti</a> et <a href="#entry-Ugajendramok_sa_na" class="skt-link">Gajendramokṣaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncasandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcasandhi</i> [<a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncasandhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. les 5 articulations de récits dramatiques; ils combinent un ressort dramatique ou moyen d'action [<a href="#entry-arthaprak_rti" class="skt-link">arthaprakṛti</a>] et une étape de déroulement [<a href="#entry-kaaryaavasthaa" class="skt-link">kāryāvasthā</a>]; ils se nomment: <a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a> «en tête» (germe de l'intrigue), <a href="#entry-pratimukha" class="skt-link">pratimukha</a> «faire face» (épreuve à surmonter lors du crescendo de l'action, incident perturbateureur, épitasis) <a href="#entry-garbha" class="skt-link">garbha</a> «matrice» (paroxysme, nœud de l'intrigue), <a href="#entry-avamarza" class="skt-link">avamarśa</a> «contact» (coup de théâtre), et <a href="#entry-upasa_mh_rti" class="skt-link">upasaṃhṛti</a>/<a href="#entry-nirvaha_na" class="skt-link">nirvahaṇa</a> «catastrophe» (dénouement).<br> <i>nāṭakaṃ</i> <i>khyātavṛttaṃ</i> <i>syāt</i> <i>pañcasandhisamanvitam</i> On postule que les récits dramatiques sont dotés de 5 articulations.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncatantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pañcatantra, livre de contes instructifs destinés aux princes [<a href="#entry-niitizaastra" class="skt-link">nītiśāstra</a>] attribué à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nuzarmaa" class="skt-link">Viṣṇuśarmā</a>; il fut composé avant le 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il comprend 5 parties: <a href="#entry-mitrabheda" class="skt-link">mitrabheda</a>, <a href="#entry-mitrapraapti" class="skt-link">mitraprāpti</a>, <a href="#entry-kaakoluukiiya" class="skt-link">kākolūkīya</a>, <a href="#entry-labdhapranaazana" class="skt-link">labdhapranāśana</a> et <a href="#entry-apariik_sitakaaritva" class="skt-link">aparīkṣitakāritva</a>; il fut traduit en arabe en 750 sous le nom «Kalīla <i>wa</i> Dimna» (adaptation du nom des chacals <a href="#entry-Ukara_taka" class="skt-link">Karaṭaka</a> et <a href="#entry-Udamanaka" class="skt-link">Damanaka</a>); cf. <a href="#entry-Utantraakhyaayika" class="skt-link">Tantrākhyāyika</a>, <a href="#entry-Upa_ncaakhyaana" class="skt-link">Pañcākhyāna</a>, <a href="#entry-Uhitopadeza" class="skt-link">Hitopadeśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncatapas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcatapas</i> [<a href="#entry-tapas" class="skt-link">tapas</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncatapas" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [«les 5 feux»] dispositif de mortification, constitué de 4 brasiers disposés en carré (plus le soleil brûlant) entre lesquels un ascète s'expose.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncataya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcataya</i> [<a href="#entry--taya" class="skt-link">-taya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncataya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncataya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncatayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcatayī</i> constitué de 5 parties.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être cinq <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. matérialité (essence des 5 éléments matériels [<a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuuta" class="skt-link">pañcabhūta</a>]).<br> <i>pañcatvaṃ</i> <i>gam</i> mourir [«retourner aux 5 éléments»].<br> <i>pañcatvaṃ</i> <i>nī</i> tuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncav_rk_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcavṛkṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rk_sa" class="skt-link">vṛkṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncav_rk_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. les 5 arbres du paradis <a href="#entry-Usvarga" class="skt-link">Svarga</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>: <a href="#entry-kalpav_rk_sa" class="skt-link">kalpavṛkṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-paarijaataka" class="skt-link">pārijātaka</a>, <a href="#entry-mandaara" class="skt-link">mandāra</a>, <a href="#entry-kalpav_rk_sa" class="skt-link">kalpavṛkṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-santaana" class="skt-link">saṃtāna</a>, <a href="#entry-haricandana" class="skt-link">haricandana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcavṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. mode de formation d'un mot; on distingue: <a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a> (suffixe primaire) <a href="#entry-taddhita" class="skt-link">taddhita</a> (suffixe secondaire) <a href="#entry-samaasa" class="skt-link">samāsa</a> (composé) <a href="#entry-ekaze_sa" class="skt-link">ekaśeṣa</a> (forme duelle ou plurielle) et <a href="#entry-sanaadyanta" class="skt-link">sanādyanta</a> (conjugaison secondaire).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncava_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcavaṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-va_ta" class="skt-link">vaṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncava_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. cordon sacré des brâhmanes, constitué de 5 brins — <a href="#entry-pa_ncava_tii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcavaṭī</i> les 5 arbres sacrés: le pipal [<a href="#entry-azvattha" class="skt-link">aśvattha</a>], le cognassier du Bengale [<a href="#entry-bilva" class="skt-link">bilva</a>], le banian [<a href="#entry-va_ta" class="skt-link">vaṭa</a>], le myrobolan [<a href="#entry-dhaatrii" class="skt-link">dhātrī</a>] et l'ashok [<a href="#entry-azoka" class="skt-link">aśoka</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la Pañcavaṭī, forêt du Sud de l'Inde où prend sa source la <a href="#entry-Ugodaavarii" class="skt-link">Godāvarī</a>; myth. là se trouvait l'ermitage d'<a href="#entry-Uagasti" class="skt-link">Agasti</a> où <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> séjourna durant son exil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncavar_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcavarṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-var_sa" class="skt-link">varṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncavar_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncavar_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncavar_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcavarṣā</i> âgé de 5 ans.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

    <i>pañcavīra</i> [<a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">vīra</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaviira" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] les 5 héros du clan <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">vṛṣṇi</a>: <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva</a>, <a href="#entry-Usafkar_sa_na" class="skt-link">Saṃkarṣaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Usaamba" class="skt-link">Sāmba</a>, <a href="#entry-Upradyumna" class="skt-link">Pradyumna</a> et <a href="#entry-Uaniruddha" class="skt-link">Aniruddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncayuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcayuddha</i> [<a href="#entry-yuddha" class="skt-link">yuddha</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncayuddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> les 5 armes de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>: la masse [<a href="#entry-gadaa" class="skt-link">gadā</a>], l'épée [<a href="#entry-kha_dga" class="skt-link">khaḍga</a>], la conque [<a href="#entry-zafkha" class="skt-link">śaṅkha</a>], le disque de feu [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>], et l'arc [<a href="#entry-saarafga" class="skt-link">sāraṅga</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pañcayuddha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> «aux Cinq armes» (ses flèches de fleurs).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncazata">

    <i>pañcaśata</i> [<a href="#entry-zata" class="skt-link">śata</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncazata" class="skt-link">n.</a> 105 — a. <a href="#entry-pa_ncazata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncazata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pa_ncazatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pañcaśatī</i> pl. 500.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncaziila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pañcaśīla</i> [<a href="#entry-ziila" class="skt-link">śīla</a>] <a href="#entry-pa_ncaziila" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. les 5 interdits de la doctrine <a href="#entry-bauddha" class="skt-link">bauddha</a>: ne pas tuer, ne pas voler, ne pas avoir de rapports sexuels illicites, ne pas mentir, ne pas s'intoxiquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncazikha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_ncopaasana">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pa_njara">

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-peya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-peya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-peya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-peyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>peyā</i> à boire, buvable, potable; qui doit être bu — <a href="#entry-peya" class="skt-link">n.</a> boisson, breuvage — <a href="#entry-peyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>peyā</i> gruau de riz.

</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिढा</span> <i>piḍhā</i> <a href="#entry-pi_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gradin, étage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arch. temple au toit en gradins.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_n_da">

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(piṇḍayati)</i> faire une boule, assembler, joindre.<br> <i>piṇḍīkṛ</i> faire une boule; modeler, compresser, rassembler, concentrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'identifier avec ⟨i.-<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>⟩.<br> <i>piṇḍīkṛtya</i> adv. au total.<br> <i>evaṃ</i> <i>pinḍīkṛtya</i> <i>mahyaṃ</i> <i>viṃśatiṃ</i> <i>rūpakāndehi</i> donne-moi 20 roupies en tout.<br> <i>piṇḍībhū</i> être mis en boule; devenir compact.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_n_daalaktaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_n_ditaartha">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_s">

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(pinaṣṭi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>piṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>nis</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> moudre, piler, broyer, écraser; détruire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>pinso</i>.<br> <i>cūrṇapeṣaṃ</i> <i>piṣ</i> réduire en poudre.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिच्छल</span> <i>picchala</i> [<a href="#entry-piccha" class="skt-link">piccha</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-picchala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-picchala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-picchalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>picchalā</i> baveux; visqueux; glissant.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-picchila">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-picu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिचु</span> <i>picu</i> <a href="#entry-picu" class="skt-link">m.</a> coton.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-picumata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>picumata</i> [<a href="#entry-mata" class="skt-link">mata</a>] <a href="#entry-picumata" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] np. du Picumata «doctrine du coton»; cf. Brahmayāmala.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-picuvaktra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>picuvaktra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaktra" class="skt-link">vaktra</a>] <a href="#entry-picuvaktra" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] «bouche de coton», euphémisme pour la vulve d'une <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-picu" class="skt-link">picu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pidhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिधा</span> <i>pidhā</i> [<a href="#entry-pi_1" class="skt-link">pi_1</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(pidadhāti)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pidhāya</i><i>)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pihita</i><i>)</i> fermer, obstruer, boucher.<br> <i>pidhehi</i> ferme (la porte, etc.).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिधान</span> <i>pidhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pidhaa" class="skt-link">pidhā</a>] <a href="#entry-pidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> obstruction, fermeture; couverture, fourreau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pidhaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिधाय</span> <i>pidhāya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-pidhaa" class="skt-link">pidhā</a>] ind. ayant obstrué.<br> <i>karnau</i> <i>pidhāya</i> se bouchant les oreilles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pifga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिङ्ग</span> <i>piṅga</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pi_nj" class="skt-link">piñj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgā</i> jaune; brun rougeâtre, tanné — <a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur jaune ou brun <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> souris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. pink.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pifgaak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piṅgākṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pifgaak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgaak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgaak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgākṣī</i> qui a les yeux bruns.<br> <i>aruṇayā</i> <i>piṅgākṣyā</i> <i>ekahāyanyā</i> <i>somaṃ</i> <i>krīṇāti</i> véd. On achète le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> avec une jeune (vache) rouge aux yeux bruns.<br> <a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">piṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pifgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिङ्गल</span> <i>piṅgala</i> [<a href="#entry-pifga" class="skt-link">piṅga</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgalā</i> rougeâtre, cuivré, brun, tanné; jaune d'or, doré — <a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur dorée; nom de divers animaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Piṅgala «Bronzé», serviteur de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>; il mesure les bonnes actions et les péchés des mortels; on le représente barbu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Piṅgala_1 «Tanné», personnifiant l'an 51 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du mathématicien Piṅgala_2 (2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.); on ne sait rien de sa vie; il rédigea une théorie de la prosodie [<a href="#entry-Uchanda_hzaastra" class="skt-link">Chandaḥśāstra</a>]; il y décrit la combinatoire des combinaisons de n syllabes longues [<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>] ou brèves [<a href="#entry-laghu" class="skt-link">laghu</a>] — <a href="#entry-pifgalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgalā</i> sorte de bronze <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nom de divers oiseaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] le canal psychique solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryanaa_dii" class="skt-link">sūryanāḍī</a>] Piṅgalā du côté droit, représentation de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a> dans le microcosme; cf. <a href="#entry-Ui_daa" class="skt-link">Iḍā</a>, <a href="#entry-Usu_sum_naa" class="skt-link">Suṣumṇā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [tantr.] np. de Piṅgalā_1 «Dorée», l'une des 8 puissances divines [<a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [BhP.] np. de Piṅgalā_2, riche courtisane de <a href="#entry-Uvidizaa" class="skt-link">Vidiśā</a>; en attendant son amant, elle fut frappée par la grâce, et se retira à la forêt comme ermite; son histoire fut contée au roi <a href="#entry-Uyadu" class="skt-link">Yadu</a> par un renonçant [<a href="#entry-avadhuuta" class="skt-link">avadhūta</a>] qui la tenait pour l'un de ses maîtres [<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pifgalaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piṅgalaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pifgalaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgalaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgalikā</i> jaune, cuivré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-yak_sa" class="skt-link">yakṣa</a> Piṅgalaka <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nom de divers animaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [PT.] np. du roi-lion Piṅgalaka_1 «Fauve»; les chacals <a href="#entry-Ukara_taka" class="skt-link">Karaṭaka</a> et <a href="#entry-Udamanaka" class="skt-link">Damanaka</a> sont ses conseillers.<br> <a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">piṅgala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pifgalin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिङ्गलिन्</span> <i>piṅgalin</i> [<a href="#entry-pifgala" class="skt-link">piṅgala</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pifgalin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgalin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pifgalinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piṅgalinī</i> cuivré, brun.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pihita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिहित</span> <i>pihita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pidhaa" class="skt-link">pidhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pihita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pihitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pihitā</i> fermé; caché, dissimulé; couvert par ⟨i.⟩ — <a href="#entry-pihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. figure de style, où l'on prétend connaître les secrets de son interlocuteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पी</span> <i>pī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_d">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीड्</span> <i>pīḍ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pīḍayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pīḍita</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(pīḍayat)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>pari</i><i>)</i> presser, comprimer, écraser, broyer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tourmenter, maltraiter, opprimer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assiéger (une ville); rompre (un vœu); négliger (sa famille) — ps. <i>(pīḍyate)</i> être tourmenté, être affligé; souffrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πιεζω.<br> <i>pīḍyate</i> <i>me</i> <i>hṛdayam</i> Mon cœur est en peine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीडा</span> <i>pīḍā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pii_d" class="skt-link">pīḍ</a>] <a href="#entry-pii_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> peine, douleur, souffrance, tourment; blessure, dommage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dévastation; restriction, limitation; fait d'obscurcir, éclipse.<br> <i>pīḍayā</i> adv. à contre-cœur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_dana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीडन</span> <i>pīḍana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pii_d" class="skt-link">pīḍ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pii_dana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_dana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_danaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīḍanā</i> qui afflige, qui tourmente, qui fait souffrir — <a href="#entry-pii_dana" class="skt-link">n.</a> pression; pressage, écrasement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> oppression, tourment; infortune, calamité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> presse, pressoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_dayat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीडयत्</span> <i>pīḍayat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-pii_d" class="skt-link">pīḍ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pii_dayat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_dayat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_dayantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīḍayantī</i> qui tourmente, qui opprime.<br> <i>kālaṃ</i> <i>kālena</i> <i>pīḍayan</i> en laissant faire le temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_dita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीडित</span> <i>pīḍita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pii_d" class="skt-link">pīḍ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pii_dita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_dita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_ditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīḍitā</i> pressé, écrasé; opprimé, maltraité, tourmenté (par ⟨i.⟩); affligé.<br> <i>pīḍitam</i> adv. en pressant; étroitement (embrassade).<br> <i>kṣudhayā</i> <i>pīḍita</i> tourmenté par la faim.<br> <i>pipāsayā</i> <i>pīḍita</i> tourmenté par la soif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीठ</span> <i>pīṭha</i> <a href="#entry-pii_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> siège, chaise; trône, piédestal, socle; district; centre religieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arch. socle-support du <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> dans un sanctuaire; syn. <a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. (plus gén.) siège de la divinité; socle d'une idole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_thaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīṭhaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pii_thaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_thaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pii_thikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīṭhikā</i> tabouret, chaise; banc; table; piédestal.<br> <i>utpīṭhikāyām</i> adv. sur la table.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_thamarda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīṭhamarda</i> [<a href="#entry-marda" class="skt-link">marda</a>] <a href="#entry-pii_thamarda" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«briseur de trône»] compagnon d'un prince ou du héros d'une pièce de théâtre; parasite, bouffon.<br> <i>pīṭhamardaviṭavidūuṣakāḥ</i> entremetteurs et débauchés divers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pii_thasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīṭhasthāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a>] <a href="#entry-pii_thasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. l'un des 51 (ou 108) endroits sacrés où sont tombés les morceaux du corps de <a href="#entry-Usatii" class="skt-link">Satī</a> quand <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> parcourut l'Univers comme un dément en transportant son cadavre, que <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> découpait en morceaux avec ses flèches; syn. <a href="#entry-deviipii_tha" class="skt-link">devīpīṭha</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pii_tha" class="skt-link">pīṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीन</span> <i>pīna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīnā</i> enflé, gonflé; musclé; épais, gras, gros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piita_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीत</span> <i>pīta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piita_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piita_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piitaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītā_1</i> bu, absorbé, avalé — ifc. abreuvé, saturé, rempli de.<br> <i>pītā</i> <i>gāvaḥ</i> les vaches ont bu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piita_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीत</span> <i>pīta_2</i> a. <a href="#entry-piita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piitaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītā_2</i> jaune (couleur des <a href="#entry-vaizyaas" class="skt-link">vaiśyās</a>) — <a href="#entry-piita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> substance jaune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitaambara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītāmbara</i> [<a href="#entry-ambara" class="skt-link">ambara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piitaambara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piitaambara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piitaambaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītāmbarā</i> vêtu de jaune — <a href="#entry-piitaambara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pītāmbara, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Vêtu de jaune» — <a href="#entry-piitaambaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītāmbarā</i> myth. np. de Pītāmbarā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvagalaa" class="skt-link">Vagalā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitaazman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītāśman</i> [<a href="#entry-azman" class="skt-link">aśman</a>] <a href="#entry-piitaazman" class="skt-link">m.</a> topaze.<br> <a href="#entry-piita_2" class="skt-link">pīta_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitakauzeya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītakauśeya</i> [<a href="#entry-kauzeya" class="skt-link">kauśeya</a>] <a href="#entry-piitakauzeya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soierie jaune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītala</i> [<a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piitala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piitala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piitalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītalā</i> jaune — <a href="#entry-piitala" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur jaune — <a href="#entry-piitala" class="skt-link">n.</a> laiton.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitarakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītarakta</i> [<a href="#entry-rakta" class="skt-link">rakta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piitarakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piitarakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piitaraktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pītaraktā</i> orangé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piitavaasas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pītavāsas</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasas" class="skt-link">vāsas</a>] <a href="#entry-piitavaasas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pītavāsas, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Vêtu de jaune».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीति</span> <i>pīti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-piiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de boire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tirage d'une boisson <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> taverne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piivan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीवन्</span> <i>pīvan</i> [<a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a><a href="#entry--van" class="skt-link">-van</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piivan" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piivan" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piivarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīvarī</i> enflé, gonflé; épais, gras, gros, fort — <a href="#entry-piivarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīvarī</i> jeune femme, jolie femme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pīvarī «Plantureuse», fille spirituelle des <a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Uzuka" class="skt-link">Śuka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piivara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीवर</span> <i>pīvara</i> [<a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a><a href="#entry--vara" class="skt-link">-vara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-piivara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piivara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-piivaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pīvarā</i> gras, gros, fort; dense — ifc. gonflé de, plein de; qui abonde en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piiyuu_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पीयूष</span> <i>pīyūṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pi_2" class="skt-link">pi_2</a>] <a href="#entry-piiyuu_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-piiyuu_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> lait crémeux; not. d'une vache ayant vêlé dans la semaine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (par ext.) crème, jus, sirop <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. breuvage d'immortalité, nectar; il fut obtenu par barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piiyuu_sadhaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīyūṣadhāman</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaaman" class="skt-link">dhāman</a>] <a href="#entry-piiyuu_sadhaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> «réceptacle du nectar», épith. de la Lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piiyuu_sadhaaraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīyūṣadhārā</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaaraa_1" class="skt-link">dhārā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-piiyuu_sadhaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> «courant de nectar», épith. de la Lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piiyuu_savar_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pīyūṣavarṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-var_sa" class="skt-link">varṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-piiyuu_savar_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> pluie de nectar — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(pīyūṣavarṣāyate)</i> devenir une pluie de nectar.<br> <a href="#entry-piiyuu_sa" class="skt-link">pīyūṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिक</span> <i>pika</i> <a href="#entry-pika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pikī</i> natu. zoo. <i>Cuculus indicus</i>, coucou indien; on dit qu'il aime les manguiers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pikaraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pikarāga</i> [<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] <a href="#entry-pikaraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. [«préféré des coucous»] manguier.<br> <a href="#entry-pika" class="skt-link">pika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pinaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिनाक</span> <i>pināka</i> <a href="#entry-pinaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pinaaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> massue, gourdin; arc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. arc de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>; trident de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pinaakin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pinākin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-pinaakin" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pinākin «l'Archer», épith. de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>-<a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Utripura" class="skt-link">Tripura</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pinaaka" class="skt-link">pināka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pipa_thi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिपठिष्</span> <i>pipaṭhiṣ</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-pa_th" class="skt-link">paṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pipa_thi_s" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pipa_thi_s" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pipa_thi_s" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui souhaite s'instruire.
  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिपास्</span> <i>pipās</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] v. pr. <i>(pipāsati)</i> désirer boire; avoir soif.

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिपासा</span> <i>pipāsā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pipaas" class="skt-link">pipās</a>] <a href="#entry-pipaasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir de boire, soif.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pipaasat">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pipiila">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pippala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिप्पल</span> <i>pippala</i> <a href="#entry-pippala" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Ficus religiosa</i>, pipal ou figuier sacré (le <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> reçut l'Éveil sous un pipal); syn. <a href="#entry-azvattha" class="skt-link">aśvattha</a>, <a href="#entry-bodhitaru" class="skt-link">bodhitaru</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> téton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] np. de Pippala, fils de <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a> et <a href="#entry-Urevatii" class="skt-link">Revatī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> école de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-pippalaada" class="skt-link">pippalāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pippalaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pippalāda</i> [<a href="#entry-ada" class="skt-link">ada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pippalaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pippalaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pippalaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pippalādā</i> qui mange le fruit du pipal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> épicurien <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. dominé par ses passions; [MO.] deux oiseaux perchés sur un pipal, l'un qui en mange le fruit, l'autre le regardant seulement, sont comparables à l'homme [<a href="#entry-jiivaatman" class="skt-link">jīvātman</a>] consommant le fruit de ses actes [<a href="#entry-karma" class="skt-link">karma</a>] et à l'Esprit Suprême [<a href="#entry-paramaatman" class="skt-link">paramātman</a>] son impassible témoin — <a href="#entry-pippalaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Pippalāda «Gourmand», ancien maître d'une école de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pippalādās</i> ses adeptes.<br> <a href="#entry-pippala" class="skt-link">pippala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pippalaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pippalaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pippalaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> téton.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pippali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिप्पलि</span> <i>pippali</i> <a href="#entry-pippali" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Piper longum</i>, poivrier long; cette liane produit un poivre moins fort que le poivre noir [<a href="#entry-marica" class="skt-link">marica</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>pippalī</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>piper</i>; ang. pepper; fr. poivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पितृ</span> <i>pitṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-paa_2" class="skt-link">pā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui protège <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> père <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>pitarau</i> les parents (père et mère) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pitaras</i> myth. les ancêtres; les mânes; cf. <a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. ils président le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> de <a href="#entry-Umaghaas" class="skt-link">Maghās</a> (Régulus) ainsi que celui de <a href="#entry-Umuulabarha_nii" class="skt-link">Mūlabarhaṇī</a> (ε du Scorpion) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πατηρ; lat. <i>pater</i>; ang. father; all. Vater; fr. père.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rdeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛdeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rdeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>pitṛdevās</i> myth. les dieux et les mânes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] possession par un ancêtre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rloka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛloka</i> [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rloka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du ciel Pitṛloka où demeurent les mânes [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rmedha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛmedha</i> [<a href="#entry-medha" class="skt-link">medha</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rmedha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. oblation aux mânes; ce rite est effectué un an ou plus après un décès; les participants font trois tours autour de l'urne contenant les cendres du défunt, au début, au milieu et à la fin d'une nuit d'été; on y joue de la <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>, on chante, et à l'aube les restes du défunt sont enterrés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rpaitaamaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛpaitāmaha</i> [<a href="#entry-paitaamaha" class="skt-link">paitāmaha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pit_rpaitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pit_rpaitaamaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pit_rpaitaamahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitṛpaitāmahī</i> ancestral — <a href="#entry-pit_rpaitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. les ancêtres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rpak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛpakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rpak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. demi mois lunaire après la pleine lune du mois <a href="#entry-bhaadrapada" class="skt-link">bhādrapada</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rsvas_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛsvasṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-svas_r" class="skt-link">svasṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rsvas_r" class="skt-link">f.</a> tante paternelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rsvasriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛsvasrīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rsvasriiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> cousin (fils d'une tante paternelle) — <a href="#entry-pit_rsvasriiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitṛsvasrīyā</i> cousine.<br> <a href="#entry-pit_rsvas_r" class="skt-link">pitṛsvasṛ</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pit_r" class="skt-link">pitṛ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rtiirtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛtīrtha</i> [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rtiirtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du Pitṛtīrtha «Purgatoire», aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Ukumbhiipaakanaraka" class="skt-link">Kumbhīpākanaraka</a>, enfer où sont torturés les damnés au <a href="#entry-Upit_rloka" class="skt-link">Pitṛloka</a>; il fut changé en paradis par <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rtva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛtva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rtva" class="skt-link">n.</a> qualité de père.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pit_rvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pit_rvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pit_rvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitṛvatī</i> dont le père est encore vivant — adv. à la manière d'un père.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rvya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पितृव्य</span> <i>pitṛvya</i> [<a href="#entry-pit_r" class="skt-link">pitṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rvya" class="skt-link">m.</a> oncle paternel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> parent âgé du côté paternel — <a href="#entry-pit_rvyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitṛvyā</i> son épouse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_rvyaputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛvyaputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_rvyaputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> cousin (fils d'un oncle paternel) — <a href="#entry-pit_rvyaputrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitṛvyaputrī</i> cousine.<br> <a href="#entry-pit_rvya" class="skt-link">pitṛvya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_ryaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛyāna</i> [<a href="#entry-yaana" class="skt-link">yāna</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_ryaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pit_ryaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. transmigration à la mort, par la «voie des ancêtres», opp. <a href="#entry-devayaana" class="skt-link">devayāna</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>pitṛyāṇa</i> véd. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pit_ryaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitṛyajña</i> [<a href="#entry-yaj_na" class="skt-link">yajña</a>] <a href="#entry-pit_ryaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [SB.] véd. le sacrifice aux ancêtres, un des cinq rites majeurs [<a href="#entry-mahaayaj_na" class="skt-link">mahāyajña</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिता</span> <i>pitā</i> [nom. <a href="#entry-pit_r" class="skt-link">pitṛ</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitaamaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitāmaha</i> [<a href="#entry-mahat" class="skt-link">mahat</a>] <a href="#entry-pitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> grand-père paternel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pitāmaha «l'Aïeul», un nom de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> — <a href="#entry-pitaamahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitāmahī</i> grand-mère paternelle.<br> <a href="#entry-pitaa" class="skt-link">pitā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitaaputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitāputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-pitaaputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. <i>pitāputrau</i> père et fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitaaputravirodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pitāputravirodha</i> [<a href="#entry-virodha" class="skt-link">virodha</a>] <a href="#entry-pitaaputravirodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> compéttion entre le père et le fils.<br> <a href="#entry-pitaaputra" class="skt-link">pitāputra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitrya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पित्र्य</span> <i>pitrya</i> [<a href="#entry-pit_r" class="skt-link">pitṛ</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pitrya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pitrya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pitryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pitryā</i> paternel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पित्त</span> <i>pitta</i> <a href="#entry-pitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> méd. la bile, une des 3 humeurs; cf. <a href="#entry-trido_sa" class="skt-link">tridoṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pittaazaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pittāśaya</i> [<a href="#entry-aazaya" class="skt-link">āśaya</a>] <a href="#entry-pittaazaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> méd. vésicule biliaire.<br> <a href="#entry-pitta" class="skt-link">pitta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pittala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pittala</i> [<a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pittala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pittala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pittaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pittālā</i> méd. bilieux; qui sécréte de la bile — <a href="#entry-pittala" class="skt-link">n.</a> bronze.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pitu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पितु</span> <i>pitu</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_1" class="skt-link">pā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pitu" class="skt-link">m.</a> jus, boisson; nourriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिश्</span> <i>piś_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(piṃśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>piśita</i><i>)</i> découper (la chair des victimes); parer (de la viande) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> orner, façonner, décorer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ποικιλος.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-piz_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिश्</span> <i>piś_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-piz_1" class="skt-link">piś_1</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-piz_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> ornement, décoration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizaaca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिशाच</span> <i>piśāca</i> [<a href="#entry-piz_1" class="skt-link">piś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pizaaca" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. démon cannibale; ogre, vampire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>piśācās</i> myth. la classe des ogres cannibales; ils descendent de <a href="#entry-Ukrodhaa" class="skt-link">Krodhā</a> — <a href="#entry-pizaacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piśācā</i> myth. ogresse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Piśācā, fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, mère des <a href="#entry-pizaacaas" class="skt-link">piśācās</a>; plus tard remplacée par <a href="#entry-Ukrodhaa" class="skt-link">Krodhā</a> — <a href="#entry-pizaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piśācī</i> myth. ogresse — <a href="#entry-pizaaci" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>piśāci</i> ifc. ogre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizaacagraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piśācagraha</i> [<a href="#entry-graha" class="skt-link">graha</a>] <a href="#entry-pizaacagraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] possession par un ogre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizaacavelaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piśācavelā</i> [<a href="#entry-velaa" class="skt-link">velā</a>] <a href="#entry-pizaacavelaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> tard dans la nuit [«à l'heure où rôdent les démons»].<br> <a href="#entry-pizaaca" class="skt-link">piśāca</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piśaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pizafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pizafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pizafgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piśaṅgī</i> rougeâtre, brun.<br> <i>piśaṅgīkṛ</i> teindre en rouge.<br> <a href="#entry-piz_2" class="skt-link">piś_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिशित</span> <i>piśita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-piz_1" class="skt-link">piś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pizita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pizita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pizitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piśitā</i> préparé, décoré — <a href="#entry-pizita" class="skt-link">n.</a> viande découpée; chair.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizuna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिशुन</span> <i>piśuna</i> [<a href="#entry-piz_1" class="skt-link">piś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pizuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> traître, calomniateur; méchant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πικρος; all. Fehde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizunataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>piśunatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pizunataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> calomnie.<br> <a href="#entry-pizuna" class="skt-link">piśuna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pizunya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिशुन्य</span> <i>piśunya</i> [<a href="#entry-pizuna" class="skt-link">piśuna</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-pizunya" class="skt-link">n.</a> calomnie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिञ्ज्</span> <i>piñj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(piṅkte)</i> teindre; peindre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pi_njara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पिञ्जर</span> <i>piñjara</i> [<a href="#entry-pi_nj" class="skt-link">piñj</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pi_njara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pi_njara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pi_njaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>piñjarā</i> doré; tanné — <a href="#entry-pi_njara" class="skt-link">n.</a> or <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> orpiment.<br> <i>piñjarīkṛ</i> teindre en rouge-jaunâtre; dorer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-plaak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्लाक्ष</span> <i>plākṣa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-plak_sa" class="skt-link">plakṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-plaak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-plaak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-plaak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>plākṣī</i> concernant le figuier — <a href="#entry-plaak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> son fruit.
  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणेतृ</span> <i>praṇetṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pra_nii" class="skt-link">praṇī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pra_net_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_net_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_netrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praṇetrī</i> guide; créateur, maître; promulgateur d'une doctrine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nidhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणिधा</span> <i>praṇidhā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-nidhaa" class="skt-link">nidhā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(praṇidadhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praṇihita</i><i>)</i> déposer, poser; s'approcher de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diriger (les yeux, l'esprit) sur ⟨loc.⟩; s'absorber dans ⟨loc.⟩; fixer son attention, réfléchir, méditer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणिधान</span> <i>praṇidhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pra_nidhaa" class="skt-link">praṇidhā</a>] <a href="#entry-pra_nidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> respect, soumission, dévotion; méditation profonde, absorption.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणिधि</span> <i>praṇidhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pra_nidhaa" class="skt-link">praṇidhā</a>] <a href="#entry-pra_nidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> observateur; espion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> émissaire; agent secret; serviteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sollicitation, requête; prière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणी</span> <i>praṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-nii_1" class="skt-link">nī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(praṇayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praṇīta</i><i>)</i> conduire; porter (not. eau, feu ou <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> sur l'autel) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exécuter, accomplir; infliger (une peine) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> établir, fixer; composer (un ouvrage); enseigner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> montrer de l'affection, aimer, désirer.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pra_nii" class="skt-link">praṇī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pra_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praṇīyā</i> à conduire devant
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(praṇipatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praṇipatita</i><i>)</i> se jeter aux pieds de; se prosterner devant ⟨acc. dat. loc.⟩ — ca. <i>(praṇipātayati)</i> faire se prosterner.<br> <i>praṇipatya</i> ind. s'étant prosterné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nipatana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणिपतन</span> <i>praṇipatana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pra_nipat" class="skt-link">praṇipat</a>] <a href="#entry-pra_nipatana" class="skt-link">n.</a> révérence; fait de se jeter aux pieds de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nipatita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणिपतित</span> <i>praṇipatita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pra_nipat" class="skt-link">praṇipat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pra_nipatita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_nipatita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_nipatitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praṇipatitā</i> prosterné, incliné respectueusement.
  </div>
</div>
