[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(praṇauti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praṇuta</i><i>)</i> bourdonner; not. chanter ou murmurer la syllabe sacrée <a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a> ॐ.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_nud">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रणुद्</span> <i>praṇud</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-nud" class="skt-link">nud</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(praṇudati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praṇunna</i><i>)</i> pousser, mettre en branle; repousser, chasser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_s_tavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रष्टव्य</span> <i>praṣṭavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-praz" class="skt-link">praś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pra_s_tavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_s_tavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pra_s_tavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praṣṭavyā</i> à demander.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_ucya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रउच्य</span> <i>pra_ucya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] ind. ayant proclamé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pra_uga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_n_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राण्</span> <i>prāṇ_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-an_2" class="skt-link">an_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prāṇiti)</i> respirer, souffler; vivre — ca. <i>(prāṇayati)</i> animer, donner le souffle — dés. <i>(prāṇiṇiṣati)</i> désirer respirer ou vivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_n_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राण्</span> <i>prāṇ_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-praa_n_1" class="skt-link">prāṇ_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-praa_n_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_n_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_n_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui respire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राण</span> <i>prāṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praa_n_1" class="skt-link">prāṇ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> souffle, respiration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>prāṇavāyu</i>] phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la respiration, l'un des 5 souffles vitaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vie, vigueur, énergie, pouvoir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>prāṇās</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] les 5 flux ou souffles vitaux: le flux d'excrétion [<a href="#entry-apaana" class="skt-link">apāna</a>], le flux d'élévation [<a href="#entry-udaana" class="skt-link">udāna</a>], la respiration [<a href="#entry-praa_na" class="skt-link">prāṇa</a>], la digestion [<a href="#entry-samaana_1" class="skt-link">samāna_1</a>] et le souffle vital [<a href="#entry-vyaana" class="skt-link">vyāna</a>], qui combine les 4 autres <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>rudraprāṇās</i>] phil. les 11 énergies vitales de l'homme, corr. aux 10 centres vitaux plus <a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a> l'âme; cf. <a href="#entry-rudra" class="skt-link">rudra</a>, <a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a> — <a href="#entry-praa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṇā</i> ifc. id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. φρην.<br> <i>tvam</i> <i>me</i> <i>prāṇaḥ</i> tu m'es aussi cher/chère que la vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_naabhara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇābharaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aabhara_na" class="skt-link">ābharaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_naabhara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Prāṇābharaṇa, eulogie du roi <a href="#entry-Upraa_nanaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Prāṇanārāyaṇa</a> des <a href="#entry-Ukaamaruupaas" class="skt-link">Kāmarūpās</a> due à <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha_1" class="skt-link">Jagannātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Upa_n_ditaraaja" class="skt-link">Paṇḍitarāja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_naantika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇāntika</i> [<a href="#entry-antika" class="skt-link">antika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praa_naantika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_naantika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_naantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṇāntikā</i> fatal, mortel; capital (châtiment) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à vie — <a href="#entry-praa_naantika" class="skt-link">n.</a> danger mortel.<br> <i>prāṇāntikam</i> adv. à vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_naayaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇāyāma</i> [<a href="#entry-aayaama" class="skt-link">āyāma</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_naayaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. la discipline du souffle, 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ étape du <a href="#entry-raajayoga" class="skt-link">rājayoga</a>; les 3 phases de la respiration sont l'inspiration [<a href="#entry-puuraka" class="skt-link">pūraka</a>], le blocage [<a href="#entry-kumbhaka" class="skt-link">kumbhaka</a>] et l'expiration [<a href="#entry-recaka" class="skt-link">recaka</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgayoga" class="skt-link">aṣṭāṅgayoga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. l'un des 3 actes de purification, avec la formule [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] et le geste [<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_naayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_naayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> organe des sens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nabh_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇabhṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-bh_rt" class="skt-link">bhṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_nabh_rt" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«qui respire»] être vivant; homme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nahara">

    <i>prāṇahara</i> [<a href="#entry-hara" class="skt-link">hara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praa_nahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_nahara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_naharii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṇaharī</i> [«qui prend la vie»] fatal (à ⟨iic.⟩) — <a href="#entry-praa_nahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> peine capitale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_namaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praa_namaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_namaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_namayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṇamayā</i> formé de souffle, vital.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_namayakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇamayakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_namayakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] l'enveloppe des souffles vitaux, formant avec <a href="#entry-annamayakoza" class="skt-link">annamayakośa</a> le corps grossier [<a href="#entry-sthuulazariira" class="skt-link">sthūlaśarīra</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-praa_namaya" class="skt-link">prāṇamaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nanaaraaya_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇanārāyaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-naaraaya_na" class="skt-link">nārāyaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_nanaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Prāṇanārāyaṇa des <a href="#entry-Ukaamaruupaas" class="skt-link">Kāmarūpās</a> (vers 1600); <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha_1" class="skt-link">Jagannātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Upa_n_ditaraaja" class="skt-link">Paṇḍitarāja</a> écrivit son eulogie <a href="#entry-Upraa_naabhara_na" class="skt-link">Prāṇābharaṇa</a>.
  </div>

    <i>prāṇapati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_napati" class="skt-link">m.</a> âme [«maître des souffles vitaux»].

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇasiddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_nasiddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la connaissance du souffle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nato_si_nii">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nayaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇayāma</i> [<a href="#entry-yaama" class="skt-link">yāma</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_nayaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-praa_naayaama" class="skt-link">prāṇāyāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṇeśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-praa_nezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. époux [«maître de la vie»].<br> <a href="#entry-praa_na" class="skt-link">prāṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_nin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राणिन्</span> <i>prāṇin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-praa_n_1" class="skt-link">prāṇ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praa_nin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_nin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praa_ninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṇinī</i> qui respire, vivant — <a href="#entry-praa_nin" class="skt-link">m.</a> être vivant; animal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रा</span> <i>prā_1</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-p_rr" class="skt-link">pṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prāti)</i> véd. remplir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रा</span> <i>prā_2</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praabhaakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राभाकर</span> <i>prābhākara</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prabhaakara" class="skt-link">prabhākara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praabhaakara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praabhaakara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praabhaakaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prābhākarā</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Uprabhaakara" class="skt-link">Prabhākara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. qualifie not. la doctrine <a href="#entry-Umiimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">Mīmāṃsā</a> selon <a href="#entry-Uprabhaakara" class="skt-link">Prabhākara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राच्</span> <i>prāc</i> var. <i>prāñc</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prācī</i> tourné vers l'avant, tourné vers l'Est; oriental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à l'est de ⟨abl.⟩; précédent, antérieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. qui pratique la <a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a> avec ferveur — <a href="#entry-praacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prācī</i> l'Orient, l'Est, le Levant.<br> <i>prāk</i> adv. avant, auparavant, autrefois; avant qqc. ⟨abl.⟩.<br> <i>prāg</i> <i>eva</i> adv. peu de temps avant, précédemment; avant tout.<br> <i>iti</i> <i>prāñcaḥ</i> selon les anciens auteurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praacaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राचार्य</span> <i>prācārya</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>] <a href="#entry-praacaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> maître avancé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaciina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācīna</i> [<a href="#entry--iina" class="skt-link">-īna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praaciina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaciina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaciinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prācīnā</i> tourné vers l'avant ou vers l'Orient; oriental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> antérieur, ancien, vieux.<br> <i>prācīnam</i> adv. en avant, avant; autrefois; vers l'Orient; à l'est de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaciinaamalaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācīnāmalaka</i> [<a href="#entry-aamalaka" class="skt-link">āmalaka</a>] <a href="#entry-praaciinaamalaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Flacourtia cataphracta</i>, petit arbre produisant des fruits ronds bruns comestibles — <a href="#entry-praaciinaamalaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> son fruit.<br> <a href="#entry-praaciinabhaarata" class="skt-link">prācīnabhārata</a> <br> <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">prāc</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaciinabhaarata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācīnabhārata</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaarata" class="skt-link">bhārata</a>] <a href="#entry-praaciinabhaarata" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. l'Inde ancienne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaciinanyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācīnanyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-praaciinanyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. école ancienne du <a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a> (opp. l'école nouvelle [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>]).<br> <a href="#entry-praaciina" class="skt-link">prācīna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaciinava_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācīnavaṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-praaciinava_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. hutte de paille orientée vers l'Est, contenant l'aire du sacrifice véd. [<a href="#entry-vedi" class="skt-link">vedi</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praacya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राच्य</span> <i>prācya</i> [<a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">prāc</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praacya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praacya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praacyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prācyā</i> en avant; oriental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> antérieur; ancien, vieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>prācyās</i> géo. la région de l'Est; ses habitants — <a href="#entry-praacyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prācyā</i> [<i>prācyabhāṣā</i>] la langue parlée à l'Est de l'Inde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praacyabodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prācyabodha</i> [<a href="#entry-bodha" class="skt-link">bodha</a>] <a href="#entry-praacyabodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. archéologie.<br> <a href="#entry-praacya" class="skt-link">prācya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रादेश</span> <i>prādeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aadeza" class="skt-link">ādeśa</a>] <a href="#entry-praadeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> empan (mesure de longueur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> geste du maître touchant l'épaule de l'élève entre le pouce et l'index.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadhaanya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राधान्य</span> <i>prādhānya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">pradhāna</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praadhaanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> suprématie, prééminence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chef <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ubhoja_1" class="skt-link">Bhoja_1</a>] prééminence du discours: signifiant (<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>), signifié (pouvant prêter à paraphrase), ou mixte (poésie).<br> <i>prādhānyena</i> var. <i>prādhānyāt</i> adv. principalement, pour l'essentiel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadhaanyatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prādhānyatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. principalement, pour l'essentiel.<br> <a href="#entry-praadhaanya" class="skt-link">prādhānya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रादि</span> <i>prādi</i> [<i>(pra)</i>-<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>] <a href="#entry-praadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. préposition [«(dans la liste) qui commence par ‘<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>’»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadibahuvriihi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prādibahuvrīhi</i> [<a href="#entry-bahuvriihi" class="skt-link">bahuvrīhi</a>] <a href="#entry-praadibahuvriihi" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. composé exocentrique commençant par une préposition.<br> <a href="#entry-praadi" class="skt-link">prādi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रादुर्</span> <i>prādur</i> adv. visiblement, évidem­ment; en vue.<br> <i>prādur</i> <i>as</i> être visible, apparaître, se révéler.<br> <i>prāduṣkṛ</i> rendre visible, révéler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praadurbhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prādurbhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-praadurbhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> manifestation, révélation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épiphanie, manifestation divine sur Terre, not. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praadur" class="skt-link">prādur</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaf">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राङ्</span> <i>prāṅ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">prāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praafmukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāṅmukha</i> [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praafmukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praafmukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praafmukhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṅmukhā</i> <a href="#entry-praafmukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāṅmukhī</i> faisant face à l'Est.<br> <i>prāṅmukham</i> adv. vers l'Est.<br> <i>prāṅmukhaḥ</i> <i>upaviśya</i> <i>sūtrāṇi</i> <i>praṇayati</i> <i>sma</i> [<a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>] Assis face à l'Est, (<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>) établit ses règles.<br> <a href="#entry-praaf" class="skt-link">prāṅ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praag">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राग्</span> <i>prāg</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">prāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagbhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgbhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaara" class="skt-link">bhāra</a>] <a href="#entry-praagbhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> pente d'une montagne, piémont <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inclinaison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> proximité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> multitude, quantité, tas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagbhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgbhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-praagbhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. existence précédente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> supériorité, excellence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagbhaavatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgbhāvatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. par une existence antérieure.<br> <a href="#entry-praagbhaava" class="skt-link">prāgbhāva</a> <br> <a href="#entry-praag" class="skt-link">prāg</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagbhakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgbhakta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhakta" class="skt-link">bhakta</a>] <a href="#entry-praagbhakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> (médicament) à prendre avant le repas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagdeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgdeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-deza" class="skt-link">deśa</a>] <a href="#entry-praagdeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> pays de l'Est.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagdiz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgdiś</i> [<a href="#entry-diz_2" class="skt-link">diś_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praagdiz" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praagdiz" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praagdiz" class="skt-link">f.</a> mentionné précédemment — <a href="#entry-praagdiz" class="skt-link">f.</a> direction de l'Est.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagdvaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgdvāra</i> [<a href="#entry-dvaara" class="skt-link">dvāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praagdvaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praagdvaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praagdvaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāgdvārā</i> dont les portes sont face à l'Est — <a href="#entry-praagdvaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> seuil; porte du côté Est.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagjyoti_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgjyotiṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-jyotis" class="skt-link">jyotis</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praagjyoti_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praagjyoti_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praagjyoti_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāgjyotiṣā</i> éclairé par l'Est — <a href="#entry-praagjyoti_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. pays du Nord de l'Inde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. ancien nom de l'Assam <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du pays de <a href="#entry-Upraagjyoti_sa" class="skt-link">Prāgjyotiṣa</a>, où régnait <a href="#entry-Ubhagadatta" class="skt-link">Bhagadatta</a> — <a href="#entry-praagjyoti_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>prāgjyotiṣapura</i>] myth. np. de la ville de Prāgjyotiṣa, capitale de <a href="#entry-Unaraka" class="skt-link">Naraka</a>, en Assam.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राग्र</span> <i>prāgra</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-agra" class="skt-link">agra</a>] <a href="#entry-praagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> point culminant, sommet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praagrahara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāgrahara</i> [<a href="#entry-hara" class="skt-link">hara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praagrahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praagrahara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praagraharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāgraharā</i> [«qui prend la meilleure part»] principal, chef; le premier, le meilleur parmi ⟨g.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-praagra" class="skt-link">prāgra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राह्</span> <i>prāh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-ah" class="skt-link">ah</a>] pft. <i>(prāha)</i> annoncer, dire, déclarer; transmettre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praajaapatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राजापत्य</span> <i>prājāpatya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praajaapatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Prājāpatya «descendant de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a>» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. forme de mariage intra <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a>, sans dot; fils issu d'un tel mariage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. forme de jeûne — <a href="#entry-praajaapatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> pouvoir de procréation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praajya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राज्य</span> <i>prājya</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aajya" class="skt-link">ājya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praajya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praajya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praajyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prājyā</i> copieux, abondant; grand, important; long, durable; élevé, éminent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> Prājya <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>, auteur de la <a href="#entry-Uraajaavalipataakaa" class="skt-link">Rājāvalipatākā</a> (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राज्ञ</span> <i>prājña</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prājñā</i> sage, intelligent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> instruit, versé en sanskrit — <a href="#entry-praaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> sage; érudit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaj_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prājñatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-praaj_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> intelligence, sagesse.<br> <a href="#entry-praaj_na" class="skt-link">prājña</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राक्</span> <i>prāk</i> cf. <a href="#entry-praac" class="skt-link">prāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राकृत</span> <i>prākṛta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prākṛtā</i> original, naturel; originel, primitif; inaltéré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commun, ordinaire; vulgaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. relatif au radical — <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> dialecte prakrit, langage naturelle vernaculaire (par opposition au sanskrit, langue prescriptive sacrée); cf. <a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a>, <a href="#entry-ardhamaagadhii" class="skt-link">ardhamāgadhī</a>, <a href="#entry-zaurasenii" class="skt-link">śaurasenī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praak_rtaprakaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prākṛtaprakāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">prakāśa</a>] <a href="#entry-praak_rtaprakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prākṛtaprakāśa, grammaire du <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a> due à <a href="#entry-Uvararuci" class="skt-link">Vararuci</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praak_rtasarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prākṛtasarga</i> [<a href="#entry-sarga" class="skt-link">sarga</a>] <a href="#entry-praak_rtasarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. cycle de création première, associé au <a href="#entry-mahaakalpa" class="skt-link">mahākalpa</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-pratisarga" class="skt-link">pratisarga</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakaamya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राकाम्य</span> <i>prākāmya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prakaama" class="skt-link">prakāma</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praakaamya" class="skt-link">n.</a> le libre arbitre, la libre volonté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] l'<a href="#entry-a_s_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">aṣṭasiddhi</a> de toute-puissance, ou pouvoir de soumettre les éléments à sa volonté; il permet de vivre sous l'eau, de se rendre invisible, de s'incarner dans d'autres êtres et de jouir d'une jeunesse éternelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राकार</span> <i>prākāra</i> [<a href="#entry-praa_2" class="skt-link">prā_2</a>-<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-praakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> muraille, mur d'enceinte, rempart.<br> <i>mathurāvat</i> <i>pāṭaliputre</i> <i>prākāraḥ</i> Il y a un mur d'enceinte à <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a> comme à <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakaarabha_njana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prākārabhañjana</i> [<a href="#entry-bha_njana" class="skt-link">bhañjana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praakaarabha_njana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praakaarabha_njana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praakaarabha_njanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prākārabhañjanā</i> qui démolit les murailles.<br> <a href="#entry-praakaara" class="skt-link">prākāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakaazya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राकाश्य</span> <i>prākāśya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prakaazya" class="skt-link">prakāśya</a>] <a href="#entry-praakaazya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être évident ou manifeste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakara_nika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राकरणिक</span> <i>prākaraṇika</i> [<a href="#entry-praa_2" class="skt-link">prā_2</a>-<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praakara_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praakara_nika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praakara_nikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prākaraṇikā</i> pertinent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ayant trait au sujet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praakara_nikatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prākaraṇikatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-praakara_nikatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> pertinence; contextualité.<br> <a href="#entry-praakara_nika" class="skt-link">prākaraṇika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praalamba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रालम्ब</span> <i>prālamba</i> [<a href="#entry-praa_2" class="skt-link">prā_2</a>-<a href="#entry-lamba" class="skt-link">lamba</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praalamba" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praalamba" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praalamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prālamī</i> qui pend — <a href="#entry-praalamba" class="skt-link">m.</a> pendentif en perles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sein féminin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praamaa_nika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रामाणिक</span> <i>prāmāṇika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">pramāṇa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praamaa_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praamaa_nika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praamaa_nikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāmāṇikā</i> formant une mesure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faisant autorité, admettant une preuve; crédible — <a href="#entry-praamaa_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> patron de sa profession.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praamaa_nikatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāmāṇikatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-praamaa_nikatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> autorité; crédibilité.<br> <a href="#entry-praamaa_nika" class="skt-link">prāmāṇika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praamaa_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रामाण्य</span> <i>prāmāṇya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">pramāṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praamaa_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> mesure, hauteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> authenticité; évidence, crédibilité; autorité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. vérité, connaissance juste; épistémologie.<br> <i>yathottaraṃ</i> <i>munīnāṃ</i> <i>prāmāṇyam</i> gram. Les Sages ont autorité dans l'ordre (<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaatyaayana" class="skt-link">Kātyāyana</a>, <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praamodya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रामोद्य</span> <i>prāmodya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pramoda" class="skt-link">pramoda</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praamodya" class="skt-link">n.</a> joie, enchantement, extase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praamodyaraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāmodyarāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-praamodyaraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. de l'accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] Prāmodyarāja.<br> <a href="#entry-praamodya" class="skt-link">prāmodya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रान्तर</span> <i>prāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-praantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> long chemin solitaire; longue distance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राप्</span> <i>prāp</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aap" class="skt-link">āp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(prāpnoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(prāpnute)</i> fut. md. <i>(prāpsyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prāpta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>prāpya</i>, <i>prāptavya</i>, <i>prāpaṇīya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> atteindre, arriver à, participer à; arriver, avoir lieu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obtenir, acquérir, attraper; gagner, recevoir; encourir, subir — ca. <i>(prāpayati)</i> faire arriver; amener — ps. <i>(prāpyate)</i> être obtenu — dés. <i>(prepsati)</i> viser, convoiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praapa_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रापणीय</span> <i>prāpaṇīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praapa_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praapa_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praapa_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāpaṇīyā</i> à amener.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राप्त</span> <i>prāpta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāptā</i> atteint, trouvé; attrapé, rejoint; obtenu; arrivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> approprié.<br> <i>kāle</i> <i>prāpte</i> adv. le temps étant venu; au moment approprié.<br> <i>prāptayauvana</i> a. m. n. devenu adolescent.<br> <i>lālayet</i> <i>pañca</i> <i>varṣāṇi</i> <i>daśa</i> <i>varṣāṇi</i> <i>tāḍayet</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>prāpte</i> <i>tu</i> <i>ṣoḍaśe</i> <i>varṣe</i> <i>putre</i> <i>mitravad</i> <i>ācaret</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-Ucaa_nakya" class="skt-link">Cāṇakya</a>] Il doit être choyé à 5 ans, et corrigé à 10 ans; mais quand le fils a 16 ans il doit être traité en ami.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptajiivika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāptajīvika</i> [<a href="#entry-jiivikaa" class="skt-link">jīvikā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praaptajiivika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptajiivika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptajiivikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāptajīvikā</i> qui a obtenu de quoi vivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptakaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāptakāla</i> [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praaptakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> temps opportun, moment propice; moment venu de — a. <a href="#entry-praaptakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptakaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptakaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāptakālā</i> dont le temps est venu; opportun, de saison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राप्तव्य</span> <i>prāptavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praaptavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaptavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāptavyā</i> qui peut ou doit être obtenu; destiné, dû, mérité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptavyamartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāptavyamartha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-praaptavyamartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. destin approprié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Upa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">Pañcatantra</a>] np. de Prāptavyamartha «Prédestiné», sobriquet d'un jeune garçon chassé de la maison paternelle pour avoir dépensé 100 roupies pour un livre n'ayant qu'un poème, qui prit son destin avec candeur, et auquel la chance sourit.<br> <i>prāptavyam</i> <i>arthaṃ</i> <i>labhate</i> <i>manuṣyaḥ</i> lit. L'homme reçoit dans la vie ce qu'il mérite (1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ vers du poème que récitait <a href="#entry-Upraaptavyamartha" class="skt-link">Prāptavyamartha</a> lorsqu'on lui demandait son nom).<br> <a href="#entry-praaptavya" class="skt-link">prāptavya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptavyavahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāptavyavahāra</i> [<a href="#entry-vyavahaara" class="skt-link">vyavahāra</a>] <a href="#entry-praaptavyavahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«capable de faire des affaires»] majeur, adulte.<br> <i>prāptavyavahāradaśa</i> en âge.<br> <a href="#entry-praapta" class="skt-link">prāpta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राप्ति</span> <i>prāpti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] <a href="#entry-praapti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'obtenir, acquisition, gain, profit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de rencontrer, de rejoindre, d'atteindre; arrivée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la supraperception ou «pouvoir d'atteindre par les sens», un <a href="#entry-a_s_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">aṣṭasiddhi</a>; ce pouvoir donne l'omniscience et le pouvoir de guérison; cf. <a href="#entry-bhagavatpraapti" class="skt-link">bhagavatprāpti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prāpti «Omniscience», fille de <a href="#entry-Ujaraasandha" class="skt-link">Jarāsandha</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Uka_msa" class="skt-link">Kaṃsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaptyaazaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāptyāśā</i> [<a href="#entry-aazaa_1" class="skt-link">āśā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praaptyaazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> espérance de gain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [dramaturgie] l'espérance pour le héros d'atteindre le but, l'un des 5 ressorts d'un récit dramatique [<a href="#entry-kaaryaavasthaa" class="skt-link">kāryāvasthā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-praapti" class="skt-link">prāpti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praapya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राप्य</span> <i>prāpya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praapya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praapya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praapyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāpyā</i> à obtenir, à atteindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qualifie un objet [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] visé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रारब्ध</span> <i>prārabdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praarabh" class="skt-link">prārabh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praarabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prārabdhā</i> commencé; entrepris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a entrepris; entrepreneur; syn. <a href="#entry-praarabdhavat" class="skt-link">prārabdhavat</a> — <a href="#entry-praarabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> entreprise <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>prārabdhakarman</i>] phil. bénéfice immédiat d'une action [<a href="#entry-karmaphala" class="skt-link">karmaphala</a>]; part du <a href="#entry-karma" class="skt-link">karma</a> qui a commencé à porter fruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabdhakaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prārabdhakārya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praarabdhakaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdhakaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdhakaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prārabdhakāryā</i> entrepreneur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. porteur du fruit de ses actes passés.<br> <a href="#entry-praarabdha" class="skt-link">prārabdha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabdhakarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prārabdhakarman</i> [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] <a href="#entry-praarabdhakarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> actes entrepris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. actes passés commençant à porter fruit; influence des actes des existences antérieures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabdhavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रारब्धवत्</span> <i>prārabdhavat</i> [ppa. <a href="#entry-praarabh" class="skt-link">prārabh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praarabdhavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdhavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praarabdhavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prārabdhavatī</i> qui a entrepris; entrepreneur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabdhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रारब्धि</span> <i>prārabdhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praarabdha" class="skt-link">prārabdha</a>] <a href="#entry-praarabdhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> commencement; début d'une entreprise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarabh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रारभ्</span> <i>prārabh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aarabh" class="skt-link">ārabh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prārabhate)</i> saisir, prendre en charge; entreprendre; commencer, se mettre à ⟨acc. inf.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarth">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रार्थ्</span> <i>prārth</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-arth" class="skt-link">arth</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. md. <i>(prārthayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prārthita</i><i>)</i> désirer, avoir envie de; prétendre à; recourir à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> demander qqc. ⟨acc. loc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc. abl.⟩; solliciter, prier, implorer.<br> <i>kṣamāṃ</i> <i>prārthaye</i> adr. excusez moi.<br> <i>koparo</i> <i>niyogo'nuṣṭhīyatāmiti</i> <i>prārthayāmāsa</i> il s'enquit des ordres suivants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarthana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रार्थन</span> <i>prārthana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praarth" class="skt-link">prārth</a>] <a href="#entry-praarthana" class="skt-link">n.</a> requête, désir, sollicitation — <a href="#entry-praarthanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prārthanā</i> requête, désir, sollicitation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. prière à un dieu.<br> <i>prārthanayā</i> adv. à la prière de, à la requête de ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarthanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रार्थना</span> <i>prārthanā</i> iic. f. de <a href="#entry-praarthana" class="skt-link">prārthana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarthanaabhafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prārthanābhaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-bhafga" class="skt-link">bhaṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-praarthanaabhafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> refus d'une requête; sollicitation en vain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarthanaasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prārthanāsiddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-praarthanaasiddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> accomplissement d'un désir.<br> <a href="#entry-praarthanaa" class="skt-link">prārthanā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praarthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रार्थित</span> <i>prārthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praarth" class="skt-link">prārth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praarthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praarthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praarthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prārthitā</i> désiré, demandé, sollicité — <a href="#entry-praarthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> objet du désir, vœu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रास्</span> <i>prās</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-as_2" class="skt-link">as_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prāsyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prāsta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer; jeter dans ⟨loc.⟩; renverser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rejeter, repousser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रास</span> <i>prāsa</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-praas" class="skt-link">prās</a>] <a href="#entry-praasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de lancer, de jeter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> javelot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praasaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रासाद</span> <i>prāsāda</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-aasad" class="skt-link">āsad</a>] <a href="#entry-praasaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> palais, temple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> terrasse, tour, tribune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. salle de réunion d'une communauté monastique — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(prāsādīyati)</i> traiter comme un palais.<br> <i>prāsādīyati</i> <i>kuṭyam</i> <i>bhikṣuḥ</i> le mendiant considère sa hutte comme son palais.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praasaadalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāsādalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-praasaadalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> arch. signe caractéristique d'un temple.<br> <a href="#entry-praasaada" class="skt-link">prāsāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praasafgika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रासङ्गिक</span> <i>prāsaṅgika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prasafga" class="skt-link">prasaṅga</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praasafgika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praasafgika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praasafgikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāsaṅgikā</i> qui résulte de l'attachement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasionnel, fortuit; opportun, approprié, pertinent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inhérent, inné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. qualifie l'école de logique fondée par <a href="#entry-Ucandrakiirti" class="skt-link">Candrakīrti</a> — <a href="#entry-praasafgika" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] corollaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praata_hprahara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prātaḥprahara</i> [<a href="#entry-prahara" class="skt-link">prahara</a>] <a href="#entry-praata_hprahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. garde de l'aube (du soleil levant à 8 h).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातर्</span> <i>prātar</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>] adv. le matin; de bonne heure, à l'aube; demain matin, demain — <a href="#entry-praatar" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Prātar, le Matin personnifié.<br> <i>prātaḥ</i> <i>prātaḥ</i> adv. tous les matins.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praataraaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prātarāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-aaza_2" class="skt-link">āśa_2</a>] <a href="#entry-praataraaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> déjeuner (premier repas du matin).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatastana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prātastana</i> [<a href="#entry-tana" class="skt-link">tana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praatastana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praatastana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praatastanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prātastanī</i> matinal — <a href="#entry-praatastana" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. petit matin, premier des 5 moments [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] de la journée, juste après le lever du soleil; il est suivi de <a href="#entry-safgava" class="skt-link">saṃgava</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praatar" class="skt-link">prātar</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praathamya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राथम्य</span> <i>prāthamya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">prathama</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praathamya" class="skt-link">m.</a> priorité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'être le premier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatibha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातिभ</span> <i>prātibha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pratibha" class="skt-link">pratibha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praatibha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praatibha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praatibhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prātibhā</i> intuitif, immédiat — <a href="#entry-praatibha" class="skt-link">n.</a> intuition; divination, clairvoyance — <a href="#entry-praatibhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prātibhā</i> intuition, présence d'esprit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatibhaasika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातिभासिक</span> <i>prātibhāsika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pratibhaasa" class="skt-link">pratibhāsa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praatibhaasika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praatibhaasika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praatibhaasikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prātibhāsikī</i> phil. illusoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatipadika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातिपदिक</span> <i>prātipadika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pratipada" class="skt-link">pratipada</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praatipadika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praatipadika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praatipadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prātipadikā</i> explicite — <a href="#entry-praatipadika" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. [«relatif au mot»] th. nominal (forme de base non fléchie).<br> <i>prātipadikānurodhāt</i> adv. de manière explicite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praativezika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातिवेशिक</span> <i>prātiveśika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prativeza" class="skt-link">prativeśa</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-praativezika" class="skt-link">m.</a> voisin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatizaakhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रातिशाख्य</span> <i>prātiśākhya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pratizaakhaa" class="skt-link">pratiśākhā</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. recueil phonético-grammatical des textes de la tradition sectaire [<a href="#entry-zaakhaa" class="skt-link">śākhā</a>]; il en existe un pour la recension de <a href="#entry-Uzaakalya" class="skt-link">Śākalya</a> du RV., deux pour le <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a>, un pour l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>; servant à expliquer comment prononcer les textes védiques, et comment en obtenir l'analyse lexicale [<a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">padapāṭha</a>]; ce sont les traités les plus anciens de la tradition grammaticale du sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praatizaakhyak_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prātiśākhyakṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a>] <a href="#entry-praatizaakhyak_rt" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. auteur d'un recueil <a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">prātiśākhya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">prātiśākhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राव्</span> <i>prāv</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-av" class="skt-link">av</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prāvati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prāvita</i><i>)</i> favoriser; être attentionné envers ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>avere</i>, <i>ave</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praav_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रावृष्</span> <i>prāvṛṣ</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prav_r_s" class="skt-link">pravṛṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-praav_r_s" class="skt-link">f.</a> saison des pluies.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praavii_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रावीण्य</span> <i>prāvīṇya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pravii_na" class="skt-link">pravīṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-praavii_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> expertise en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राय</span> <i>prāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pre" class="skt-link">pre</a>] <a href="#entry-praaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> départ, not. pour une bataille ou une course <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (départ de la vie) mort; suicide, renoncement à la vie (par inanition) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> partie principale ou dominante; habitude, condition; majorité, règle générale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> quantité, abondance, richesse; excès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> proche; similaire; presque, comme si — <a href="#entry-praayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāyā</i> ifc. riche en; composé principalement de; presque complètement; destiné surtout à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> proche de; similaire à; presque, comme si.<br> <i>prāyeṇa</i> adv. principalement, généralement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> probablement, sans doute.<br> <i>prāyaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> renoncer à la vie, jeûner jusqu'à la mort.<br> <i>mṛtaprāya</i> presque mort.<br> <i>adhunā</i> <i>prabhātaprāyā</i> <i>rajanī</i> c'est presque l'aube maintenant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayagata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāyagata</i> [<a href="#entry-gata" class="skt-link">gata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praayagata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praayagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praayagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāyagatā</i> mourant, agonisant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रायस्</span> <i>prāyas</i> [<a href="#entry-praaya" class="skt-link">prāya</a>] adv. généralement, principalement; en règle générale, pour la plupart <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> probablement, vraisemblablement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रायश्</span> <i>prāyaś</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-praayas" class="skt-link">prāyas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāyaśas</i> var. <i>prāyeṇa</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. ordinairement, généralement, principalement; en règle générale, pour la plupart; abondamment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> probablement, peut-être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayazcitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāyaścitta</i> [<a href="#entry-citta" class="skt-link">citta</a>] <a href="#entry-praayazcitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [véd.] pénitence, expiation (d'une faute, d'une erreur ou d'un accident dans le rituel, d'un mauvais présage, d'un voyage à l'étranger), propitiation; not. sacrifice à <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>.<br> <i>brāhmaṇasya</i> <i>hanane</i> <i>prāyaścittaṃ</i> <i>nāsti</i> Il n'y a pas d'expiation du meurtre d'un brâhmane.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayazcittasamuccaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāyaścittasamuccaya</i> [<a href="#entry-samuccaya" class="skt-link">samuccaya</a>] <a href="#entry-praayazcittasamuccaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prāyaścittasamuccaya, compendium shivaïte de prescriptions tantr. d'expiation dû à Hṛdayaśiva (Inde du Nord, 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); un texte contemporain d'Inde du Sud de même nom est dû à <a href="#entry-Utrilocanaziva" class="skt-link">Trilocanaśiva</a> <a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praayazcitta" class="skt-link">prāyaścitta</a> <br> <a href="#entry-praayaz" class="skt-link">prāyaś</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayogika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रायोगिक</span> <i>prāyogika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prayoga" class="skt-link">prayoga</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praayogika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praayogika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praayogikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāyogikī</i> applicable; utilisé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praayopavezana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prāyopaveśana</i> [<a href="#entry-upavezana" class="skt-link">upaveśana</a>] <a href="#entry-praayopavezana" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«attente paisible de la mort»] suicide par le jeûne.<br> <a href="#entry-praaya" class="skt-link">prāya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राश्</span> <i>prāś_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-az_2" class="skt-link">aś_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(prāśnāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prāśita</i><i>)</i> manger, dévorer — ca. <i>(prāśayati)</i> nourrir, donner à manger ⟨2 acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaz_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राश्</span> <i>prāś_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praz" class="skt-link">praś</a>] <a href="#entry-praaz_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> requête.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaza">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazana">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राशन</span> <i>prāśana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praaz_1" class="skt-link">prāś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> repas; nourriture; victuailles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> alimentation; fait de se nourrir de ⟨iic.⟩, fait de nourrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. premier repas solide d'un enfant; cf. <a href="#entry-annapraazana" class="skt-link">annaprāśana</a> — <a href="#entry-praazanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśanī</i> jouissance de — <a href="#entry-praazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>prāśana</i> ifc. qui se nourrit de ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazaniiya">

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-praaz_1" class="skt-link">prāś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praazaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praazaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praazaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśanīyā</i> à manger; consommable; servi comme nourriture — <a href="#entry-praazaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राशित</span> <i>prāśita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praaz_1" class="skt-link">prāś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praazita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praazita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praazitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśitā</i> mangé, dévoré — <a href="#entry-praazita" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. oblation quotidienne (de riz et d'eau) offerte aux mânes [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazitavya">

[<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-praaz_1" class="skt-link">prāś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praazitavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praazitavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praazitavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśitavyā</i> mangeable, comestible; succulent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praaznika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्राश्निक</span> <i>prāśnika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-prazna" class="skt-link">praśna</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praaznika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praaznika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praaznikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśnikā</i> qui enquête, qui arbitre — <a href="#entry-praaznika" class="skt-link">m.</a> enquêteur, examinateur; arbitre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> témoin, spectateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praazya">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-praaz_1" class="skt-link">prāś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praazya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praazya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prāśyā</i> à manger; mangeable, comestible.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabaadh">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबद्ध</span> <i>prabaddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabandh" class="skt-link">prabandh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabaddhā</i> lié, attaché; enchaîné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrêté, entravé, empêché — ifc. qui dépend de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबल</span> <i>prabala</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bala" class="skt-link">bala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabalā</i> fort, puissant, important; violent (douleur) — ifc. abondant en.<br> <i>prabalībhū</i> se renforcer, acquérir de la puissnace.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabalataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabalatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-prabalataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> force, puissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabalatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabalatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-prabalatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> force, puissance.<br> <a href="#entry-prabala" class="skt-link">prabala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabandh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
