[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(prabadhnāti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. md. <i>(prabadhnīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabaddha</i><i>)</i> lier, attacher; enchaîner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबन्ध</span> <i>prabandha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabandh" class="skt-link">prabandh</a>] <a href="#entry-prabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> continuation ininterrompue, série continue; continuité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. discours <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> composition littéraire; chant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. style poétique de la cour de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_nadeva" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇadeva</a> <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. gestion.<br> <i>prabandhena</i> répétitivement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabandhavakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabandhavakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-prabandhavakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique d'un ouvrage poétique.<br> <a href="#entry-prabandha" class="skt-link">prabandha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabh_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभृ</span> <i>prabhṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bh_r" class="skt-link">bhṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(prabibharti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prabharati)</i> pr. md. <i>(prabharate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabhṛta</i><i>)</i> présenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabh_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभृति</span> <i>prabhṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabh_r" class="skt-link">prabhṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prabh_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> commencement — ifc. en commençant par, à partir de, après; syn. <a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a> — adv. après ⟨abl.⟩.<br> <i>adya</i> <i>prabhṛti</i> adv. à partir d'aujourd'hui.<br> <i>tatprabhṛti</i> adv. désormais.<br> <i>tataḥ</i> <i>prabhṛti</i> adv. à partir de ce moment là; dorénavant.<br> <i>tadā</i> <i>prabhṛti</i> id.<br> <i>bālyāt</i> <i>prabhṛti</i> dès l'enfance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभ</span> <i>prabha</i> [<a href="#entry-prabhaa_2" class="skt-link">prabhā_2</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-prabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> splendeur, éclat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaa_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभाष्</span> <i>prabhāṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_s" class="skt-link">bhāṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prabhāṣate)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> dire, déclarer, expliquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dire à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभा</span> <i>prabhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_1" class="skt-link">bhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prabhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabhāta</i><i>)</i> briller, resplendir, éclairer; paraître, sembler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभा</span> <i>prabhā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabhaa_1" class="skt-link">prabhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> lumière, splendeur, éclat <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prabhā «Lumière», épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaacandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhācandra</i> [<a href="#entry-candra" class="skt-link">candra</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaacandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du logicien jaïne Prabhācandra (980–1065), auteur du <a href="#entry-Uprameyakamalamaarta_n_da" class="skt-link">Prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaadevii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhādevī</i> [<a href="#entry-devii" class="skt-link">devī</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaadevii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. du temple de Prabhādevī «Lumineuse Déesse» à Bombay.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhākara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaakara" class="skt-link">m.</a> luminaire; le Soleil; la Lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. classe de divinités, les êtres de lumière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. np. de Prabhākara <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a> «Lumineux», philosophe <a href="#entry-miimaa_msaka" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsaka</a> du 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, élève de <a href="#entry-Ukumaarila" class="skt-link">Kumārila</a>; il professait qu'il n'y a pas d'erreur de perception, seulement des imprécisions; il reconnaissait les langues étrangères [<a href="#entry-mleccha" class="skt-link">mleccha</a>] comme non dérivées du sanskrit et encouragea le bilinguisme [<i>dvaibhāṣika</i>]; il est l'auteur de la <a href="#entry-Ub_rhatii" class="skt-link">Bṛhatī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Prabhākara_1; il fonda la dynastie <a href="#entry-Uvardhana_1" class="skt-link">Vardhana_1</a> d'Inde du Nord au 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Usthaanezvara" class="skt-link">Sthāneśvara</a>; habillé de soie blanche, il adorait le Soleil à l'aube; à sa mort en 605, son fils aîné <a href="#entry-Uraajya" class="skt-link">Rājya</a> lui succéda, puis son cadet <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a> monta sur le trône à 16 ans pour fonder un empire.<br> <i>prabhākarau</i> le Soleil et la Lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaakaravardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhākaravardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaakaravardhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Prabhākaravardhana, père de <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uprabhaakara_1" class="skt-link">Prabhākara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhaakara" class="skt-link">prabhākara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaama_n_dala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāmaṇḍala</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaama_n_dala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhaama_n_dala" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«cercle de lumière»] auréole; couronne de lumière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभास्</span> <i>prabhās</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaas_1" class="skt-link">bhās_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prabhāsate)</i> briller, resplendir; apparaître, sembler — ca. <i>(prabhāsayati)</i> éclairer, illuminer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभास</span> <i>prabhāsa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prabhaas" class="skt-link">prabhās</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> splendeur, beauté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prabhāsa la Lumière, l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] — <a href="#entry-prabhaasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du <a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a> Prabhāsa_1, important lieu de pélerinage sur la côte du Gujarāt, près de <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasak_setra" class="skt-link">Prabhāsakṣetra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaasak_setra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāsakṣetra</i> [<a href="#entry-k_setra" class="skt-link">kṣetra</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaasak_setra" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du Prabhāsakṣetra «Lieu de Lumière», lieu de pélerinage [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] sur la côte du Gujarāt, près de <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasapattana" class="skt-link">Prabhāsapattana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaasak_setramaahaatmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya</i> [<a href="#entry-maahaatmya" class="skt-link">māhātmya</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaasak_setramaahaatmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, 1⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ section du <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasakha_n_da" class="skt-link">Prabhāsakhaṇḍa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhaasak_setra" class="skt-link">prabhāsakṣetra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaasakha_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāsakhaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaasakha_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhaasakha_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, section du <a href="#entry-Uskandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Skandapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaasapattana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāsapattana</i> [<a href="#entry-pattana" class="skt-link">pattana</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaasapattana" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du <a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a> Prabhāsapattana, lieu de pélerinage du <a href="#entry-Ugurjara" class="skt-link">Gurjara</a>, près de <a href="#entry-Usomanaathapattana" class="skt-link">Somanāthapattana</a>; myth. c'est ici que <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> pria <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> de le délivrer de la malédiction de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>; c'est ici aussi que <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> fut incinéré, après avoir été mortellement touché au talon par la flèche du chasseur <a href="#entry-Ujaraa_h" class="skt-link">Jarāḥ</a>; le fils de <a href="#entry-Usaandiipani" class="skt-link">Sāndīpani</a> s'y était noyé, capturé par le démon <a href="#entry-Upa_ncajana" class="skt-link">Pañcajana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhaasa" class="skt-link">prabhāsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभात</span> <i>prabhāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabhaa_1" class="skt-link">prabhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhātā</i> apparu; qui s'éclaircit — <a href="#entry-prabhaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> aube, matin.<br> <i>prabhāte</i> adv. à l'aube, le matin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभाव</span> <i>prabhāva</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabhuu" class="skt-link">prabhū</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> puissance, force, pouvoir; majesté, dignité; splendeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> efficacité; impact.<br> <i>prabhāvāt</i> var. <i>prabhāveṇa</i>, <i>prabhāvatas</i> au moyen de; à cause de, en conséquence de; par.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhaavali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhāvali</i> [<a href="#entry-aavali" class="skt-link">āvali</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhaavali" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«rangée de lumières»] halo ou arche de flammes entourant une idole.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhaa_2" class="skt-link">prabhā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभद्र</span> <i>prabhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhadra" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Azadirachta indica</i> [«très propice»] margousier ou arbre <i>nīm</i>; cf. <a href="#entry-nimba" class="skt-link">nimba</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभव</span> <i>prabhava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabhuu" class="skt-link">prabhū</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> origine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Prabhava «Début», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 1 d'un cycle de vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभेद</span> <i>prabheda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabhid" class="skt-link">prabhid</a>] <a href="#entry-prabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> action de fendre, de couper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभिद्</span> <i>prabhid</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhid_1" class="skt-link">bhid_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(prabhinatti)</i> pr. md. <i>(prabhintte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabhinna</i><i>)</i> fendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhinna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभिन्न</span> <i>prabhinna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabhid" class="skt-link">prabhid</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhinna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhinna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhinnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhinnā</i> fendu; percé, cassé, ouvert; séparé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en rut (se dit d'un éléphant en rut dont les tempes sont fendues et laissent couler le <a href="#entry-mada" class="skt-link">mada</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhinnaa_njana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhinnāñjana</i> [<a href="#entry-a_njana" class="skt-link">añjana</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhinnaa_njana" class="skt-link">n.</a> collyre gris.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhinna" class="skt-link">prabhinna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhra_mz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभ्रंश्</span> <i>prabhraṃś</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhra_mz" class="skt-link">bhraṃś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prabhraṃśate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabhraṣṭa</i><i>)</i> tomber, glisser, disparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhra_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभ्रष्ट</span> <i>prabhraṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabhra_mz" class="skt-link">prabhraṃś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhra_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhra_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhra_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhraṣṭā</i> tombé, enfui de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभु</span> <i>prabhu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prabhuu" class="skt-link">prabhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhū</i> <a href="#entry-prabhvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhvī</i> fort, puissant, capable; riche, abondant — <a href="#entry-prabhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> seigneur, maître, roi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prabhu «Seigneur», épith. de divers dieux; un nom de Dieu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhupaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhupāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhupaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de renonçant de <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a> Prabhupāda «Maître aux pieds du Seigneur» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de <a href="#entry-Uzriila" class="skt-link">Śrīla</a> Rūpa <a href="#entry-Ugosvaamii" class="skt-link">Gosvāmī</a> Prabhupāda_1, premier d'entre les 6 <a href="#entry-Ugosvaamii" class="skt-link">Gosvāmī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. adresse de respect donnée par ses disciples à <a href="#entry-Ubhaktivedaanta" class="skt-link">Bhaktivedānta</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a>, né Abhaya Charan De (1896–1977), fondateur de l'«International Society for <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> Consciousness» (ISKCON).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhutaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhutā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> souveraineté, puissance suprême
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhutva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhutva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-prabhutva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état de souveraineté, puissance suprême
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभू</span> <i>prabhū</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuu_1" class="skt-link">bhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prabhavati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabhūta</i><i>)</i> provenir de, surgir de ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apparaître, devenir visible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> augmenter, devenir fort; être puissant, commander, contrôler; être maître de ⟨g.⟩, l'emporter sur ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रभूत</span> <i>prabhūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabhuu" class="skt-link">prabhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhūtā</i> nombreux, riche, abondant, grand — iic. beaucoup de, en grande quantité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>prabhūtās</i> plusieurs, beaucoup de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabhuzabdaze_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabhuśabdaśeṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-zabda" class="skt-link">śabda</a>-<a href="#entry-ze_sa" class="skt-link">śeṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabhuzabdaze_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhuzabdaze_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabhuzabdaze_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabhuśabdaśeṣā</i> roi seulement en nom.<br> <a href="#entry-prabhu" class="skt-link">prabhu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबोध्</span> <i>prabodh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-prabudh" class="skt-link">prabudh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(prabodhayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>prabodhya</i><i>)</i> éveiller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबोध</span> <i>prabodha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prabodh" class="skt-link">prabodh</a>] <a href="#entry-prabodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> éveil (du sommeil ou de l'ignorance); prise de conscience <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> connaissance, compréhension, intelligence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. l'Éveil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhacandrodaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabodhacandrodaya</i> [<a href="#entry-candrodaya" class="skt-link">candrodaya</a>] <a href="#entry-prabodhacandrodaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prabodhacandrodaya «Lever de lune de la connaissance», drame allégorique en 6 actes de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_namizra" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇamiśra</a> (11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il enseigne la version <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> du monisme [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] en mettant en scène des sentiments abstraits.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबोधक</span> <i>prabodhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prabodh" class="skt-link">prabodh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabodhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhikā</i> qui éveille; qui fait fleurir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. serviteur chargé de réveiller le roi — <a href="#entry-prabodhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> ifc. compréhension, intelligence de.<br> <i>sukhaprabodhaka</i> bien compréhensible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबोधन</span> <i>prabodhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prabodh" class="skt-link">prabodh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabodhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhanī</i> qui éveille, qui stimule — <a href="#entry-prabodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> éveil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> compréhension; connaissance — <a href="#entry-prabodhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhanī</i> soc. festival célébrant l'éveil de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, le 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-kaarttika" class="skt-link">kārttika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhasudhaakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabodhasudhākara</i> [<a href="#entry-sudhaakara" class="skt-link">sudhākara</a>] <a href="#entry-prabodhasudhaakara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prabodhasudhākara «Réservoir du nectar de la connaissance», œuvre philosophique [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṃkara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prabodha" class="skt-link">prabodha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prabodhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prabodh" class="skt-link">prabodh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabodhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhinī</i> qui éveille; qui annonce, qui révèle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> émanant de ⟨abl.⟩ — <a href="#entry-prabodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhinī</i> révélation; ifc. titre d'ouvrages didactiques.<br> <i>hastinādaprabodhinī</i> f. (la Déesse) annoncée par le bruit de ses éléphants.<br> <a href="#entry-prabodhana" class="skt-link">prabodhana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabodhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबोध्य</span> <i>prabodhya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-prabodh" class="skt-link">prabodh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabodhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabodhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabodhyā</i> que l'on doit réveiller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabruu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रब्रू</span> <i>prabrū</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-bruu" class="skt-link">brū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prabravīti)</i> pr. md. <i>(prabrūte)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>prati</i><i>)</i> expliquer, enseigner; annoncer; appeler, nommer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबुद्ध</span> <i>prabuddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prabudh" class="skt-link">prabudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prabuddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prabuddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prabuddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prabuddhā</i> réveillé; éveillé, attentif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> développé, ouvert; actif; intelligent, clairvoyant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prabudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रबुध्</span> <i>prabudh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-budh_1" class="skt-link">budh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prabodhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(prabudhyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prabuddha</i><i>)</i> s'éveiller — ca. <i>(prabodhayati)</i> éveiller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praca_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रचण्ड</span> <i>pracaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-ca_n_da" class="skt-link">caṇḍa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praca_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praca_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praca_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pracaṇḍā</i> très violent, furieux, terrible — <a href="#entry-praca_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pracaṇḍa «Terrible», l'un des deux gardiens [<a href="#entry-dvaarapaalau" class="skt-link">dvārapālau</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; son compagnon est <a href="#entry-Uca_n_da" class="skt-link">Caṇḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praca_n_daca_n_dikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pracaṇḍacaṇḍikā</i> [<a href="#entry-ca_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">caṇḍikā</a>] <a href="#entry-praca_n_daca_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Pracaṇḍacaṇḍikā ou Pracaṇḍogracaṇḍikā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uca_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">Caṇḍikā</a> «la terrible».<br> <a href="#entry-praca_n_da" class="skt-link">pracaṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pracaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रचार</span> <i>pracāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pracar" class="skt-link">pracar</a>] <a href="#entry-pracaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> manifestation, apparition; pratique; conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> coutume, usage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> endroit d'exercice; terrain de jeu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pâturage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pracaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(pracaṣṭe)</i> raconter, annoncer, dire, déclarer; tenir pour, considérer comme ⟨acc.⟩; appeler, nommer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pracal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pracalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pracalita</i><i>)</i> se mettre en mouvement, avancer, partir; dévier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trembler, s'agiter.<br> <i>vṛkṣaḥ</i> <i>pracalan</i> <i>sahāvayavaiḥ</i> <i>pracalati</i> [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Mahābhāṣya</a>] Quand un arbre tremble, il tremble de toutes ses parties (exprime la cohérence de la syntaxe).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pracalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रचलित</span> <i>pracalita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pracal" class="skt-link">pracal</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pracalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pracalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pracalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pracalitā</i> mis en mouvement; agité, déplacé; roulé (yeux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> parti <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confus, perplexe, décontenancé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> courant, commun, usuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> reconnu, préféré; reçu comme autorité — <a href="#entry-pracalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> départ.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pracarati)</i> pr. md. <i>(pracarate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pracarita</i><i>)</i> avancer, errer; apparaître, avoir lieu; arriver à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être occupé à ⟨loc.⟩; pratiquer.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradak_si_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदक्षिण</span> <i>pradakṣiṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dak_si_na" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradak_si_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradak_si_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradak_si_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradakṣiṇā</i> vers la droite; opp. <a href="#entry-prasavya" class="skt-link">prasavya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dextrogyre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tourné vers qqn. ou qqc. placé à sa droite; respectueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en direction du Sud — <a href="#entry-pradak_si_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradak_si_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> circumambulation d'un temple dans le sens des aiguilles d'une montre, laissant le sanctuaire à main droite — <a href="#entry-pradak_si_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradakṣiṇā</i> id.<br> <i>pradakṣiṇaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> tourner dans le sens des aiguilles d'une montre (autour d'un sanctuaire).<br> <i>yāni</i> <i>kāni</i> <i>ca</i> <i>pāpāni</i> <i>janmāntara</i> <i>kṛtāni</i> <i>ca</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>tāni</i> <i>tāni</i> <i>vinaśyanti</i> <i>pradakṣiṇa</i> <i>pade</i> <i>pade</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (prière prononcée pendant la circumambulation) Tous les péchés des vies antérieures, tous leurs bienfaits aussi, tous s'effaceront, alors que pas après pas nous tournons.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradak_si_napatha">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradauhitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदौहित्र</span> <i>pradauhitra</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dauhitra" class="skt-link">dauhitra</a>] <a href="#entry-pradauhitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrière-petit-fils (fils d'une petite-fille) — <a href="#entry-pradauhitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradauhitrī</i> fille d'une petite-fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदव</span> <i>pradava</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradu" class="skt-link">pradu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradavā</i> qui brûle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prade_s_t_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदेष्टृ</span> <i>pradeṣṭṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradiz_1" class="skt-link">pradiś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prade_s_t_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prade_s_t_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prade_s_trii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradeṣṭrī</i> juge; inspecteur royal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदेश</span> <i>pradeśa</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-pradiz_1" class="skt-link">pradiś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pradeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> exemple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> région, contrée; endroit, place — iic. courte durée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधा</span> <i>pradhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. md. <i>(pradhatte)</i> mettre en avant; offrir; délivrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se vouer à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधा</span> <i>pradhā_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradhaa_1" class="skt-link">pradhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pradhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Pradhā «Vouée à accoucher (de <a href="#entry-Utilottamaa" class="skt-link">Tilottamā</a>)», fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>; elle est mère de <a href="#entry-Utilottamaa" class="skt-link">Tilottamā</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uhaahaa" class="skt-link">Hāhā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधान</span> <i>pradhāna</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradhaa_1" class="skt-link">pradhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradhānā</i> principal, prééminent — <a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> partie principale ou essen­tielle; personne principale, chef <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la Nature Primordiale [<a href="#entry-muulaprak_rti" class="skt-link">mūlaprakṛti</a>] sous sa forme du Principe Préétabli inerte, préalable à son évolution [<a href="#entry-pari_naama" class="skt-link">pariṇāma</a>] en les phénomènes du monde matériel; support et cause de l'univers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (substantif) objet principal d'une phrase; opp. <a href="#entry-gau_na" class="skt-link">gauṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. composant primaire ou principal d'un mot composé; opp. <a href="#entry-upasarjana" class="skt-link">upasarjana</a> — iic. le plus important, le mieux, le principal de — ifc. qui consiste principalement en.<br> <i>pradhānamantrī</i> soc. premier ministre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaanabhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pradhānabhūta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhaanabhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaanabhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaanabhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradhānabhūtā</i> prédominant; de plus haut rang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaanamalla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pradhānamalla</i> [<a href="#entry-malla" class="skt-link">malla</a>] <a href="#entry-pradhaanamalla" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. principal adversaire d'un érudit, élaborant des réfutations.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaanapaatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pradhānapātra</i> [<a href="#entry-paatra" class="skt-link">pātra</a>] <a href="#entry-pradhaanapaatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. personnage principal d'une pièce de théâtre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaanazi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pradhānaśiṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-zi_s_ta_2" class="skt-link">śiṣṭa_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhaanazi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaanazi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaanazi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradhānaśiṣṭā</i> gram. spécifié comme principal; opp. <a href="#entry-anvaacayazi_s_ta" class="skt-link">anvācayaśiṣṭa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">pradhāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaav_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधाव्</span> <i>pradhāv_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaav_1" class="skt-link">dhāv_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pradhāvati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradhāvita</i><i>)</i> courir, s'enfuir; se précipiter sur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diffuser, imprégner — ca. <i>(pradhāvayati)</i> poursuivre, pourchasser, faire s'enfuir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaav_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधाव्</span> <i>pradhāv_2</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaav_2" class="skt-link">dhāv_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pradhāvati)</i> nettoyer, frotter, effacer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhaavita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधावित</span> <i>pradhāvita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pradhaav_1" class="skt-link">pradhāv_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhaavita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaavita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhaavitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradhāvitā</i> enfui, parti.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradham">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधम्</span> <i>pradham</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dham" class="skt-link">dham</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pradhamati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradhmāta</i><i>)</i> souffler (not. dans une conque ⟨acc.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रधी</span> <i>pradhī</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dhii_2" class="skt-link">dhī_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhii" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhii" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> d'une intelligence supérieure — <a href="#entry-pradhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> grande intelligence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradhva_ms">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रध्वंस्</span> <i>pradhvaṃs</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dhva_ms" class="skt-link">dhvaṃs</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pradhvaṃsate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradhvasta</i><i>)</i> tomber au sol; périr, disparaître — ca. <i>(pradhvaṃsayati)</i> faire périr, détruire; anéantir, annihiler.
  </div>
</div>
