  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रध्वस्त</span> <i>pradhvasta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pradhva_ms" class="skt-link">pradhvaṃs</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradhvasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhvasta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradhvastaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradhvastā</i> détruit, disparu; annihilé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदिष्ट</span> <i>pradiṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pradiz_2" class="skt-link">pradiś_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradiṣṭā</i> indiqué; déterminé; ordonné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiip">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदीप्</span> <i>pradīp</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-diip" class="skt-link">dīp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(pradīpyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradīpta</i><i>)</i> brûler, flamber — ca. <i>(pradīpayati)</i> allumer, incendier, enflammer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदीप</span> <i>pradīpa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradiip" class="skt-link">pradīp</a>] <a href="#entry-pradiipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lampe, lanterne — ifc. lumière de, gloire de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lumière sur, éclaircissement de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>bhāṣyapradīpa</i>] lit. np. du Pradīpa «Lumière sur la glose (de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>)», dû à <a href="#entry-Ukaiya_ta" class="skt-link">Kaiyaṭa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubhaa_syapradiipa" class="skt-link">Bhāṣyapradīpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiipaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदीपक</span> <i>pradīpaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradiip" class="skt-link">pradīp</a>] <a href="#entry-pradiipaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradiipaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradiipikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradīpikā</i> petite lampe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. (au fig.) éclaicissement; titre d'ouvrages d'exégèse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदीप्त</span> <i>pradīpta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pradiip" class="skt-link">pradīp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradiipta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradiipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradiiptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradīptā</i> allumé, brûlant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदिश्</span> <i>pradiś_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-diz_1" class="skt-link">diś_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pradiśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> montrer, indiquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prescrire, ordonner; déterminer — ca. <i>(pradeśayati)</i> exhorter, exciter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradiz_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदिश्</span> <i>pradiś_2</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-pradiz_1" class="skt-link">pradiś_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pradiz_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> direction, région du ciel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradizas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pradiśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. dans toutes les directions, partout.<br> <a href="#entry-pradiz_2" class="skt-link">pradiś_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prado_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदोष</span> <i>pradoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-do_sa" class="skt-link">doṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-prado_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> crépuscule, début de la nuit.<br> <i>pradoṣam</i> à la nuit tombée, dans le noir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्रु</span> <i>pradru</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dru_1" class="skt-link">dru_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pradravati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradruta</i><i>)</i> [«courir en avant»] se sauver, s'enfuir; se précipiter vers ⟨acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(pradrāvayati)</i> mettre en fuite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradruta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्रुत</span> <i>pradruta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pradru" class="skt-link">pradru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pradruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pradruta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pradrutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradrutā</i> enfui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रदु</span> <i>pradu</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-du" class="skt-link">du</a>] ps. <i>(pradūyate)</i> être consumé par les flammes — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(pradunoti)</i> opprimer, tourmenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradve_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्वेष</span> <i>pradveṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pradvi_s" class="skt-link">pradviṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-pradve_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> adversion, dégoût, répugnance; haine — <a href="#entry-pradve_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pradveṣī</i> myth. np. de Pradveṣī «Répulsion», épouse de <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a>, mère not. de <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradvi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्विष्</span> <i>pradviṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dvi_s_1" class="skt-link">dviṣ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pradveṣṭi)</i> pr. md. <i>(pradviṣṭe)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pradviṣṭa</i><i>)</i> haïr, détester; trouver répugnant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradyota">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्योत</span> <i>pradyota</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pradyut" class="skt-link">pradyut</a>] <a href="#entry-pradyota" class="skt-link">m.</a> lumière, radiance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de la dynastie Pradyota, qui régnait en <a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a> au 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.; [<a href="#entry-Uvaayupuraa_na" class="skt-link">Vāyupurāṇa</a>] ses rois annexèrent le <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>, et conquirent <a href="#entry-Ukauzaambii" class="skt-link">Kauśāmbī</a>; le roi Śiśunāga y mit fin en 413 ant. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Upradyota" class="skt-link">Pradyota</a> <a href="#entry-Uca_n_damahaasena" class="skt-link">Caṇḍamahāsena</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a>; on dit qu'il régnait à <a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a> au 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.; la reine <a href="#entry-Uafgaaravatii" class="skt-link">Aṅgāravatī</a> est son épouse; <a href="#entry-Ugopaala_3" class="skt-link">Gopāla_3</a> est leur fils aîné, <a href="#entry-Uvaasavadattaa_2" class="skt-link">Vāsavadattā_2</a> leur fille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukathaasaritsaagara" class="skt-link">Kathāsaritsāgara</a>] np. du roi Pradyota_1 du <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>; <a href="#entry-Upadmaavatii_2" class="skt-link">Padmāvatī_2</a> est sa fille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Ubhavi_syapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhaviṣyapurāṇa</a>] np. du roi Pradyota_1 de <a href="#entry-Uhastinaapura" class="skt-link">Hastināpura</a>, fils de Kṣemaka, tué par les barbares; pour le repos de son père, <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> l'incita à faire un grand massacre d'étrangers [<a href="#entry-mlecchayaj_na" class="skt-link">mlecchayajña</a>]; il régna 10000 ans, puis son fils <a href="#entry-Uvedavaan" class="skt-link">Vedavān</a> régna 2000 ans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradyumna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्युम्न</span> <i>pradyumna</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dyumna" class="skt-link">dyumna</a>] <a href="#entry-pradyumna" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pradyumna «le Glorieux», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a>; il renaquit comme fils de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Urukmi_nii" class="skt-link">Rukmiṇī</a>; une prophétie disait qu'il serait tué par le démon <a href="#entry-Uzambara_1" class="skt-link">Śambara_1</a>; il fut volé enfant par <a href="#entry-Uzambara_1" class="skt-link">Śambara_1</a>, jeté à la mer et retrouvé dans le ventre d'un poisson; il fut élevé par <a href="#entry-Umaayaavatii" class="skt-link">Māyāvatī</a> qu'il épousa; leur fils est <a href="#entry-Uaniruddha" class="skt-link">Aniruddha</a>; phil. [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>] il est déifié comme aspect [<a href="#entry-vyuuha" class="skt-link">vyūha</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; au ciel spirituel il est la direction du Sud.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pradyut">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रद्युत्</span> <i>pradyut</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-dyut_1" class="skt-link">dyut_1</a>] ca. <i>(pradyotayati)</i> illuminer, envelopper de lumière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prag_rhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगृह्य</span> <i>pragṛhya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pragrah" class="skt-link">pragrah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prag_rhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prag_rhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prag_rhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pragṛhyā</i> à prendre (séparément) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>] exception au <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>, à prononcer séparément avec hiatus; par ex. mot composé avec <a href="#entry-u" class="skt-link">u</a>, ou voyelle finale non soumise au <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> (désinences <i>ī</i>, <i>ū</i> et <i>e</i> du nom. acc. duel) — ind. ayant pris, ayant saisi; avec ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragalbh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगल्भ्</span> <i>pragalbh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-galbh" class="skt-link">galbh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pragalbhate)</i> être résolu; être hardi; être arrogant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragalbha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगल्भ</span> <i>pragalbha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pragalbh" class="skt-link">pragalbh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pragalbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pragalbha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pragalbhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pragalbhā</i> résolu, courageux, hardi; confiant, fier; effronté, insolent.<br> <i>pragalbham</i> adv. hardiment, résolument.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragalbhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pragalbhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pragalbhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> résolution, confiance, force; hardiesse, insolence.<br> <a href="#entry-pragalbha" class="skt-link">pragalbha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगम्</span> <i>pragam</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-gam" class="skt-link">gam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pragacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pragata</i><i>)</i> se mettre en route, démarer; s'avancer, progresser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'acheminer vers ⟨acc. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> atteindre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगत</span> <i>pragata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pragam" class="skt-link">pragam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pragata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pragata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pragataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pragatā</i> démarré, avancé; séparé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रगति</span> <i>pragati</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pragam" class="skt-link">pragam</a>] <a href="#entry-pragati" class="skt-link">f.</a> progrès.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praghaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रघास</span> <i>praghāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-ghaasa" class="skt-link">ghāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-praghaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> festin d'orge; cf. <a href="#entry-varu_napraghaasa" class="skt-link">varuṇapraghāsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pragrah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रग्रह्</span> <i>pragrah</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-grah" class="skt-link">grah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pragṛhṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pragṛhṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pragṛhīta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>pragṛhya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pragṛhya</i><i>)</i> prendre, saisir; arrêter; tirer sur les rênes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prah_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहृ</span> <i>prahṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-h_r_1" class="skt-link">hṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(praharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> frapper, attaquer, combattre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prah_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहृष्</span> <i>prahṛṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-h_r_s" class="skt-link">hṛṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prahṛṣyati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(praharṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> se réjouir, être gai — ca. <i>(praharṣayati)</i> réjouir, rendre gai.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prah_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहृष्ट</span> <i>prahṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prah_r_s" class="skt-link">prahṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prah_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prah_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prah_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahṛṣṭā</i> gai, joyeux; ravi, réjoui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prah_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहृत</span> <i>prahṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prah_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prah_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prah_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahṛtā</i> frappé, blessé, battu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहा</span> <i>prahā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-haa_1" class="skt-link">hā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(prajahāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahīṇa</i>, <i>prahāṇa</i><i>)</i> quitter, abandonner, laisser; renoncer à; violer (un serment, un devoir) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> renvoyer; lancer, jeter — ps. <i>(prahīyate)</i> être négligé, être mis à l'écart <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> échouer; dépérir; succomber.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहाण</span> <i>prahāṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prahaa" class="skt-link">prahā</a>] <a href="#entry-prahaa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> abandon, bannissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abstraction; méditation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहार</span> <i>prahāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> coup, choc; blessure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prahārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prahaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prahaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prahaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahāriṇī</i> qui frappe; qui combat contre ⟨g. iic.⟩; combattant, guerrier.<br> <a href="#entry-prahaara" class="skt-link">prahāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहर</span> <i>prahara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> tour de garde (de 3 h); période de 3 h; cf. <a href="#entry-astaprahara" class="skt-link">astaprahara</a>, <a href="#entry-dviprahara" class="skt-link">dviprahara</a>, <a href="#entry-praata_hprahara" class="skt-link">prātaḥprahara</a>, <a href="#entry-madhyamaprahara" class="skt-link">madhyamaprahara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहरण</span> <i>praharaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prahara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de frapper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> coup; attaque, combat <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arme, missile.<br> <i>praharaṇīkṛ</i> employer comme arme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praharat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहरत्</span> <i>praharat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-prah_r" class="skt-link">prahṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praharat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praharat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praharantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praharantī</i> combattant — <a href="#entry-praharat" class="skt-link">m.</a> soldat, guerrier, garde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहस्</span> <i>prahas</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-has" class="skt-link">has</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prahasati)</i> pr. md. <i>(prahasate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahasita</i><i>)</i> éclater de rire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहस</span> <i>prahasa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prahas" class="skt-link">prahas</a>] <a href="#entry-prahasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> ironie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहसन</span> <i>prahasana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prahas" class="skt-link">prahas</a>] <a href="#entry-prahasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gaieté, rire, dérision <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> situation comique ou ridicule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. farce, pièce burlesque; cf. <a href="#entry-Umattavilaasa" class="skt-link">Mattavilāsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahasta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहस्त</span> <i>prahasta</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-hasta" class="skt-link">hasta</a>] <a href="#entry-prahasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> posture de main ouverte, doigts tendus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahelaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहेलक</span> <i>prahelaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-helaa" class="skt-link">helā</a>] <a href="#entry-prahelaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> friandise (not. distribuée lord d'un festival) — <a href="#entry-prahelikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahelikā</i> devinette, énigme, charade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहि</span> <i>prahi</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-hi_2" class="skt-link">hi_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(prahinoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahita</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer sur ⟨dat. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> procurer, remettre, accorder, expédier (à ⟨dat.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahii_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहीण</span> <i>prahīṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prahaa" class="skt-link">prahā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prahii_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prahii_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prahii_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahīṇā</i> laissé; resté; seul; rejeté, banni; usé (vêtement) — <a href="#entry-prahii_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> perte; fait d'enlever; destruction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहित</span> <i>prahita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prahi" class="skt-link">prahi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prahita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prahita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prahitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahitā</i> jeté, lancé; envoyé contre ⟨dat.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> procuré, remis, envoyé à ⟨g.⟩; chargé de ⟨loc.⟩ — ifc. dirigé vers (esprit, regard).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahlaad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रह्लाद्</span> <i>prahlād</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-hlaad" class="skt-link">hlād</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prahlādate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahlādita</i><i>)</i> se rafraîchir, se réconforter — ca. <i>(prahlādayati)</i> rafraîchir, réconforter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahlaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रह्लाद</span> <i>prahlāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prahlaad" class="skt-link">prahlād</a>] <a href="#entry-prahlaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> réconfort, consolation, bonheur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Prahlāda «Réconfort», fils de <a href="#entry-Uhira_nyakazipu" class="skt-link">Hiraṇyakaśipu</a>; il était adorateur de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, et par suite persécuté par son père, qui essaya de l'empoisonner, de le faire tuer par des serpents, de le jeter dans un précipice, de le faire piétiner par un éléphant; il fut sauvé par <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha</a>; il incarne la patience récompensée du dévot persécuté; il est père de <a href="#entry-Ugave_s_thin" class="skt-link">Gaveṣṭhin</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvirocana" class="skt-link">Virocana</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uholikaa" class="skt-link">Holikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहु</span> <i>prahu</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-hu" class="skt-link">hu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(prajuhoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prahuta</i><i>)</i> offrir en oblation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prahuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रहुत</span> <i>prahuta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prahu" class="skt-link">prahu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prahuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prahuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prahutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prahutā</i> offert (en oblation) — <a href="#entry-prahuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> offrande, nourriture sacrée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prai_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रैष</span> <i>praiṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pre_s" class="skt-link">preṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-prai_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> invitation; instruction; ordre à un assistant ou un serviteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. not. ordre d'un prêtre à un assistant de commencer une cérémonie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prai_sa_nika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>praiṣaṇika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prai_sa_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prai_sa_nika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prai_sa_nikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praiṣaṇikā</i> qui est aux ordres — <a href="#entry-prai_sa_nika" class="skt-link">m.</a> factotum.<br> <a href="#entry-prai_sa" class="skt-link">praiṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prai_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रैष्य</span> <i>praiṣya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-pre_s" class="skt-link">preṣ</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-prai_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prai_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praiṣyā</i> serviteur; esclave — <a href="#entry-prai_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> service; servitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रजा</span> <i>prajā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prajan" class="skt-link">prajan</a>] <a href="#entry-prajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> procréation; progéniture; descendant; race, postérité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> créature, homme; sujet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>prajās</i> sujets (du royaume); enfants, progéniture; race, lignée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. progéniture.<br> <i>yathā</i> <i>rājā</i> <i>tathā</i> <i>prajā</i> [SRB.] Tel roi, tel peuple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaag_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रजागृ</span> <i>prajāgṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-jaag_r" class="skt-link">jāgṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prajāgarti)</i> guetter ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रजागर</span> <i>prajāgara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prajaag_r" class="skt-link">prajāgṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prajaagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaagara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaagaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajāgarā</i> qui veille — <a href="#entry-prajaagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> gardien, veilleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prajāgara, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Celui qui veille (sur nous)» — <a href="#entry-prajaagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> veille, privation de sommeil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajāhita</i> [<a href="#entry-hita_2" class="skt-link">hita_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prajaahita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaahita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaahitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajāhitā</i> favorable à la race; bénéfique aux sujets.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaakaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajākāma</i> [<a href="#entry-kaama" class="skt-link">kāma</a>] <a href="#entry-prajaakaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> désir de descendance — a. <a href="#entry-prajaakaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaakaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prajaakaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajākāmā</i> qui désire une progéniture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajaapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajāpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du démiurge Prajāpati «le Seigneur des créatures», épith. de la moitié mâle <a href="#entry-Uviraa_t" class="skt-link">Virāṭ</a> de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> le Créateur; astr. il préside le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> de <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_1" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_1</a>; il commit l'inceste primordial avec sa fille <a href="#entry-Uu_saa" class="skt-link">Uṣā</a> sous la forme d'un daim [<a href="#entry-m_rga" class="skt-link">mṛga</a>], et fut épinglé au ciel comme <a href="#entry-Um_rgaziras" class="skt-link">Mṛgaśiras</a> par <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>; phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] il est le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] de la faculté de reproduction [<a href="#entry-upastha" class="skt-link">upastha</a>]; on l'invoque parfois comme <a href="#entry-Uka" class="skt-link">Ka</a>; il personnifie l'an 5 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>]; [SP.] il créa l'Univers en proférant <i>bhūr</i> <i>bhuvar</i> <i>svaḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a> est aussi le Cosmos [<a href="#entry-Upuru_sa" class="skt-link">Puruṣa</a>] démembré en les 5 directions de l'espace [<a href="#entry-diz_2" class="skt-link">diś_2</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. démiurge en gén.; not. l'un des 10 géniteurs, esprits issus de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> (ou créés par <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Usvaayambhuva" class="skt-link">Svāyaṃbhuva</a>) pour peupler le monde; la liste traditionnelle des géniteurs comprend les 7 patriaches [<a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>]: <a href="#entry-Umariici" class="skt-link">Marīci</a>, <a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a>, <a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upulastya" class="skt-link">Pulastya</a>, <a href="#entry-Upulaha" class="skt-link">Pulaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukratu" class="skt-link">Kratu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>, auquels on ajoute: <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-Upracetaa" class="skt-link">Pracetā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> et <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a>; on inclut aussi parfois <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubharadvaaja" class="skt-link">Bharadvāja</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>, <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a>, et aussi <a href="#entry-Ukardama" class="skt-link">Kardama</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रजन्</span> <i>prajan</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-jan" class="skt-link">jan</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(prajāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prajāta</i><i>)</i> naître, surgir — ca. <i>(prajanayati)</i> engendrer, produire; évoquer, suggérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रजन</span> <i>prajana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prajan" class="skt-link">prajan</a>] <a href="#entry-prajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prajana" class="skt-link">n.</a> procréation, génération; descendance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géniteur.<br> <i>prajanārtham</i> adv. pour les besoins de la procréation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajotpatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajotpatti</i> [<a href="#entry-utpatti" class="skt-link">utpatti</a>] <a href="#entry-prajotpatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'élever une progéniture.<br> <i>prajotpattyānupūrvyeṇa</i> selon l'ordre de séniorité.<br> <a href="#entry-prajaa" class="skt-link">prajā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prajval">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्वल्</span> <i>prajval</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-jval" class="skt-link">jval</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prajvalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prajvalita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> s'enflammer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञ</span> <i>prajña</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajñā</i> instruit, savant; sage — ifc. qui connaît.<br> <i>pathiprajña</i> qui connaît bien le chemin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञा</span> <i>prajñā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-j_naa_1" class="skt-link">jñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(prajānāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(prajānīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prajñāta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> reconnaître, distinguer; être familier avec <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> connaître; percevoir; découvrir; apprendre — ca. <i>(prajñāpayati)</i> montrer (la voie, la méthode) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> convoquer, inviter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञा</span> <i>prajñā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> connaissance, sagesse, jugement; intuition; intelligence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la sagesse, une des 6 perfections [<a href="#entry-paaramitaa" class="skt-link">pāramitā</a>] d'un accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] désigne la <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a> dans la symbolique bd. érotique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naabhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñābhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naabhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> bengali Prajñābhadra «Qui excelle en sagesse» (989–1069); bd. il devint le Parfait [<a href="#entry-mahaasiddha" class="skt-link">mahāsiddha</a>] <a href="#entry-Utilopa" class="skt-link">Tilopa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naakaragupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñākaragupta</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>-<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naakaragupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du maître bd. Prajñākaragupta (8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); on lui doit le traité <a href="#entry-Upramaa_navaarttikaalafkarabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Pramāṇavārttikālaṃkarabhāṣya</a>, commentaire sur les moyens de connaissance selon <a href="#entry-Udharmakiirti" class="skt-link">Dharmakīrti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naaloka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāloka</i> [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naaloka" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] [«lieu de savoir»] vision ou connaissance divine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naapaaramitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāpāramitā</i> [<a href="#entry-paaramitaa" class="skt-link">pāramitā</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. sagesse parfaite (une des vertus cardinales du bouddhisme) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. np. de Prajñāpāramitā, la Sagesse personnifiée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. famille de textes donnant l'enseignement de <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> par ses dialogues avec des disciples et des dieux; cf. <a href="#entry-Ua_s_tasaahasrikaa" class="skt-link">Aṣṭasāhasrikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upa_ncavi_mzatisahasrikaa" class="skt-link">Pañcaviṃśatisahasrikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajracchedikaa" class="skt-link">Vajracchedikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uak_sobhya" class="skt-link">Akṣobhya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naapaaramitaasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāpāramitāsūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naapaaramitaasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. np. du Prajñāpāramitāsūtra «Traité de la Grande Vertu de Sagesse», dû à <a href="#entry-Unaagaarjuna" class="skt-link">Nāgārjuna</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">prajñāpāramitā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naapaaramitaazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāpāramitāśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naapaaramitaazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. np. du Prajñāpāramitāśāstra ou <a href="#entry-Umahaapraj_naapaaramitaazaastra" class="skt-link">Mahāprajñāpāramitāśāstra</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Upraj_naapaaramitaasuutra" class="skt-link">Prajñāpāramitāsūtra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāpti</i> [<a href="#entry-aapti" class="skt-link">āpti</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naapti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. dénotation d'un mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञात</span> <i>prajñāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praj_naata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_naata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_naataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajñātā</i> connu, reconnu, découvert; bien connu, notoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_naavarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prajñāvarman</i> [<a href="#entry-varman" class="skt-link">varman</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_naavarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Prajñāvarmā «Protégé par sa sagesse», lettré bd. de la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Upaala" class="skt-link">Pāla</a> <a href="#entry-Ugopaala" class="skt-link">Gopāla</a>; il est l'auteur de l'<a href="#entry-Uudaanavargavivara_na" class="skt-link">Udānavargavivaraṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praj_naa_2" class="skt-link">prajñā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_napta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञप्त</span> <i>prajñapta</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praj_napta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_napta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praj_naptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajñaptā</i> prescrit; ordonné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrangé (siège).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praj_napti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रज्ञप्ति</span> <i>prajñapti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praj_naa_1" class="skt-link">prajñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praj_napti" class="skt-link">f.</a> information; instruction, enseignement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nomination; accord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrangement (siège).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकृ</span> <i>prakṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-k_r_1" class="skt-link">kṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(prakaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prakṛta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>prakārya</i><i>)</i> faire, produire, mettre au jour; accomplir; décider.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(prakṛṣati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prakarṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prakṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> entraîner, tirer en avant; étirer, étendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकृष्ट</span> <i>prakṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prak_r_s" class="skt-link">prakṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṛṣṭā</i> étiré; prolongé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excellent, supérieur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकॄ</span> <i>prakṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rr" class="skt-link">kṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(prakirati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prakīrṇa</i><i>)</i> éparpiller; émettre.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकृत</span> <i>prakṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prak_r" class="skt-link">prakṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṛtā</i> fait, produit; accompli; préparé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commencé; mentionné, dont il est question <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> primaire; opp. <a href="#entry-aprak_rta" class="skt-link">aprakṛta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_rtaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rtaartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rtaarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṛtārthā</i> ayant le sens d'origine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réel; conforme aux faits, exact.<br> <a href="#entry-prak_rta" class="skt-link">prakṛta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकृति</span> <i>prakṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prak_r" class="skt-link">prakṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> nature; ordre naturel; forme primitive <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fondement, origine, cause; élément constitutif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> état naturel, tempérament; état de santé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. radical d'origine d'un mot; il se combine avec un suffixe [<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la Nature Originelle, combinant les potentialités de l'Énergie et de la Matière, principe femelle dynamique activé par le contact avec le principe mâle statique [<a href="#entry-puru_sa" class="skt-link">puruṣa</a>] exprimant l'Esprit; elle est le point d'équilibre du <a href="#entry-trigu_na" class="skt-link">triguṇa</a> de ses qualités: <a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>, <a href="#entry-rajas" class="skt-link">rajas</a> et <a href="#entry-tamas" class="skt-link">tamas</a>; elle se manifeste par l'évolution [<a href="#entry-pari_naama" class="skt-link">pariṇāma</a>] des 24 substances [<a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>] dont elle forme la 25⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩; cf. <a href="#entry-vik_rti" class="skt-link">vikṛti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] injonction originale; opp. <a href="#entry-vik_rti" class="skt-link">vikṛti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. base d'un substantif; syn. <a href="#entry-praatipadika" class="skt-link">prātipadika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. la langue sanskrite, vue (par les grammairiens indiens) comme origine des langues vernaculaires [<a href="#entry-praak_rta" class="skt-link">prākṛta</a>].<br> <i>prakṛtyā</i> i. adv. naturellement.<br> <i>prakṛtyā</i> <i>subhaghaḥ</i> naturellement fortuné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtibhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rtibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> condition naturelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtibhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtibhava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhava" class="skt-link">bhava</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_rtibhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rtibhava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_rtibhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṛtibhavā</i> naturel, usuel, commun.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtipratyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtipratyaya</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>] iic. gram. radical et suffixe en morphologie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtipratyayavivecana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtipratyayavivecana</i> [<a href="#entry-vivecana" class="skt-link">vivecana</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rtipratyayavivecana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. morphological analysis.<br> <a href="#entry-prak_rtipratyaya" class="skt-link">prakṛtipratyaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rtitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> état d'origine, état naturel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rtitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état d'origine, état naturel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtivat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtivat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. comme dans la forme originelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] selon l'injonction d'origine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_rtyartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakṛtyartha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-prak_rtyartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. sens naturel.<br> <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_saalaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रक्षालक</span> <i>prakṣālaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prak_sal" class="skt-link">prakṣal</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_saalaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_saalaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_saalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṣālikā</i> qui lave.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_saalana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रक्षालन</span> <i>prakṣālana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prak_sal" class="skt-link">prakṣal</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_saalana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_saalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_saalanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṣālanā</i> qui effectue des ablutions fréquentes — <a href="#entry-prak_saalana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lavage, purification; ablutions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> produit de nettoyage; filtre; eau de lavage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_sal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रक्षल्</span> <i>prakṣal</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sal" class="skt-link">kṣal</a>] ca. <i>(prakṣālayati)</i> laver, nettoyer, rincer.<br> <i>hastau</i> <i>prakṣālaya</i> lave toi les mains.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_sip">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रक्षिप्</span> <i>prakṣip</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sip" class="skt-link">kṣip</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(prakṣipati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prakṣipta</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer; décocher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> laisser tomber, faire descendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ajouter, insérer; interpoler — ca. <i>(prakṣepayati)</i> faire lancer; faire mettre dans ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>agnau</i> <i>prakṣipati</i> <i>ghṛtam</i> il fait tomber le beurre dans le feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prak_sipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रक्षिप्त</span> <i>prakṣipta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prak_sip" class="skt-link">prakṣip</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prak_sipta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_sipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prak_siptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakṣiptā</i> jeté, lancé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mis en avant, poussé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ajouté, inséré, interpolé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. not. vers apocryphe ou interpolé d'une œuvre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praka_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकट</span> <i>prakaṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-ka_ta" class="skt-link">kaṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praka_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praka_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praka_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakaṭā</i> manifeste, public; évident, clair.<br> <i>prakaṭam</i> adv. visiblement, ouvertement, en public.<br> <i>prakaṭīkṛ</i> manifester, exhiber, montrer.<br> <i>prakaṭībhū</i> se manifester, se montrer, apparaître.<br> <i>prakaṭaḥ</i> <i>so</i> <i>'stu</i> Qu'il se montre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praka_taliilaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakaṭalīlā</i> [<a href="#entry-liilaa" class="skt-link">līlā</a>] <a href="#entry-praka_taliilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. manifestation visible de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> durant sa vie terrestre; opp. <a href="#entry-apraka_taliilaa" class="skt-link">aprakaṭalīlā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-praka_ta" class="skt-link">prakaṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकाम</span> <i>prakāma</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-kaama" class="skt-link">kāma</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> joie, délice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>prakāmās</i> choses agréables, objets désirables; délices.<br> <i>prakāmam</i> var. <i>prakāmatas</i> adv. volontairement; à son gré, selon son désir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à satiété, suffisamment; beaucoup; vraiment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकार</span> <i>prakāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prak_r" class="skt-link">prakṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> manière, mode, façon; sorte, espèce <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> similitude, différence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. modifieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] prédicat qualifiant.<br> <i>prakārais</i> d'une manière ou d'une autre.<br> <i>kena</i> <i>prakāreṇa</i> de quelle manière? comment?.<br> <i>prakāro</i> <i>dvividhaḥ</i> <i>viśeṣaṇamupalakṣaṇaśca</i> [<a href="#entry-Uma_nika_na" class="skt-link">Maṇikaṇa</a>] Il y a deux sortes de prédications: les qualifieurs et les indicateurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-prakaaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaaraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaarakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakārakā</i> sorte de, espèce de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qualifiant de.<br> <i>tatprakāraka</i> de cette sorte.<br> <i>niṣprakāraka</i> d'une autre sorte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaarataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaarataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. fait d'être une espèce, d'être un qualifiant; prédicativité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaarataaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāratāka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prakaarataaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaarataaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaarataakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāratākā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qui qualifie; syn. <a href="#entry-prakaaraka" class="skt-link">prakāraka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prakaarataa" class="skt-link">prakāratā</a> <br> <a href="#entry-prakaara" class="skt-link">prakāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकार्य</span> <i>prakārya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-prak_r" class="skt-link">prakṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prakaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāryā</i> qui doit être manifesté ou exposé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकाश्</span> <i>prakāś</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-kaaz" class="skt-link">kāś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prakāśate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prakāśita</i><i>)</i> paraître, apparaître, se manifester <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> briller, resplendir — ca. <i>(prakāśayati)</i> ca. <i>(prakāśayate)</i> dévoiler, rendre visible, éclairer; montrer, expliquer; proclamer, révéler; faire connaître, publier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकाश</span> <i>prakāśa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prakaaz" class="skt-link">prakāś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāśā</i> brillant, resplendissant; clair, ouvert, public; explicite, évident <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fameux, renommé, célèbre (pour ⟨i. iic.⟩) — ifc. qui a l'aspect de, qui ressemble à — <a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> apparition, manifestation; publication, publicité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> clarté, lumière; splendeur, gloire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> élucidation, explication <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> grand air, endroit découvert <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. pouvoir de révélation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] la Conscience universelle, associée à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; elle est réfléchie dans la Nature [opp. <a href="#entry-vimarza" class="skt-link">vimarśa</a>], émanation de <a href="#entry-Uzakti" class="skt-link">Śakti</a>.<br> <i>prakāśam</i> adv. ouvertement, publiquement; à haute voix.<br> <i>prakāśīkṛ</i> éclairer, illuminer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> publier, faire savoir.<br> <i>prakāśībhū</i> devenir public.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazaatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāśātman</i> [<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prakaazaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaazaatman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaazaatmanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāśātmanī</i> de nature brillante <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, etc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du philosophe Prakāśātman «Révélateur», auteur du <a href="#entry-Uvivara_na" class="skt-link">Vivaraṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">prakāśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकाशक</span> <i>prakāśaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prakaaz" class="skt-link">prakāś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prakaazaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaazaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prakaazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāśikā</i> clair, brillant; qui illumine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> renommé, célèbre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui explique, qui rend manifeste; qui rend public, qui révèle, qui trahit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. signifiant; opp. <a href="#entry-prakaazya" class="skt-link">prakāśya</a> — <a href="#entry-prakaazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāśikā</i> ifc. lit. lumière sur (titre d'ouvrage).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रकाशन</span> <i>prakāśana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prakaaz" class="skt-link">prakāś</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> qui illumine; brillance, lustre — <a href="#entry-prakaazanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prakāśanā</i> enseignement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāśatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaazataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> brillance; splendeur; renom <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> publicité, célébrité.<br> <i>prakāśatāṃ</i> <i>gam</i> être connu; devenir public.<br> <i>sā</i> <i>dāruṇā</i> <i>pratijñā</i> <i>loke</i> <i>prakāśatāṃ</i> <i>gatā</i> Cette résolution terrible fut connue du monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prakāśatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-prakaazatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> brillance; splendeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> célébrité, renom <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> publicité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prakaazavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमाण</span> <i>pramāṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pramaa_2" class="skt-link">pramā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mesure, grandeur, capacité, longueur, largeur, masse, durée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étalon, modèle, norme; autorité, règle; preuve, évidence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. moyen de connaissance légitime; le <a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a> en reconnaît quatre, selon leur instrument [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] de connaissance: la constatation directe par perception [<a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">pratyakṣa</a>] des matérialistes [<a href="#entry-caarvaakaas" class="skt-link">cārvākās</a>]; l'inférence [<a href="#entry-anumaana" class="skt-link">anumāna</a>] des logiciens, fondée sur l'argumentation logique [<a href="#entry-tarka" class="skt-link">tarka</a>]; l'identification par analogie [<a href="#entry-upamaana" class="skt-link">upamāna</a>]; et la connaissance induite de la parole [<a href="#entry-zabdabodha" class="skt-link">śabdabodha</a>], lorsque cette parole est révélée [<a href="#entry-zruti" class="skt-link">śruti</a>] ou transmise par un locuteur digne de foi [<a href="#entry-aaptopadeza" class="skt-link">āptopadeśa</a>]; le <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a> ne reconnaît que les deux premiers; la <a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a> ajoute la réfutation [<a href="#entry-abhaava" class="skt-link">abhāva</a>], qui postule que ce que nous n'avons pas le moyen de connaître n'existe pas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] instrument de connaissance droite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] le jugement valide, un processus cognitif [<a href="#entry-cittav_rtti" class="skt-link">cittavṛtti</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le sens des proportions, un sentiment esthétique [<a href="#entry-_sa_dafgazilpa" class="skt-link">ṣaḍaṅgaśilpa</a>] — <a href="#entry-pramaa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramāṇā</i> ifc. grandeur de, mesure de.<br> <i>pramāṇīkṛ</i> prendre pour autorité; en appeler à.<br> <i>asminnarthe'trabhavantaṃ</i> <i>pramāṇīkaromi</i> j'en appelle à Votre Honneur pour cette affaire.<br> <i>pramāṇam</i> <i>bhavān</i> soyez juge.<br> <i>devaḥ</i> <i>pramāṇam</i> c'est au roi de décider.<br> <i>atrabhavān</i> <i>pramāṇam</i> j'en appelle à Votre Honneur.<br> <i>sarvam</i> <i>jñānam</i> <i>pramāṇam</i> [<a href="#entry-Uprabhaakara" class="skt-link">Prabhākara</a>] Toute perception est une connaissance légitime.<br> <i>pramāṇam</i> <i>antareṇa</i> <i>na</i> <i>arthapratipattiḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>na</i> <i>arthapratipattim</i> <i>antareṇa</i> <i>pravṛttisāmarthyam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-Uvaatsyaayana_1" class="skt-link">Vātsyāyana_1</a>] On ne peut connaître l'object sans moyen de connaissance adéquat; sans connaissance de l'objet il n'y a pas d'action efficace.
  </div>
</div>
