    <i>pramātmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-aatmaka" class="skt-link">ātmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramaatmaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramaatmaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramaatmikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramātmikā</i> phil. caractérise la connaissance [<a href="#entry-j_naana" class="skt-link">jñāna</a>] valide; opp. <a href="#entry-bhramaatmaka" class="skt-link">bhramātmaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pramaa_2" class="skt-link">pramā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramad_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमद्</span> <i>pramad_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-mad_1" class="skt-link">mad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(pramādyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pramatta</i><i>)</i> être joyeux, prendre du plaisir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être indifférent à ⟨abl. loc.⟩, être négligent; perdre son temps; se laisser aller, s'abandonner à ⟨loc.⟩; céder à l'illusion.<br> <i>devapitṛkāryābhyāṃ</i> <i>na</i> <i>pramaditavyam</i> [TU.] Il ne faut pas négliger les rites envers les dieux et les mânes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramad_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमद्</span> <i>pramad_2</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-pramad_1" class="skt-link">pramad_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pramad_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir; luxure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमद</span> <i>pramada</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pramad_1" class="skt-link">pramad_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramadā</i> insouciant; libertin, dissolu — <a href="#entry-pramada" class="skt-link">m.</a> joie, plaisir — f. cf. <a href="#entry-pramadaa" class="skt-link">pramadā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramadaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमदा</span> <i>pramadā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-pramada" class="skt-link">pramada</a>] <a href="#entry-pramadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme folâtre ou de mœurs légères; jeune femme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramadaajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pramadājana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-pramadaajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> gent féminine, les femmes.<br> <a href="#entry-pramadaa" class="skt-link">pramadā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramadvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pramadvara</i> [<a href="#entry-vara_2" class="skt-link">vara_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramadvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramadvara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramadvaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramadvarā</i> insouciant, imprudent — <a href="#entry-pramadvaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramadvarā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de la jolie nymphe Pramadvarā, fille de <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaavasu" class="skt-link">Viśvāvasu</a>; elle épousa le sage <a href="#entry-Ururu" class="skt-link">Ruru</a>, qui lui sauva la vie après sa morsure avec un serpent venimeux, et dont elle enfanta de <a href="#entry-Uzunaka" class="skt-link">Śunaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pramad_2" class="skt-link">pramad_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमन्</span> <i>praman</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-man" class="skt-link">man</a>] pr. md. <i>(pramante)</i> cogiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramanth">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमन्थ्</span> <i>pramanth</i> var. <i>pramath</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-manth" class="skt-link">manth</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pramanthati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pramathita</i><i>)</i> user de violence, maltraiter, tourmenter — ca. <i>(pramāthayati)</i> attaquer, molester, violenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमथ</span> <i>pramatha</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-matha" class="skt-link">matha</a>] <a href="#entry-pramatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. classe de démons tourmenteurs, serviteurs de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pramatha «Tourmenteur», fils de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramathaprathama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pramathaprathama</i> [<a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">prathama</a>] <a href="#entry-pramathaprathama" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. «premier parmi les serviteurs de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>», épith. de <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pramatha" class="skt-link">pramatha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमति</span> <i>pramati</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praman" class="skt-link">praman</a>] <a href="#entry-pramati" class="skt-link">f.</a> protection, providence — <a href="#entry-pramati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'ermite Pramati «Protecteur», fils de <a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a> et <a href="#entry-Usukanyaa" class="skt-link">Sukanyā</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ururu" class="skt-link">Ruru</a> par <a href="#entry-Uprataapii" class="skt-link">Pratāpī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमत्त</span> <i>pramatta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pramad_1" class="skt-link">pramad_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramattā</i> indifférent, négligent; oublieux de ⟨abl.⟩; qui se laisse aller <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lascif, dissolu; ivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prameya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमेय</span> <i>prameya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pramaa_1" class="skt-link">pramā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prameya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prameya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prameyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prameyā</i> à mesurer; mesurable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. à prouver, à établir; prouvable; dont il faut former jugement — <a href="#entry-prameya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] objet de jugement ou de connaissance; il y en a douze: l'âme [<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>], le corps [<a href="#entry-zariira" class="skt-link">śarīra</a>], les facultés [<a href="#entry-indriya" class="skt-link">indriya</a>], leurs objets [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>], la conscience [<a href="#entry-buddhi" class="skt-link">buddhi</a>], l'esprit [<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>], l'activité [<a href="#entry-prav_rtti" class="skt-link">pravṛtti</a>], les fautes [<a href="#entry-do_sa" class="skt-link">doṣa</a>], l'existence après la mort [<a href="#entry-pretyabhaava" class="skt-link">pretyabhāva</a>], le fruit des actes [<a href="#entry-phala" class="skt-link">phala</a>], le malheur [<a href="#entry-du_hkha" class="skt-link">duḥkha</a>] et la délivrance [<a href="#entry-apavarga" class="skt-link">apavarga</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] instrument de connaissance correcte — <a href="#entry-prameya" class="skt-link">n.</a> sujet à discuter; proposition à établir — <a href="#entry-prameyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prameyā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prameyadiipikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prameyadīpikā</i> [<a href="#entry-diipikaa" class="skt-link">dīpikā</a>] <a href="#entry-prameyadiipikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Prameyadīpikā «Lumières sur la connaissance», commentaire du <a href="#entry-Ugiitaa" class="skt-link">Gītā</a> <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a> de <a href="#entry-Umadhvaacaarya" class="skt-link">Madhvācārya</a>, dû à <a href="#entry-Ujayatiirtha" class="skt-link">Jayatīrtha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prameyakamalamaarta_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kamala" class="skt-link">kamala</a>-<a href="#entry-maarta_n_da" class="skt-link">mārtaṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-prameyakamalamaarta_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa «Soleil du lotus de la connaissance», œuvre de philosophie jaïne de la connaissance due à <a href="#entry-Uprabhaacandra" class="skt-link">Prabhācandra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prameyapradhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prameyapradhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-pradhaana" class="skt-link">pradhāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prameyapradhaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prameyapradhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prameyapradhaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prameyapradhānā</i> qui a pour objet principal le jugement.<br> <a href="#entry-prameya" class="skt-link">prameya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमित</span> <i>pramita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pramaa_1" class="skt-link">pramā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramitā</i> limité, modéré, petit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमिति</span> <i>pramiti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pramaa_1" class="skt-link">pramā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pramiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] acte de connaissance, cognition — <a href="#entry-pramiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. ce qui est connu; connaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramod">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमोद्</span> <i>pramod</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pramud_1" class="skt-link">pramud_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pramodayati)</i> réjouir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramoda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमोद</span> <i>pramoda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pramod" class="skt-link">pramod</a>] <a href="#entry-pramoda" class="skt-link">m.</a> joie; plaisir extrême <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la joie, l'une des 8 perfections <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [MP.] np. de Pramoda «Plaisir», un <a href="#entry-maanasaputra" class="skt-link">mānasaputra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pramoda_1, un guerrier compagnon de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a> Pramoda_2; il périt au <a href="#entry-sarpasattra" class="skt-link">sarpasattra</a> de <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Pramoda_3 «Joyeux», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 4 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pramodās</i> délices, plaisirs.<br> <i>sapramodena</i> <i>cittena</i> adv. avec l'esprit joyeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramoha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमोह</span> <i>pramoha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pramuh" class="skt-link">pramuh</a>] <a href="#entry-pramoha" class="skt-link">m.</a> stupeur, évanouissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> égarement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramohacitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pramohacitta</i> [<a href="#entry-citta" class="skt-link">citta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramohacitta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramohacitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramohacittaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramohacittā</i> qui a l'esprit égaré, stupéfait, abasourdi.<br> <a href="#entry-pramoha" class="skt-link">pramoha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramohita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमोहित</span> <i>pramohita</i> [<a href="#entry-pramoha" class="skt-link">pramoha</a><a href="#entry--ta" class="skt-link">-ta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramohita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramohita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramohitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramohitā</i> égaré, affolé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramud_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमुद्</span> <i>pramud_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-mud_1" class="skt-link">mud_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pramodate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pramudita</i><i>)</i> se réjouir, être joyeux — ca. <i>(pramodayati)</i> réjouir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramud_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमुद्</span> <i>pramud_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pramud_1" class="skt-link">pramud_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pramud_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> joie; plaisir; plaisir sensuel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramuh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमुह्</span> <i>pramuh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-muh" class="skt-link">muh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(pramuhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pramugdha</i>, <i>pramūḍha</i><i>)</i> être stupéfié, perdre la raison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perdre connaissance, s'évanouir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमुख</span> <i>pramukha</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramukhī</i> qui fait face à ⟨acc.⟩; premier, principal — ifc. qui a pour chef; précédé par — <a href="#entry-pramukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> début (d'un chapitre).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramukhatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pramukhatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. en face de; face à face.<br> <a href="#entry-pramukha" class="skt-link">pramukha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pramuu_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रमूढ</span> <i>pramūḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pramuh" class="skt-link">pramuh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pramuu_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pramuu_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pramuu_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pramūḍhā</i> fou, insensé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prana_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रनष्ट</span> <i>pranaṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pra_naz" class="skt-link">praṇaś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prana_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prana_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prana_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pranaṣṭā</i> disparu, perdu; détruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pranaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रनाल</span> <i>pranāla</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-naala" class="skt-link">nāla</a>] <a href="#entry-pranaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> canal; drain — <a href="#entry-pranaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pranālī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pranaayaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रनायक</span> <i>pranāyaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-naayaka" class="skt-link">nāyaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pranaayaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pranaayaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pranaayakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pranāyakā</i> que le guide a quitté; dont le guide est parti; sans chef.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pranaazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रनाशन</span> <i>pranāśana</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-naazana" class="skt-link">nāśana</a>] <a href="#entry-pranaazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> destruction, perte.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prapad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(prapadyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prapanna</i><i>)</i> tomber de ⟨abl.⟩; se jeter (aux pieds [<a href="#entry-paadau" class="skt-link">pādau</a>] de ⟨acc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aller vers, se rendre à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chercher refuge ou secours auprès de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obtenir, jouir de; entreprendre, réussir.<br> <i>vidyāṃ</i> <i>prapad</i> accéder à la connaissance.<br> <i>śaraṇaṃ</i> <i>prapad</i> chercher refuge auprès de ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>bahūnāṃ</i> <i>janmanām</i> <i>ante</i> <i>jñānavān</i> <i>māṃ</i> <i>prapadyate</i> [BhG.] Ce n'est qu'après de nombreuses renaissances que l'on parvient à me connaître.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prapatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prapatita</i><i>)</i> s'envoler; se hâter vers, tomber sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tomber; être privé de, perdre ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(prapātayati)</i> faire s'envoler; pourchasser; faire tomber — dés. <i>(prapipatiṣati)</i> désirer se sauver — int. <i>(prapāpatīti)</i> lancer.

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prarohati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prarūḍha</i><i>)</i> croître, pousser (plante); augmenter, prospérer.

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prasarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> se mettre en mouvement, partir; commencer; jaillir, couler — ca. <i>(prasārayati)</i> étaler, exposer (marchandise).

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pras_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसृत</span> <i>prasṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pras_r" class="skt-link">prasṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pras_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pras_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pras_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasṛtā</i> issu de, jailli de ⟨abl. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étalé; couvrant largement; étendu sur ou jusqu'à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intense, fort — <a href="#entry-pras_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> paume de la main tendue pour recevoir un liquide <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> poignée (mesure valant deux <a href="#entry-pala" class="skt-link">pala</a>) — <a href="#entry-pras_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> produit, poussé (herbe, plantes, légumes); agriculture.<br> <i>iti</i> <i>vārtā</i> <i>prasṛtā</i> cette rumeur se répandit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(prasādayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasādita</i><i>)</i> prier, implorer, demander une faveur.<br> <i>prasādāt</i> grâce à.<br> <i>prasādaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> se montrer aimable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasaadaatta">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prasīdati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasanna</i><i>)</i> s'éclaircir; s'apaiser, devenir serein; être de bonne humeur; être aimable envers qqn. ⟨g.⟩ — ca. <i>(prasādayati)</i> purifier; apaiser; prier qqn. ⟨acc.⟩ de ⟨inf.⟩ (en vue de ⟨dat. loc. <i>arthe</i>-g.⟩).<br> <i>prasīda</i> adr. s'il vous plaît; grâce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasafga">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] corollaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. conséquences — ifc. connecté avec.<br> <i>prasaṅgena</i> var. <i>prasaṅgāt</i>, <i>prasaṅgatas</i> adv. en relation avec; en conséquence de, à cause de, au moyen de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> au cours de; ex. <i>kathāprasaṅgena</i> au cours de la conversation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incidemment, en passant; quand l'occasion se présente, opportunément.<br> <i>madhuprasaṅga</i> ⟨ifc.⟩ de printemps.<br> <i>prasaṅge</i> <i>kutrāpi</i> en une certaine occasion.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

(règle) applicable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continuel; durable, constant; éternel — ifc. pourvu de — iic. continuellement, toujours, éternellement.<br> <i>utsargeṇa</i> <i>prasaktasyāpavādo</i> <i>bādhako</i> <i>bhavati</i> gram. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Mahābhāṣya</a>] Une règle entravante empêche de s'appliquer ce qui était applicable de par la règle générale.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prasajati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasakta</i><i>)</i> s'attacher, adhérer à; s'accrocher à ⟨loc.⟩ — pr. md. <i>(prasajate)</i> être attaché à, s'adonner à ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasenajit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prasenajit</i> [<a href="#entry-jit" class="skt-link">jit</a>] <a href="#entry-prasenajit" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Prasenajit «qui vainc par sa grande armée», fils de <a href="#entry-Up_rthulaazva" class="skt-link">Pṛthulāśva</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; son épouse est <a href="#entry-Ure_nu_1" class="skt-link">Reṇu_1</a>; il est père de <a href="#entry-Uyuvanaazva" class="skt-link">Yuvanāśva</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ure_nukaa" class="skt-link">Reṇukā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzraavastii" class="skt-link">Śrāvastī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Prasenajit_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Ususandhi" class="skt-link">Susandhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Prasenajit_2, roi du <a href="#entry-Ukosala" class="skt-link">Kosala</a> (6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.); il régnait à <a href="#entry-Uzraavastii" class="skt-link">Śrāvastī</a>; il était disciple laïc [<a href="#entry-upaasaka" class="skt-link">upāsaka</a>] du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>; il donna une de ses filles en mariage à <a href="#entry-Ubimbisaara" class="skt-link">Bimbisāra</a>, une autre à son fils <a href="#entry-Uajaatazatru_1" class="skt-link">Ajātaśatru_1</a> dont il devint le vassal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prakrit Pasenadi.<br> <a href="#entry-prasena" class="skt-link">prasena</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praseva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasiddha">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasiddhi">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasidh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसिध्</span> <i>prasidh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-sidh_1" class="skt-link">sidh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prasidhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasiddha</i><i>)</i> être accompli, réussir, aboutir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trouver son explication dans, dériver de ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(prasādhayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-prasaadh" class="skt-link">prasādh</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasiiv">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसीव्</span> <i>prasīv</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-siiv" class="skt-link">sīv</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prasīvyati)</i> coudre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praskand">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्कन्द्</span> <i>praskand</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-skand" class="skt-link">skand</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(praskandati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praskanna</i><i>)</i> sauter, descendre de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्न</span> <i>prasna</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-prasnaa" class="skt-link">prasnā</a>] <a href="#entry-prasna" class="skt-link">m.</a> bain; baignoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasnaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्ना</span> <i>prasnā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-snaa" class="skt-link">snā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prasnāti)</i> entrer dans l'eau — ca. <i>(prasnapayati)</i> se baigner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasnava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्नव</span> <i>prasnava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasnu" class="skt-link">prasnu</a>] <a href="#entry-prasnava" class="skt-link">m.</a> écoulement, flot; urine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. pleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasnu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्नु</span> <i>prasnu</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-snu" class="skt-link">snu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prasnauti)</i> émettre un fluide; verser, arroser — pr. md. <i>(prasnute)</i> couler — ca. <i>(snāvayati)</i> faire couler.<br> <i>prasnute</i> <i>śoṇitam</i> le sang coule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasrava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्रव</span> <i>prasrava</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prasru" class="skt-link">prasru</a>] <a href="#entry-prasrava" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui s'écoule; flot, courant, jet; not. jet de lait lors de la traite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> débordement; not. de l'eau de cuisson du riz <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. flot de larmes; jet d'urine — <a href="#entry-prasrava" class="skt-link">n.</a> cascade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasrava_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्रवण</span> <i>prasravaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasru" class="skt-link">prasru</a>] <a href="#entry-prasrava_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> écoulement, flot, décharge (de ⟨iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> émission de lait, de sueur, d'urine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cascade; cataracte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> embouchure; bec verseur — <a href="#entry-prasrava_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasravaṇā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasrava_najala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prasravaṇajala</i> [<a href="#entry-jala" class="skt-link">jala</a>] <a href="#entry-prasrava_najala" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau de source.<br> <a href="#entry-prasrava_na" class="skt-link">prasravaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्रु</span> <i>prasru</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-sru" class="skt-link">sru</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prasravati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasruta</i><i>)</i> couler, s'écouler (de ⟨abl.⟩), jaillir de ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(srāvayati)</i> émettre de l'eau; uriner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prast_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तॄ</span> <i>prastṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-st_rr" class="skt-link">stṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(prastṛṇāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prastīrṇa</i><i>)</i> étendre, répandre, étaler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तार</span> <i>prastāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prast_rr" class="skt-link">prastṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-prastaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> étalement, extension, distribution; fait de répandre ou de joncher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) abondance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> paillasse, couche; jungle, broussailles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. table des combinaisons binaires (not. de voyelles longues et brèves).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्ताव</span> <i>prastāva</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prastu" class="skt-link">prastu</a>] <a href="#entry-prastaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> commencement; introduction, prologue, mention préliminaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> allusion, référence; thème, sujet d'une conversation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasion, opportunité, conjoncture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. prélude d'un <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a> (chanté par le <a href="#entry-prastot_r" class="skt-link">prastotṛ</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastaavanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prastāvanā</i> [<a href="#entry--naa" class="skt-link">-nā</a>] <a href="#entry-prastaavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> annonce <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. introduction, avant-propos, préface <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. prologue d'une pièce de théâtre.<br> <a href="#entry-prastaava" class="skt-link">prastāva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तर</span> <i>prastara</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-prast_rr" class="skt-link">prastṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-prastara" class="skt-link">m.</a> couche (de feuilles ou de fleurs); siège pour le sacrifice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> surface plane; dalle; niveau; plateau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. représentation tabulaire d'un mètre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. véd. touffe d'herbe <a href="#entry-kuza" class="skt-link">kuśa</a> [<a href="#entry-darbha" class="skt-link">darbha</a>] utilisée comme effigie du sacrifiant et jetée dans le feu offertoire lors de la cérémonie du <a href="#entry-sarpa_na" class="skt-link">sarpaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्थ</span> <i>prastha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasthā</i> stable, solide; étendu — <a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> plateau, plaine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sommet, montagne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mesure de poids, not. de grain (environ 1,5 kg) ou de contenance (1,5 l); un <a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">prastha</a> vaut 32 (ou 16) <a href="#entry-pala" class="skt-link">pala</a>; il y en a 4 dans un <a href="#entry-aa_dhaka" class="skt-link">āḍhaka</a> — ifc. qui est parti pour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> forme des noms de villes et de villages.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्था</span> <i>prasthā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratiṣṭhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasthita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> se lever; partir, se mettre en marche; démarrer, commencer — pr. md. <i>(pratiṣṭhate)</i> être éveillé — ca. <i>(prasthāpayati)</i> faire partir, envoyer, expédier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्थान</span> <i>prasthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] <a href="#entry-prasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> départ, fait de se mettre en marche (not. d'une armée) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marche, procession <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> départ de la vie, mort; renoncement religieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méthode, système philosophique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> point de départ, origine; source, cause.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthaanabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prasthānabheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-prasthaanabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Prasthānabheda «Classification des systèmes», œuvre philosophique de <a href="#entry-Umadhusuudana_1" class="skt-link">Madhusūdana_1</a> <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a> visant à expliquer la suprématie de l'<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a> <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prasthaana" class="skt-link">prasthāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthaanatrayii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prasthānatrayī</i> [<a href="#entry-trayii" class="skt-link">trayī</a>] <a href="#entry-prasthaanatrayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Prasthānatrayī «Triade des fondements», ensemble des textes canoniques du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>: les leçons [<a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>] ou textes instructifs [<a href="#entry-upadeza" class="skt-link">upadeśa</a>], les aphorismes [<a href="#entry-brahmasuutra" class="skt-link">brahmasūtra</a>] ou textes logiques [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>], et la <a href="#entry-Ubhagavadgiitaa" class="skt-link">Bhagavadgītā</a> ou texte de pratique [<a href="#entry-saadhana" class="skt-link">sādhana</a>]; des commentaires [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] de ces textes ont été écrits par <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a> et <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvallabha_1" class="skt-link">Vallabha_1</a> leur ajouta le <a href="#entry-Ubhaagavatapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhāgavatapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्थातृ</span> <i>prasthātṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prasthaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prasthaat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasthaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasthātrī</i> qui part, qui commence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्थित</span> <i>prasthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prasthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prasthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasthitā</i> nommé (à un poste); prêt; mis en route, parti — ifc. qui arrive jusqu'à — <a href="#entry-prasthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> départ.<br> <i>prasthitam</i> on a envoyé qqn. ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasthiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्थिति</span> <i>prasthiti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] <a href="#entry-prasthiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de se mettre en route; départ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déplacement, voyage, marche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastot_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तोतृ</span> <i>prastotṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prastu" class="skt-link">prastu</a>] <a href="#entry-prastot_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. prêtre assistant de l'<a href="#entry-udgaat_r" class="skt-link">udgātṛ</a>, qui chante le <a href="#entry-prastaava" class="skt-link">prastāva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तु</span> <i>prastu</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-stu" class="skt-link">stu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prastauti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prastuta</i><i>)</i> louer, célébrer en chantant, entonner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> venir à parler de; se mettre à, entreprendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तुत</span> <i>prastuta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prastu" class="skt-link">prastu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prastuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prastuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prastutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prastutā</i> loué, mentionné; commencé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> primaire, principal — <a href="#entry-prastuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> commencement, entreprise; sujet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prastuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्तुति</span> <i>prastuti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prastu" class="skt-link">prastu</a>] <a href="#entry-prastuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> louange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसुप्त</span> <i>prasupta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prasvap" class="skt-link">prasvap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prasupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prasupta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasuptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasuptā</i> endormi, dormant; clos (fleur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inactif, lent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasuu_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसू</span> <i>prasū_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-suu_1" class="skt-link">sū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(prasūte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasūta</i><i>)</i> procréer, enfanter, engendrer; produire, porter des fruits.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasuu_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसू</span> <i>prasū_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasuu_1" class="skt-link">prasū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-prasuu_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prasuu_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasuu_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> production, procréation — ifc. fait de donner naissance à — <a href="#entry-prasuu_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> mère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसूत</span> <i>prasūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prasuu_1" class="skt-link">prasū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prasuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prasuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prasuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasūtā</i> procréé, produit, engendré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> procréé par, provoqué par ⟨abl. g.⟩; issu de ⟨loc. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-prasuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> source de production <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] essence primodiale — <a href="#entry-prasuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prasūtā</i> femme sortant de couches.<br> <i>yasya</i> <i>tasya</i> <i>prasūto</i> <i>'pi</i> <i>guṇavānpūjyate</i> <i>naraḥ</i> [Hit.] Quelle que soit son origine un homme de qualité est honoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasuuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसूति</span> <i>prasūti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prasuu_1" class="skt-link">prasū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-prasuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> procréation, génération, production; naissance; ponte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apparition; croissance (fruits, fleurs) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> procréateur, procréatrice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> progéniture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prasūti «Procréatrice», fille de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaayambhuva" class="skt-link">Svāyaṃbhuva</a>, une des épouses de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasuzruta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रसुश्रुत</span> <i>prasuśruta</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-suzruta" class="skt-link">suśruta</a>] <a href="#entry-prasuzruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Prasuśruta «Célèbre», fils de Maru_1, père d'<a href="#entry-Uambarii_sa_1" class="skt-link">Ambarīṣa_1</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uprazuzruka" class="skt-link">Praśuśruka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prasvap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रस्वप्</span> <i>prasvap</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-svap" class="skt-link">svap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prasvapiti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prasvapati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prasupta</i><i>)</i> s'endormir, aller dormir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prat_rd">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतृद्</span> <i>pratṛd</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rd" class="skt-link">tṛd</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(pratṛṇatti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratṛṇṇa</i><i>)</i> percer avec un épieu, embrocher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prat_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतॄ</span> <i>pratṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rr" class="skt-link">tṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratīrṇa</i><i>)</i> traverser, franchir — ca. <i>(pratārayati)</i> tromper, induire en erreur; séduire, persuader de ⟨dat. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रताप</span> <i>pratāpa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pratap" class="skt-link">pratap</a>] <a href="#entry-prataapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> Majesté [«pareil au Soleil brûlant»]; nom de prince — <a href="#entry-prataapii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratāpī</i> myth. np. de la jolie nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] Pratāpī, épouse de <a href="#entry-Upramati" class="skt-link">Pramati</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Ururu" class="skt-link">Ruru</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataaparudra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratāparudra</i> [<a href="#entry-rudra" class="skt-link">rudra</a>] <a href="#entry-prataaparudra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Pratāparudra_1, dernier roi des <a href="#entry-Ukaakatiiyaas" class="skt-link">Kākatīyās</a>, fils de la reine <a href="#entry-Urudraambaa" class="skt-link">Rudrāmbā</a>; il régnait à <a href="#entry-Uekazilaa" class="skt-link">Ekaśilā</a> (1290–1323); il combattit le sultanat de Delhi sous les Khilji puis sous les Tughluk; Ulugh Khān prit le fort d'<a href="#entry-Uekazilaa" class="skt-link">Ekaśilā</a> (mod. Warangal) et fit prisonnier <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudra_1" class="skt-link">Pratāparudra_1</a>, qui se suicida en se jetant dans la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Pratāparudra_2 or Pratāparudradeva «<a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> le Majestueux», fils du roi <a href="#entry-Ugajapati" class="skt-link">Gajapati</a> <a href="#entry-Upuru_sottamadeva_1" class="skt-link">Puruṣottamadeva_1</a>; il se prétendait issu de la lignée <a href="#entry-Usuuryava_mzii" class="skt-link">Sūryavaṃśī</a>; il régna sur le <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> de 1497 à 1540; sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Uka_taka" class="skt-link">Kaṭaka</a>; il combattit le Sultan du Bengale Allaudi Hussain Shah au Nord et <a href="#entry-Uviira_1" class="skt-link">Vīra_1</a> <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha_6" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha_6</a>, roi de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> au Sud; il patronna les lettrés, not. <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Uziroma_ni" class="skt-link">Śiromaṇi</a>; il est l'auteur de plusieurs ouvrages de droit [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>], d'érotique et de magie; cf. <a href="#entry-Usarasvatiivilaasa" class="skt-link">Sarasvatīvilāsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataaparudradeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratāparudradeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-prataaparudradeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. cf. <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudra_2" class="skt-link">Pratāparudra_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataaparudriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratāparudrīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-prataaparudriiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pratāparudrīya, ouvrage de rhétorique en forme d'éloge du roi <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudra_1" class="skt-link">Pratāparudra_1</a> dû à Vidyānātha (début du 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); Kumārasvāmī en fit un commentaire.<br> <a href="#entry-prataaparudra" class="skt-link">pratāparudra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataapavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratāpavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prataapavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prataapavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prataapavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratāpavatī</i> majestueux.<br> <a href="#entry-prataapa" class="skt-link">pratāpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतार्</span> <i>pratār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-prat_rr" class="skt-link">pratṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pratārayati)</i> tromper, induire en erreur; séduire, persuader de ⟨dat. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prataaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतारक</span> <i>pratāraka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prat_rr" class="skt-link">pratṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prataaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prataaraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prataarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratārikā</i> qui trompe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतन्</span> <i>pratan</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-tan_1" class="skt-link">tan_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(pratanoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratanute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratata</i><i>)</i> produire, exécuter; révéler, manifester; entreprendre, commencer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> propager.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतप्</span> <i>pratap</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-tap" class="skt-link">tap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratapati)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratapate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratapita</i>, <i>pratapta</i><i>)</i> dégager de la chaleur, réchauffer; brûler; briller; illuminer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infliger des brûlures, torturer — ps. <i>(pratapyate)</i> souffrir — ca. <i>(pratāpayati)</i> réchauffer; chauffer; mettre en feu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> irradier, illuminer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire souffrir, brûler; tourmenter, harasser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतप</span> <i>pratapa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratap" class="skt-link">pratap</a>] <a href="#entry-pratapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> chaleur du Soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतप्त</span> <i>pratapta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pratap" class="skt-link">pratap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prataptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prataptā</i> brûlant; chauffé au rouge; recuit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soumis au fer rouge, torturé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratardana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतर्दन</span> <i>pratardana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prat_rd" class="skt-link">pratṛd</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratardana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratardana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratardanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratardanā</i> qui transperce; lancier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-raajar_si" class="skt-link">rājarṣi</a> Pratardana, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Udivodaasa" class="skt-link">Divodāsa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Umaadhavii" class="skt-link">Mādhavī</a>; il régna sur <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a>; on lui attribue des hymnes du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvatsa_1" class="skt-link">Vatsa_1</a> est son fils <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «qui embroche».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratark">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतर्क्</span> <i>pratark</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-tark" class="skt-link">tark</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pratarkayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratarkita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>pratarkya</i><i>)</i> considérer comme; imaginer, concevoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratarka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतर्क</span> <i>pratarka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratark" class="skt-link">pratark</a>] <a href="#entry-pratarka" class="skt-link">m.</a> conjecture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratarkya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतर्क्य</span> <i>pratarkya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pratark" class="skt-link">pratark</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratarkya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratarkya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratarkyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratarkyā</i> imaginable, concevable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prath">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रथ्</span> <i>prath</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-p_rth" class="skt-link">pṛth</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prathate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prathita</i><i>)</i> s'étendre, augmenter, se répandre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> devenir célèbre — ca. <i>(prathayati)</i> étendre, répandre; proclamer, rendre célèbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रथ</span> <i>pratha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prath" class="skt-link">prath</a>] <a href="#entry-pratha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Pratha «Célèbre», fils de <a href="#entry-Uvazi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vaśiṣṭha</a>, auteur supposé d'hymnes du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a> — <a href="#entry-prathaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prathā</i> extension, dispersion; généralisation; expansion, fait de se répandre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> popularité, célébrité; célébration.<br> <i>prathāṃ</i> <i>gam</i> devenir célèbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prathama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रथम</span> <i>prathama</i> a. <a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prathamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prathamā</i> ord. premier, initial, aîné, qui précède; qui est en tête, le meilleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> le plus ancien — acc. <i>prathamam</i> adv. précédemment, autrefois; auparavant; avant ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> premièrement; d'abord, la première fois <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du premier coup, tout de suite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déjà — <a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">m.</a> [<i>prathamapuruṣa</i>] gram. 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ pers. (listée en premier en sanskrit) — <a href="#entry-prathamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prathamā</i> gram. nominatif (1⟨sup⟩re⟨/sup⟩ déclinaison) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πρωτος; lat. <i>primus</i>; fr. premier.<br> <i>prathamaikavacana</i> gram. (forme au) nominatif singulier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prathamatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prathamatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. d'abord.<br> <a href="#entry-prathama" class="skt-link">prathama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रथन</span> <i>prathana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prath" class="skt-link">prath</a>] <a href="#entry-prathana" class="skt-link">n.</a> extension; déploiement; exposition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> célébration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prathita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रथित</span> <i>prathita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prath" class="skt-link">prath</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prathita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prathita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prathitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prathitā</i> célèbre, connu, renommé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रति</span> <i>prati</i> prép. en sens inverse, en opposition, en retour; contre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vers, en face de, vis-à-vis de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> respectivement à, en ce qui concerne ⟨acc.⟩ — pf. distributif, de répétition — ifc. vers; à propos de, en ce qui concerne; contre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> petite quantité de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. προτι.<br> <i>vṛkṣaṃ</i> <i>prati</i> en direction de l'arbre.<br> <i>sukhaprati</i> ind. une parcelle de plaisir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिष्ठ</span> <i>pratiṣṭha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaa_1" class="skt-link">pratiṣṭhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prati_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prati_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratiṣṭhā</i> stable, ferme, solide — ifc. se terminant par, menant à, prenant pour base — <a href="#entry-prati_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> point de support, centre, base — f. cf. <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaa_2" class="skt-link">pratiṣṭhā_2</a>.<br> <i>pratiṣṭhā</i> <i>hṛdyā</i> <i>jaghantha</i> [RV.] Tu m'as touché en plein cœur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati_s_thaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिष्ठा</span> <i>pratiṣṭhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratitiṣṭhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratitiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratiṣṭhita</i><i>)</i> s'étendre, reposer sur ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cesser, disparaître, se coucher (astre) — ca. <i>(pratiṣṭhāpayati)</i> conduire à, porter sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> établir, fonder, soutenir; offrir, accorder à qqn. ⟨dat. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati_s_thaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिष्ठा</span> <i>pratiṣṭhā_2</i> [f. <a href="#entry-prati_s_tha" class="skt-link">pratiṣṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> base, fondement, support; stabilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> domicile, maison; repos, confort; place, poste, haute dignité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. rite, cérémonie, consécration; not. installation d'une image; cf. <a href="#entry-praa_naprati_s_thaa" class="skt-link">prāṇapratiṣṭhā</a>, <a href="#entry-lifgaprati_s_thaa" class="skt-link">liṅgapratiṣṭhā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>] aspect stable du <a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a> associé à <a href="#entry-Usadaaziva" class="skt-link">Sadāśiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvaamadeva" class="skt-link">Vāmadeva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati_s_thaacaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratiṣṭhācārya</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>] <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaacaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. religieux ayant qualité pour consacrer les images sacrées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prati_s_thaalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> attribut caractéristique d'une image sacrée aux fins d'identifier la divinité [<a href="#entry-devataa" class="skt-link">devatā</a>] représentée.

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pratigṛhṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratigṛhṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratigṛhīta</i><i>)</i> prendre, saisir; recevoir, accepter; accueillir — ca. <i>(pratigrāhayati)</i> faire prendre, donner, rendre.

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratiharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratihṛta</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> frapper, attaquer, combattre; repousser, retenir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> presser, fermer en poussant, garder fermé.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratihaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिहार</span> <i>pratihāra</i> var. <i>pratīhāra</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pratih_r" class="skt-link">pratihṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-pratihaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratihaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratihārī</i> fait de presser, fermeture; fait de retenir, arrêt; fait de repousser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. contact de la langue avec les dents lors de la prononciation des dentales <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. syllabes chantées par le <a href="#entry-pratihart_r" class="skt-link">pratihartṛ</a> lorsqu'il se met à chanter, au dernier vers d'un hymne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. formule magique prononcée sur les armes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> porte; gardien, portier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>pratīhāra</i>] hist. np. d'une dynastie d'Inde de l'Ouest <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>pratīhārau</i> les deux statues de gardiens à l'entrée d'un temple — <a href="#entry-pratihaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratihārī</i> soc. gardienne de porte royale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratihan">

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pratihanti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratihata</i><i>)</i> repousser, écarter; arrêter, retenir, empêcher; affaiblir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> garder fermé (not. outre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attaquer, assaillir; frapper, blesser; offenser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratihara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिहरण</span> <i>pratiharaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratih_r" class="skt-link">pratihṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-pratihara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de repousser; rejet; évitement.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratihata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतिहत</span> <i>pratihata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pratihan" class="skt-link">pratihan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratihata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratihata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratihataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratihatā</i> repoussé, écarté, retenu.<br> <i>pratihatam</i> <i>amaṅgalam</i> le malheur est écarté (formule pour conjurer un mauvais présage).
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pratyeti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratīta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> aller vers, aller contre; résister à; retourner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> admettre, croire, avoir confiance; reconnaître — ca. <i>(pratyāyayati)</i> convaincre de, faire croire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiicii">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiihaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratīhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-haara_1" class="skt-link">hāra_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pratiihaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de la dynastie des Pratīhārās, d'origine incertaine; ils régnaient à l'Ouest du Deccan, leur capitale était Bhinmal près du Mont Abu (du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ au 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiihaarenduraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiik_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pratīkṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratīkṣita</i><i>)</i> attendre; s'attendre à, anticiper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> supporter; tolérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiik_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतीक्ष</span> <i>pratīkṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratiik_s" class="skt-link">pratīkṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratiik_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiik_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiik_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratīkṣā</i> qui regarde en arrière — ifc. qui s'attend à, qui anticipe, qui a hâte de — <a href="#entry-pratiik_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratīkṣā</i> anticipation; attente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> considération, respect, vénération.<br> <i>muhūrtaṃ</i> <i>pratīkṣā</i> <i>karaṇīyā</i> il faut attendre un instant.<br> <i>sukhapratīkṣa</i> qui anticipe du plaisir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de nature optimiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतीक</span> <i>pratīka</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyac" class="skt-link">pratyac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratiika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratīkā</i> contraire, inversé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> symbolique — ifc. tourné vers, dirigé vers, opposé à; regardant — <a href="#entry-pratiika" class="skt-link">n.</a> extérieur, surface; apparence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> face, visage, front — <a href="#entry-pratiika" class="skt-link">m.</a> image, symbole; copie; membre, partie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. citation d'un passage du texte d'origine dans un commentaire; son premier segment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. focalisation d'un commentaire grammatical; par ex. un <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">vārttika</a> pour le <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>, un exemple à l'appui [<a href="#entry-udaahara_na" class="skt-link">udāharaṇa</a>] ou un détail opérationnel pour la dérivation [<a href="#entry-prakriyaa" class="skt-link">prakriyā</a>], etc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. symbole de la religion jaïne
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रतीकार</span> <i>pratīkāra</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pratikaara" class="skt-link">pratikāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiikanaa_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiindhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Pratīndhaka <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Umaru" class="skt-link">Maru</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ukiirtiratha" class="skt-link">Kīrtiratha</a>.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiipa">

[<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi <a href="#entry-kaurava" class="skt-link">kaurava</a> Pratīpa «le Revêche» père de <a href="#entry-Udevaapi" class="skt-link">Devāpi</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzaantanu" class="skt-link">Śāṃtanu</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubaahliika" class="skt-link">Bāhlīka</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiipaga">

    <i>pratīpaga</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratiipaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiipaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratiipagaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratīpagā</i> qui va à contre-courant; qui va à reculons.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratiipaka">

[BhP.] np. du roi Pratīpaka <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a> «l'Hostile», fils de <a href="#entry-Umaru" class="skt-link">Maru</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uk_rtiraata" class="skt-link">Kṛtirāta</a>.
  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Prativindhya, fils de <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> et <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>; il tua le roi <a href="#entry-Ucitra_2" class="skt-link">Citra_2</a> lors de la grande bataille, mais fut abattu par <a href="#entry-Uazvatthaamaa" class="skt-link">Aśvatthāmā</a> pendant la nuit.

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratizru">

[<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(pratiśṛṇoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratiśruta</i><i>)</i> entendre, écouter; prêter l'oreille à ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> promettre qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨g. dat.⟩; s'engager à — dés. <i>(pratiśuśrūṣati)</i> vouloir promettre.<br> <i>pūrvam</i> <i>arthaṃ</i> <i>pratiśrutya</i> <i>pratijñāṃ</i> <i>hātum</i> <i>icchasi</i> [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] D'abord tu promets quelque chose, puis tu veux revenir sur ta parole.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaahaara">

[«sélection par énoncé condensé»] abréviation par une paire de lettres désignant un intervalle de phonèmes dans le <a href="#entry-pratyaahaarasuutra" class="skt-link">pratyāhārasūtra</a> de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaahaarasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyāhārasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyaahaarasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. <i>pratyāhārasūtrāṇi</i> formulaire mnémotechnique pour composer des ensembles de lettres de l'alphabet sanskrit: <i>a</i> <i>i</i> <i>u</i> <i>ṇ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ṛ</i> <i>ḷ</i> <i>k</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>e</i> <i>o</i> <i>ṅ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ai</i> <i>au</i> <i>c</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ha</i> <i>ya</i> <i>va</i> <i>ra</i> <i>ṭ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>la</i> <i>ṇ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ña</i> <i>ma</i> <i>ṅa</i> <i>ṇa</i> <i>na</i> <i>m</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>jha</i> <i>bha</i> <i>ñ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>gha</i> <i>ḍha</i> <i>dha</i> <i>ṣ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ja</i> <i>ba</i> <i>ga</i> <i>ḍa</i> <i>da</i> <i>ś</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>kha</i> <i>pha</i> <i>cha</i> <i>ṭha</i> <i>tha</i> <i>ca</i> <i>ṭa</i> <i>ta</i> <i>v</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ka</i> <i>pa</i> <i>y</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>śa</i> <i>ṣa</i> <i>sa</i> <i>r</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ha</i> <i>l</i> ||; les dernières consonnes de chaque vers [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] sont des marqueurs; un <a href="#entry-pratyaahaara" class="skt-link">pratyāhāra</a> comprend un phonème de début, et un marqueur final; il nomme toutes les lettres intermédiaires, marqueurs exclus; ainsi <i>hal</i> nomme toutes les consonnes, <i>ac</i> les voyelles, <i>śar</i> les sibilantes, <i>yaṇ</i> les semi-voyelles, et <i>al</i> tout l'alphabet; syn. <a href="#entry-zivasuutra" class="skt-link">śivasūtra</a>, <a href="#entry-mahezvarasuutra" class="skt-link">maheśvarasūtra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pratyaahaara" class="skt-link">pratyāhāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naa_1">

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pratyabhijānāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pratyabhijānīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratyabhijñāta</i><i>)</i> reconnaître, se rappeler de; savoir, comprendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> retrouver ses esprits, reprendre conscience — ca. <i>(pratyabhijñāpayati)</i> rappeler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यभिज्ञा</span> <i>pratyabhijñā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naa_1" class="skt-link">pratyabhijñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de reconnaître <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>īśvarapratyabhijñā</i>] phil. [<a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a>] np. de la Pratyabhijñā «Reconnaissance (du Seigneur)», doctrine reconnaissant l'identité de l'âme individuelle et de l'Âme universelle, développée par <a href="#entry-Uutpaladeva" class="skt-link">Utpaladeva</a> et <a href="#entry-Uabhinavagupta" class="skt-link">Abhinavagupta</a>; elle affirme la réalité du Monde et transcende l'opposition entre dualisme [<a href="#entry-dvaita" class="skt-link">dvaita</a>] et monisme [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] — <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>pratyabhijña</i> ifc. reconnaissance de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naadarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyabhijñādarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. point de vue de la Reconnaissance (du Seigneur) [<a href="#entry-Upratyabhij_naa" class="skt-link">Pratyabhijñā</a>], enseigné par l'école <a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a> du shivaïsme du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; il fut développé not. par <a href="#entry-Uvasugupta" class="skt-link">Vasugupta</a>, <a href="#entry-Usomaananda" class="skt-link">Somānanda</a>, <a href="#entry-Uutpaladeva" class="skt-link">Utpaladeva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uabhinavagupta" class="skt-link">Abhinavagupta</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_semaraaja" class="skt-link">Kṣemarāja</a>; son but est que <a href="#entry-Ujiiva" class="skt-link">Jīva</a> s'identifie à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naah_rdaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyabhijñāhṛdaya</i> [<a href="#entry-h_rdaya" class="skt-link">hṛdaya</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naah_rdaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Pratyabhijñāhṛdaya «Essence de la reconnaissance du Soi», compendium de <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naazaastra" class="skt-link">pratyabhijñāśāstra</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Uk_semaraaja" class="skt-link">Kṣemarāja</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naa_2" class="skt-link">pratyabhijñā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naata">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhij_naazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyabhivaada">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyac">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyafgiraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यङ्गिरा</span> <i>pratyaṅgirā</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-afgiras" class="skt-link">aṅgiras</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyafgiraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] antidote à un sort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. forme tantr. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyagni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यग्नि</span> <i>pratyagni</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a>] adv. vers le feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यह</span> <i>pratyaha</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-aha_2" class="skt-link">aha_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratyaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratyahā</i> quotidien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaham">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यहम्</span> <i>pratyaham</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-ahan" class="skt-link">ahan</a>] adv. chaque jour, quotidiennement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यक्</span> <i>pratyak</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pratyac" class="skt-link">pratyac</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यक्ष</span> <i>pratyakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratyakṣā</i> devant les yeux; visible, perceptible; manifeste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> clair, direct, immédiat; réel — <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> évidence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. perception; constatation, expérience directe; [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] l'observation, un des 4 moyens de connaissance légitime [<a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">pramāṇa</a>] — <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> propriété générique.<br> <i>pratyakṣam</i> var. <i>pratyakṣe</i> adv. en présence de, à la vue de; publiquement.<br> <i>pratyakṣīkṛ</i> rendre visible; rendre évident, révéler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inspecter, vérifier de ses propres yeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sabrahman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyakṣabrahman</i> [<a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyak_sabrahman" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. support cosmogonique des poètes véd. visant à rendre perceptible le <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">pratyakṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyakṣakṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratyak_sak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyak_sak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyak_sak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratyakṣakṛtā</i> soc. se dit d'un hymne dans lequel la divinité est adressée directement ou à la 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ personne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyakṣakaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyak_sakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. organe ou moyen de perception.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sapramaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyakṣapramā</i> [<a href="#entry-pramaa_2" class="skt-link">pramā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyak_sapramaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] connaissance correcte issue de la perception.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyak_sataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pratyakṣatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyak_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> visibilité; évidence — i. <i>pratyakṣatāyā</i> adv. au vu de tous, publiquement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यन्त</span> <i>pratyanta</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratyanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratyantā</i> voisin, contigu, adjacent — <a href="#entry-pratyanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> frontière, bordure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> région frontalière, marche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyantajanapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyapak_r">
