[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratyapakarṣati)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pratyapakṛtya</i><i>)</i> se venger sur ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyapakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यपकार</span> <i>pratyapakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyapak_r" class="skt-link">pratyapakṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyapakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> vengeance.
  </div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyarth">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyartham">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyarthin">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyavam_rz">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyavaroha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यवरोहण</span> <i>pratyavarohaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratyavaruh" class="skt-link">pratyavaruh</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyavaroha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. rite domestique [<a href="#entry-g_rhya" class="skt-link">gṛhya</a>] pendant le mois <a href="#entry-maargaziir_sa" class="skt-link">mārgaśīrṣa</a>; le célébrant doit «descendre de son lit» et dormir par terre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyavaruh">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratyavarohati)</i> descendre de nouveau; descendre de ⟨abl.⟩ (en l'honneur de ⟨acc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> célébrer le festival de <a href="#entry-pratyavaroha_na" class="skt-link">pratyavarohaṇa</a> — ca. <i>(pratyavaropayati)</i> faire descendre; priver de ⟨abl. i.⟩.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaviik_sa_na">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyaya">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyekabuddha">

[<a href="#entry-Ujaatakamaalaa" class="skt-link">Jātakamālā</a>] <a href="#entry-buddha" class="skt-link">buddha</a> ermite qui obtient la libération pour lui-même et non pour les autres <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>paccekabuddha</i>.<br> <a href="#entry-pratyeka" class="skt-link">pratyeka</a>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyupta">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyutsuka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्युत्सुक</span> <i>pratyutsuka</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-utsuka" class="skt-link">utsuka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pratyutsuka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyutsuka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pratyutsukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pratyutsukā</i> désirant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyutthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्युत्था</span> <i>pratyutthā</i> [<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-<a href="#entry-utthaa" class="skt-link">utthā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pratyuttiṣṭhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pratyutthita</i><i>)</i> se lever pour accueillir ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyutthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्युत्थान</span> <i>pratyutthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pratyutthaa" class="skt-link">pratyutthā</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyutthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. acte de se lever pour accueillir une personne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pratyuu_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रत्यूष</span> <i>pratyūṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyu_sa" class="skt-link">pratyuṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pratyuu_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'aube <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pratyūṣa le Soleil, l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prau_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रौढ</span> <i>prauḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prau_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prau_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prau_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prauḍhā</i> complètement développé; mûr, adulte; grand, fort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avancé, confirmé; expert, érudit; opp. <a href="#entry-baala" class="skt-link">bāla</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hardi, effronté, impertinent — ifc. rempli de, plein de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prau_dhamanoramaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prauḍhamanoramā</i> [<a href="#entry-manoramaa" class="skt-link">manoramā</a>] <a href="#entry-prau_dhamanoramaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Prauḍhamanoramā «Joie des connaisseurs», commentaire lucide de <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_toji" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭoji</a> <a href="#entry-Udiik_sita" class="skt-link">Dīkṣita</a> sur sa propre grammaire <a href="#entry-Usiddhaantakaumudii" class="skt-link">Siddhāntakaumudī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-prau_dha" class="skt-link">prauḍha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prau_dhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prauḍhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-prau_dhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> effronterie, culot, impertinence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> maturité; expertise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prau_dhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रौढि</span> <i>prauḍhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] <a href="#entry-prau_dhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> croissance complète, maturité; perfection, haut degré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> majesté, dignité; assurance, confiance en soi; témérité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prauha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रौह</span> <i>prauha</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-uuha" class="skt-link">ūha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prauha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prauha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prauhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prauhā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-proha" class="skt-link">proha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृष्</span> <i>pravṛṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravarṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> se mettre à pleuvoir, pleuvoir; couvrir de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_r_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृ</span> <i>pravṛ_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(pravṛṇoti)</i> écarter, empêcher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_r_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृ</span> <i>pravṛ_2</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_r_2" class="skt-link">vṛ_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(pravṛṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pravṛṇīte)</i> choisir, prendre pour ⟨dat.⟩; accepter avec joie — ca. <i>(pravarayati)</i> choisir, sélectionner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृद्ध</span> <i>pravṛddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prav_rdh" class="skt-link">pravṛdh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prav_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prav_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prav_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravṛddhā</i> grandi, développé; augmenté, accru <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> grand, fort, intense; nombreux; gonflé (vague, océan) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prospère, puissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Pravṛddha «Prospère», fils de <a href="#entry-Uraghu" class="skt-link">Raghu</a>, épith. du roi cannibale [<a href="#entry-puru_saadaka" class="skt-link">puruṣādaka</a>] <a href="#entry-Ukalmaa_sapaada" class="skt-link">Kalmāṣapāda</a>; il est père de <a href="#entry-Uzafkha_na" class="skt-link">Śaṅkhaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rdh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृध्</span> <i>pravṛdh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pravardhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravṛddha</i><i>)</i> augmenter, s'accroître, prospérer — ca. <i>(pravardhayati)</i> agrandir, augmenter, allonger, faire prospérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृज्</span> <i>pravṛj</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rj" class="skt-link">vṛj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(pravṛṇakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(pravṛṅkte)</i> véd. placer dans le feu sacrificiel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. effectuer le rite <a href="#entry-pravargya" class="skt-link">pravargya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृत्</span> <i>pravṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pravartate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravṛtta</i><i>)</i> rouler; se mettre en mouvement, avancer; se rendre à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> provenir, être originaire de; se produire, s'ensuivre, avoir lieu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commencer, entreprendre, se mettre à, procéder à ⟨inf. acc.⟩; agir; s'occuper de ⟨dat. loc.⟩; procurer qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'écouler, continuer — ca. <i>(pravartayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pravart" class="skt-link">pravart</a>.<br> <i>śivāj</i> <i>jñānam</i> <i>pravartate</i> la connaissance procède de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृत्त</span> <i>pravṛtta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prav_rt" class="skt-link">pravṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prav_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prav_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prav_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravṛttā</i> [«roulant»] coulant, facile (not. de la parole) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> produit, causé, arrivé; issu de ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commencé, qui s'est mis à; occupé de, adonné à.<br> <i>pravṛttaṃ</i> <i>cakram</i> [«la roue a été mise en branle»] le sort en est jeté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवृत्ति</span> <i>pravṛtti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prav_rt" class="skt-link">pravṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-prav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> mouvement en avant, impulsion; progression <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> progrès, évolution; manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> origine, source <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> activité, effort, action; voie active (opp. <a href="#entry-niv_rtti" class="skt-link">nivṛtti</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pravṛtti «Cogitation», personnifiant l'activité mentale, épouse-<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Umanas" class="skt-link">Manas</a> le Mental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tendance; inclination pour ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conduite, pratique; sort, destinée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. application d'une règle; validité d'une règle, fait qu'une forme soit produite.<br> <i>madhupravṛttiḥ</i> venue du printemps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rttibheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pravṛttibheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-prav_rttibheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. ambiguité entre deux règles.<br> <a href="#entry-prav_rtti" class="skt-link">pravṛtti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prav_rttinimitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pravṛttinimitta</i> [<a href="#entry-nimitta" class="skt-link">nimitta</a>] <a href="#entry-prav_rttinimitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. règle d'usage d'un mot; cause de production d'une forme; argument à l'appui du choix du sens d'un mot ambigu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] cause d'application d'un terme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवा</span> <i>pravā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vaa_2" class="skt-link">vā_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pravāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravāta</i><i>)</i> souffler, venter; exhaler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवाह्</span> <i>pravāh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pravāhayati)</i> mettre en mouvement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवाह</span> <i>pravāha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] <a href="#entry-pravaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> courant, eau courante; rivière; écoulement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continuité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> train de pensées; activité continue; plan d'action.<br> <i>pravāhe</i> <i>mūtrita</i> n. [«comme de pisser dans la rivière»] action inutile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaaha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवाहण</span> <i>pravāhaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaaha_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaaha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaaha_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravāhaṇī</i> qui transporte; qui emmène — <a href="#entry-pravaaha_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [BU.] np. du prince [<a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a>] Pravāhaṇa Jaivali; il enseigna la doctrine de la réincarnation au sage <a href="#entry-Uaaru_ni" class="skt-link">Āruṇi</a> — <a href="#entry-pravaaha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'emmener; évacuation — <a href="#entry-pravaaha_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravāhaṇī</i> méd. muscle du sphincter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaahaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवाहक</span> <i>pravāhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaahaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaahaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaahikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravāhikā</i> qui transporte — <a href="#entry-pravaahikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravāhikā</i> diarrhée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवाल</span> <i>pravāla</i> var. <i>prabāla</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-val" class="skt-link">val</a>] <a href="#entry-pravaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> bourgeon, jeune pousse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> corail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवास</span> <i>pravāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravas" class="skt-link">pravas</a>] <a href="#entry-pravaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> séjour à l'étranger; résidence étrangère, exil; absence de son domicile; émigration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवासिन्</span> <i>pravāsin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravas" class="skt-link">pravas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravāsinī</i> voyageur; résident à l'étranger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवात</span> <i>pravāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pravaa" class="skt-link">pravā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravātā</i> éventé; battu par les vents — <a href="#entry-pravaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> courant d'air; tempête.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवच्</span> <i>pravac</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(pravakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prokta</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pra_ucya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> dire; annoncer, proclamer; expliquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवचन</span> <i>pravacana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] <a href="#entry-pravacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> élocution; proclamation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récitation, interprétation; enseignement, doctrine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravacaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवचनीय</span> <i>pravacanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravacaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravacaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravacaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravacanīyā</i> servant à énoncer, expliquant; à annoncer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. préposition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवद्</span> <i>pravad</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravadati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prodita</i><i>)</i> prononcer, déclarer; dire qqc. à qqn. ⟨2 acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवह्</span> <i>pravah</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravahati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prauḍha</i><i>)</i> emporter, entraîner; porter à ⟨acc.⟩; manifester — ca. <i>(pravāhayati)</i> mettre en mouvement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवह</span> <i>pravaha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravahā</i> ifc. qui porte; qui emporte; qui transporte — <a href="#entry-pravaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pravaha, l'un des 7 Vents célestes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवहण</span> <i>pravahaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravah" class="skt-link">pravah</a>] <a href="#entry-pravaha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'envoyer au loin (not. de donner sa fille en mariage) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chariot (pour transporter des femmes).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवक</span> <i>pravaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pru" class="skt-link">pru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravakā</i> qui va de façon répétée; qui va bien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravakt_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवक्तृ</span> <i>pravaktṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravakt_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravakt_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaktrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravaktrī</i> énonciateur, orateur; narrateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. promoteur d'une école de pensée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. celui qui révèle ou proclame la parole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवप्</span> <i>pravap</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vap_2" class="skt-link">vap_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravapati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>propta</i><i>)</i> semer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवरण</span> <i>pravaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prav_r_2" class="skt-link">pravṛ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pravara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> appel, convocation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cérémonie religieuse; observance [<a href="#entry-vinaya" class="skt-link">vinaya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravara_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर</span> <i>pravara_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vara_2" class="skt-link">vara_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravara_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravara_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravarā</i> le meilleur, le premier, excellent; éminent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (le fils) aîné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> meilleur que ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> supérieur (opp. <a href="#entry-nyuuna" class="skt-link">nyūna</a> inférieur et <a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a> égal) — <a href="#entry-pravara_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. véd. liste d'ancêtres de sa lignée [<a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a>]; on en compte traditionnellement 49, listant un, deux, trois ou cinq sages [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-aar_seya" class="skt-link">ārṣeya</a> — <a href="#entry-pravara_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. un très grand nombre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville de Pravara ou Pravarasenapura au <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> (mod. <a href="#entry-Uzriinagara" class="skt-link">Śrīnagara</a>) — <a href="#entry-pravaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravarā</i> géo. np. de la rivière Pravarā, affluent de la <a href="#entry-Ugodaavarii" class="skt-link">Godāvarī</a>.<br> <i>āṅgīrasāmbarīṣayauvanāśvatryārṣeyapravarānvitaḥ</i> <i>āṅgīrasagotrotpanna</i> <i>āśvalāyanasūtra</i> <i>ṛk-śākhādhyāyī</i> <i>arjunaśarmā'haṃ</i> <i>bho</i> <i>abhivādaye</i> Doté de la lignée des 3 sages <a href="#entry-Uaafgiirasa" class="skt-link">Āṅgīrasa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uambarii_sa" class="skt-link">Ambarīṣa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uyauvanaazva" class="skt-link">Yauvanāśva</a>, issu du clan des chantres radieux, suivant les rites de la lignée d'<a href="#entry-Uazvala" class="skt-link">Aśvala</a>, et étudiant la branche des hymnes du Véda, moi, <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> le brâhmane, vous salue respectueusement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravara_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर</span> <i>pravara_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prav_r_1" class="skt-link">pravṛ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pravara_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> couverture, vêtement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravara_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर</span> <i>pravara_3</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prav_r_2" class="skt-link">pravṛ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pravara_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> appel, convocation; invocation (not. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> au début d'un sacrifice) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. investiture (not. accession d'un brâhmane à la fonction sacerdotale).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravarapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pravarapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-pravarapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Pravarapura, prospère au 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle sous la dynastie des <a href="#entry-Uvaakaa_takaas" class="skt-link">Vākāṭakās</a>; ses ruines se trouvent près du village mod. de Mansar au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravarasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pravarasena</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-pravarasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. Pravarasena «à l'éminente armée», np. de princes du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; <a href="#entry-Upravarasena" class="skt-link">Pravarasena</a> II créa la ville de <a href="#entry-Upravarasenapura" class="skt-link">Pravarasenapura</a> (mod. <a href="#entry-Uzriinagara" class="skt-link">Śrīnagara</a>) vers le 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Pravarasena_1 de la dynastie des <a href="#entry-Uvaakaa_takaas" class="skt-link">Vākāṭakās</a> (270–330); ce conquérant régnait sur tout le Deccan et une grande partie de l'Inde du Nord; il avait le titre d'Empereur [<a href="#entry-samraaj" class="skt-link">samrāj</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Pravarasena_2, roi des <a href="#entry-Uvaakaa_takaas" class="skt-link">Vākāṭakās</a> (400–415); on lui attribue le <a href="#entry-Usetubandha" class="skt-link">Setubandha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravarezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pravareśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-pravarezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du temple de Pravareśvara à <a href="#entry-Upravarapura" class="skt-link">Pravarapura</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pravara_1" class="skt-link">pravara_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravargya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर्ग्य</span> <i>pravargya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prav_rj" class="skt-link">pravṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-pravargya" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. rite introductif au sacrifice du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> [<a href="#entry-somayaaga" class="skt-link">somayāga</a>]; on y verse du lait frais dans un pot chauffé [<a href="#entry-mahaaviira" class="skt-link">mahāvīra</a>] représentant le Soleil, ou dans du beurre fondu [<a href="#entry-gh_rta" class="skt-link">ghṛta</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravart">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर्त्</span> <i>pravart</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-prav_rt" class="skt-link">pravṛt</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(pravartayati)</i> inciter; faire rouler, mettre en mouvement; entreprendre, commencer; mettre en route, divulguer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> installer, déployer; produire, former; construire, accomplir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravartaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर्तक</span> <i>pravartaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prav_rt" class="skt-link">pravṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravartaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravartaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravartikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravartikā</i> qui met en mouvement, qui impulse, qui fait avancer; initiateur — <a href="#entry-pravartaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> auteur, fondateur; réalisateur, producteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवर्तन</span> <i>pravartana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravart" class="skt-link">pravart</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravartanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravartanī</i> qui avance; qui coule — <a href="#entry-pravartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> mouvement en avant; fait de couler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> activité, occupation; conduite; fait d'avoir lieu, occurrence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incitation à une activité; production, création — <a href="#entry-pravartanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravartanā</i> incitation à l'activité; permission <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. signification du précatif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>pavattana</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवस्</span> <i>pravas</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vas_1" class="skt-link">vas_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>proṣita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> partir (en voyage, à l'étranger ou en exil), quitter la maison, s'absenter; disparaître; être absent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravayas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवयस्</span> <i>pravayas</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vayas_1" class="skt-link">vayas_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravayas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravayas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravayas" class="skt-link">f.</a> avancé en âge; âgé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravayyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवय्या</span> <i>pravayyā</i> [<a href="#entry-pravii" class="skt-link">pravī</a>] <a href="#entry-pravayyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> (vache) propre à être fécondée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prave_s_tavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवेष्टव्य</span> <i>praveṣṭavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prave_s_tavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prave_s_tavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prave_s_tavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praveṣṭavyā</i> qui peut être entré, accessible, ouvert <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit ou peut entrer, qui peut être admis — <a href="#entry-prave_s_tavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> (impers.) il faut rentrer (dans ⟨loc.⟩).<br> <i>na</i> <i>praveṣṭavya</i> a. m. n. interdit d'accès — n. (impers.) il est défendu d'entrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravet_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवेतृ</span> <i>pravetṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pravii" class="skt-link">pravī</a>] <a href="#entry-pravet_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> conducteur de chariot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praveza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवेश</span> <i>praveśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] <a href="#entry-praveza" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait d'entrer; arrivée, pénétration; début; entrée en scène <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lieu d'entrée, accès; admission <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intrusion dans ⟨loc. g. iic.⟩; intervention inopportune — ifc. lit. introduction à.<br> <i>praveśaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> entrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravezaanumati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>praveśānumati</i> [<a href="#entry-anumati" class="skt-link">anumati</a>] <a href="#entry-pravezaanumati" class="skt-link">f.</a> mod. visa.<br> <a href="#entry-praveza" class="skt-link">praveśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravezaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवेशक</span> <i>praveśaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] <a href="#entry-pravezaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. scène intercalaire au théâtre, où des personnages secondaires commentent l'action — ifc. introduction à — <a href="#entry-pravezikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praveśikā</i> id. (nom d'ouvrages).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravezya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवेश्य</span> <i>praveśya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravezya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravezya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravezyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praveśyā</i> où l'on peut entrer; accessible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> où l'on doit entrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रविष्ट</span> <i>praviṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praviṣṭā</i> entré, qui a pénétré dans ⟨loc. acc. iic.⟩; occupé à ⟨loc. iic.⟩; s'accordant avec ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dans lequel on est entré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravical">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रविचल्</span> <i>pravical</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vical" class="skt-link">vical</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravicalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravicalita</i><i>)</i> s'agiter, trembler, bouger; s'écarter de — ca. <i>(pravicālayati)</i> bouger, agiter, secouer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravicaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravici">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रविचि</span> <i>pravici</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vici" class="skt-link">vici</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(pravicinoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravicita</i><i>)</i> rechercher; investiguer, examiner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravih_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रविहृ</span> <i>pravihṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vih_r" class="skt-link">vihṛ</a>] pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> [inusité sans pf.].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravihaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रविहा</span> <i>pravihā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vihaa_1" class="skt-link">vihā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(pravijahāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravihīna</i><i>)</i> abandonner, délaisser, négliger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवी</span> <i>pravī</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vii_1" class="skt-link">vī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(praveti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravīta</i><i>)</i> avancer; entre, avancer; imprégner, féconder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conduire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravii_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रवीण</span> <i>pravīṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pravii_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pravii_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pravii_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravīṇā</i> adroit, habile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> versé en ⟨loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praviira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(pravimuñcati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravimukta</i><i>)</i> lâcher, délivrer, libérer; abandonner.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praviz">

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(praviśati)</i> pr. md. <i>(praviśate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praviṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>praveśya</i>, <i>praveṣṭavya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>praviśya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> entrer; pénétrer, rentrer dans ⟨acc.⟩; arriver dans ⟨acc. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> paraître (indication scénique) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avoir des rapports sexuels avec ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commencer, entreprendre; s'appliquer à — ca. <i>(praveśayati)</i> introduire dans ⟨2 acc.⟩.<br> <i>praviśāmi</i> me voici.<br> <i>agniṃ</i> <i>praviś</i> monter sur le bûcher funéraire.<br> <i>dine</i> <i>dine</i> <i>hi</i> <i>bhūtāni</i> <i>praviśanti</i> <i>yamālayam</i> [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] Tous les jours vraiment des vivants entrent au royaume des morts.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravraj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रव्रज्</span> <i>pravraj</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(pravrajati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pravrajita</i><i>)</i> avancer, se mettre en marche; errer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abandonner son foyer (pour devenir un ascète errant).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravrajya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रव्रज्य</span> <i>pravrajya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pravraj" class="skt-link">pravraj</a>] <a href="#entry-pravrajya" class="skt-link">n.</a> émigration — <a href="#entry-pravrajyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pravrajyā</i> départ de chez soi; abandon de son foyer; renoncement au monde <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. premier acte d'un novice voulant devenir moine et quittant sa famille; premier niveau d'ordination <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> errance, not. de moine bd.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravyaah_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pravyaah_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रया</span> <i>prayā</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-yaa_1" class="skt-link">yā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(prayāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayāta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> aller, se mettre en marche; marcher vers, s'en aller vers ⟨acc. loc.⟩; courir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> partir, être en route pour, s'avancer; errer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assumer (une forme ou un état), tomber dans tel état <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> atteindre, parvenir à, réussir.<br> <i>diśo</i> <i>prayā</i> se répandre en tous sens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयाण</span> <i>prayāṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prayaa" class="skt-link">prayā</a>] <a href="#entry-prayaa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> départ, fait de se mettre en marche; début, commencement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> progrès, avancée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marche, voyage; attaque, invasion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (départ de l'âme) mort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयाग</span> <i>prayāga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prayaj" class="skt-link">prayaj</a>] <a href="#entry-prayaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. [«lieu du sacrifice»] np. de Prayāga, lieu de pélerinage [<a href="#entry-kumbhamela" class="skt-link">kumbhamela</a>] au confluent de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a> et de la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>, un des quatre lieux sacrés où serait tombée du <a href="#entry-kumbha" class="skt-link">kumbha</a> mythique une goutte de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> provenant du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>] (mod. Allāhābād); cf. <a href="#entry-trive_nii" class="skt-link">triveṇī</a>, <a href="#entry-prati_s_thaana" class="skt-link">pratiṣṭhāna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayaaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयास</span> <i>prayāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prayas_1" class="skt-link">prayas_1</a>] <a href="#entry-prayaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> effort, travail, acharnement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयातृ</span> <i>prayātṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prayaa" class="skt-link">prayā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prayaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prayaat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prayaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prayātrī</i> qui va, qui peut aller, qui va aller.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयम्</span> <i>prayam</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-yam" class="skt-link">yam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(prayacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayata</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> tendre, étendre; donner, offrir, accorder, envoyer, produire.<br> <i>vikrayeṇa</i> <i>prayam</i> vendre.<br> <i>uttaraṃ</i> <i>prayam</i> répondre.<br> <i>śāpaṃ</i> <i>prayam</i> jeter une malédiction.<br> <i>yuddhaṃ</i> <i>prayam</i> donner bataille.<br> <i>viśaṃ</i> <i>prayam</i> administrer un poison.<br> <i>buddhau</i> <i>prayam</i> présenter à l'esprit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयस्</span> <i>prayas_1</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-yas" class="skt-link">yas</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prayasyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayasta</i><i>)</i> s'efforcer à ⟨dat.⟩; entreprendre.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयत्</span> <i>prayat</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-yat_1" class="skt-link">yat_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prayatate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayatta</i>, <i>prayatita</i><i>)</i> inf. <i>(prayatitum)</i> s'efforcer de, s'appliquer à ⟨dat.⟩; tenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयत</span> <i>prayata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prayam" class="skt-link">prayam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prayata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prayata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prayataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prayatā</i> offert, présenté, accordé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> préparé à un rite religieux; dans des dispositions pieuses, pur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prudent, modéré — <a href="#entry-prayata" class="skt-link">n.</a> pureté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayatita">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayatitavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयतितव्य</span> <i>prayatitavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-prayat" class="skt-link">prayat</a>] <a href="#entry-prayatitavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> (impers.) il faut s'efforcer de ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>prayattavya</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayatna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयत्न</span> <i>prayatna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prayat" class="skt-link">prayat</a>] <a href="#entry-prayatna" class="skt-link">n.</a> volition, intention d'agir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tentative; effort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> activité, acte volontaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] de l'effort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. articulation; elle peut être interne [<a href="#entry-aabhyantara" class="skt-link">ābhyantara</a>] ou externe [<a href="#entry-baahya" class="skt-link">bāhya</a>] — iic. à peine — abl. <i>prayatnāt</i> adv. avec effort, à grands soins; à peine, difficilement.<br> <i>prayatnatas</i> var. <i>prayatnena</i>, <i>prayatnais</i> adv. avec effort; avec zèle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयत्त</span> <i>prayatta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prayat" class="skt-link">prayat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prayatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prayatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prayattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prayattā</i> occupé à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयोग</span> <i>prayoga</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prayuj" class="skt-link">prayuj</a>] <a href="#entry-prayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> plan, projet; acte, effort; procédure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> emploi, usage, utilisation; traitement (médical) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la pratique, opp. <a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a> la théorie; syn. <a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. manuel de rituel; syn. <a href="#entry-paddhati" class="skt-link">paddhati</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> représentation, exécution; not. représentation théâtrale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt, placement, usure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayogavidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prayogavidhi</i> [<a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-prayogavidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] injonction rituelle procédurale.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayoj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयोज्</span> <i>prayoj</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-prayuj" class="skt-link">prayuj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(prayojayati)</i> jeter, lancer; diriger vers, envoyer à ⟨loc.⟩.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayojaka">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayojana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयोजन</span> <i>prayojana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prayoj" class="skt-link">prayoj</a>] <a href="#entry-prayojana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cause, motif; but, objet, intention; utilité; utilité de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moyen d'obtenir; besoin de ⟨i.⟩; utilisation de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. motivation pour la discussion d'un sujet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. rôle sémantique [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] de but, marqué par le datif — <a href="#entry-prajoyanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prajoyanā</i> ifc. moyen de, motif de, but de ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>prayojanena</i> adv. avec une intention déterminée; exprès.<br> <i>kena</i> <i>prayojanena</i> pour quel motif? à cause de quoi? quelle en est l'utilité?<br> <i>kasmin</i> <i>prayojane</i> id.<br> <i>kasmāt</i> <i>prayojanāt</i> id.<br> <i>kasmai</i> <i>prayojāya</i> id.<br> <i>kim</i> <i>prayojanam</i> à quoi bon ⟨i.⟩.<br> <i>taruṇā</i> <i>kim</i> <i>prayojanam</i> à quoi sert cet arbre?<br> <i>bhavatvetaiḥ</i> <i>kusumaiḥ</i> <i>prayojanam</i> que ces fleurs soient utilisées.<br> <i>prayojanam</i> <i>atikram</i> négliger une opportunité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayojanakathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prayojanakathana</i> [<a href="#entry-kathana" class="skt-link">kathana</a>] <a href="#entry-prayojanakathana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phrase liminaire d'un ouvrage annonçant son intention.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayojanavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prayojanavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prayojanavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prayojanavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prayojanavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prayojanavatī</i> qui poursuit un but, intéressé.<br> <a href="#entry-prayojana" class="skt-link">prayojana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayojya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयोज्य</span> <i>prayojya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-prayoj" class="skt-link">prayoj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prayojya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prayojya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prayojyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prayojyā</i> à lancer (flèche, missile) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être utilisé ou pratiqué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à nommer (à un poste), qui doit être appointé ou commissionné; subalterne, collaborateur, serviteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être représenté (rôle au théâtre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. agent subalterne (d'un causatif) — <a href="#entry-prayojya" class="skt-link">n.</a> capital (prêté avec intérêts).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayokt_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(prayudhyate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(prayudhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayuddha</i><i>)</i> combattre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रयुज्</span> <i>prayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-yuj_1" class="skt-link">yuj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(prayunakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(prayuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prayukta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> mettre en mouvement, jeter (dés); lancer contre ⟨dat. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> employer, faire usage de, pratiquer; accomplir, faire; montrer, exhiber <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entreprendre, commencer; tourner son esprit vers, se préparer à ⟨dat.⟩ — ca. <i>(prayojayati)</i> jeter, lancer; diriger vers, envoyer à ⟨loc.⟩ — dés. md. <i>(prayuyukṣate)</i> désirer utiliser, avoir besoin de.<br> <i>sukhārthe</i> <i>viṣayaśabdaṃ</i> <i>na</i> <i>prayuṃjate</i> ils n'emploient pas le mot <i>viṣaya</i> dans le sens de bonheur.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्</span> <i>praś</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(pṛcchati)</i> pft. <i>(papraccha)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>praṣṭavya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pṛṣṭvā</i>, <i>-pṛcchya</i>, <i>pṛccham</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>pari</i><i>)</i> demander, interroger, questionner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prier (d'accorder) ⟨2 acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(pracchayati)</i> faire interroger — ps. <i>(pṛcchyate)</i> être interrogé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>precari</i>; all. fragen; fr. prier; ang. praise.<br> <i>nāmataḥ</i> <i>praś</i> s'enquérir du nom de qqn. ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(praśāsti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praśāsita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>praśāsya</i><i>)</i> enseigner, indiquer, instruire; diriger, commander; régner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> décider de ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> punir.

[«directeur»] l'un des 16 prêtres officiant à un sacrifice; c'est le premier assistant du <a href="#entry-hot_r" class="skt-link">hotṛ</a>; syn. <a href="#entry-maitraavaru_na" class="skt-link">maitrāvaruṇa</a>.

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(praśāmyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>praśānta</i><i>)</i> s'apaiser, se calmer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'éteindre, cesser; retomber (poussière) — ca. <i>(praśamayati)</i> calmer, apaiser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire cesser, rendre inoffensif; éteindre, supprimer.
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-Uudbha_ta" class="skt-link">Udbhaṭa</a>] tournure rhétorique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] exprimant la cessation d'un sentiment [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>], d'une humeur [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] ou de leur affectation [<a href="#entry-aabhaasa" class="skt-link">ābhāsa</a>].<br> <i>praśamaṃ</i> <i>nī</i> juguler.<br> <i>praśamam</i> <i>upanī</i> calmer, apaiser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazastapaada">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्न</span> <i>praśna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-praz" class="skt-link">praś</a>] <a href="#entry-prazna" class="skt-link">m.</a> demande; question, interrogation; enquête, examen <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> problème; controverse — ifc. examen de.<br> <i>praśnam</i> <i>āgam</i> demander l'arbitrage de ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>praśnam</i> <i>i</i> id.<br> <i>praśnam</i> <i>prabrū</i> décider d'un point controversé.<br> <i>praśnas</i> <i>tava</i> <i>pitari</i> la décision appartient à ton père.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>praśnaḥ</i> là est la question.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praznika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्निक</span> <i>praśnika</i> [<a href="#entry-prazna" class="skt-link">praśna</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-praznika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-praznika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-praznikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>praśnikī</i> qui enquête, qui questionne — <a href="#entry-praznika" class="skt-link">m.</a> enquêteur; arbitre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> témoin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praznopani_sad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>praśnopaniṣad</i> [<a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>] <a href="#entry-praznopani_sad" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Praśnopaniṣad «Leçon sur la décision».<br> <a href="#entry-prazna" class="skt-link">praśna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-praznottara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>praśnottara</i> [<a href="#entry-uttara_1" class="skt-link">uttara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-praznottara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. figure de style poétique, où la question forme la réponse; opp. <a href="#entry-uttaraprazna" class="skt-link">uttarapraśna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazrava_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्रवण</span> <i>praśravaṇa</i> <a href="#entry-prazrava_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-prasrava_na" class="skt-link">prasravaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रशुति</span> <i>praśuti</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-prazasti" class="skt-link">praśasti</a>] <a href="#entry-prazuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> éloge, glorification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excellence, éminence.<br> <i>praśutiṃ</i> <i>dhā</i> faire l'éloge de, glorifier ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazuzruka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रशुश्रुक</span> <i>praśuśruka</i> [<a href="#entry-prasuzruta" class="skt-link">prasuśruta</a>] <a href="#entry-prazuzruka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Praśuśruka, fils de Maru_1, père d'<a href="#entry-Uambarii_sa_1" class="skt-link">Ambarīṣa_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazvaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्वास</span> <i>praśvāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prazvas" class="skt-link">praśvas</a>] <a href="#entry-prazvaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> respiration; inspiration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prazvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रश्वस्</span> <i>praśvas</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-zvas_1" class="skt-link">śvas_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(praśvasiti)</i> respirer, inhaler.<br> <i>praśvasitavya</i> n. (imp.) il faut reprendre son souffle; pause.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रे</span> <i>pre</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-i" class="skt-link">i</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(praiti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>preta</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>pretya</i><i>)</i> se mettre en marche, s'avancer; arriver à, entrer dans ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'en aller, partir; quitter (ce monde), mourir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dépasser, ressortir, faire saillie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेष्</span> <i>preṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-i_s_2" class="skt-link">iṣ_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(preṣyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>preṣita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>preṣya</i><i>)</i> pousser; impulser; démarrer (not. un jeu) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. diriger (se dit du prêtre en chef signalant à un assistant de démarrer une lecture ou un rite) — ca. <i>(preṣayati)</i> jeter, lancer, envoyer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diriger les yeux vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेषण</span> <i>preṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pre_s" class="skt-link">preṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-pre_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> charge, service, emploi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेषित</span> <i>preṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pre_s" class="skt-link">preṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pre_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pre_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pre_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preṣitā</i> jeté, envoyé; banni.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेष्य</span> <i>preṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-pre_s" class="skt-link">preṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pre_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pre_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pre_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preṣyā</i> qui peut ou doit être envoyé — <a href="#entry-pre_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> servitude <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> obligation, service — <a href="#entry-pre_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pre_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preṣyā</i> serviteur, esclave.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pre_syavadhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>preṣyavadhū</i> [<a href="#entry-vadhuu" class="skt-link">vadhū</a>] <a href="#entry-pre_syavadhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> servante.<br> <a href="#entry-pre_sya" class="skt-link">preṣya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prefkh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेङ्ख्</span> <i>preṅkh</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-iifkh" class="skt-link">īṅkh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(preṅkhati)</i> trembler, vibrer — ca. <i>(preṅkhayati)</i> balancer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prefkha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेङ्ख</span> <i>preṅkha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prefkh" class="skt-link">preṅkh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prefkha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prefkha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prefkhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preṅkhā</i> tremblant, branlant — <a href="#entry-prefkha" class="skt-link">m.</a> balançoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>preṅkhau</i> poteaux d'une balançoire — <a href="#entry-prefkhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preṅkhā</i> balançoire; hamac.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेक्ष्</span> <i>prekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-iik_s" class="skt-link">īkṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(prekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prekṣita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>prekṣya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> voir, regarder, observer, considérer; tolérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेक्षण</span> <i>prekṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-prek_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> regard; spectacle; observation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_sa_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prekṣaṇīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prek_sa_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_sa_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_sa_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prekṣaṇīyā</i> visible, apparent — ifc. qui semble, qui ressemble à ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de bonne apparence; digne d'être vu; spectaculaire — <a href="#entry-prek_sa_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> spectacle.<br> <a href="#entry-prek_sa_na" class="skt-link">prekṣaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेक्षा</span> <i>prekṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-prek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> spectacle; observation, contemplation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_saag_rha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prekṣāgṛha</i> [<a href="#entry-g_rha" class="skt-link">gṛha</a>] <a href="#entry-prek_saag_rha" class="skt-link">n.</a> salle de spectacle.<br> <a href="#entry-prek_saa" class="skt-link">prekṣā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेक्षित</span> <i>prekṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prek_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prekṣitā</i> vu, regardé, observé, considéré; toléré — <a href="#entry-prek_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> regard, œillade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prek_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेक्ष्य</span> <i>prekṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prek_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prek_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prekṣyā</i> visible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à voir; à considérer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui vaut d'être vu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prema">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेम</span> <i>prema</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-preman" class="skt-link">preman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-premabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>premabandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-premabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> attachement de l'amour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-premabandhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>premabandhana</i> [<a href="#entry-bandhana" class="skt-link">bandhana</a>] <a href="#entry-premabandhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-prema" class="skt-link">prema</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेमन्</span> <i>preman</i> [<a href="#entry-prii" class="skt-link">prī</a><a href="#entry--man" class="skt-link">-man</a>] <a href="#entry-preman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-preman" class="skt-link">n.</a> affection, amour, faveur — <a href="#entry-prema" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>prema</i> ifc. amour pour, attachement à — <a href="#entry-premaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>premā</i> ifc. qui éprouve de l'amour pour.<br> <i>premṇā</i> i. adv. par amour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preps">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेप्स्</span> <i>preps</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-praap" class="skt-link">prāp</a>] v. pr. <i>(prepsati)</i> pr. md. <i>(prepsate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prepsita</i><i>)</i> désirer obtenir, convoiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prepsu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेप्सु</span> <i>prepsu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-preps" class="skt-link">preps</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prepsu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prepsu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prepsu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui désire obtenir, qui convoite, qui recherche ⟨acc. inf.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prer">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेर्</span> <i>prer</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-iir" class="skt-link">īr</a>] ca. <i>(prerayati)</i> mettre en route, conduire (not. un bateau).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prera_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेरण</span> <i>preraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prer" class="skt-link">prer</a>] <a href="#entry-prera_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mise en route; exhortation; injonction, commande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेत</span> <i>preta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pre" class="skt-link">pre</a>] a. <a href="#entry-preta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-preta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pretaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pretā</i> parti, décédé, mort — <a href="#entry-preta" class="skt-link">m.</a> mort, trépassé; esprit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. esprit d'un mort avant son incinération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> revenant, mauvais esprit, fantôme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>peta</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pretakalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pretakalpa</i> [<a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>] <a href="#entry-pretakalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. rituel des morts; il est détaillé dans le <a href="#entry-Ugaru_dapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Garuḍapurāṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-sapi_n_dana" class="skt-link">sapiṇḍana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-preta" class="skt-link">preta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेति</span> <i>preti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pre" class="skt-link">pre</a>] <a href="#entry-preti" class="skt-link">f.</a> départ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> approche; arrivée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pretya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेत्य</span> <i>pretya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-pre" class="skt-link">pre</a>] ind. étant mort; dans l'au-delà (opp. <a href="#entry-iha" class="skt-link">iha</a> en ce monde).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pretyabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pretyabhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-pretyabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. l'existence après la mort.<br> <a href="#entry-pretya" class="skt-link">pretya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रेयस्</span> <i>preyas</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-preyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-preyas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-preyasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preyasī</i> plus cher, plus agréable, préféré; très cher, bien-aimé — <a href="#entry-preyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> amant, amoureux; cher ami <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [KU.] la voie des plaisirs, qui mène à la perdition (opp. <a href="#entry-zreyas" class="skt-link">śreyas</a> la voie préférable, qui mène au salut) — <a href="#entry-preyas" class="skt-link">n.</a> flatterie — <a href="#entry-preyasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preyasī</i> maîtresse, bien-aimée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-preyasvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>preyasvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-preyasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-preyasvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-preyasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>preyasvatī</i> qui possède de l'affection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Uudbha_ta" class="skt-link">Udbhaṭa</a>] figure rhétorique de la simple suggestion d'une émotion sans développement complet du mode esthétique [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] correspondant; opp. <a href="#entry-rasavat" class="skt-link">rasavat</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-preyas" class="skt-link">preyas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्री</span> <i>prī</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(prīṇāti)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <i>(aprīyāt)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(apraiṣīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prīta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> réjouir, contenter, satisfaire; plaire, donner du plaisir — pr. md. <i>(prīṇīte)</i> se réjouir — ca. <i>(prīṇayati)</i> faire se réjouir, plaire à, réjouir — dés. <i>(piprīṣati)</i> désirer plaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. friend; all. Freund.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रीत</span> <i>prīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-prii" class="skt-link">prī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prītā</i> réjoui, satisfait, joyeux; comblé, content <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> heureux de ⟨i. loc. g. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-priita" class="skt-link">n.</a> joie, plaisir.<br> <i>prītaḥ</i> <i>bhava</i> sois satisfait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priitaatma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prītātma</i> [<a href="#entry-aatma" class="skt-link">ātma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priitaatma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priitaatma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priitaatmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prītātmā</i> réjoui dans son cœur.<br> <a href="#entry-priita" class="skt-link">prīta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रीति</span> <i>prīti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prii" class="skt-link">prī</a>] <a href="#entry-priiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> plaisir, satisfaction, joie; affection, amitié; amabilité, faveur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> joie de ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Prīti la Joie personnifiée, fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>.<br> <i>prītyā</i> i. adv. avec joie, amicalement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priitikara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prītikara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priitikara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priitikara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priitikarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prītikarī</i> qui se plaît à rendre service.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priitimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prītimat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priitimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priitimat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priitimatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prītimatī</i> satisfait, content, réjoui; favorable, aimable; qui a de l'affection pour ⟨loc. g. acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priitimaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>prītimaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priitimaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priitimaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priitimayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prītimayī</i> provoqué par la joie (larmes).<br> <a href="#entry-priiti" class="skt-link">prīti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रिय</span> <i>priya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-prii" class="skt-link">prī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyā</i> cher, aimé; amical, agréable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cher à ⟨g. loc. dat. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cher, coûteux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui aime, qui apprécie; épris de, attaché à ⟨loc. inf.⟩ — <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">m.</a> bien-aimé, mari, amant — <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">n.</a> ce qui est cher, agréable; désir, plaisir, amour; service, faveur — <a href="#entry-priyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyā</i> bien-aimée, épouse — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(priyāyate)</i> aimer, chérir.<br> <i>priyeṇa</i> adv. volontiers, avec plaisir.<br> <i>priyapriyeṇa</i> adv. de bon cœur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priya_mvada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyaṃvada</i> [<a href="#entry-vada" class="skt-link">vada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priya_mvada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priya_mvada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priya_mvadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyaṃvadā</i> qui parle aimablement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraghuva_mza" class="skt-link">Raghuvaṃśa</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> Priyaṃvada «Beau parleur», fils du roi <a href="#entry-Ucitraratha" class="skt-link">Citraratha</a>; par orgueil il s'était baigné dans la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a> en amont du sage <a href="#entry-Umatafga" class="skt-link">Mataṅga</a>; celui ci le maudit de rôder comme éléphant sauvage jusqu'à être atteint par une flèche d'<a href="#entry-Uaja" class="skt-link">Aja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyaalaapin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyālāpin</i> [<a href="#entry-aalaapin" class="skt-link">ālāpin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyaalaapin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyaalaapin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyaalaapinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyālāpinī</i> qui dit des choses aimables.<br> <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyabhaa_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyabhāṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sa_na" class="skt-link">bhāṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-priyabhaa_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> parole aimable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyabhaa_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyabhāṣin</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sin" class="skt-link">bhāṣin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyabhaa_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyabhaa_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyabhaa_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyabhāṣiṇī</i> qui parle aimablement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyadarza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyadarśa</i> [<a href="#entry-darza" class="skt-link">darśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyadarza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarzaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyadarśā</i> agréable à la vue (de ⟨g.⟩); joli, gracieux — <a href="#entry-priyadarza" class="skt-link">n.</a> regard amical.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyadarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyadarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyadarzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarzanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyadarśanī</i> plaisant à la vue (de ⟨g.⟩); chéri <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. du <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> <a href="#entry-Ucitraratha" class="skt-link">Citraratha</a>.<br> <i>ekapriyadarśana</i> cher à tous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyadarzikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyadarśikā</i> [<a href="#entry-darzikaa" class="skt-link">darśikā</a>] <a href="#entry-priyadarzikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la princesse Priyadarśikā, et de la comédie de cour éponyme de <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyadarzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
