    <i>priyadarśin</i> [<a href="#entry-darzin" class="skt-link">darśin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyadarzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyadarzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyadarśinī</i> au regard amical — <a href="#entry-priyadarzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Priyadarśin (<a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a> Piyadassi), épith. du roi <a href="#entry-Uazoka" class="skt-link">Aśoka</a> «au Regard amical».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyafgu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रियङ्गु</span> <i>priyaṅgu</i> [<a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] <a href="#entry-priyafgu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyafgu" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Panicum italicum</i>, panic, millet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Sinapis ramosa</i>, moutarde noire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Callicarpa macrophylla</i>, arbuste de l'est de l'Inde, aux fleurs roses rassemblées en globules; c'est une plante médicinale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> liane, plante grimpante (réputée fleurir au toucher d'une femme).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyafkara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyaṃkara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priya_mkara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priya_mkara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priya_mkarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyaṃkarī</i> qui agit avec bonté envers ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plaisant, agréable; aimable.<br> <a href="#entry-priyam" class="skt-link">priyam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyakaamya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyakāmya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaamya" class="skt-link">kāmya</a>] <a href="#entry-priyakaamya" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Terminalia elliptica</i>, grand arbre combrétacée (30 m) au bois rouge; il stocke de l'eau dans son tronc — <a href="#entry-priyakaamya" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir de montrer de la gentillesse envers ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyakaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyakaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyakārī</i> qui fait une gentillesse ou une faveur envers ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyakaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyakāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara_na" class="skt-link">kāraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-priyakaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> raison d'une faveur.<br> <i>priyakāraṇāt</i> afin de faire une faveur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyakarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyakarman</i> [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyakarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyakarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyakarmanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyakarmanī</i> gentil, aimable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रियम्</span> <i>priyam</i> [acc. <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyamedha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyamedha</i> [<a href="#entry-medha" class="skt-link">medha</a>] <a href="#entry-priyamedha" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Priyamedha.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyapraaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyaprāya</i> [<a href="#entry-praayas" class="skt-link">prāyas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyapraaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyapraaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyapraayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyaprāyā</i> toujours aimable, très poli, raffiné (not. langage) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui s'exprime plaisamment; éloquent — <a href="#entry-priyapraaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> éloquence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyatama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रियतम</span> <i>priyatama</i> [super. <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyatama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyatamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyatamā</i> préféré, chéri entre tous — <a href="#entry-priyatama" class="skt-link">m.</a> bien-aimé, mari, amant — <a href="#entry-priyatamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyatamā</i> maitresse; épouse préférée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रियतर</span> <i>priyatara</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyatara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyataraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyatarā</i> préféré, mieux aimé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyavaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyavāc</i> [<a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyavaac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavaac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavaac" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui parle aimablement, poli, sociable — <a href="#entry-priyavaac" class="skt-link">f.</a> discours aimable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyavaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyavādin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">vādin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyavaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyavādinī</i> qui parle agréablement, flatteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-priyavrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>priyavrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-priyavrata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-priyavrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>priyavratā</i> bénin, indulgent; juste [«dont on apprécie les ordres»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui aime être obéi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du roi primordial Priyavrata «aux justes édits», fils de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaayambhuva" class="skt-link">Svāyaṃbhuva</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzataruupaa" class="skt-link">Śatarūpā</a>; ce géant [<a href="#entry-Uuttaanapaada" class="skt-link">Uttānapāda</a>] répartit les continents et les océans à la surface de la Terre en y faisant rouler son char; il est père de <a href="#entry-Udhruva" class="skt-link">Dhruva</a> par <a href="#entry-Usuniiti" class="skt-link">Sunīti</a>, d'<a href="#entry-Uuttama" class="skt-link">Uttama</a> par <a href="#entry-Usuruci" class="skt-link">Suruci</a>, et d'<a href="#entry-Uaagniidhra" class="skt-link">Āgnīdhra</a>; astr. il personnifie l'étoile β de la petite ourse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pro_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोष्ठ</span> <i>proṣṭha</i> <a href="#entry-pro_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> banc, tabouret, lit de repos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pro_s_thapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>proṣṭhapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-pro_s_thapada" class="skt-link">m.</a> pied de tabouret, de banc ou de lit — <a href="#entry-pro_s_thapadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>proṣṭhapadā</i> pl. astr. np. de Proṣṭhapadās «les Pieds de lit», astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>] du Carré de Pégase, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-bhaadrapadaa" class="skt-link">bhādrapadā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Upuurvapro_s_thapadaas" class="skt-link">Pūrvaproṣṭhapadās</a>, <a href="#entry-Uuttarapro_s_thapadaas" class="skt-link">Uttaraproṣṭhapadās</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pro_s_tha" class="skt-link">proṣṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-proccaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोच्चारित</span> <i>proccārita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-proccar" class="skt-link">proccar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-proccaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-proccaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-proccaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>proccāritā</i> fait résonné; bruyant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-proccar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोच्चर्</span> <i>proccar</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-uccar" class="skt-link">uccar</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(proccarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>proccarita</i><i>)</i> émettre un son, prononcer — ca. <i>(proccārayati)</i> faire émettre un son, faire bruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-proha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोह</span> <i>proha</i> var. <i>prauha</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-uuha" class="skt-link">ūha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-proha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-proha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prohaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prohā</i> adroit, intelligent, malin — <a href="#entry-proha" class="skt-link">m.</a> raisonnement logique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prok_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोक्ष्</span> <i>prokṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-uk_s" class="skt-link">ukṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(prokṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>prokṣita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> asperger d'eau sacrée; consacrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prok_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोक्ष</span> <i>prokṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prok_s" class="skt-link">prokṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-prok_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> aspersion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prok_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोक्षण</span> <i>prokṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-prok_s" class="skt-link">prokṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-prok_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. consécration par aspersion d'un animal destiné au sacrifice, ou d'un cadavre avant les rites funèbres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prokta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोक्त</span> <i>prokta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pravac" class="skt-link">pravac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prokta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prokta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-proktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>proktā</i> dit, déclaré; appelé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> promulgé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-prottufga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोत्तुङ्ग</span> <i>prottuṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-uttufga" class="skt-link">uttuṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-prottufga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-prottufga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-prottufgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>prottuṅgā</i> très haut, dressé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pro_nch">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोञ्छ्</span> <i>proñch</i> [<a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>-<a href="#entry-u_nch" class="skt-link">uñch</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(proñchati)</i> balayer; nettoyer, effacer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pro_nchana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रोञ्छन</span> <i>proñchana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pro_nch" class="skt-link">proñch</a>] <a href="#entry-pro_nchana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de nettoyer, d'essuyer, d'effacer.<br> <i>padaproñchana</i> paillasson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रु</span> <i>pru</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-plu" class="skt-link">plu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(pravate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pruta</i><i>)</i> véd. surgir, jaillir — ca. <i>(prāvayati)</i> atteindre, inonder.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pruu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">प्रू</span> <i>prū</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pru" class="skt-link">pru</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-pruu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pruu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pruu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui surgit de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_m">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुं</span> <i>puṃ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_ms">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुंस्</span> <i>puṃs</i> <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme, mâle, être humain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> serviteur; âme, esprit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-pul_lifga" class="skt-link">pulṁliṅga</a>] gram. genre masculin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_msa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुंस</span> <i>puṃsa</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_msavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃsavana</i> [<a href="#entry-savana_2" class="skt-link">savana_2</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_msavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cérémonie [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] faite pendant la gestation pour obtenir un fils; c'est un <a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">saṃskāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_msavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃsavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_msavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_msavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_msavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṃsavatī</i> qui a engendré un fils — adv. comme un homme.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_msa" class="skt-link">puṃsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mska">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃska</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-pu_mska" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_mska" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_mskaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṃskā</i> gram. (mot) au masculin.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mvadbhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃvadbhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_mvadbhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. action morphologique transformant un mot en son thème masculin [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sitapu_mska" class="skt-link">bhāṣitapuṃska</a>] pour servir de partie gauche à un mot composé.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_mvat" class="skt-link">puṃvat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. comme un homme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (mot) employé au masculin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुंश्</span> <i>puṃś</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mzcala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃścala</i> [<a href="#entry-cala" class="skt-link">cala</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_mzcala" class="skt-link">m.</a> débauché — <a href="#entry-pu_mzcalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṃścalī</i> [«qui court après les hommes»] prostituée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mzcaliiputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃścalīputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_mzcaliiputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> vulg. fils de pute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_mzcaliiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃścalīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_mzcaliiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_mzcala" class="skt-link">puṃścala</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pu_mz" class="skt-link">puṃś</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dariika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुण्डरीक</span> <i>puṇḍarīka</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-paa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">pāṇḍuraṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">n.</a> fleur de lotus; not. fleur de lotus blanc, symbole de la beauté — ifc. beauté de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tigre; variété d'animaux, de riz, de canne à sucre, de mangue, etc. — <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du saint Puṇḍarīka «Lotus immaculé», jeune brâhmane parti en pélerinage sur sa mule alors que ses vieux parents devaient marcher derrière lui; arrivé à <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dharpur" class="skt-link">Paṇḍharpur</a>, il passa la nuit chez un hôte qui lui fit honte de sa conduite, et il s'établit dans cette ville pour prendre soin de ses parents; un jour où <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> déguisé en jeune vacher tenta de le distraire de son devoir, il lui lança une brique et lui dit d'attendre debout dessus; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> le bénit et lui transmit son essence divine, sous le nom de <a href="#entry-Uvi_t_thala" class="skt-link">Viṭṭhala</a>; ce saint symbolise la piété filiale; il est aussi appelé Puṇḍalīka, Puṇḍaraṅga ou <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_durafga" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍuraṅga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste Puṇḍarīka_1, <a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a> du Sud-Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a>] np. du beau Puṇḍarīka_2 «aux yeux en lotus», né du regard de <a href="#entry-Uzrii" class="skt-link">Śrī</a> sur <a href="#entry-Uzvetaketu" class="skt-link">Śvetaketu</a>, amoureux de la nymphe <a href="#entry-Umahaazvetaa" class="skt-link">Mahāśvetā</a> mais voué au célibat par ses vœux d'ascète; accusant <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> d'être insensible à sa détresse, il le maudit de ne jamais pouvoir aimer à travers ses transmigrations, et mit fin à sa vie; il se réincarna en <a href="#entry-Uvaizampaayana_1" class="skt-link">Vaiśampāyana_1</a>, puis en un perroquet, alors que <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> se réincarna en <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da_1" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa_1</a> puis en <a href="#entry-Uzuudraka_1" class="skt-link">Śūdraka_1</a>; dans l'histoire-cadre, le perroquet narre l'histoire à ce dernier, qui se souvient alors de sa vraie nature; après leur mort ils revivent comme <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika_2" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka_2</a> et <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da_1" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa_1</a> et peuvent tous deux connaître enfin l'amour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Puṇḍarīka_3, auteur de la <a href="#entry-Uparamaarthasevaa" class="skt-link">Paramārthasevā</a> (10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩-11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles) — <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇḍarīkā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de l'<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a> Puṇḍarīkā «Splendeur de lotus».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dariikaak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇḍarīkākṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikaak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> «aux yeux de lotus» (symbole de beauté) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> ou de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">puṇḍarīka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dariikanayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇḍarīkanayana</i> [<a href="#entry-nayana" class="skt-link">nayana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikanayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikanayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikanayanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇḍarīkanayanā</i> aux yeux de lotus (symbole de beauté) — <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikanayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> ou de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> «aux yeux de lotus».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dariikapur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇḍarīkapur</i> [<a href="#entry-pur" class="skt-link">pur</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_n_dariikapur" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Puṇḍarīkapur «Ville du Lotus Blanc», au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a> sur la rivière <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a>; mod. Paṇḍharpur, nommée d'après le saint <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Unaamadeva" class="skt-link">Nāmadeva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvizvaruupa_2" class="skt-link">Viśvarūpa_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुण्ड्र</span> <i>puṇḍra</i> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">m.</a> canne à sucre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du roi Puṇḍra, fils de <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a> et <a href="#entry-Usude_s_naa" class="skt-link">Sudeṣṇā</a>, ancêtre mythique des <a href="#entry-pu_n_draas" class="skt-link">puṇḍrās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> peuple et pays corr. au Bengale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>puṇḍrās</i> ses habitants — <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">n.</a> marque sectaire, ligne sur le front; cf. <a href="#entry-tripu_n_dra" class="skt-link">tripuṇḍra</a>, <a href="#entry-uurdhvapu_n_dra" class="skt-link">ūrdhvapuṇḍra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dranaagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇḍranāgara</i> [<a href="#entry-naagara" class="skt-link">nāgara</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_n_dranaagara" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. très ancienne ville de Puṇḍranāgara, capitale des <a href="#entry-pu_n_draas" class="skt-link">puṇḍrās</a>, au bord de la rivière <a href="#entry-Ukaratoyaa" class="skt-link">Karatoyā</a> au Bengale, aussi appelée <a href="#entry-Upau_n_dravardhanapura" class="skt-link">Pauṇḍravardhanapura</a>; son plateau surélevé la met à l'abri des inondations; mod. Mahāsthana au Bangladesh.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_n_dravardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇḍravardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_n_dravardhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du Puṇḍravardhana, pays des <a href="#entry-pu_n_draas" class="skt-link">puṇḍrās</a> au <a href="#entry-Ugau_da" class="skt-link">Gauḍa</a> (nord du Bengale); sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dranaagara" class="skt-link">Puṇḍranāgara</a>; aussi appelé <i>puṇḍrakṣetra</i>.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_n_dra" class="skt-link">puṇḍra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुण्य</span> <i>puṇya</i> a. <a href="#entry-pu_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇyā</i> de bon augure, favorable, heureux; bon, beau, méritoire, juste, pur; saint — <a href="#entry-pu_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> bien, justice, acte de mérite, œuvre pie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le Bien; opp. <a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">pāpa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cérémonie religieuse; not. exécutée par une femme, pour garder l'amour de son mari et obtenir un fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyāha</i> [<a href="#entry-aha" class="skt-link">aha</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyaaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> jour de bon augure, jour favorable; jour de fête.<br> <i>puṇyāhaṃ</i> <i>vac</i> (ca.) souhaiter à ⟨acc.⟩ une bonne journée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyaahavaacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyāhavācana</i> souhait d'une journée favorable; bonjour.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_nyaaha" class="skt-link">puṇyāha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-pu_nya" class="skt-link">puṇya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyabhaaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyabhāj</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaaj" class="skt-link">bhāj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaaj" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaaj" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui partage la joie, bienheureux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyabhaajin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyabhājin</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaajin" class="skt-link">bhājin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaajin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaajin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyabhaajinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇyabhājinī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyadarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyadarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_nyadarzana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyadarzanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇyadarśanī</i> agréable à regarder, de belle apparence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyadhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyadhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_nyadhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyadhara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyadharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇyadharā</i> bénéfique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyajana</i> [<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyajana" class="skt-link">m.</a> honnête homme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>puṇyajanās</i> myth. classe de génies bénins; <a href="#entry-yak_saas" class="skt-link">yakṣās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyakaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyakāla</i> [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> temps propice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyanaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyanāma</i> [<a href="#entry-naama_2" class="skt-link">nāma_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_nyanaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyanaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_nyanaamnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṇyanāmnī</i> au nom heureux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Puṇyanāma, un serviteur de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyanagarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyanagarī</i> [<a href="#entry-nagarii" class="skt-link">nagarī</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyanagarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Puṇyanagarī «la Cité Pure», capitale marathe, mod. Pune dans le <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyapaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyapāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-paapa" class="skt-link">pāpa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyapaapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> du. <i>puṇyapāpau</i> phil. le Bien et le Mal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyaraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyarāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyaraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du grammairien Puṇyarāja (11-12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles), auteur d'un commentaire [<a href="#entry-_tiikaa" class="skt-link">ṭīkā</a>] du <a href="#entry-Uvaakyapadiiya" class="skt-link">Vākyapadīya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyarazmi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyaraśmi</i> [<a href="#entry-razmi" class="skt-link">raśmi</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyarazmi" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du prince Puṇyaraśmi «Splendeur du bien», accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] mythique dont le <a href="#entry-jaataka" class="skt-link">jātaka</a> est conté dans la <a href="#entry-Uraa_s_trapaalaparip_rcchaa" class="skt-link">Rāṣṭrapālaparipṛcchā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyastambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyastambha</i> [<a href="#entry-stambha" class="skt-link">stambha</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyastambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Puṇyastambha, au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>; mod. Puntambem, près d'Ahmadnagar.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_nyavarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṇyavarman</i> [<a href="#entry-varman" class="skt-link">varman</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_nyavarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [DKC.] np. de Puṇyavarmā «Protégé par le bien», roi du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्ट</span> <i>puṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pu_s_1" class="skt-link">puṣ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣṭā</i> bien nourri, fort, gros, gras; riche en ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_tavipu_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣṭavipuṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-vipu_s_ta" class="skt-link">vipuṣṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_s_tavipu_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. le bien nourri et le mal nourri.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_s_ta" class="skt-link">puṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्टि</span> <i>puṣṭi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pu_s_1" class="skt-link">puṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> croissance, développement, complétude; prospérité, richesse, opulence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> engraissement; abondance, graisse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. rite de prospérité; pouvoir [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] de restoration de la santé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Puṣṭi «Opulence», fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, une des épouses de <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a>; elle est aussi mère de <a href="#entry-Ulobha" class="skt-link">Lobha</a> par <a href="#entry-Udambha" class="skt-link">Dambha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_tikara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣṭikara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_s_tikara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_tikara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_tikarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣṭikarī</i> qui fait prospérer; qui apporte l'opulence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_timaarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣṭimārga</i> [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_s_timaarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«voie du bien-être»] doctrine de la tradition <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> fondée par <a href="#entry-Uvallabhaacaarya" class="skt-link">Vallabhācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_timat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣṭimat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_s_timat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_timat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_timatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣṭimatī</i> abondant; prospère, florissant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_tivardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣṭivardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_s_tivardhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_tivardhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_tivardhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣṭivardhanī</i> qui nourrit, qui engraisse; qui augmente la prospérité.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_s_ti" class="skt-link">puṣṭi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्</span> <i>puṣ_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(puṣyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>puṣṭa</i><i>)</i> prospérer, être nourri, jouir de ⟨i.⟩ — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(puṣyati)</i> nourrir, augmenter, accroître — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(puṣṇāti)</i> entretenir — ca. <i>(poṣayati)</i> faire prospérer, élever, nourrir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_s_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्</span> <i>puṣ_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-pu_s_1" class="skt-link">puṣ_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-pu_s_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_s_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui nourrit; qui fait prospérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्कल</span> <i>puṣkala</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-pu_skara" class="skt-link">puṣkara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_skala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_skala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_skalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣkalā</i> nombreux, copieux, abondant; beaucoup de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> copieux, riche; splendide, excellent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fort, sonore, résonnant — <a href="#entry-pu_skala" class="skt-link">m.</a> sorte de tambour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du héros Puṣkala «l'Éclatant», fils de <a href="#entry-Ubharata_1" class="skt-link">Bharata_1</a> le demi-frère de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>; <a href="#entry-Utak_saa" class="skt-link">Takṣā</a> est son frère aîné — <a href="#entry-pu_skala" class="skt-link">n.</a> mesure de volume de grain, égale à 8 <a href="#entry-ku_nci" class="skt-link">kuñci</a>, soit 64 poignées — <a href="#entry-pu_skalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣkalā</i> myth. np. de Puṣkalā «Abondance», première épouse de <a href="#entry-Uhariharaputra" class="skt-link">Hariharaputra</a>-<a href="#entry-Uzaastaa" class="skt-link">Śāstā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skalaavata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣkalāvata</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_skalaavata" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de Puṣkalāvata, résidence de <a href="#entry-Upu_skala" class="skt-link">Puṣkala</a> — <a href="#entry-pu_skalaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣkalāvatī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-Upu_skaraavatii" class="skt-link">Puṣkarāvatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_skala" class="skt-link">puṣkala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्कर</span> <i>puṣkara</i> <a href="#entry-pu_skara" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Nymphæa nelumbo</i>, lotus bleu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> peau de tambour; bout de la trompe d'un éléphant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Puṣkara_1 «Abondance», continent mythique, l'un des 7 continents [<a href="#entry-dviipa" class="skt-link">dvīpa</a>]; <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> y préside <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville de Puṣkara_2, lieu de pélerinage du Rajasthan, à 11 km d'Ajmer; son lac est sacré; sur ses bords se trouve un sanctuaire de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>; au moyen âge c'était un centre d'enseignement de la religion jaïne — <a href="#entry-pu_skara" class="skt-link">m.</a> sorte de tambour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Puṣkara «Lotus», frère envieux de <a href="#entry-Unala" class="skt-link">Nala</a> qui se fit aider du démon du jeu <a href="#entry-Ukali" class="skt-link">Kali</a> pour usurper son royaume en le possédant lors d'un jeu de dés — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(puṣkarāyate)</i> ressembler à un lotus bleu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skaraak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣkarākṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_skaraak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_skaraak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_skaraak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣkarākṣī</i> aux yeux de lotus (signe de beauté).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skaraavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣkarāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_skaraavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣkarāvatī</i> géo. np. de Puṣkarāvatī «Ville des lotus bleus», ancienne capitale du <a href="#entry-Ugandhaara" class="skt-link">Gandhāra</a>, entre Indus et Swat (près de mod. Peshawar).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skaracuu_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣkaracūḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daa" class="skt-link">cūḍā</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_skaracuu_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Puṣkaracūḍa «Couronné de lotus», l'un des 4 éléphants cosmiques [<a href="#entry-gajapati" class="skt-link">gajapati</a>] supportant le monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_skari_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣkariṇī</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_skari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> étang couvert de lotus, étang.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_skara" class="skt-link">puṣkara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्प</span> <i>puṣpa</i> [<a href="#entry-pu_s_1" class="skt-link">puṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">n.</a> fleur — <a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">m.</a> topaze — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(puṣpyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>puṣpita</i><i>)</i> fleurir — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(puṣpāyate)</i> devenir une fleur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spaahara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpāhara</i> [<a href="#entry-aahara" class="skt-link">āhara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_spaahara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spaahara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spaaharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpāharā</i> qui cueille des fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spaastara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpāstaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aastara_na" class="skt-link">āstaraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spaastara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> l'arrangement de jonchées de fleurs, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spabaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpabāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-baa_na" class="skt-link">bāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spabaa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. flèche de fleur, arme de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a>; il y en a 5: <a href="#entry-ketaka" class="skt-link">ketaka</a>, <a href="#entry-dahana" class="skt-link">dahana</a>, <a href="#entry-bilva" class="skt-link">bilva</a>, <a href="#entry-mohana" class="skt-link">mohana</a>, <a href="#entry-har_sa_na" class="skt-link">harṣaṇa</a>; elles sont associées aux troubles amoureux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spabhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpabhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spabhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> arch. pavillon à 62 colonnes — <a href="#entry-pu_spabhadraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpabhadrā</i> géo. np. de la rivière Puṣpabhadrā «Ornée de fleurs».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spacaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpacāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-caapa" class="skt-link">cāpa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spacaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. arc de fleurs, un attribut de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> «à l'arc fleuri».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spadanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpadanta</i> [<a href="#entry-danta" class="skt-link">danta</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spadanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Puṣpadanta «Fleur d'ivoire», 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est blanc, son symbole est un <a href="#entry-makara" class="skt-link">makara</a> ou un crabe; on l'appelle aussi <a href="#entry-Usuvidhinaatha" class="skt-link">Suvidhinātha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste Puṣpadanta_1, <a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a> du Nord-Ouest.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spadruma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpadruma</i> [<a href="#entry-druma" class="skt-link">druma</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spadruma" class="skt-link">m.</a> arbre en fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spadrumakusumitamuku_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpadrumakusumitamukuṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-kusumita" class="skt-link">kusumita</a>-<a href="#entry-muku_ta" class="skt-link">mukuṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spadrumakusumitamuku_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> Puṣpadrumakusumitamukuṭa «Couronné de fleurs comme un arbre en fleurs».<br> <a href="#entry-pu_spadruma" class="skt-link">puṣpadruma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spagiri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpagiri</i> [<a href="#entry-giri" class="skt-link">giri</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spagiri" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de l'université bd. de Puṣpagiri «Colline des fleurs», à 100 km à l'Est de <a href="#entry-Ubhubanezvar" class="skt-link">Bhubaneśvar</a>, mod. Orissa; elle s'étendait sur les sites de <a href="#entry-Uratnagiri" class="skt-link">Ratnagiri</a>, <a href="#entry-Ulalitagiri" class="skt-link">Lalitagiri</a> et <a href="#entry-Uudayagiri_1" class="skt-link">Udayagiri_1</a>; elle prospéra jusqu'au 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spaguccha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpaguccha</i> [<a href="#entry-guccha" class="skt-link">guccha</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spaguccha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bouquet de fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>puṣpakavimāna</i>] myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Puṣpaka «Fleuri», char aérien de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>, construit par <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a>; c'est un palais merveilleux fait d'or et de joyaux, il se déplaçait à la vitesse de la pensée, il changeait de forme à la volonté de ses occupants, et il pourvoyait à tous leurs désirs; on n'y avait ni chaud ni froid, et ses arbres donnaient des fruits en toute saison; <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> le déroba pour à son frère <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> qu'il assomma; il s'en servit pour enlever <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>, et provoquer la guerre qui fut sa perte; <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> victorieux l'utilisa pour rentrer à <a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> avec <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a> — <a href="#entry-pu_spikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpikā</i> tartre; mucus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spakaku_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpakakuṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-ku_n_da" class="skt-link">kuṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spakaku_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spakaku_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> pot de fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spakara_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpakaraṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_n_da" class="skt-link">karaṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spakara_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> corbeille de fleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. jardin d'agrément près d'<a href="#entry-Uavantii" class="skt-link">Avantī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spakara_n_daka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpakaraṇḍaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spakara_n_daka" class="skt-link">n.</a> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. nom d'un ancien jardin royal dans la <a href="#entry-Um_rcchaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">Mṛcchakaṭikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spakara_n_dinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpakaraṇḍinī</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spakara_n_dinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Puṣpakaraṇḍinī, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uavantii" class="skt-link">Avantī</a> «la bien fleurie».<br> <a href="#entry-pu_spakara_n_da" class="skt-link">puṣpakaraṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spakavimaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpakavimāna</i> [<a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">vimāna_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spakavimaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. char fleuri de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Upu_spaka" class="skt-link">Puṣpaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_spaka" class="skt-link">puṣpaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spamaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spamaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> guirlande de fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spapurii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpapurī</i> [<a href="#entry-purii" class="skt-link">purī</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Puṣpapurī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a> «Ville des fleurs».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spavar_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpavarṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-var_sa" class="skt-link">varṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spavar_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> pluie de fleurs en hommage à un héros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_spavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpavatī</i> couvert de fleurs, décoré de fleurs, fleuri — ind. comme une fleur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spazaka_tikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpaśakaṭikā</i> [<a href="#entry-zaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">śakaṭikā</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spazaka_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> l'arrangement d'un chariot de fleurs, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्पिन्</span> <i>puṣpin</i> [<a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">puṣpa</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_spin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpiṇī</i> fleuri — <a href="#entry-pu_spi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpiṇī</i> (femme) ayant ses règles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्पित</span> <i>puṣpita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">puṣpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_spita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpitā</i> fleuri, en fleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spitaagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpitāgra</i> [<a href="#entry-agra" class="skt-link">agra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_spitaagra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spitaagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_spitaagraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpitāgrā</i> [«aux extrémités fleuries»] se dit d'arbres en fleurs — <a href="#entry-pu_spitaagraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṣpitāgrā</i> lit. mètre poétique de 2×12+2×13 syllabes.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_spita" class="skt-link">puṣpita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_spotka_taa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣpotkaṭā</i> [<a href="#entry-utka_taa" class="skt-link">utkaṭā</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_spotka_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Puṣpotkaṭā «Gigantesque fleur», épith. de la l <a href="#entry-raak_sasii" class="skt-link">rākṣasī</a> <a href="#entry-Ukezinii_2" class="skt-link">Keśinī_2</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ukumbhakar_na" class="skt-link">Kumbhakarṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_spa" class="skt-link">puṣpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुष्य</span> <i>puṣya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-pu_s_1" class="skt-link">puṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fleur, crème, meilleure partie de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Puṣya «le Meilleur», 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. au Cancer; <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a> y préside; son symbole est une flèche; cf. <a href="#entry-Uti_sya" class="skt-link">Tiṣya</a>, <a href="#entry-Usidhya" class="skt-link">Sidhya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_syamitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣyamitra</i> [<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_syamitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Puṣyamitra <a href="#entry-Uzufga_1" class="skt-link">Śuṅga_1</a>, général [<a href="#entry-senaapati" class="skt-link">senāpati</a>] du roi <a href="#entry-Ub_rhadratha" class="skt-link">Bṛhadratha</a>, dernier des <a href="#entry-mauryaas" class="skt-link">mauryās</a>, qu'il assassina; il devint alors roi du <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a>; il effectua un sacrifice du cheval [<a href="#entry-azvamedha" class="skt-link">aśvamedha</a>], et fonda ainsi la dynastie des <a href="#entry-zufgaas" class="skt-link">śuṅgās</a> qui régna sur un empire s'étendant sur toute la vallée du Gange; il régna de 185 à 151 ant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_syaraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṣyarāga</i> [<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_syaraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> topaze.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_sya" class="skt-link">puṣya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुट</span> <i>puṭa</i> <a href="#entry-pu_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> pli, creux; enveloppe, poche, sac, bourse; réceptacle; étui <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> paupière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enveloppe d'un bourgeon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> page (d'un livre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>pattrapuṭa</i>] récipient fait de feuilles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pu_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṭaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pli, creux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récipient — <a href="#entry-pu_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṭikā</i> récipient.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_ta" class="skt-link">puṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puccha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुच्छ</span> <i>puccha</i> <a href="#entry-puccha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-puccha" class="skt-link">n.</a> queue, derrière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pudgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुद्गल</span> <i>pudgala</i> a. <a href="#entry-pudgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pudgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pudgalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pudgalā</i> beau, joli, gracieux — <a href="#entry-pudgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> le corps <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. l'individu et son ego <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la personne esclave de ses désirs <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>puggala</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pufgava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃgava</i> var. <i>puṅgava</i> [<a href="#entry-go" class="skt-link">go</a>] <a href="#entry-pu_mgava" class="skt-link">m.</a> taureau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mâle, héros [«fort comme un taureau»] — ifc. meilleur parmi les, expert en, chef des.<br> <i>kavipuṃgava</i> m. expert en poésie.<br> <i>narapuṃgava</i> m. meilleur parmi les hommes.<br> <i>munipuṃgava</i> m. meilleur d'entre les sages.<br> <i>pakṣīpuṃgava</i> m. [«meilleur d'entre les oiseaux»] épith. de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a> ou de <a href="#entry-Uja_taayu" class="skt-link">Jaṭāyu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pufkha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुङ्ख</span> <i>puṅkha</i> <a href="#entry-pufkha" class="skt-link">m.</a> empennage d'une flèche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faucon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pufkhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुङ्खित</span> <i>puṅkhita</i> [<a href="#entry-pufkha" class="skt-link">puṅkha</a><a href="#entry--ita" class="skt-link">-ita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pufkhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pufkhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pufkhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṅkhitā</i> empenné (flèche).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pufkhitazara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṅkhitaśara</i> [<a href="#entry-zara" class="skt-link">śara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pufkhitazara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pufkhitazara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pufkhitazaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṅkhitaśarā</i> qui a une flèche empennée — <a href="#entry-pufkhitazara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a>-<a href="#entry-Umadana" class="skt-link">Madana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-pufkhita" class="skt-link">puṅkhita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुल</span> <i>pula</i> a. <a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulā</i> large, étendu — <a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">m.</a> horripilation, chair de poule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलह</span> <i>pulaha</i> <a href="#entry-pulaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du géniteur [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>] Pulaha, né de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलक</span> <i>pulaka</i> [<a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">pula</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-pulaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> grenat <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pulakās</i> horripilation (de plaisir) — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(pulakayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>pulakita</i><i>)</i> frémir de plaisir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulakezin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulakeśin</i> [<a href="#entry-kezin" class="skt-link">keśin</a>] <a href="#entry-pulakezin" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Pulakeśī_1 ou Pulikeśī_1 de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> (6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il établit sa capitale à <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> (mod. Badāmi) en 550 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Pulakeśī_2 ou Pulikeśī_2, son petit-fils, qui étendit l'empire <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> au Sud, au détriment des <a href="#entry-Upallavaas" class="skt-link">Pallavās</a>, et à l'Est; lors d'une bataille sur les rives de la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a> il mit en déroute les troupes du roi <a href="#entry-Uhar_sa" class="skt-link">Harṣa</a> avec ses éléphants, et devint empereur d'une grande partie du Deccan, de la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a> à la <a href="#entry-Ukaaverii" class="skt-link">Kāverī</a>; son règne finit en 642, avec la capture de <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> par les <a href="#entry-Upallavaas" class="skt-link">Pallavās</a>; son fils aîné était <a href="#entry-Ucandraaditya" class="skt-link">Candrāditya</a>, dont l'épouse <a href="#entry-Uvijayabha_t_taarikaa" class="skt-link">Vijayabhaṭṭārikā</a> assura la régence de l'empire jusqu'à l'avènement de son 3 ème fils <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_1" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_1</a> qui restaura l'empire; son étendard portait <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a>; il fut le premier à émettre des monnaies d'or en Inde du Sud.<br> <a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">pula</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulakita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलकित</span> <i>pulakita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-pulaka" class="skt-link">pulaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pulakita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pulakita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pulakitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulakitā</i> frémissant de plaisir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulastya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलस्त्य</span> <i>pulastya</i> <a href="#entry-pulastya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Pulastya, géniteur [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>] né de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] c'est l'un des sept sages [<a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>]; [<a href="#entry-Uraamopaakhyaana" class="skt-link">Rāmopākhyāna</a>] il est père de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> par <a href="#entry-Ugo" class="skt-link">Go</a>-<a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>; mais, fâché que celui-ci honore son grand-père, il se recréa [<a href="#entry-dvija" class="skt-link">dvija</a>] sous la forme de <a href="#entry-Uvizravaa" class="skt-link">Viśravā</a>, enfanté de <a href="#entry-Umaaninii" class="skt-link">Māninī</a> pour lui servir d'écran et que <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> soit <a href="#entry-Uvaizrava_na" class="skt-link">Vaiśravaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulikezin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलिकेशिन्</span> <i>pulikeśin</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pulakezin" class="skt-link">pulakeśin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलिन</span> <i>pulina</i> <a href="#entry-pulina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pulina" class="skt-link">n.</a> banc de sable; îlot au milieu d'une rivière; petite île; plage de sable; berge d'une rivière — <a href="#entry-pulinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulinā</i> ifc. rive de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulinavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulinavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pulinavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pulinavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pulinavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulinavatī</i> sablonneux.<br> <a href="#entry-pulina" class="skt-link">pulina</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulinda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलिन्द</span> <i>pulinda</i> <a href="#entry-pulinda" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme d'une tribu barbare du <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>pulindās</i> cette tribu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulkasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुल्कस</span> <i>pulkasa</i> <a href="#entry-pulkasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pulkasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulkasī</i> soc. tribu mélangée impure; cf. <a href="#entry-paulkasa" class="skt-link">paulkasa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puloma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलोम</span> <i>puloma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-puloman" class="skt-link">puloman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulomajaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulomajā</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-pulomajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Pulomajā, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindraa_nii" class="skt-link">Indrāṇī</a>-<a href="#entry-Uzacii" class="skt-link">Śacī</a> fille de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulomajit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulomajit</i> [<a href="#entry-jit" class="skt-link">jit</a>] <a href="#entry-pulomajit" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pulomajit, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> vainqueur de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a>; il tua son beau-père pour éviter sa malédiction suite au viol de sa fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puloman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलोमन्</span> <i>puloman</i> <a href="#entry-puloman" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Pulomā_1, un <a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a>; enamouré de la belle <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_2" class="skt-link">Pulomā_2</a>, il s'introduisit sous la forme d'un sanglier dans l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> pour l'enlever, provoquant la naissance de <a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a> qui le foudroya de son éclat; <a href="#entry-Uzacii" class="skt-link">Śacī</a> <a href="#entry-devii" class="skt-link">devī</a> était sa fille, <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> l'enleva et tua <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a> — <a href="#entry-pulomaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulomā</i> myth. np. de la belle Pulomā_2 ou Pulomī, fille d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvaizvaanara" class="skt-link">Vaiśvānara</a>; le démon [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a> la convoitait; elle fut mariée à <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a>, mais les rites prescrits ne furent pas accomplis; <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a> l'ayant appris d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, il enleva <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_2" class="skt-link">Pulomā_2</a> qui était en fin de grossesse; l'embryon tomba sur le sol [<a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a>], et son éclat était tel qu'il réduisit <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a> en cendres; les pleurs de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_2" class="skt-link">Pulomā_2</a> devinrent la rivière <a href="#entry-Uvadhuusaraa" class="skt-link">Vadhūsarā</a>; <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> condamna alors <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> à manger tout et n'importe quoi [<a href="#entry-sarvabhak_saka" class="skt-link">sarvabhakṣaka</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asurii" class="skt-link">asurī</a> Pulomā_3; avec sa sœur Kalakā elles firent des pénitences pour plaire à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, qui leur promit que leurs fils seraient immortels; ceux-ci [<a href="#entry-paulomaas" class="skt-link">paulomās</a>] habitent une cité d'or indestructible dans les airs — <a href="#entry-pulomii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>pulomī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pulomaa" class="skt-link">pulomā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pulomani_suudana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulomaniṣūdana</i> [<a href="#entry-ni_suudana" class="skt-link">niṣūdana</a>] <a href="#entry-pulomani_suudana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Pulomaniṣūdana, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> tueur de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_1" class="skt-link">Pulomā_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-puloma" class="skt-link">puloma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pul_">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुलँ</span> <i>pulṁ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-pu_m" class="skt-link">puṃ</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pul_lifga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pulṁliṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-pul__lifga" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. genre masculin.<br> <a href="#entry-pul_" class="skt-link">pulṁ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pum">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुम्</span> <i>pum</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pumaa_ms">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुमांस्</span> <i>pumāṃs</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pumaan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुमान्</span> <i>pumān</i> cf. <a href="#entry-pu_ms" class="skt-link">puṃs</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pumbhuuman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>pumbhūman</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuuman" class="skt-link">bhūman</a>] <a href="#entry-pumbhuuman" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. mot masculin utilisé au pluriel (comme <a href="#entry-daaraas" class="skt-link">dārās</a>).<br> <i>pumbhūmni</i> adv. gram. au masculin pluriel.<br> <a href="#entry-pum" class="skt-link">pum</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puna_h">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुनः</span> <i>punaḥ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-punar" class="skt-link">punar</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puna_hsuuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punaḥsūti</i> [<a href="#entry-suuti" class="skt-link">sūti</a>] <a href="#entry-puna_hsuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> nouvelle production.<br> <a href="#entry-puna_h" class="skt-link">punaḥ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुनर्</span> <i>punar</i> adv. de nouveau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en retour; en réponse, en revanche — conj. pourtant, mais; néanmoins.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>api</i> adv. de nouveau, mais encore.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>eva</i> adv. une fois de plus.<br> <i>punaḥ</i> <i>punar</i> adv. sans cesse.<br> <i>atha</i> <i>punar</i> adv. mais.<br> <i>kim</i> <i>punar</i> adv. à plus forte raison.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>i</i> rentrer, retourner; s'en aller.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>gam</i> id.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>dā</i> rendre.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>as</i> retomber sur.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>bhū</i> tourner en rond.<br> <i>pare</i> <i>ihi</i> <i>nāri</i> <i>punar</i> <i>ehi</i> <i>kṣipram</i> [AV.] Va-en, femme; mais reviens vite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarbhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarbhava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhava" class="skt-link">bhava</a>] a. <a href="#entry-punarbhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-punarbhava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-punarbhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>punarbhavā</i> né de nouveau — <a href="#entry-punarbhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> renaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarbhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarbhū</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_2" class="skt-link">bhū_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-punarbhuu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-punarbhuu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-punarbhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> régénéré; revenu à la vie ou à la jeunesse — <a href="#entry-punarbhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. jeune veuve remariée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punardarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punardarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] <a href="#entry-punardarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de revoir — dat. <i>punardarśanāya</i> adr. au revoir.<br> <i>apunardarśanāya</i> ind. adr. adieu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarjanman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarjanman</i> [<a href="#entry-janman" class="skt-link">janman</a>] <a href="#entry-punarjanman" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. renaissance, nouvelle naissance, réincarnation.<br> <i>mām</i> <i>upetya</i> <i>tu</i> <i>punarjanma</i> <i>na</i> <i>vidyate</i> [BhG.] Lorsque l'on m'a rejoint il n'y a plus de renaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarnava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarnava</i> [<a href="#entry-nava_1" class="skt-link">nava_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-punarnava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-punarnava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-punarnavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>punarnavā</i> renouvelé; rajeuni; rafraîchi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarnavataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarnavatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-punarnavataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> rajeunissement, renouveau.<br> <i>kleśaḥ</i> <i>phalena</i> <i>hi</i> <i>punarnavatāṃ</i> <i>vidhatte</i> [<a href="#entry-Ukumaarasambhava" class="skt-link">Kumārasambhava</a>] Par son fruit, oui vraiment le dur labeur apporte le réconfort.<br> <a href="#entry-punarnava" class="skt-link">punarnava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarukta</i> [<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-punarukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-punarukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-punaruktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>punaruktā</i> redit, répété; superflu, inutile — <a href="#entry-punarukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> répétition, tautologie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punarvasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>punarvasu</i> [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] <a href="#entry-punarvasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. <i>punarvasū</i> astr. np. des deux Punarvasū «Qui rétablissent la richesse», 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. aux Gémeaux Castor et Pollux; <a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a> y préside; son symbole est une maison; cf. <a href="#entry-Uyamakau" class="skt-link">Yamakau</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-punar" class="skt-link">punar</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-punnaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puṃnāman</i> [<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-pu_mnaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_mnaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-pu_mnaamnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>puṃnāmnī</i> qui a un nom masculin.<br> <a href="#entry-pu_m" class="skt-link">puṃ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-pur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुर्</span> <i>pur</i> [<a href="#entry-p_rr" class="skt-link">pṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-pur" class="skt-link">f.</a> rempart, (mur de) fortification; citadelle, ville fortifiée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cité, ville — <a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>pura</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gynécée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> maison, résidence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Pura = <a href="#entry-Utripura" class="skt-link">Tripura</a>, la «Ville aux trois forteresses» des démons [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] — <a href="#entry-purii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>purī</i> forteresse; cité, ville <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville sainte de Purī, capitale du <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> (mod. Sud Orissa), siège du culte de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. πολις; fr. police, politique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुरा</span> <i>purā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-puras" class="skt-link">puras</a>] adv. avant, auparavant; autrefois, jadis, naguère (donne au présent le sens prétérit) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> au commencement, d'abord; tôt, bientôt (donne au présent le sens futur) — prép. avant, à l'exception de ⟨abl.⟩.<br> <i>na</i> <i>purā</i> adv. jamais.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुराण</span> <i>purāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa" class="skt-link">purā</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-puraa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>purāṇī</i> vieux, ancien, antique; fané — <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> antiquité; vieille légende, histoire ancienne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. «récit d'antan», recueil mythologique et religieux; ils traitent traditionnellement de cinq sujets [<a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">pañcalakṣaṇa</a>]: <a href="#entry-sarga" class="skt-link">sarga</a> la création de l'Univers, <a href="#entry-pratisarga" class="skt-link">pratisarga</a> les créations secondaires, <a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a> la généalogie des dieux et des sages, <a href="#entry-manvantara" class="skt-link">manvantara</a> la création de la race humaine et des premiers hommes, et <a href="#entry-va_mzaanucarita" class="skt-link">vaṃśānucarita</a> les histoires dynastiques; cf. <a href="#entry-mahaapuraa_na" class="skt-link">mahāpurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-upapuraa_na" class="skt-link">upapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-sthalapuraa_na" class="skt-link">sthalapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-kulapuraa_na" class="skt-link">kulapurāṇa</a>; la plupart furent composés entre 400 et 1200.<br> <i>sargaś</i> <i>ca</i> <i>pratisargaś</i> <i>ca</i> <i>vaṃśo</i> <i>manvantarāṇi</i> <i>ca</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>vaṃśānucaritaṃ</i> <i>caiva</i> <i>purāṇaṃ</i> <i>pañcalakṣaṇam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Les cinq sujets d'un <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a> sont ...
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puraakalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>purākalpa</i> [<a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>] <a href="#entry-puraakalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> ére ancienne.<br> <i>purākalpe</i> var. <i>purākalpeṣu</i> autrefois; il était une fois.<br> <a href="#entry-puraa" class="skt-link">purā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">पुरम्</span> <i>puram</i> [acc. <a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-puramathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puramathana</i> [<a href="#entry-mathana" class="skt-link">mathana</a>] <a href="#entry-puramathana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Puramathana, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «Destructeur de <a href="#entry-Utripura" class="skt-link">Tripura</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-pur" class="skt-link">pur</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-purandara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>puraṃdara</i> var. <i>purandara</i> [<a href="#entry-dara" class="skt-link">dara</a>] <a href="#entry-pura_mdara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Purandara «Destructeur de remparts», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; aussi abrégé en Puranda.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-purandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
